papers.title: Your Mouse and Eyes Secretly Leak Your Preference: LLM Alignment using Implicit Feedback from Users
papers.abstract_en: To align a Large Language Model (LLM), most existing methods collect explicit human feedback and train a reward model to predict the human preference based on the response text. These existing methods have two key limitations. First, the users rarely provide explicit feedback for LLM responses, which makes the high-quality preference annotation expensive to collect. Second, the methods do not leverage implicit human feedback, which has proven vital to the economic moats of Internet giants. To quantify the value of implicit feedback, we build a new dataset called IFLLM, which collects 1336 multi-turn questions from the 59 Mechanical Turk workers, their mouse trajectories, and eye gazing points to the LLMs' responses from their webcams. IFLLM shows that the users have very diverse types of gazing behavior and mouse trajectories. Our reward model based on the implicit user feedback boosts the accuracy of the text-based reward model from 55% to 64% and nearly triples the relative response quality improvements after applying the DPO to eight LLMs, demonstrating the value of implicit feedback in the wild. Our data collection website, dataset, and codes can be found at https://github.com/themehulpatwari/llm-implicit-feedback/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用用户在与大语言模型交互时产生的隐式反馈（鼠标轨迹和眼动数据）来改进模型对齐。作者构建了 IFLLM 数据集，包含 59 名工人的 1336 个多轮问题及其鼠标和眼动记录。基于隐式反馈的奖励模型将文本奖励模型的准确率从 55% 提升至 64%，并对 8 个 LLM 应用 DPO 后，响应质量相对提升近三倍，证明隐式反馈在实际场景中的价值。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 对齐方法依赖昂贵的显式人工反馈，而用户很少提供显式评价，忽略了互联网公司常用的隐式反馈（如鼠标轨迹和眼动）这一重要信号。
Method: 构建 IFLLM 数据集，收集用户阅读 LLM 响应时的鼠标轨迹和眼动数据，并训练一个基于隐式反馈的奖励模型来预测人类偏好。
Result: 隐式反馈奖励模型将文本奖励模型的准确率从 55% 提高到 64%；在 8 个 LLM 上应用 DPO 后，响应质量相对提升近三倍。
Conclusion: 隐式反馈能有效提升 LLM 对齐的效果，且数据收集成本较低；相关数据集和代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leveraging tails for adaptation
papers.abstract_en: We consider contraction of Bayesian posterior distributions in nonparametric settings where coefficients of a function over a basis or dictionary are given priors with $p$--exponential tails, including Laplace tails $(p=1)$ and heavier tails $(p<1)$. It is shown that contraction rates improve as $p$ decreases and that full adaptation to smoothness, up to logarithmic factors, is obtained in an appropriate $p\to 0$ regime. As applications, we consider both series priors in white noise regression and shallow ReLU neural networks in random design regression. In particular, we show that overparametrised shallow ReLU networks can adapt to any regularity $0\le β\le 2$. Through a simulation study, we show strong empirical agreement with the behavior predicted by our theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在非参数贝叶斯设置中，给函数在基或字典上的系数赋予 p-指数尾先验（包括拉普拉斯尾 p=1 和更重尾 p<1）时的后验收缩率。理论表明收缩率随 p 减小而提高，并在 p→0 时实现完全自适应（直至对数因子）。应用涵盖白噪声回归的级数先验和浅层 ReLU 神经网络，证明过参数化网络能适应任意正则性 0≤β≤2。仿真实验与理论预测高度一致。
Motivation: 非参数贝叶斯中先验的尾部形状对后验收缩率有重要影响，但 p-指数尾先验的收缩特性及其自适应能力尚未充分刻画。
Method: 对函数在基或字典上的系数施加 p-指数尾先验，推导后验收缩率，并考察 p→0 极限下的适应性；具体应用于白噪声回归的级数先验和随机设计回归的浅层 ReLU 网络。
Result: 收缩率随 p 减小而单调改善，在 p→0 时达到完全自适应（仅差对数因子）；浅层 ReLU 网络可适应任意 0≤β≤2 的正则性。仿真验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 通过选择合适的尾部指数，p-指数尾先验可实现非参数贝叶斯的自适应收缩，理论结果在多种模型中成立且被仿真支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Training of Spatially Grounded 2D Vision-Language Models for Radiology
papers.abstract_en: We study how to train visually grounded vision-language models (VLMs) for radiology without manual spatial annotations. We introduce RefRad2D, a large-scale bilingual (German/English) dataset of 1.2M CT and MR image-text pairs derived from clinical practice, with task-specific VQA and spatial grounding subsets generated automatically via LLM-based curation and automated segmentation. Trained on this data, our model RadGrounder jointly performs report generation, visual question answering, and spatial grounding via bounding-box detection or segmentation. On external VQA benchmarks (Slake, VQA-RAD), RadGrounder achieves competitive results with specialized medical VLMs. Adding our clinical data to the training mixture improves open-ended VQA over fine-tuning on the downstream datasets alone, showing the transferability of our dataset. Crucially, adding grounding supervision does not degrade language quality, enabling spatially verifiable outputs at no cost to VQA performance.
papers.comment: Accepted for MICCAI 2026. First two authors: equal contribution. Last two authors: equal supervision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何在没有人工空间标注的情况下训练放射学领域的视觉语言模型（VLM）。作者构建了RefRad2D大规模双语（德/英）数据集，包含120万对CT和MR图像-文本对，通过LLM自动生成任务特定VQA和空间基础子集。模型RadGrounder联合进行报告生成、视觉问答和空间定位（边界框或分割）。在外部VQA基准（Slake, VQA-RAD）上取得竞争性结果；添加临床数据改善了开放VQA性能，且空间监督不降低语言质量。
Motivation: 放射学VLM需要空间基础能力，但缺乏大规模带人工空间标注的医学图像-文本对，限制了模型的训练和可解释性。
Method: 提出RefRad2D数据集和RadGrounder模型。数据集通过LLM和自动分割从临床实践中自动生成VQA和空间基础子集；模型联合训练报告生成、VQA和空间定位任务。
Result: 在Slake和VQA-RAD上取得与专用医学VLM相当的结果；添加RefRad2D数据训练提升了开放VQA性能；引入空间基础监督不损害语言质量。
Conclusion: 证明了可以在无手工空间标注的情况下训练具备空间基础能力的放射学VLM，且空间监督与语言性能兼容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Marginal Advantage Accumulation for Memory-Driven Agent Self-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: In batch-style trace distillation, the same memory operation may receive contradictory feedback across different batches. Existing methods lack a cross-batch, operation-level evidence accumulation mechanism, making it impossible to distinguish stably effective operations from accidental hits. This paper formalizes the requirement as two structural conditions, alignability and comparability, and proposes Marginal Advantage Accumulation (MAA). MAA constructs differential signals to make them comparable across batches, accumulates signed evidence per operation via EMA, and ensures cross-batch traceability through semantic identity merging. As a post-processing architecture, MAA achieves the best results in 14 out of 16 settings across 4 benchmarks and 4 target models, consistently outperforming existing batch-level distillation baselines and matching or surpassing online alternatives in most settings, while reducing optimization-phase token consumption by approximately 75%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对批式轨迹蒸馏中同一内存操作在不同批次获得矛盾反馈的问题，提出边界优势积累（Marginal Advantage Accumulation, MAA）方法。MAA构建差分信号使其跨批次可比，通过EMA积累每操作的符号证据，并通过语义身份合并确保跨批次可追溯性。作为后处理架构，MAA在4个基准和4个目标模型的16个设置中取得14个最佳结果，一致优于现有批次级蒸馏基线，并在大多数设置中匹配或超越在线替代方案，同时将优化阶段令牌消耗减少约75%。
Motivation: 当前批式轨迹蒸馏方法缺乏跨批次、操作级别的证据积累机制，无法区分稳定有效操作与偶然成功。论文将此需求形式化为两个结构条件：可对齐性和可比性。
Method: 提出边界优势积累（MAA），包括构建差分信号使其跨批次可比、通过指数移动平均（EMA）积累每操作的有符号证据、以及通过语义身份合并确保跨批次可追溯性。MAA作为后处理架构。
Result: 在4个基准和4个目标模型的16个设置中，MAA取得14个最佳结果，一致优于现有批次级蒸馏基线，在大多数设置中匹配或超越在线替代方案，同时将优化阶段令牌消耗减少约75%。
Conclusion: MAA作为后处理架构有效解决了批式蒸馏中的矛盾反馈问题，显著提升性能并降低计算成本。摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: UltraQuant: 4-bit KV Caching for Context-Heavy Agents
papers.abstract_en: Context-heavy agents place unusual pressure on the key-value (KV) cache: long prefixes are reused across many short turns, while concurrency determines whether the serving system can keep GPUs utilized. We study 4-bit KV-cache compression for this setting, using TurboQuant-style rotation and codebook quantization as a quality anchor and vLLM FP8 KV caching as the deployment anchor. We report three contributions. First, we frame 4-bit KV caching around multi-round agent workloads where task quality, cache residency, and serving throughput must be measured jointly. Second, we describe the practical design choices needed to make the 4-bit path robust, including asymmetric K/V treatment, Walsh-Hadamard rotation, QJL removal, and block-scale variants. Third, we present serving optimizations on AMD GPUs, including optimized decode-attention kernels and UltraQuant, an FP4 approximation path that uses FP8 queries, FP4 KV tensors, UE8M0 group scales, and native scaled-MFMA support on CDNA4. On a long-context, multi-turn agentic workload, UltraQuant cuts P50 time-to-first-token by 3.47x in the cache-pressured late rounds (2.3x across all rounds) and raises output throughput by 1.63x over the FP8 KV baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究上下文密集型代理场景下的4位KV缓存压缩，提出UltraQuant方法，结合TurboQuant风格旋转量化与vLLM FP8缓存部署。在长上下文多轮代理工作负载上，UltraQuant将P50首令牌延迟降低3.47倍（后期轮次），输出吞吐量提升1.63倍。
Motivation: 上下文密集型代理的长前缀跨多轮重用与高并发需求，给KV缓存带来巨大压力，现有8位FP8 KV缓存性能不足。
Method: 采用TurboQuant风格的旋转和码本量化作为质量锚点，vLLM FP8 KV缓存作为部署锚点。实际设计包括非对称K/V处理、Walsh-Hadamard旋转、移除QJL、块尺度变体，以及AMD GPU上的优化解码注意力核和UltraQuant（FP4近似路径）。
Result: 在长上下文多轮代理工作负载上，UltraQuant在缓存压力大的后期轮次中P50首令牌延迟降低3.47倍（所有轮次平均2.3倍），输出吞吐量比FP8 KV基线提高1.63倍。
Conclusion: 强调联合评估任务质量、缓存驻留和服务吞吐量的必要性，并总结了使4位KV缓存鲁棒的实用设计选择。

papers.title: Analyzing Defensive Misdirection Against Model-Guided Automated Attacks on Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on language-model components to interpret instructions, process external data, invoke tools, and coordinate with other agents. These capabilities make prompt-injection and jailbreak attacks more consequential, especially as attackers adopt model-guided automation to scale probing, prompt refinement, and response evaluation. This work analyzes the resulting attack-defense setting through a probabilistic model of a target system, its defense mechanism, and the attacker's automated judge. Our analysis shows that conventional detect-and-block defenses can allow attacker success rate (ASR) to approach one as the query budget grows, since predictable refusals provide useful feedback to automated search. We then examine detect-and-misdirect, where detected malicious interactions receive controlled, non-operational responses designed to induce false-positive errors in the attacker's judge. This strategy reduces the positive predictive value of attacker-selected candidates and yields a bounded asymptotic ASR. We evaluate a proof-of-concept realization of this strategy through Contextual Misdirection via Progressive Engagement (CMPE), a lightweight conversational misdirection method designed to replace predictable refusal text with safe but strategically misleading responses in automated jailbreak settings. On jailbreak benchmarks, CMPE reduces estimated ASR upper bounds by up to two orders of magnitude and nearly eliminates verified attack success in end-to-end PAIR and GPTFuzz attack runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了基于模型引导的自动化攻击对智能AI系统的威胁，并提出了检测-误导（detect-and-misdirect）防御策略。通过概率模型证明，传统的检测-拦截防御在查询预算充足时攻击成功率趋近于1，而检测-误导策略通过向攻击者裁判注入假阳性错误，使攻击成功率有界。作者实现了上下文误导渐进式参与（CMPE）方法，在jailbreak基准上将攻击成功率上限降低两个数量级，并在PAIR和GPTFuzz攻击中几乎消除成功攻击。
Motivation: 现有的检测-拦截防御在面对模型引导的自动化攻击时，其可预测的拒绝行为会被攻击者利用来优化攻击，导致攻击成功率随查询预算增加而趋近于1。
Method: 提出检测-误导防御框架，对检测到的恶意交互生成受控的非操作响应，以诱导攻击者裁判产生假阳性错误。具体实现为CMPE（Contextual Misdirection via Progressive Engagement），一种轻量级对话误导方法，用安全但策略性误导的回复替代标准拒绝文本。
Result: 在jailbreak基准上，CMPE将估计的攻击成功率上限降低两个数量级，并在端到端PAIR和GPTFuzz攻击中几乎消除验证成功的攻击。
Conclusion: 检测-误导策略可有效对抗模型引导的自动化攻击，使攻击成功率有界，为防御提供新方向。

papers.title: Fisher-Geometric Sharpness and the Implicit Bias of SGD toward Flat Minima
papers.abstract_en: A widely held intuition in deep learning is that stochastic gradient descent (SGD) implicitly favors flat minima and that flat minima generalize better, but standard Euclidean measures of flatness such as the trace or maximum eigenvalue of the loss Hessian are not invariant under reparametrizations that preserve the network function, which undermines the theoretical foundations of this narrative. In this study we resolve this issue by grounding flatness in the Riemannian geometry of the statistical manifold induced by the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM). We define Riemannian sharpness mathematically and prove that it is invariant under smooth, function-preserving reparametrizations, which directly addresses the critique of Dinh et al. in the paper ``Sharp minima can generalize for deep nets''.We note that this invariance is a property of the true FIM; the diagonal empirical estimator used in practice (and in all experiments below) inherits invariance only approximately, and exact invariance under arbitrary reparametrizations would require structured estimators such as K-FAC. We formalize the gradient noise of mini-batch SGD as having a covariance structure proportional to the FIM, derive the stationary distribution of the resulting stochastic differential equation, and then show that the probability mass is exponentially concentrated at Riemannian-flat minima. A PAC-Bayes generalization bound controlled explicitly by SR formally links this geometric bias to test performance. Our experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 confirm that SR reliably tracks generalization in ways that Euclidean sharpness does not, and that its scaling with $η/B$ matches the theoretical predictions. Together these results provide a rigorous, reparametrization-invariant account of why flat minima generalize.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于Fisher信息矩阵的Riemannian sharpness度量，证明其对保持网络函数的重新参数化具有不变性，并形式化了SGD对平坦最小值的隐式偏好。通过PAC-Bayes泛化界将几何偏置与测试性能联系起来，在MNIST和CIFAR-10上实验验证该度量能可靠跟踪泛化。
Motivation: 传统欧氏平坦性度量（如Hessian的迹或最大特征值）在保持网络函数的重新参数化下不是不变的，这质疑了“SGD偏好平坦最小值且平坦最小值泛化更好”的理论基础。本文旨在解决这一不变性问题。
Method: 利用Fisher信息矩阵诱导的统计流形的Riemannian几何，定义Riemannian sharpness并证明其对于光滑、保函数重参数化的不变性。将小批量SGD的梯度噪声形式化为与FIM成比例的协方差结构，推导随机微分方程的平稳分布，证明概率质量指数集中在Riemannian平坦最小值处。
Result: 实验在MNIST和CIFAR-10上表明，SR在跟踪泛化方面比欧氏sharpness更可靠，且其随η/B的缩放与理论预测一致。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个严格的、重参数化不变的解释，说明为何平坦最小值泛化更好。但注意，对角线经验估计器（实验中使用的）仅近似继承不变性，精确不变性需要结构化估计器如K-FAC。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic Symbolic Search: Characterizing PDEs Beyond Hand-crafted Expressions, Meshes, and Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Mathematicians understand a PDE solution through mathematical structures rather than tables of computed values. Historically, this has been the product of mathematical analysis, carried out by hand for each problem individually. Neither numerical simulation nor neural networks produce those structures directly. We propose Agentic Symbolic Search (ASYS), a prior-guided framework in which an agent translates PDE theory, public problem constraints, and accumulated search experience into testable differentiable symbolic programs. The mathematical forms are refined under evolutionary search, while their continuous parameters are fit by gradient-based optimization. This makes the search an automated form of inductive-bias injection rather than blind symbolic regression. For problems with known analytical forms, ASYS recovers these forms naturally; for other problems, ASYS constructs analytical approximations which can guide mathematicians toward further analysis. In our experiments, across five problems spanning bounded dynamics, finite-time blow-up, and free-boundary focusing, ASYS produces interpretable representations, including a geometric interface formula for Allen-Cahn 2D dynamics and a nine-parameter contraction law for Keller-Segel chemotactic blow-up, in settings where no closed-form description was previously available. ASYS shows the possibility of a new paradigm for characterizing PDE solutions, beyond handcrafted analytical solutions, mesh-based numerical solutions, and neural network approximations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出代理符号搜索（ASYS）框架，用于自动发现偏微分方程的解的解析形式或近似解析表达式。ASYS结合演化搜索和梯度优化，在五个不同问题（包括有界动力学、有限时间爆破和自由边界聚焦）上生成了可解释的表示，例如Allen-Cahn 2D动力学的几何界面公式和Keller-Segel趋化爆破的九参数收缩律。该方法超越了手工解析解、基于网格的数值解和神经网络近似，展示了表征PDE解的新范式。
Motivation: 传统上，理解PDE解需要手工数学分析，而数值模拟和神经网络无法直接产生数学结构。ASYS旨在自动化这一过程，通过注入归纳偏置来搜索可测试的符号程序，而不是进行盲目的符号回归。
Method: ASYS是一个先验引导的框架，代理（agent）将PDE理论、问题约束和累积搜索经验转化为可微分的符号程序。数学形式通过演化搜索精炼，连续参数通过基于梯度的优化拟合，从而将搜索转化为自动化的归纳偏置注入。
Result: 在五个问题（包括有界动力学、有限时间爆破和自由边界聚焦）上，ASYS在先前没有封闭形式描述的场景中生成了可解释的表示，例如Allen-Cahn 2D动力学的几何界面公式和Keller-Segel趋化爆破的九参数收缩律。对于已知解析形式的问题，ASYS自然恢复了这些形式。
Conclusion: ASYS展示了超越手工解析解、网格数值解和神经网络近似的PDE解表征新范式的可能性，其生成的解析近似可以指导数学家进行进一步分析。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Data Bias Mitigation under Coverage Constraints & The Price of Fairness
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models have been shown to exhibit discriminatory outcomes or degraded performance for individuals at the intersection of multiple sensitive attributes, such as race and gender. This stems in part from two interrelated challenges: the lack of principled measures for quantifying bias (potentially intersectional), and insufficient representation of intersectional subgroups in training data. We extend a recent bias mitigation framework to incorporate coverage constraints that enforce sufficient representation across groups, including intersectional subgroups. Since achieving exactly zero bias for all groups may not be data efficient (meaning it may require large amounts of data), our solution trades small approximation errors in bias for greater data efficiency while satisfying coverage constraints. We also formulate bias mitigation as an integer linear program that optimizes over all mitigation strategies, and characterize the price of fairness, the minimum data modification cost, as a function of fairness tolerance. This is essential both for legal compliance, where regulations may mandate specific fairness thresholds, and for data governance, enabling practitioners to make informed trade-offs between bias reduction and data modification (particularly, data purchasing) costs. We evaluate our techniques on publicly available datasets, demonstrating that bias mitigation via our framework preserves predictive accuracy across multiple classifiers, and that coverage constraints, while motivated by statistical considerations, are essential for preserving downstream ML performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了现有偏差缓解框架，引入覆盖约束（coverage constraints）以确保跨群体（包括交叉子群）的充分代表性。通过将偏差缓解形式化为整数线性规划，在满足覆盖约束的同时，用可容忍的小偏差换取数据效率，并刻画公平代价与数据修改成本的关系。实验表明该方法在保持预测精度的同时有效减少偏差。
Motivation: 机器学习模型在多个敏感属性（如种族和性别）的交叉点上常表现出歧视性结果或性能下降，根源在于缺乏量化偏差（尤其是交叉性偏差）的原则性方法，以及训练数据中交叉子群的代表性不足。
Method: 提出一个扩展的偏差缓解框架，引入覆盖约束以强制各群体（包括交叉子群）的充分代表性；将偏差缓解形式化为整数线性规划，优化所有缓解策略，并推导公平代价（最小数据修改成本）与公平容忍度的函数关系。
Result: 在公开数据集上，该方法在多个分类器上保持预测精度的同时有效减少偏差，且覆盖约束对于保持下游ML性能至关重要。
Conclusion: 覆盖约束虽源于统计考量，但对保持下游ML性能必不可少；该方法可帮助从业者在偏差减少与数据修改（如数据购买）成本之间做出知情权衡，并满足法规要求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Context-Aware Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling of IVF Laboratory Environmental Conditions
papers.abstract_en: IVF pregnancy rates are routinely modeled using patient-level variables, while high-resolution laboratory environmental data remain underutilized. We show that this is a missed opportunity. Rather than relying on raw sensor averages, we engineer 55 context-aware temporal features, including rolling thermal stability, simultaneous temperature-humidity adherence, peak stress duration, and post-stress recovery speed, that capture the dynamics of incubator microenvironments. On 61 weeks of data from an Asian IVF clinic, these features reduce cross-validated prediction error to 1.27%, compared to 3-5% for raw averages. We then train a hierarchical Bayesian Beta regression model that shares environmental effects across an Asian and a Northern European clinic via partial pooling, while preserving site-specific baselines. On held-out data from the Northern European clinic, the model achieves R2 = 0.86 and a 64% error reduction for the 35-39 age group over a naive baseline, demonstrating that structured environmental monitoring contains clinically meaningful, transferable signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用高分辨率实验室环境数据，从孵化器微环境中提取55个上下文感知的时间特征，训练层次贝叶斯Beta回归模型，在亚洲和北欧两个IVF诊所数据上实现跨诊所共享环境效应，将预测误差从3-5%降至1.27%，并在北欧诊所35-39岁年龄组上获得R²=0.86和64%的误差降低，证明结构化环境监测包含临床有意义的可迁移信号。
Motivation: 当前IVF妊娠率模型主要使用患者级变量，而高分辨率实验室环境数据未被充分利用，造成信息损失。
Method: 提取55个上下文感知的时间特征（如滚动热稳定性、温湿度同时达标时长、峰值应力持续时间、恢复速度），并训练层次贝叶斯Beta回归模型，通过部分池化在诊所间共享环境效应，同时保留各个诊所的基线差异。
Result: 在亚洲诊所数据上交叉验证预测误差降至1.27%（原始平均值为3-5%）；在北欧诊所留出数据上R²=0.86，35-39岁年龄组误差降低64%。
Conclusion: 结构化环境监测包含临床有意义的、可跨诊所迁移的信号，表明实验室环境数据应被纳入IVF结果预测模型。

papers.title: Repurposing a Speech Classifier for Guided Diffusion-Based Speech Generation
papers.abstract_en: Classifier guidance is a way to control diffusion generation by using a noise-conditioned classifier to steer the sampling process toward a target class. One drawback of classifier guidance is that it requires two separately trained models: a classifier and a diffusion model. We therefore study a more compact alternative in which a conventionally trained speech classifier is repurposed as the backbone for diffusion generation. Starting from a frozen noise-conditioned classifier in log-Mel space, we attach a lightweight subnetwork that reuses intermediate classifier representations and train only this subnetwork under a Denoising Score Matching objective. Our work shows that a pretrained classifier can be repurposed for conditional generation, providing an appealing bridge between discriminative modeling and conditional speech synthesis resulting in high speech quality within a single-backbone model, with reduced memory footprint and computational cost.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将预训练的语音分类器重新用于引导扩散语音生成。通过在冻结的噪声条件分类器上附加轻量级子网络，仅训练子网络进行去噪分数匹配，实现了单骨干模型的条件语音合成，降低了内存占用和计算成本，同时保持高语音质量。
Motivation: 传统分类器引导需要分别训练分类器和扩散模型，参数量和计算成本高。本文旨在利用现有分类器作为扩散骨干，实现更紧凑的生成框架。
Method: 使用预训练的噪声条件分类器（在log-Mel谱上训练），冻结其权重，并附加一个轻量级子网络来重用中间层特征；仅训练该子网络，优化目标为去噪分数匹配。
Result: 该方法生成高语音质量，并相比传统分类器引导显著减少内存占用和计算开销。
Conclusion: 证明了预训练分类器可被有效重新用于条件生成，为判别式与生成式建模之间提供了桥梁。

papers.title: PCFootprint: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Vectorized Building Footprint Extraction from Aerial LiDAR Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Building footprint extraction is a fundamental task in photogrammetry, remote sensing, and computer vision. Recent image-based methods have achieved remarkable progress in extracting vectorized footprints from high-resolution optical imagery. However, optical imagery inherently susceptible to occlusions, perspective distortions, and residual relief displacement, yielding incomplete or misaligned footprint extraction. Furthermore, the lack of explicit elevation information limits its direct applicability to Level of Detail building modeling. In this paper, we present PCFootprint, the first large-scale public dataset for footprint extraction from airborne laser scanning point clouds. PCFootprint comprises \num{33000} tiles derived from the Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board, covering diverse urban and rural landscapes. Each tile spans \qtyproduct{128 x 128}{\m} with systematically aligned vectorized footprints aligned to point clouds. The dataset includes a \num{3000} tiles cross-domain test set for evaluating generalization across geographic regions. We establish comprehensive benchmarks by evaluating mainstream methods. Experimental results reveal significant challenges including high intra-class variance, data imbalance, and noise across complex geospatial environments. We believe PCFootprint will advance future research in building modeling, urban scene understanding, and geospatial analysis. The PCFootprint dataset is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/Haoyuan-Shen/PCFootprint}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PCFootprint 是首个大规模公开的航空激光雷达点云建筑足迹提取数据集，包含 33,000 个 128×128 米瓦片，覆盖多种城乡景观，并提供跨域测试集。摘要报告了主流方法在该数据集上的基准实验结果，揭示了高类内方差、数据不平衡和噪声等挑战。
Motivation: 基于光学图像的建筑足迹提取方法易受遮挡、透视畸变和残余地形位移影响，导致提取不完整或错位，且缺乏高程信息，难以直接用于建筑细节层次建模。
Method: 构建 PCFootprint 数据集，使用爱沙尼亚土地与空间发展局的机载激光扫描点云，系统生成与点云对齐的矢量化建筑足迹，并划分 3000 瓦片的跨域测试集以评估地理泛化能力。
Result: 摘要报告了主流方法在 PCFootprint 上的基准性能，指出高类内方差、数据不平衡和噪声是主要挑战。
Conclusion: PCFootprint 数据集将推动建筑建模、城市场景理解和地理空间分析等领域的研究。

papers.title: SSH-Net: A Deep Neural Network for Predicting Failure Time Distribution Functions under Competing Risks with Application to GPU Data
papers.abstract_en: Competing risks are commonly observed in engineering fields and can bring challenges to time-to-event data modeling when the application scenarios are complicated. Recently, deep neural networks have received great attention for prediction with competing risks, due to their flexibility and high learning capability. However, the complexity of neural network structure brings extra difficulty in hyperparameter tuning based on different data inputs. Additionally, when an engineered system has complex physical structures with multiple hierarchical levels, treating all structural levels as a single group of inputs may fail to capture critical information. To address the issues, we propose a Structured Segmented Hazard Deep Neural Network (SSH-Net) for failure time prediction under cause-specific competing risks framework. Our approach associates neural network structure with data structures, and allows different covariate groups to impact the failure prediction through separate sub-networks. The neural network is constructed based on a cause-specific competing risks model. The SSH-Net outputs cause-specific hazard functions, and utilizes the penalized log-likelihood as the loss function. The prediction accuracy of SSH-Net is validated through simulation studies by evaluating the Brier score, the area under receiver operating characteristic curves (AUC), and the root mean square error (RMSE) of the predicted cause-specific cumulative incident function. We further demonstrate the model's ability to predict failure time distribution functions using the Titan GPU failure time data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构化分段风险深度神经网络（SSH-Net），用于竞争风险下的故障时间预测，并将其应用于GPU故障数据。通过网络结构与数据结构的关联，不同协变量组通过独立子网络影响预测，输出原因特定风险函数，并采用惩罚对数似然作为损失函数。模拟实验和Titan GPU数据验证了预测准确性。
Motivation: 竞争风险在工程中常见，深度神经网络虽有高学习能力但超参数调优困难；同时，复杂多层级系统若将所有结构层次视为单一输入可能丢失关键信息。
Method: 提出SSH-Net，其网络结构与数据结构关联，允许不同协变量组通过独立子网络影响故障预测，基于原因特定竞争风险模型构建，输出原因特定风险函数，损失函数为惩罚对数似然。
Result: 模拟实验通过Brier分数、AUC和RMSE评估预测准确性，并在Titan GPU故障时间数据上展示了预测故障时间分布函数的能力。
Conclusion: SSH-Net能够有效处理竞争风险下的故障时间预测，特别适用于具有复杂层级结构的工程系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InfantFace: Detecting infant faces in neonatal clinical environments
papers.abstract_en: Reliable localisation of the neonatal face is the first step for several video-camera based non-contact assessments such as pain and distress related facial expression analysis, pain scoring, cardiorespiratory signal extraction and cessation of breathing alerts. However, major challenges persist in neonatal clinical environments. Cluttered backgrounds, illumination changes and poor lighting conditions can reduce the accuracy of face detection models. Clinical interventions, monitoring equipment and, in some cases, medical devices can obstruct the face, making visual assessment difficult. We propose a one-stage YOLOv11m-based model tailored for face detection of infants in neonatal clinical environments. We combined multiple publicly available datasets (VGGFace2, CelebA, FDDB, WIDER FACE) to train and evaluate our proposed model. We then fine-tuned our model on a neonatal research dataset involving 228 videos from 114 recording sessions of 113 independent infants. Before fine-tuning, our model achieved an AP50 of 0.87, surpassing the performance of three state-of-the-art general face detectors. Performance improved further to an AP50 of 0.96 after clinical-domain adaptation. Evaluating face detection performance across different datasets remains a challenge due to the lack of publicly available neonatal datasets. Prioritising the creation of such datasets, while upholding appropriate privacy safeguards and ethical standards in their creation and use, would greatly support further progress in this field.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对新生儿临床环境中的面部检测挑战，提出基于YOLOv11m的单阶段面部检测模型InfantFace。该模型利用多个公开数据集训练，并在新生儿研究数据集上微调，微调前AP50为0.87，超过三个现有通用面部检测器；领域适应后AP50提升至0.96。论文还指出缺乏公开新生儿数据集是当前评估的主要障碍。
Motivation: 新生儿临床环境中，背景杂乱、光照变化、遮挡等问题使现有面部检测器精度不足，而可靠的面部定位是非接触式疼痛评估、心肺信号提取等应用的第一步。
Method: 采用YOLOv11m作为基础架构，结合VGGFace2、CelebA、FDDB、WIDER FACE等公开数据集训练，然后在包含113名婴儿的228个视频数据集上微调，实现临床领域适应。
Result: 微调前AP50为0.87，优于三个最先进通用面部检测器；临床领域适应后AP50提升至0.96。
Conclusion: 论文强调新生儿面部检测的可行性与改进空间，并呼吁在隐私和伦理规范下创建更多公开新生儿数据集以推动进展。

papers.title: Topological Data Analysis for High-Dimensional Dynamic Process Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Real-time process monitoring requires methods that extract actionable information from high-dimensional time-series data. In this work, we present a new approach for process monitoring that combines tools of topological data analysis (TDA) and machine learning. In the proposed approach, we represent multivariate time-series data as manifolds and use topological descriptors to summarize the structure of such data; we then use a neural ordinary differential equation to learn the dynamic evolution of the topological structure of the system. Using real data from an industrial process, we show that this trajectory-based event detection approach is effective at detecting diverse types of events. We contrast this approach against reconstruction-based approaches such as principal component analysis and autoencoders and against a trajectory-based approach that uses Koopman autoencoders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合拓扑数据分析（TDA）和机器学习的高维时间序列过程监测方法。该方法将多变量时间序列表示为流形，使用拓扑描述符总结数据结构，并利用神经常微分方程学习系统拓扑结构的动态演化。在工业过程数据上，该轨迹事件检测方法能有效检测多种事件类型。
Motivation: 实时过程监测需要从高维时间序列中提取可操作信息，现有方法如PCA和自编码器在捕捉复杂动态结构方面存在局限。
Method: 将多变量时间序列表示为流形，用拓扑描述符（如持续同调）总结结构，再用神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）学习拓扑特征的动态演化，实现轨迹事件检测。
Result: 在工业过程真实数据上，该方法能有效检测多种事件类型，并与主成分分析、自编码器及Koopman算符方法进行了对比。
Conclusion: 拓扑数据分析与神经常微分方程的结合为高维动态过程监测提供了一种新的有效途径。

papers.title: Evolutionary Two-Stage Hyperparameter Optimization Strategies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) solve Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws into neural network training. However, their performance suffers from unstable convergence, training plateaus, and strong sensitivity to architectural and optimization hyperparameters due to the highly non-convex and multi-term structure of the physics-informed loss. In this setting, the outer-loop hyperparameter search is a noisy and black-box optimization problem over heterogeneous parameters, where classical local or gradient-based strategies are easily trapped in suboptimal regions. Evolutionary algorithms, with their population-based exploration and ability to handle mixed, non-differentiable search spaces, provide a more robust mechanism for discovering promising configurations. We propose and investigate a two-stage approach based on evolutionary algorithms that combines exploration and exploitation parts of PINNs training to improve solution accuracy and robustness under fixed computational budgets. In the first stage, we perform low-fidelity training runs with truncated epochs to rapidly screen candidate configurations, treating hyperparameter selection as a black-box outer-loop problem. In the second stage, only the most promising candidates are fully trained with standard gradient-based optimizers to refine the solution. Evaluated on three popular problems, namely Advection, Klein-Gordon and Helmholtz equations, our method consistently outperforms standard training and achieves significantly lower mean error within constrained computational resources.
papers.comment: Equal advising: Daria Pugacheva and Fedor Ratnikov. Accepted to the ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI and PDEs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段进化算法超参数优化策略用于物理信息神经网络（PINNs），以解决其训练不稳定和超参数敏感问题。第一阶段用低保真训练快速筛选候选配置，第二阶段对最优候选进行完整训练。在Advection、Klein-Gordon和Helmholtz方程上测试，在固定计算预算下显著降低平均误差。
Motivation: PINNs训练受超参数敏感和损失函数非凸多峰影响，外循环超参数搜索是噪声黑箱优化问题，传统局部或梯度方法易陷入次优区域。
Method: 提出基于进化算法的两阶段方法：第一阶段用截断epoch的低保真训练快速筛选候选配置，视为黑箱外循环；第二阶段仅对最有希望的候选进行标准梯度优化器的完整训练。
Result: 在Advection、Klein-Gordon和Helmholtz三个经典方程上，所提方法一致优于标准训练，在有限计算资源内实现更低的平均误差。
Conclusion: 两阶段进化策略能有效提升PINNs解的精度和鲁棒性，适用于固定计算预算场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable Sperm Morphology Classification via Attention-Guided Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Male infertility is a major cause of couple infertility, often linked to abnormal sperm morphology. While deep learning models offer automated analysis, most lack interpretability, limiting their clinical adoption. This study proposes an attention-guided deep learning framework for sperm morphology classification. We combine a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 with a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) to focus on key areas of the sperm head, improving both accuracy and interpretability. Evaluated on the SMIDS and HuSHem public datasets, our model achieves accuracies of 90.2% and 93.9% (macro F1 scores of 0.913 and 0.948), outperforming SimpleCNN and standard EfficientNet-B0. Furthermore, we use Grad-CAM++ visualizations to highlight features influencing the model's decisions. The results demonstrate that this accurate and transparent framework is a practical tool for automated sperm analysis in fertility clinics.

papers.title: HEPTv2: End-to-End Efficient Point Transformer for Charged Particle Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Charged-particle tracking -- reconstructing trajectories from sparse detector measurements -- is a fundamental high-energy-physics inference problem and a canonical example of learning under extreme combinatorial ambiguity. At the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC), tracking must remain accurate and efficient despite unprecedented collision densities. Graph neural networks perform strongly, but incur substantial costs from graph construction and processing, while transformer-based approaches rely on auxiliary stages that prevent end-to-end optimization. To address this, we present HEPTv2, an end-to-end point-transformer architecture that reconstructs tracks from detector hits in one trainable pipeline. HEPTv2 combines a locality-aware point encoder with a track decoder that predicts complete trajectories without graph-building, clustering, or filtering. The encoder uses locality-sensitive hashing in detector coordinate space to preserve tracking-relevant geometry while enabling efficient local attention. The decoder resolves ambiguities through sectorized decoding and direct hit-to-track prediction under joint encoder-decoder supervision, allowing the full pipeline to be optimized end-to-end. On TrackML, HEPTv2 achieves 98.6% double-majority tracking efficiency at a 0.8% fake rate, while requiring only $\sim$15~ms inference time and 0.4~GB peak memory per event on a NVIDIA A100 GPU. Latency and memory scale approximately linearly for events with up to $5\times10^5$ hits. HEPTv2 establishes a new state of the art in the accuracy-latency trade-off, improving efficiency by 4.5% over the strongest prior transformer and by 1.1--2.2% over optimized graph-based pipelines, while reducing latency by factors of 7 and 38--52, respectively. These results show end-to-end transformers can deliver the accuracy and efficiency required for real-time particle reconstruction at the HL-LHC.

TL;DR: HEPTv2 是一个端到端的点变换器架构，用于从探测器击中点重建带电粒子轨迹。它结合了局部感知点编码器和轨迹解码器，避免了图构建、聚类和过滤等辅助阶段。在 TrackML 数据集上，HEPTv2 实现了 98.6% 的双多数追踪效率、0.8% 的假阳率，推理时间约 15 ms，峰值内存 0.4 GB。相比最强的先前变换器，效率提升 4.5%，延迟降低 7 倍；相比优化的图方法，效率提升 1.1-2.2%，延迟降低 38-52 倍。
Motivation: 高亮度大型强子对撞机 (HL-LHC) 需要在高碰撞密度下保持精确高效的带电粒子跟踪。现有图神经网络和图变换器方法因图构建和处理开销大，或依赖辅助阶段无法端到端优化，难以同时满足精度和延迟要求。

Result: 在 TrackML 上达到 98.6% 双多数追踪效率、0.8% 假阳率，每事件推理时间约 15 ms，峰值内存 0.4 GB。延迟和内存随击中数线性缩放（至 5×10^5 击中）。相比先前最优变换器效率提升 4.5%，延迟降低 7 倍；相比优化图方法效率提升 1.1-2.2%，延迟降低 38-52 倍。
Conclusion: HEPTv2 证明了端到端变换器可以在 HL-LHC 实时粒子重建中同时实现所需精度和效率，在精度-延迟权衡上达到新最优。

papers.title: Multi-View Decompilation for LLM-Based Malware Classification
papers.abstract_en: Malware analysts often inspect compiled binaries through decompiled pseudo-C, when source code is unavailable. Recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) can assist this process by classifying decompiled code as benign or malicious, but existing pipelines typically rely on a single decompiler view. We argue that this assumption is fragile: decompilers are lossy heuristic tools, and different decompilers can expose different artefacts of the same binary. We curate a benchmark of benign utilities and malicious programs spanning a range of threat behaviors. Each sample is compiled and decompiled with both Ghidra and RetDec, yielding matched pseudo-C views. Across a range of LLMs from major model families, we find that providing both decompiler views improves malicious-class F1, mainly by increasing recall on malicious samples. Agreement analyses further show that Ghidra and RetDec make partially different errors, supporting the view that decompiler outputs provide complementary evidence. Our results suggest that multi-decompiler prompting is a simple, training-free way to improve LLM-based malware triage in practical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多视角反编译方法，利用多个反编译器（Ghidra和RetDec）生成互补的伪C代码，以提高基于LLM的恶意软件分类性能。实验表明，提供两个反编译器视图可提升恶意样本的F1分数，主要归因于召回率的提升。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的恶意软件分类通常依赖单一反编译器视图，但反编译器是有损耗的启发式工具，不同反编译器可能暴露相同二进制文件的不同特征，单一视图易受限于特定反编译器的缺陷。
Method: 收集良性工具和恶意程序基准，每个样本用Ghidra和RetDec编译并反编译，得到匹配的伪C视图。使用多个主流LLM系列，通过提示词提供两个反编译视图进行分类。
Result: 在多个LLM系列上，提供两个反编译器视图相比单一视图提升了恶意样本分类的F1分数，主要由于召回率增加。差错分析表明Ghidra和RetDec的出错模式部分不同，支持其提供互补证据的观点。
Conclusion: 多反编译器提示是一种简单、无需训练的方法，可在实际场景中改进基于LLM的恶意软件分类。

papers.title: Sparsity, Superposition, and Forgetting: A Mechanistic Study of Representation Retention in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) systems often forget previously acquired knowledge, yet the mechanisms driving forgetting remain hard to isolate in practice because real datasets entangle many factors. We present a controlled, toy-world framework that makes these mechanisms observable and testable. Using a synthetic generator-separator pipeline, we define ground-truth latent features, build tasks with tunable sparsity and overlap, and introduce measurable quantities for representation strength and superposition (directional overlap among features). We then study retention dynamics-the temporal change of representation strength by fitting sparse dynamical relations (via SINDy) between retention, superposition, and exposure history. A complementary task-level analysis based on effective rank characterizes how representational capacity is allocated across tasks. Our controlled experiments yield three takeaways. (1) Superposition tends to increase over time with transient dips at task boundaries, suggesting boundary-specific interference rather than steady drift. (2) Higher feature sparsity induces more superposition yet does not inevitably cause forgetting; when representations remain strong, forgetting can be reduced despite overlap. (3) Task-level effective rank grows with sparsity, indicating broader capacity usage under sparse regimes. Together, these results nuance the common intuition that more superposition leads to more forgetting by showing that overlap interacts with representation strength and capacity allocation. Our toy analysis provides falsifiable hypotheses and diagnostic tools for CL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个可控的合成玩具世界框架，研究持续学习（CL）中表示遗忘的机制。作者使用生成器-分离器流水线定义真实潜在特征，构建具有可调稀疏性和重叠的任务，并引入表示强度和叠加（特征间的方向重叠）的可测量量。通过拟合保留、叠加和暴露历史之间的稀疏动态关系（SINDy），以及基于有效秩的任务级分析，揭示了三个发现：叠加随时间增加但在任务边界处有短暂下降；更高的特征稀疏性导致更多叠加但并不必然导致遗忘；任务级有效秩随稀疏性增加，表示更广泛的能力使用。这些结果修正了“更多叠加导致更多遗忘”的常见直觉。
Motivation: 持续学习系统经常遗忘先前知识，但实际数据中遗忘机制难以隔离，因为真实数据集纠缠了多种因素。需要一个可控框架使这些机制可观察和可测试。
Method: 构建合成生成器-分离器流水线，定义真实潜在特征，用可调稀疏性和重叠构建任务。引入表示强度和叠加的度量，并通过SINDy拟合保留、叠加和暴露历史之间的稀疏动态关系，同时使用有效秩进行任务级分析。
Result: 叠加随时间增加但在任务边界处有短暂下降；更高特征稀疏性导致更多叠加但并不必然导致遗忘；任务级有效秩随稀疏性增加。
Conclusion: 这些结果挑战了“更多叠加导致更多遗忘”的常见直觉，表明重叠与表示强度和能力分配相互作用，并为持续学习提供了可证伪的假设和诊断工具。

papers.title: Spectral Query-Key Product Weight Steering for Training-Free VLM Hallucination Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) often generate fluent but visually unsupported descriptions, especially by mentioning objects absent from the image. We propose QK Product Steering, a data-free, training-free, and zero-inference-cost weight edit for reducing object hallucination. The method directly edits the per-head query-key product, the operator that produces pre-softmax attention logits, by suppressing a small number of dominant singular modes in selected middle layers. The edited product is then mapped back to the query weights through a closed-form query-only update while keeping shared key weights fixed, making the edit compatible with grouped-query attention. We further decompose the QK product into symmetric and antisymmetric components to distinguish mutual content-similarity patterns from directional attention patterns. Across three GQA-based VLMs, QK Product Steering achieves an average relative CHAIR$_s$ reduction of $4.0\%$, while matched random-mode controls show negligible change. Interpretability ablations show that the hallucination signal is specific to dominant QK modes and is primarily localized to the symmetric mutual-attention channel. Overall, QK Product Steering offers a simple alternative to decoding-time mitigation, requiring no additional data, fine-tuning, or inference-time overhead while largely preserving general multimodal capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无数据、无训练、零推理开销的权重编辑方法QK Product Steering，用于减少视觉语言模型（VLM）的对象幻觉。该方法通过抑制中间层QK乘积的主要奇异模式，并采用闭式更新仅修改查询权重，同时保持共享键权重不变。在三个基于GQA的VLM上，平均相对CHAIR_s降低4.0%，且随机模式控制变化可忽略。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型常生成流畅但视觉上不支持的描述，特别是提及图像中不存在的对象，即对象幻觉问题。现有缓解方法需要额外数据、微调或推理时开销。
Method: 提出QK Product Steering，直接编辑每头查询-键（query-key）乘积，通过抑制选定中间层的少数主导奇异模式，并将编辑后的乘积通过闭式查询仅更新映射回查询权重，同时保持共享键权重固定。进一步将QK乘积分解为对称和反对称分量，以区分内容相似性模式和方向注意力模式。
Result: 在三个GQA-based VLM上，平均相对CHAIR_s降低4.0%，而随机模式控制变化可忽略。可解释性消融表明幻觉信号主要集中于主导QK模式，且主要位于对称互注意力通道。
Conclusion: QK Product Steering提供了一种简单的替代解码时缓解的方法，无需额外数据、微调或推理开销，同时大致保持通用多模态能力。

papers.title: Neural network surrogates with uncertainty quantification for inverse problems in partial differential equations
papers.abstract_en: Inverse problems for differential equations arise throughout science and engineering, where one seeks to infer unknown model parameters from noisy or incomplete observations. Traditional numerical methods for these problems are often computationally expensive, particularly in Bayesian settings where evaluating the likelihood becomes costly for complex forward models and high-dimensional parameter spaces. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepGaLA, a neural-network surrogate for differential equation solvers that provides uncertainty-aware predictions, reducing overconfident inference when training data are limited. To evaluate the fidelity of the surrogate-induced posterior approximations in practice, we show that a short run of delayed-acceptance Markov chain Monte Carlo can serve as an effective diagnostic. Across a range of numerical experiments, DeepGaLA delivers forward-model approximations with accuracy comparable to established Gaussian-process surrogates, while better maintaining efficiency as parameter dimension grows. Moreover, it can incorporate differential-equation constraints, including in nonlinear settings. Overall, these results indicate that uncertainty-quantified neural surrogates can enable scalable and reliable Bayesian inference for inverse problems in complex systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepGaLA，一种为偏微分方程反问题设计的神经网络代理模型，能够提供不确定性感知的预测，减少有限训练数据下的过自信推断。通过延迟接受马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛作为诊断工具，实验表明 DeepGaLA 在准确性与高斯过程代理相当的同时，在高维参数空间中保持效率，并能集成微分方程约束。
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯反问题中，前向模型计算成本高，尤其在复杂模型和高维参数空间下，现有代理模型在数据有限时可能产生过自信推断。
Method: 提出 DeepGaLA，一种不确定性量化的神经网络代理，用于替代偏微分方程求解器；采用延迟接受马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛评估代理后验近似的保真度。
Result: 实验表明 DeepGaLA 的前向模型近似精度与高斯过程代理相当，且在高维参数空间中效率更优；能处理非线性微分方程约束。
Conclusion: 不确定性量化的神经代理可为复杂系统的反问题提供可扩展且可靠的贝叶斯推断。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: On the Redundancy of Timestep Embeddings in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models rely heavily on explicit timestep embeddings to modulate the denoising process across various noise scales. In this work, we challenge the necessity of these temporal signals by analyzing their impact on U-Net and Diffusion Transformer architectures. Beyond empirical evidence, we provide a theoretical framework demonstrating that, under certain conditions, the global minimizer of the diffusion training objective can be achieved without explicit timestep conditioning. Our findings reveal a surprising robustness when timestep embeddings are completely removed. Extensive ablation studies on the CelebA and CIFAR-10 datasets show that these time-agnostic models can maintain high structural fidelity and even surpass their conditioned counterparts in competitive metrics, including FID, precision, and recall. Our analysis suggests these architectures can implicitly infer noise scales from the corrupted input under specific assumptions, rendering explicit temporal conditioning redundant. This study challenges long-standing temporal conditioning paradigms and paves the way for more efficient and structurally focused generative architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验证明，扩散模型中的显式时间步嵌入并非必要。在U-Net和扩散Transformer架构中，完全移除时间步嵌入后，模型仍能在CelebA和CIFAR-10数据集上保持高结构保真度，甚至在FID、精确率和召回率等指标上超越条件版本。理论分析表明，全局优化目标可在无时间条件下达到，架构可隐式从噪声输入中推断噪声尺度。
Motivation: 挑战扩散模型长期依赖显式时间步嵌入的范式，探究其是否冗余。
Method: 提供理论框架证明扩散训练目标的全局最小值可在无时间步条件下实现；在U-Net和扩散Transformer上进行完全移除时间步嵌入的消融实验。
Result: 在CelebA和CIFAR-10数据集上，时间无关模型保持高结构保真度，在FID、精确率和召回率等指标上甚至超越条件版本。
Conclusion: 扩散架构可隐式推断噪声尺度，显式时间条件冗余，为更高效的生成架构铺平道路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Pseudo-Feature Padding: A Lightweight Defense Against False Data Injection in Power Grids
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks DNNs have achieved remarkable accuracy in various tasks including their application in CyberPhysical Systems CPS for detecting False Data Injection Attacks FDIA during critical operations However the unique infrastructure of CPS makes DNNs vulnerable to exploitation by attackers aiming to evade detection Additionally the distinct nature of CPS presents challenges for conventional defense mechanisms against FDIA This paper proposes an innovative defense framework that strengthens DNNs against such attacks by introducing an additional input layer that performs padding in the input samples using pseudofeature values derived from the inputs statistical distribution This padding increases the input dimensionality in a randomized and dataaware manner making adversarial attacks computationally infeasible due to the nontransferable nature of crafted perturbations and the unpredictability of the padded structure Our method is lightweight modelagnostic and requires no modifications to the core architecture making it highly deployable in realworld CPS settings We evaluated our framework on critical power grid applications such as state estimation using the IEEE 14bus 30bus 118bus and 300bus systems Experiments under adversarial settings demonstrate that our padding strategy significantly improves model robustness with negligible impact on performance and effectively mitigates attacks that would otherwise bypass conventional defenses
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级的伪特征填充防御框架，通过在输入样本中添加基于统计分布的伪特征值来增加输入维度，使对抗扰动不可转移，从而保护深度神经网络免受电力系统中虚假数据注入攻击。该方法在IEEE 14、30、118、300总线系统的状态估计任务上验证，显著提升模型鲁棒性且性能影响极小。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在检测虚假数据注入攻击中表现优异，但容易受到攻击者利用，且传统防御机制在网宇物理系统（CPS）中面临挑战，需要一种轻量级、模型无关的防御方法。
Method: 提出伪特征填充框架：在输入层添加由输入统计分布导出的伪特征值，以随机和数据感知的方式增加输入维度，使对抗性攻击因填充结构不可预测而计算上不可行。
Result: 在IEEE 14、30、118、300总线系统的状态估计攻击场景下，该填充策略显著提高了模型鲁棒性，同时对原始性能影响可忽略，并能有效缓解传统防御无法抵御的攻击。
Conclusion: 该方法轻量级、模型无关，无需修改核心架构，适用于实际CSP部署，摘要强调其有效性及实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Direct Advantage Estimation for Scalable and Sample-efficient Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE) has been shown to improve the sample efficiency of deep reinforcement learning algorithms. However, its reliance on full environment observability limits its applicability in realistic settings, and its requirement to model transition probabilities incurs substantial computational overhead for high-dimensional observations. In the present work, we address both limitations. First, we extend the theoretical framework of DAE to partially observable domains with minimal modifications. Second, we reduce its computational complexity by introducing discrete latent dynamics models that efficiently approximate transition probabilities. We evaluate our approach on the Arcade Learning Environment and find that DAE scales effectively with function approximator capacity while retaining high sample efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了直接优势估计（Direct Advantage Estimation, DAE）方法，将其应用于部分可观测环境，并通过离散潜在动力学模型降低计算复杂度。在Arcade学习环境上的实验表明，DAE能够随函数逼近器容量有效扩展，同时保持高样本效率。
Motivation: 原始DAE方法需要完全环境可观测性且建模转移概率计算开销大，限制了其在现实场景中的应用。
Method: 将DAE的理论框架扩展到部分可观测领域，并引入离散潜在动力学模型来高效近似转移概率。
Result: 在Arcade学习环境上的实验表明，DAE随函数逼近器容量扩展有效，且保持高样本效率。
Conclusion: 该工作解决了DAE的两个主要局限性，使其更适用于实际强化学习任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM agent safety, multi-turn red-teaming, jailbreak benchmarks, adversarial robustness, safety-critical systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed as supervisory components for safety-critical systems, yet their robustness under sustained, adaptive adversarial pressure remains poorly characterized. We present NRT-Bench, a benchmark for multi-turn red-teaming of LLM agents acting as operators of a safety-critical system, instantiated in a simulated nuclear power plant control room. A five-role operator team, each backed by a configurable LLM, runs a plant governed by six critical safety functions (CSFs), while adversaries inject messages over four channels in bounded multi-turn sessions with per-turn feedback. Harm is an objective signal rather than LLM-judged text: a run terminates the moment any CSF is lost, attributed to the causing message. Evaluating four frontier operator models under a fixed-attack paired-replay protocol, we find that adaptive multi-turn attacks reliably push the operator team past a safety limit: across the four models, between 8.7% and 12.1% of attack sessions end with the plant losing a critical safety function. Although the four models look almost equally robust by this aggregate rate, their failures barely overlap: of $149$ sessions, none defeat all four models while a third defeat at least one, so vulnerabilities are nearly disjoint across models rather than nested. The effect of added defences is strongly model-dependent: the same guardrail stack or safety-advisor agent that lowers attack success for one model can raise it for another. We release the simulation venue, attack dataset, and replay tooling for reproducible safety evaluation of LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了NRT-Bench，一个用于对作为安全关键系统操作员的LLM代理进行多轮红队攻击的基准测试，实例化为模拟核电站控制室。攻击者通过四个通道在有限多轮会话中注入消息，一旦任何关键安全功能丧失即判定为伤害。实验表明，自适应多轮攻击可靠地使操作员团队越过安全极限，四个前沿模型的失败率在8.7%至12.1%之间，但漏洞几乎不重叠，防御效果高度依赖模型。
Motivation: LLM代理越来越多地被提议作为安全关键系统的监督组件，但其在持续自适应对抗压力下的鲁棒性尚未得到充分表征。
Method: 构建NRT-Bench基准，包含五角色操作员团队（每个由可配置LLM支持）、模拟核电站控制室、六项关键安全功能以及四个攻击通道。采用固定攻击配对回放协议评估四个前沿模型。
Result: 自适应多轮攻击在8.7%至12.1%的会话中导致关键安全功能丧失；四个模型的失败几乎不重叠（149个会话中无一次同时击败所有模型），防御效果高度模型依赖。
Conclusion: LLM代理在安全关键系统中的脆弱性因模型而异且几乎不相交，防御措施的效果高度依赖模型，需要针对性的安全评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowBender: Feedback-Aware Training for Self-Correcting Conditional Flows
papers.abstract_en: Conditional diffusion and flow models routinely fail to satisfy the very constraints that define their task. For instance, a depth-conditioned model often produces images whose re-extracted depth disagrees with the input, even though the forward operator--the depth predictor defining the constraint--is available during both training and inference. Existing approaches generally fall into two categories: supervised models that treat the conditioning signal as a static cue and ignore alignment information at inference, and guidance-based methods that consult it through hand-tuned linear updates, typically trading fidelity to the condition against the plausibility of the generated sample. We argue that the fundamental gap in both paradigms is that the model is never trained to utilize its own alignment error. We introduce FlowBender, a closed-loop framework that treats this error as a first-class input, training the network to learn a correction policy conditioned on inference-time feedback. At each step, an unguided look-ahead pass estimates the clean signal, a task-specific deviation is computed via the forward operator, and a refinement pass consumes this signal to produce a corrected velocity. We propose several variants of FlowBender, including a gradient-based formulation for differentiable operators and a zero-order variant for non-differentiable settings such as JPEG compression. For efficient sampling, we introduce a prior-step shortcut that enables closed-loop correction at a minimal additional computational cost. Across image-to-image translation, restoration, and 3D mesh texturing, FlowBender consistently outperforms standard supervised baselines, alignment-loss-augmented training, and state-of-the-art inference-time guidance, improving fidelity and plausibility simultaneously rather than trading them against each other. Project page: https://flow-bender.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowBender 提出一种闭环训练框架，将条件扩散/流模型的约束违反误差作为一等输入，训练网络根据推理时的反馈信号学习修正策略。该方法在无需手工调参的线性引导下，同时提升保真度与生成合理性，在图像翻译、恢复和3D纹理任务上优于监督基线和对齐损失增强训练。
Motivation: 现有条件扩散/流模型常无法满足任务约束（如深度条件模型生成的图像与输入深度不一致），而现有方法要么忽略对齐信息，要么通过手工线性引导牺牲保真度或合理性。
Method: 引入可微或零阶的前向算子计算偏差，通过无引导的前瞻步估计干净信号，再以偏差修正速度。提出 prior-step shortcut 以最小附加计算实现闭环修正，支持可微与非可微算子。
Result: 在图像到图像翻译、恢复和3D纹理任务上，FlowBender 同时提升保真度与合理性，优于标准监督基线、对齐损失增强训练和推理时引导方法。
Conclusion: 将模型自身的对齐误差作为输入进行训练可有效改善条件生成中的约束满足，且无需在保真度与合理性之间权衡。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The Significance of Style Diversity in Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-utility synthetic data for intent classification typically requires human-annotated seed data, which is often unavailable in fast-paced industrial settings. In this paper, we propose a framework for synthetic dialogue generation that works entirely without human-annotated data, relying solely on intent definitions. Our proposed dialogue generation framework utilizes two different types of topic and style attributes to improve data diversity. Also, we propose two novel post-hoc stylization models called Univ and Exam to transform synthetic LLM-generated utterances into more varied, human-like linguistic styles. To enhance data quality, we utilize an LLM-as-a-judge filtering process. Experimental results on both industrial and public datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves up to 93.3% of the performance obtained using human-annotated training data. Crucially, the findings reveal that style diversity is more critical than topic diversity for synthetic data utility, as it prevents models from learning spurious stylistic correlations. Furthermore, the study shows that incorporating style attributes during the generation process is more effective than post-hoc style adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 提出一个框架，基于意图定义生成合成对话，使用两类主题和风格属性提升多样性；并设计两种后处理风格模型（Univ和Exam）将LLM生成的语句转换为更自然多样的风格，结合LLM-as-a-judge过滤提高质量。
Result: 在工业与公开数据集上，该方法达到使用人工标注数据训练性能的93.3%；进一步发现风格多样性比主题多样性更关键，且生成过程中融入风格属性优于后处理风格适配。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Superpixel Graph Transformer with Metadata for Skin Lesion Classification
papers.abstract_en: Automated skin cancer classification from dermoscopic images remains challenging due to heterogeneous lesion structure, strong intra-class variability, and subtle visual differences between benign and malignant cases. Existing CNN/ViT pipelines typically rely on global or patch-level features and often combine patient metadata via late fusion, which limits spatially grounded multimodal reasoning. We present a novel region-based graph learning framework that explicitly models lesions as graphs of spatially coherent superpixel regions represented as frozen CNN features. To capture fine-grained lesion arrangements, we encode inter-regional geometry as edge attributes and introduce a dedicated metadata context node connected to all regions, providing structured integration of demographic/clinical variables within the same relational space. Node representations are updated using our edge-aware graph transformer followed by attention-driven propagation, and a final graph-level embedding for benign-malignant classification. Experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate that explicit region-level relational modeling and graph-native multimodal fusion yield consistent gains over the state-of-the-art. Consequently, we establish a new graph-centric perspective in which CNN features are modeled as relational nodes and improved through contextual integration, yielding more expressive and robust classifications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于超像素图变换器的皮肤病变分类框架，将皮肤镜图像中的病变区域建模为图结构，节点由CNN特征表示，边编码区域间几何关系，并引入元数据上下文节点实现多模态融合。实验在四个公开基准上取得优于现有方法的分类性能。
Motivation: 现有CNN/ViT方法依赖全局或patch级特征，通过后期融合整合患者元数据，缺乏空间感知的多模态推理能力，难以处理病变异质性和类内变异。
Method: 将病变图像分割为超像素区域，提取CNN特征作为图节点，计算区域间几何关系作为边属性，并添加元数据上下文节点连接所有区域；使用边缘感知图变换器（edge-aware graph transformer）更新节点表示，最终通过图级嵌入进行良恶性分类。
Result: 在四个公开皮肤病变分类基准上，该方法一致优于现有最先进方法，验证了显式区域级关系建模和图原生多模态融合的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作建立了新的图中心视角，将CNN特征作为关系节点并通过上下文集成提升分类表达力和鲁棒性。

papers.title: DataMagic: Transforming Tabular Data into Data Insight Video
papers.abstract_en: Data videos integrate dynamic charts, voice narration, and synchronized animations to communicate data insights as temporal narratives, making them an effective medium for improving data consumption efficiency in the data management lifecycle. However, producing high-quality data videos requires expertise spanning data analysis, narrative design, and video production. Existing approaches fall short: static visualization tools (e.g., BI dashboards) lack narrative logic and animation; authoring tools require users to pre-prepare visualizations rather than working from raw data; pixel-level video generation models cannot guarantee data fidelity or provenance. We demonstrate DataMagic, an end-to-end interactive system that transforms raw tabular data and natural language queries into narrative data-insight videos. To ensure data fidelity, DataMagic introduces the declarative specification DVSpec, which binds visual and animation elements to underlying data fields through data-driven semantic references. To address the combinatorial explosion of the design space, DataMagic adopts a Generate-then-Orchestrate multi-agent architecture that generates candidate scenes in parallel and then optimizes narrative coherence through global orchestration. Leveraging DVSpec's decoupling of logic and rendering, the system further supports three interaction modes and structured provenance-based data Q&A, transforming one-way videos into explorable interactive data interfaces. Evaluation on 109 real-world samples validates the effectiveness of the DataMagic. Homepage: https://datamagic-home.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍DataMagic，一个端到端交互系统，将原始表格数据和自然语言查询转化为叙事数据洞察视频。系统引入声明式规范DVSpec确保数据保真度，采用生成后编排（Generate-then-Orchestrate）多智能体架构处理设计空间组合爆炸问题，并支持三种交互模式和基于结构溯源的数据问答。
Motivation: 现有方法要么缺乏叙事逻辑和动画（静态可视化工具），要么需要预准备可视化（创作工具），要么无法保证数据保真度（像素级视频生成模型）。
Method: 提出DataMagic系统，包含DVSpec声明式规范将视觉和动画元素绑定到数据字段；采用生成后编排多智能体架构并行生成候选场景，再通过全局编排优化叙事连贯性；支持三种交互模式和基于结构溯源的数据问答。
Result: 在109个真实样本上的评估验证了DataMagic的有效性。
Conclusion: DataMagic将单向视频转变为可探索的交互式数据界面，实现了从原始数据到叙事视频的端到端转换。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Modality-imbalanced Federated Graph Learning: A Data Synthesis-based Approach
papers.abstract_en: MultiModal Federated Graph Learning (MM-FGL) offers a natural collaborative training paradigm, but its practical deployment is challenged by two granularities of modality imbalance. Client-level imbalance occurs when certain clients lack entire modalities, while node-level imbalance occurs when individual nodes exhibit missing visual or textual attributes. While several relevant studies exist, our investigation reveals that they predominantly target graph-agnostic or centralized scenarios, rendering them difficult to adapt directly. To address these challenges, we formalize modality-imbalanced MM-FGL as an implicit graph-aware latent semantic representation synthesis problem. This paradigm recovers missing modal semantics directly within the representation space, thereby maximizing alignment with the original data's semantic distribution and mitigating the high variance induced by missing modalities. To this end, we propose FedMGS (Federated Modality-aware Graph Synthesis), which integrates three core components. The availability-aware graph encoder prevents missing modalities from contaminating local structural propagation. The prototype-guided latent semantic synthesizer establishes cross-client semantic anchors for unavailable modalities. The reliability-calibrated semantic fusion mechanism regulates the impact of recovered latent representations prior to predictive readout. Extensive experiments on four tasks show that FedMGS consistently outperforms competitive baselines with gains up to 17.41% with best efficiency-performance tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态联邦图学习（MM-FGL）中客户端级和节点级模态不平衡问题，提出基于隐式图感知的潜在语义表示合成方法FedMGS。该方法包括可用性感知图编码器、原型引导的潜在语义合成器和可靠性校准的语义融合机制，在四个任务上最高提升17.41%。
Motivation: 现有联邦图学习方法无法直接适应模态不平衡场景，导致缺失模态引入高方差和语义偏移。
Method: 提出FedMGS框架，包含三个核心组件：可用性感知图编码器防止缺失模态污染局部传播；原型引导潜在语义合成器建立跨客户端语义锚点；可靠性校准语义融合机制调节恢复表示的可靠性。
Result: 实验表明FedMGS在四个任务上优于基线，最高提升17.41%，并实现最佳效率-性能平衡。
Conclusion: 通过直接合成缺失模态的潜在语义表示，有效缓解了联邦图学习中的模态不平衡问题。

papers.title: Rethinking Shrinkage Bias in LLM FP4 Pretraining: Geometric Origin, Systemic Impact, and UFP4 Recipe
papers.abstract_en: FP4 training promises substantial reductions in memory and computation cost for LLM pretraining, yet current FP4 hardware paths and recipes, including NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin-class systems and AMD MI350-series GPUs, remain centered on E2M1 data elements. In this study, we identify a fundamental limitation of that choice: non-uniform formats such as E2M1 inherently suffer from Shrinkage Bias, a systematic negative rounding error caused by the geometric asymmetry of their representable bins. We show that this bias accumulates multiplicatively across layers and is amplified by the Random Hadamard Transform (RHT), providing a unified explanation for the training instability observed in existing E2M1-based FP4 recipes. In contrast, uniform grids (E1M2/INT4) bypass this grid-geometry error and better convert the improved bucket utilization from RHT into higher quantization quality. Based on this finding, we propose UFP4, a uniform 4-bit training recipe that applies RHT to all three training GEMMs while restricting stochastic rounding to dY alone. On Dense 1.5B, MoE 7.9B, and MoE 124B long-run pretraining, UFP4 consistently achieves lower BF16-relative loss degradation than strong E2M1-based baselines, supported by scaling-law analysis and ablation studies. Our results suggest that future accelerators should support E1M2/INT4-style uniform 4-bit grids as first-class training primitives alongside E2M1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现E2M1等非均匀格式在LLM FP4预训练中存在收缩偏差，即由可表示区间的几何不对称性导致的系统性负舍入误差。该偏差在层间乘积累积，并被随机哈达玛变换（RHT）放大，解释了基于E2M1的FP4训练的不稳定性。相比之下，均匀网格（E1M2/INT4）避免了这种网格几何误差，并能更好地将RHT改进的桶利用率转化为更高的量化质量。作者提出UFP4，一种均匀4位训练方案，在Dense 1.5B、MoE 7.9B和MoE 124B长程预训练中，相较于强E2M1基线持续实现更低的BF16相对损失退化。
Motivation: 现有FP4硬件路径和配方（如NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin-class系统和AMD MI350系列GPU）主要基于E2M1数据元素，但非均匀格式存在收缩偏差，导致训练不稳定。本文旨在揭示这种偏差的几何起源和系统影响，并提出更好的均匀格式方案。
Method: 提出UFP4，一种均匀4位训练配方，对所有三个训练GEMM应用随机哈达玛变换（RHT），同时将随机舍入限制在dY上。通过理论分析和实验验证了E1M2/INT4均匀网格相对于E2M1的优势。
Result: 在Dense 1.5B、MoE 7.9B和MoE 124B长程预训练中，UFP4持续实现比强E2M1基线更低的BF16相对损失退化，得到缩放定律分析和消融研究的支持。
Conclusion: 未来加速器应支持E1M2/INT4风格的均匀4位网格作为与E2M1并列的一等训练原语。

papers.title: CRAX: Fast Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Safety is a core concern for deploying reinforcement learning (RL) agents in real-world domains such as robotics and autonomous driving. While benchmarks have been central to progress in RL, existing safety benchmarks with high-fidelity 3D physics remain computationally slow, limiting large-scale experimentation and rapid prototyping. To address this gap, we propose CRAX (Constrained RL Accelerated with JAX). Built on top of the MuJoCo XLA (MJX) physics engine with realistic 3D dynamics, CRAX leverages vectorized operations and hardware acceleration, yielding up to ~100x speedups over comparable CPU-based safety benchmarks. The benchmark features six environment suites and three agent-specific tasks, each spanning three difficulty levels. Evaluating six popular safe RL methods shows that no single approach dominates across all tasks, and reveals the trade-offs between performance and safety. We find that curriculum learning across difficulty levels and safety transfer can improve performance over direct training in harder settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRAX 是一个基于 JAX 加速的安全强化学习基准测试平台，利用 MuJoCo XLA 物理引擎实现高达约100倍的速度提升，包含六个环境套件和三个智能体特定任务，每个任务有三个难度等级。评估了六种流行的安全 RL 方法，发现没有单一方法在所有任务中占优，并揭示了性能与安全性之间的权衡。课程学习和安全迁移能提升在困难设置下的训练效果。
Motivation: 现有高保真3D物理的安全强化学习基准计算速度慢，限制了大规模实验和快速原型开发。
Method: 构建 CRAX 基准，基于 MuJoCo XLA (MJX) 物理引擎，利用向量化操作和硬件加速实现快速仿真。
Result: CRAX 相比 CPU 基安全基准实现约100倍加速；评估六种安全 RL 方法表明无单一方法在所有任务中占优，课程学习和安全迁移可提升表现。
Conclusion: CRAX 提供了一个快速、可扩展的安全 RL 基准平台，有助于大规模实验和方法比较。

papers.title: AutoPass: Evidence-Guided LLM Agents for Compiler Performance Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for code compilation tasks, but applying them to runtime performance tuning is difficult due to complex microarchitectural effects and noisy runtime measurements. We present AutoPass, a multi-agent framework for compiler performance tuning that uses compiler and runtime evidence to guide LLM-generated optimization decisions. Rather than treating the compiler as a black box like prior auto-tuning schemes, AutoPass opens up the compiler to the LLM, enabling it to query compiler-internal optimization states and analyze the intermediate representation to orchestrate compiler options. The search process iteratively refines optimization configurations using measured runtime feedback to diagnose regressions and guide latency-improving edits. AutoPass operates in an inference-only, training-free setting and requires no offline training or task-specific fine-tuning, making it readily applicable to new benchmarks and platforms. We implement AutoPass on the LLVM compiler and evaluate it on server-grade x86-64 and embedded ARM64 systems. AutoPass outperforms expert-tuned heuristics and classical autotuning methods, achieving geometric-mean speedups of 1.043x and 1.117x over LLVM -O3 on x86-64 and ARM64, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoPass 是一个基于 LLM 的多智能体框架，用于编译器性能调优。它通过查询编译器内部优化状态和分析中间表示来引导优化决策，并使用运行时反馈迭代改进配置。在 x86-64 和 ARM64 上，AutoPass 分别比 LLVM -O3 获得 1.043x 和 1.117x 的几何平均加速。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 应用于运行时性能调优时面临微架构效应复杂和运行时测量噪声大的挑战，而传统自动调优方法将编译器视为黑盒，缺乏对编译器内部状态的利用。
Method: 提出多智能体框架 AutoPass，通过查询编译器内部优化状态和分析中间表示来引导 LLM 生成优化决策，并利用运行时反馈迭代优化配置，无需离线训练或微调。
Result: 在 LLVM 编译器上，AutoPass 在 x86-64 和 ARM64 上分别实现 1.043x 和 1.117x 的几何平均加速，优于专家调优的启发式和经典自动调优方法。
Conclusion: AutoPass 通过打开编译器黑盒并利用运行时证据，实现了无需训练的编译器性能调优，适用于新基准和平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Judging to Improve: A De-biased VLM-as-3D-Judge Protocol for Single-Image 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: A companion study established a de-biased, cross-model VLM-as-3D-judge that reliably ranks single-image-to-3D mesh quality where cheap geometry and CLIP proxies fall short. This paper asks: can that judge's preferences specialize a strong open generator, TRELLIS, on one asset class (furniture), cheaply and without human labels? Taking the judge from ranking to optimization is where the work lives. Pushing a VLM judge into the training and evaluation loop exposes failure modes ranking never triggered, so our contribution is an optimization-grade hardening of the judge: a training judge (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) held distinct from an evaluation judge (InternVL3-8B) to break circularity; position-bias correction; and fixes for three failure modes (image overload, geometry-hiding splat renders, and reference-free judging that rewards clean-but-wrong outputs), with calibration evidence (clear-gap win-rate 0.83-1.0; base-vs-base ~0.5). Using this protocol as an independent evaluator, and working only from public models and data with lightweight parameter-efficient adaptation, we find our methods match the strong base rather than exceed it. Independent base samples carry essentially no learnable preference (0.94 order-flip rate), so signal must be engineered by quality-contrastive construction. Across six adaptation methods, two input regimes, and a severity sweep, the most targeted - conditioner repair under severe degradation - reaches parity (0.50) with the base, while no method clears the >=65% win-rate target. The result is mechanistic: clean inputs saturate the judge, flow-DIT fine-tuning washes out through the sampler, and conditioning repair is the locus that moves geometry. Win-rates are directional at n=8 objects. Matching a strong public-data base with cheap adaptation is itself informative: exceeding it needs more than lightweight PEFT on public data, and the judge protocol is reusable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用去偏的VLM作为评判来优化单图像3D生成模型。作者将评判从排序任务扩展到优化循环，提出训练评判与评估评判分离、位置偏差校正等硬化工序，并识别出三种失败模式。实验表明，在轻量级参数高效微调下，优化方法仅能与强基线持平，未能超过，因为干净输入饱和了评判，流式DiT微调被采样器冲淡，只有条件修复能改善几何。
Motivation: 现有单图像3D生成缺乏可靠的自动评判，而VLM评判在排名任务中有效，但将其直接用于训练优化会暴露新问题（如循环依赖、位置偏差、假阳性输出），需要硬化协议才能用于优化。
Method: 提出优化的VLM-as-3D-Judge协议：使用不同VLM作为训练评判（Qwen2.5-VL-7B）和评估评判（InternVL3-8B）打破循环；校正位置偏差；修复三种失败模式（图像过载、几何隐藏的splat渲染、无参考评判奖励干净但错误的输出）。然后通过6种适应方法、2种输入设置和严重度扫描，在TRELLIS生成器上微调。
Result: 摘要报告：经过优化的协议作为独立评估器，在轻量级PEFT下，所有方法均未达到≥65%胜率目标，最好的条件修复仅在严重退化下达到50%平局。独立基础样本的胜率顺序翻转率高达0.94，表明信号必须靠质量对比构建。
Conclusion: 摘要强调：在公开数据上使用轻量级适配无法超越强基线，但匹配基线本身即有参考意义；所提评判协议可复用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automating SKILL.md Generation for Computer-Using Agents via Interaction Trajectory Mining
papers.abstract_en: Explicit skill libraries make computer-using agents easier to inspect, but it remains unclear whether such libraries can be mined from interaction data in a way that improves downstream policies. We study this question through a three-stage pipeline that segments GUI trajectories, clusters segments into candidate skills, and trains a skill-aware policy from the resulting annotations. The mined clusters are readable on the source benchmark: five of eight clusters have at least 0.95 purity against InteraSkill Workflows labels. However, readability does not imply transfer. GRPO improves IW skill-step accuracy only from 18.5\% to 20.5\%, leaves BrowseComp+ essentially unchanged, and underperforms trivial frequency priors on key source-domain metrics. We therefore present the method as a diagnostic study: trajectory mining can expose inspectable skill structure, but the current boundary detector, orderless segment representation, and offline reward model are insufficient for reliable cross-domain policy improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否从交互轨迹中自动挖掘显式技能库（SKILL.md）以改进计算机使用代理的策略。提出三阶段流水线：分割GUI轨迹、聚类为候选技能、基于标注训练技能感知策略。聚类结果在源基准上可读（5/8簇纯度≥0.95），但技能感知策略仅将GRPO的IWSkill步骤准确率从18.5%提升至20.5%，对BrowseComp+无改善，甚至在关键源域指标上不如简单频率先验。因此，该方法被定位为诊断性研究：轨迹挖掘可暴露可检查的技能结构，但当前边界检测器、无序段表示和离线奖励模型不足以实现可靠的跨域策略改进。
Motivation: 显式技能库使计算机使用代理更易检查，但尚不清楚能否从交互数据中挖掘此类库并改进下游策略。
Method: 提出三阶段流水线：首先分割GUI轨迹，然后聚类分割片段为候选技能，最后利用聚类标注训练技能感知策略。
Result: 聚类可读性高（5/8簇纯度≥0.95），但技能感知策略效果有限：GRPO的IWSkill步骤准确率仅从18.5%升至20.5%，BrowseComp+准确率几乎不变，且源域关键指标不如频率先验。
Conclusion: 轨迹挖掘可暴露可检查的技能结构，但现有组件（边界检测器、无序段表示、离线奖励模型）不足以实现可靠的跨域策略改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Train, Retrieve, or Both? A Four-Arm Head-to-Head for Correct Statutory Citation on the Ontario Residential Tenancies Act
papers.abstract_en: Self-represented tenants, landlords, and help-desk staff need to be pointed at the provision of law that actually governs a question, with a correct statutory citation. We study this task on the Ontario Residential Tenancies Act, 2006 (RTA) and its core regulation, asking the operator's question empirically: is fine-tuning enough, or is hybrid retrieval needed? We run a four-arm head-to-head on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (base zero-shot, LoRA SFT-only, RAG-only, and an SFT+RAG hybrid), scored on citation exact-match (section+subsection) over a small, human-verification-pending real eval set. The base model cannot cite the RTA and SFT-only mis-recalls sections; retrieval is essential and drives hallucination to zero by construction; and the SFT+RAG hybrid scores highest at 0.481 exact-match with zero hallucinated citations. Its edge comes from SFT making provision selection more robust to the higher-recall candidate sets that hurt zero-shot RAG. Notably, this cheap bge-small hybrid matches or beats a pipeline built on bigger, specialized retrieval models (a larger embedder and a cross-encoder reranker), and a larger/improved training set does not help either: strong statutory-citation performance here does not require specialized retrieval models or more data. The artifact zeroes hallucination and clears the lift-over-base bar but does not reach the aspirational 0.70 exact-match target. All results are on a small, human-verification-pending real eval set and are reported as preliminary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在安大略省住宅租赁法（RTA）中正确引用法条的任务，通过四臂实验比较基座模型、仅微调、仅检索和微调+检索混合方法。结果表明，混合方法（SFT+RAG）在精确匹配和零幻觉方面表现最佳，且无需专门的检索模型或更多数据。
Motivation: 自我代表的租户、房东和帮助台人员需要被引导到实际管辖问题的法律条款，但现有模型在准确引用法条方面存在不足。
Method: 使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct作为基座模型，进行四项对比实验：基座零样本、LoRA SFT、仅RAG、SFT+RAG混合，并在小规模人工验证待定的真实评估集上评估引用精确匹配（条款+小节）。
Result: SFT+RAG混合方法在精确匹配上达到0.481，且零幻觉；而基座模型无法引用RTA，仅SFT错误回忆条款。该方法甚至优于使用更大专用检索模型（大嵌入器和交叉编码器重排序）的流水线。
Conclusion: 对于法条引用任务，检索是必要的，且SFT+RAG混合方法效果最佳，但尚未达到0.70的精确匹配目标；所有结果基于小规模评估集，应视为初步。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: On the Variance of Temporal Difference Learning and its Reduction Using Control Variates
papers.abstract_en: We analyze the variance of temporal difference (TD) learning using the phased setting with tabular representation, and show that one of the mechanisms behind its ability to reduce variance is by effectively aggregating over a larger number of independent trajectories. Based on this insight, we demonstrate that (1) the variance of TD is asymptotically bounded from above by Monte Carlo (MC) estimators, and (2) shorter horizon updates incurs less variance for a fixed number of samples. Beyond TD, we show that Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE), a method for estimating the advantage function, can be seen as a type of regression-adjusted control variate, which achieves a tighter bound on the variance compared to TD in the large-sample limit. Finally, we numerically illustrate the behaviors of these estimators with carefully designed environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在表格表示的分阶段设定下分析了时序差分学习（TD）的方差，揭示了其降低方差的机制之一是有效聚合更多独立轨迹。证明TD方差渐近上界不超过蒙特卡洛估计，且短视更新在固定样本量下方差更小。此外，将直接优势估计（DAE）解释为回归调整控制变量，在大样本极限下实现比TD更紧的方差界。数值实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 理解TD学习方差的来源及其降低机制，并与MC估计及控制变量方法进行比较，为改进强化学习算法提供理论指导。
Method: 在表格表示的分阶段设定下，理论分析TD估计量的方差，证明其渐近上界；引入DAE作为回归调整控制变量，推导其方差界。
Result: TD方差渐近上界不超过MC估计；短视更新方差更小；DAE在大样本极限下方差界比TD更紧。
Conclusion: TD通过聚合轨迹降低方差，DAE作为控制变量可进一步减少方差，但理论结果基于表格设定，推广性需进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust $Q$-learning for mean-field control under Wasserstein uncertainty in common noise
papers.abstract_en: In this article, we present a robust $Q$-learning algorithm for discrete-time mean-field control problems under Wasserstein uncertainty in the common noise law. The algorithm combines a quantization-and-projection scheme with a Wasserstein dual reformulation on the common-noise space. We establish its convergence together with finite-time iteration bounds for both synchronous and asynchronous learning schemes. Numerical experiments on systemic risk and epidemic models compare the asynchronous implementation with an idealized Bellman iteration, illustrate the robustness-performance tradeoff under common-noise misspecification, and report the observed convergence behavior of the asynchronous $Q$-learning algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种鲁棒 Q-learning 算法，用于处理公共噪声定律下具有 Wasserstein 不确定性的离散时间均场控制问题。该算法结合了量化投影方案和公共噪声空间上的 Wasserstein 对偶重构，并证明了同步和异步学习方案的收敛性及有限时间迭代界。数值实验在系统性风险和流行病模型上展示了鲁棒性-性能权衡。
Motivation: 均场控制问题中公共噪声定律的不确定性可能导致模型误指定，需要开发鲁棒的控制方法。
Method: 提出鲁棒 Q-learning 算法，结合量化投影方案和 Wasserstein 对偶重构，在公共噪声空间上处理不确定性。

papers.title: Critical Percolation as a Synthetic Data Model for Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks learn features that reflect the hierarchical, multi-scale structure of natural data. Synthetic datasets used to evaluate interpretability methods typically lack this structure, limiting their value as realistic toy models. To close this gap, we introduce a family of synthetic datasets consisting of hierarchical functions defined on critical mean-field percolation clusters embedded in a high-dimensional data space. The percolation data consists of sparse, low-dimensional fractal clusters with a power-law size distribution. Latent variables modeling a taxonomic hierarchy generate each data point's target value. The data model is analytically tractable with known critical exponents that fix its properties without requiring hyperparameter tuning. We leverage a mapping between percolation clusters, random trees, and additive coalescence to propose an almost linear-time algorithm to jointly sample a random tree and its hierarchical latent decomposition, enabling data generation at arbitrary scale. Using probing experiments, we find that the model's ground-truth latent variables can be linearly decoded from neural network activations. Together, sparsity, self-similarity, power-law statistics, and analytical tractability make critical percolation a principled testbed for interpretability research.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有合成数据集缺乏自然数据层次多尺度结构的问题，提出基于临界平均场渗流（critical mean-field percolation）簇的层次函数合成数据模型。该模型具有解析可追溯性，通过映射到随机树和加法凝聚实现近似线性时间采样。探测实验表明，模型的真实潜在变量可从神经网络激活中线性解码。
Motivation: 现有用于评估可解释性方法的合成数据集通常缺乏自然数据中的层次多尺度结构，限制了其作为现实玩具模型的价值。
Method: 引入一族合成数据集，由定义在高维数据空间中的临界平均场渗流簇上的层次函数组成。通过渗流簇、随机树和加法凝聚之间的映射，提出近似线性时间算法联合采样随机树及其层次潜在分解。
