papers.title: Evaluation of Image Matching for Art Skills Assessment
papers.abstract_en: While some individuals possess a natural talent for drawing, mastering this skill requires dedicated training and practice. Determining one's skill in the art of drawing requires proper comprehensive assessment. In this paper, we propose a method to measure drawing skill by by matching the hand-drawn image with the original template. Existing techniques often involve complex processes. However, advancements in computer vision allow us to train computers to perform these comparisons at a human-like level, thereby resolving the tedious and overwhelming traditional process. Using computer vision applications, determining image similarity involves identifying the level of similarities in an image with a reference image. We have implemented and analyzed the SIFT feature and Siamese network to measure image similarity. Our results indicate that it is feasible to assess art skill levels. Through feature analysis, we found that SIFT-based key point matching provides a more effective means of detecting drawing skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图像匹配的绘画技能自动评估方法，通过将手绘图像与原始模板比较来衡量技能水平。实验比较了SIFT特征匹配和Siamese网络，发现SIFT关键点匹配在检测绘画技能方面更有效。
Motivation: 传统绘画技能评估繁琐复杂，需要人工评判。计算机视觉技术的进展使得自动比较成为可能，但需要有效的方法来衡量手绘与模板的相似性。
Method: 采用SIFT特征匹配和Siamese网络两种方法进行图像相似性度量，用于评估手绘与模板的匹配程度。
Result: 结果表明基于SIFT的关键点匹配在检测绘画技能方面更有效，证实了图像匹配用于艺术技能评估的可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过特征分析，SIFT特征匹配是一种更有效的绘画技能评估手段。

papers.title: Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long: Exploring Dataset Distillation for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) aims to maintain model performance under evolving target domains by adapting online without labeled data. However, practical deployments often cannot retain the source dataset due to privacy or licensing constraints, and purely source-free CTTA methods tend to become unstable under long-term distribution shift, suffering from compounding self-training errors and catastrophic forgetting. We introduce DO-ALL (Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long), a plug-and-play framework that revisits source information in a compact and privacy-conscious form via Dataset Distillation (DD). Before deployment, DO-ALL performs DD to produce a small set of synthetic distilled anchors that summarize the source distribution. During adaptation, each target sample is matched with its most semantically aligned anchor, which provides a stable reference for various CTTA via source replay, representation alignment, and manifold-smoothing regularization. DO-ALL can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTTA algorithms, consistently improving long-term robustness across CIFAR100-C, ImageNet-C, and the CCC benchmark. This demonstrates the potential of leveraging DD to enable stable and continuous adaptation without retaining raw source data. The code is available at https://github.com/blue-531/DOALL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DO-ALL 框架，通过数据集蒸馏（Dataset Distillation）生成合成锚点，在持续测试时适应（CTTA）中提供源信息参考，避免保留原始源数据。在 CIFAR100-C、ImageNet-C 和 CCC 基准上，该方法提升了长期鲁棒性，并可与现有 CTTA 算法无缝集成。
Motivation: 实际部署中由于隐私或许可限制，无法保留源数据集；纯无源 CTTA 方法在长期分布漂移下不稳定，存在自训练误差累积和灾难性遗忘。
Method: 部署前对源数据进行数据集蒸馏，生成一组小型合成蒸馏锚点；适应时，将每个目标样本与最语义对齐的锚点匹配，通过源回放、表征对齐和流形平滑正则化实现稳定适应。
Result: 在 CIFAR100-C、ImageNet-C 和 CCC 基准上，DO-ALL 一致提升了现有 CTTA 算法的长期鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 数据集蒸馏能以紧凑且隐私保护的形式保留源分布信息，为无源 CTTA 提供稳定参考，实现持续的模型适应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AK-MCS-C2 : Active Kriging Monte Carlo Simulation method with conformal certification for failure probability estimation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel active-learning framework for failure probability estimation in structural reliability analysis that integrates Active Kriging Monte Carlo simulation with conformal prediction. The proposed approach employs an adaptive cross-conformal strategy specifically designed for small-sample settings and kriging surrogate models using the J+GP conformal estimator. Unlike standard AK-MCS methods, the proposed framework provides distribution-free guarantees on prediction errors, leading to more reliable classification of samples near the limit-state surface. This improved uncertainty quantification enhances both the accuracy and robustness of failure probability estimates, especially for rare-event regimes where such efficiency is crucial. Reproducible numerical results illustrate the effectiveness of the method and also compare it to classical approaches on well-established benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种主动Kriging蒙特卡洛模拟与共形预测（conformal prediction）相结合的框架，用于结构可靠性分析中的失效概率估计。该方法采用自适应交叉共形策略，针对小样本和Kriging代理模型使用J+GP共形估计器，提供分布自由的预测误差保证，提高极限状态面附近样本分类的可靠性，增强稀有事件区域失效概率估计的准确性和鲁棒性。数值结果表明该方法在经典基准测试上优于传统方法。
Motivation: 传统AK-MCS方法在小样本或稀有事件场景下对预测误差缺乏分布自由的保证，导致失效概率估计不够可靠。
Method: 将Active Kriging Monte Carlo模拟与共形预测结合，采用自适应交叉共形策略，利用J+GP共形估计器对Kriging代理模型进行小样本下的不确定性量化。
Result: 在基准测试上，该方法相比经典方法提高了失效概率估计的准确性和鲁棒性，尤其在稀有事件区域。
Conclusion: 共形预测为Kriging代理模型提供了分布自由的误差保证，有效提升了失效概率估计的可靠性，适用于小样本和稀有事件场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HilDA: Hierarchical Distillation with Diffusion for Advancing Self-Supervised LiDAR Pre-trainin
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) for camera-to-LiDAR knowledge distillation offers a promising solution to the scarcity of annotated data needed to represent the immense geometric and kinematic diversity of real-world autonomous driving (AD). However, current approaches typically treat VFMs as black-box teachers, relying exclusively on frame-wise feature similarity. Consequently, they do not fully exploit the teacher's layer-wise semantic structure and global context, as well as the rich spatiotemporal information inherent in LiDAR sequences. We propose HilDA, a self-supervised pretraining framework for LiDAR backbones that better captures the semantic what and geometric where needed for driving tasks. HilDA combines hierarchical distillation comprising multi-layer distillation for progressive semantic alignment and global context distillation for scene-level semantics, with a temporal occupancy diffusion objective promoting spatiotemporal consistency. Models pre-trained with HilDA achieve state-of-the-art results on cross-modal distillation benchmarks and outperform models trained via prior distillation approaches on 3D object detection, scene flow, and semantic occupancy prediction. Code available at: https://maxiuw.github.io/hilda.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Maciej and Jesper contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HilDA，一种用于LiDAR主干网络的自监督预训练框架，通过层级蒸馏（多层蒸馏实现渐进语义对齐，全局上下文蒸馏捕获场景级语义）结合时间占用扩散目标，促进时空一致性。在跨模态蒸馏基准上取得最优结果，并在3D目标检测、场景流和语义占用预测任务上超越先前方法。
Motivation: 现有方法将视觉基础模型（VFM）视为黑箱教师，仅依赖逐帧特征相似性，未能充分利用教师的分层语义结构和全局上下文，以及LiDAR序列中的丰富时空信息。
Method: HilDA结合层级蒸馏（多层蒸馏与全局上下文蒸馏）和时间占用扩散目标，强制时空一致性，从而更好地捕捉驾驶任务所需的语义（what）和几何（where）信息。
Result: 在跨模态蒸馏基准上达到最先进结果，在3D目标检测、场景流和语义占用预测任务上优于先前蒸馏方法。
Conclusion: HilDA有效利用VFM的层级语义和时空信息，提升LiDAR自监督预训练质量。

papers.title: Effective Dimension Governs Generalization in Quantum Kernel Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent quantum vision models-quantum vision transformers and quantum convolutional networks-report two striking but unexplained empirical phenomena: (i) ansatze with more, or more uniformly distributed, entanglement generalize better, and (ii) injecting quantum noise can improve test accuracy rather than degrade it. These observations are currently treated as curiosities, discovered by grid search and explained, if at all, by hand. We show that both are manifestations of a single, measurable quantity: the \emph{effective dimension} $d_{\rm eff}$ of the (noise-shaped) quantum feature kernel. Working primarily with quantum-kernel vision models-a quantum feature map read out by a kernel classifier-we give a spectral account in which entanglement structure and quantum noise are two knobs that move $d_{\rm eff}$; in an overfitting regime, contracting $d_{\rm eff}$ acts as ridge-like regularization. We analyze the mechanism: an \emph{exact} decomposition of the depolarized kernel $K_p=(1-p)^2K+\tfrac{p(2-p)}{D}\mathbf{1}\mathbf{1}^\top$ with $d_{\rm eff}(K_p)\to1$, a contraction result (and its boundary) for amplitude damping, a kernel-machine capacity bound, and a capacity/alignment risk decomposition; the monotone contraction operative in our entangled experiments is verified empirically, not proven in general. Along the one-parameter depolarizing family the collapse is instead exact by construction; we use it only to confirm the kernel decomposition to machine precision and at up to $12$ qubits, not as evidence for $d_{\rm eff}$. Amplitude damping contracts $d_{\rm eff}$ and lifts test accuracy by up to $+13\%$ along an inverted-U sweet spot; the effect's sign flips between the over- and under-fitting regimes; noise injection matches an explicit spectral-filtering frontier. Our results organize two reported anecdotes into a single measurable principle for designing quantum-vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 最近量子视觉模型报告了两个令人困惑的经验现象：纠缠越多或纠缠分布越均匀的ansatze泛化越好，以及注入量子噪声可以提升测试精度。本文证明两者均源于同一个可测量量——有效维度d_eff。通过量子核视角，纠缠结构和量子噪声是调节d_eff的旋钮，在过拟合区域收缩d_eff起到类似岭正则化的作用。实验显示振幅阻尼在倒U形窗口内将测试精度提升最多+13%，且效果在过拟合和欠拟合区域符号相反。
Motivation: 现有量子视觉模型中两个经验现象缺乏统一解释，本文旨在揭示其背后的共同原理，即有效维度d_eff的控制作用。
Method: 采用量子核模型，通过去极化核的精确分解、振幅阻尼的收缩结果、核机器容量界限以及容量/对齐风险分解进行理论分析，并在实验中验证振幅阻尼对d_eff的单调收缩效果（虽未普遍证明）。
Result: 振幅阻尼在倒U形窗口内将测试精度提升最多+13%，且过拟合与欠拟合区域效果相反；噪声注入匹配明确的谱滤波前沿。
Conclusion: 本文将两个被报告的现象统一为一个可测量的原则：有效维度d_eff是设计量子视觉模型的核心控制量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 采用量子核模型，通过去极化核的精确分解、振幅阻尼的收缩结果、核机器容量界限以及容量/对齐风险分解进行理论分析，并在实验中验证振幅阻尼对d_eff的单调收缩效果（虽未普遍证明）。
summary_sections.result: 振幅阻尼在倒U形窗口内将测试精度提升最多+13%，且过拟合与欠拟合区域效果相反；噪声注入匹配明确的谱滤波前沿。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文将两个被报告的现象统一为一个可测量的原则：有效维度d_eff是设计量子视觉模型的核心控制量。

papers.title: Evaluating and Enhancing Negation Comprehension in Remote Sensing MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in various Remote Sensing (RS) tasks. However, their ability to comprehend negation remains underexplored, limiting deployment in real-world applications where models must explicitly identify what is false or absent, e.g., emergency responders need to locate non-flooded routes for evacuation. To comprehensively study this limitation, we introduce RS-Neg, the first benchmark to evaluate negation understanding across region-level to scene-level tasks. Specifically, we design an automated data generation pipeline for RS imagery, using LLMs to synthesize diverse negation queries, and introduce a dynamic visual focus module for verification. Our evaluation reveals that advanced RS MLLMs struggle with negation, exhibiting hallucinations and substantial performance degradation. To close this gap, we propose NeFo, a novel test-time learning method that explicitly incorporates the logical role of negation into the model optimization. Remarkably, using about 5\% unlabeled test samples, NeFo significantly improves the negation understanding of models and shows strong generalization to unseen tasks. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出 RS-Neg 基准，用于系统评估遥感多模态大模型 (MLLMs) 的否定理解能力。作者发现现有 RS MLLMs 在否定查询上表现较差，存在幻觉和性能下降。为此提出 NeFo 方法，通过利用少量无标注测试样本进行测试时学习，显著提升否定理解并泛化到未见任务。
Motivation: 现实遥感应用中模型需要明确识别什么是不存在或不正确的（例如非淹没路线），但现有 MLLMs 的否定理解能力未被充分研究和评测。
Method: 构建 RS-Neg 基准，包含从区域级到场景级的否定理解任务，并设计自动数据生成管道和动态视觉焦点验证模块。提出 NeFo，一种测试时学习方法，将否定逻辑显式纳入模型优化，仅需约 5% 无标注测试样本。
Result: 评估表明当前先进 RS MLLMs 在否定查询上表现严重退化；NeFo 显著提升否定理解，并展现出对未见任务的良好泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了 RS MLLMs 在否定理解上的缺陷，并提供了有效的改进方法，有望推动其在真实场景中的应用。局限在于仅在测试时学习，未涉及训练阶段。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Computational Methods and Challenges in Cell-Free DNA Analysis for Multi-Cancer Early Detection
papers.abstract_en: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) is a promising avenue for non-invasive multicancer early detection (MCED), in that, it can enable multiple cancer detection simultaneously from a single blood draw, with particular sensitivity to cancers that currently lack established screening programs. Here we review the computational methods developed between 2022 and 2025 for cfDNA-based MCED. We focus on how fragmentomics and epigenetic features are extracted and analyzed to detect cancer at early stages. We first briefly outline the biological basis of cfDNA signals, then review classical statistical and machine learning approaches alongside deep learning frameworks including autoencoder-based models. For each method we discuss biological interpretability, validation strategy, and readiness for clinical integration. Furthermore, we categorize the current challenges into technical, computational, and methodological while outlining open problems in the field. This review shows that multimodal ensemble approaches have the strongest promise for clinical integration and the highest readiness. However, for better assessment of future work and side-by-side comparison, standardization of evaluation protocols and reporting results will be crucial.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了2022至2025年间基于cfDNA的多癌早期检测计算方法，重点关注片段组学和表观遗传特征的提取与分析，涵盖经典统计/机器学习及深度学习框架。文章指出多模态集成方法最具临床整合潜力，但标准化评估协议对后续比较至关重要。
Motivation: cfDNA有望实现非侵入性多癌早期检测，尤其对缺乏筛查手段的癌症。但现有方法在生物可解释性、验证策略和临床就绪性方面存在差异，亟需系统性梳理。
Method: 系统回顾了2022-2025年间的方法，按特征类型（片段组学、表观遗传学）和组织方式（传统ML、深度学习如自编码器）分类，并讨论可解释性、验证与临床整合准备度。
Result: 多模态集成方法被评价为最有可能用于临床，且准备度最高；但方法的公平对比需要标准化的评估与报告协议。
Conclusion: 综述强调了技术、计算和方法论层面的开放挑战，指出标准化是未来评估的关键。

papers.title: Predicting gestational age at birth in the context of preterm birth from multi-modal fetal MRI
papers.abstract_en: Preterm birth is associated with significant mortality and a risk for lifelong morbidity. The complex multifactorial aetiology hampers accurate prediction and thus optimal care. A pipeline consisting of bespoke machine learning methods for data imputation, feature selection, and regression models to predict gestational age (GA) at birth was developed and evaluated from comprehensive multi-modal morphological and functional fetal MRI data from 333 control cases and 93 preterm birth cases. The GA at birth predictions were classified into term and preterm categories and their accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity were reported. An ablation study was performed to further validate the design of the pipeline. Performance was evaluated using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The pipeline achieves an R2 score of 0.13 and a mean absolute error of 2.74 weeks. It also achieves a 0.77 accuracy, 0.59 sensitivity, and 0.82 specificity across folds. The predominant features selected by the pipeline include cervical length and statistics derived from placental T2* values. The confluence of fast, motion-robust and multi-modal fetal MRI techniques and machine learning prediction allowed the prediction of the gestation at birth. This information is essential for any pregnancy. To the best of our knowledge, preterm birth had only been addressed as a classification problem in the literature. Therefore, this work provides a proof of concept. Future work will increase the cohort size to allow for finer stratification within the preterm birth cohort. Our code is available at https://github.com/dfajardorojas/ml-for-preterm-birth-.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:013
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套机器学习流水线，利用多模态胎儿MRI数据（包括形态和功能成像）预测出生时的胎龄（gestational age, GA），并区分足月与早产。基于333例对照和93例早产病例，管道采用数据插补、特征选择和回归模型。性能方面，R²为0.13，平均绝对误差2.74周，分类准确率0.77，灵敏度0.59，特异度0.82。重要特征包括宫颈长度和胎盘T2*值。研究为胎龄预测提供了概念验证。
Motivation: 早产死亡率高且可能导致终身并发症，其复杂多因素病因导致预测困难，现有研究多将其视为分类问题而非回归问题。
Method: 开发了一个包含数据插补、特征选择和回归模型的机器学习管道，利用多模态胎儿MRI数据（形态和功能）预测出生时胎龄，并通过消融实验验证设计。
Result: 管道在10折交叉验证中取得R²=0.13、MAE=2.74周；分类准确率0.77、灵敏度0.59、特异度0.82。关键特征为宫颈长度和胎盘T2*值。
Conclusion: 本研究证明结合快速运动鲁棒的多模态胎儿MRI与机器学习可预测出生时胎龄，为早产预测提供概念验证；未来需扩大队列以细化早产亚组分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Modal Contrastive Learning for Implicit Earth Embeddings via Location Tying
papers.abstract_en: Spatial prediction tasks are often limited by a lack of high-quality labelled ground-truth observations. To overcome this challenge, self-supervised pre-training is a possible solution, with contrastive learning dominant for location encoders. Those approaches usually align geographic coordinates with just one additional modality. We propose two multimodal contrastive learning architectures: Multimodal Embedding via Location Tying (MELT) and Sequential Alternating Location Training (SALT). These architectures expand this framework beyond two modalities by utilising unpaired geospatial data. Both methods are technically viable and match the performance of the strongest two-modality baseline (SATCLIP) across four downstream tasks. However, increasing the number of modalities does not consistently improve performance, suggesting that the chosen location encoder is the main limitation - the contrastive objective reaches its peak early, regardless of modality diversity or pre-training volume. MELT provides more stable training than SALT and presents a stronger foundation for future scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两种多模态对比学习架构 MELT 和 SALT，用于位置编码器的自监督预训练，将对比学习从双模态扩展到多模态，利用未配对的时空数据。实验表明两种方法在四个下游任务上与最强双模态基线 SATCLIP 性能持平，但增加模态数并未持续提升性能，说明位置编码器本身是主要瓶颈。MELT 训练更稳定，更适合未来扩展。
Motivation: 空间预测任务缺乏高质量标注数据，自监督预训练是可行方案，但现有对比学习方法通常只对齐地理坐标与一种额外模态。
Method: 提出 MELT（Multimodal Embedding via Location Tying）和 SALT（Sequential Alternating Location Training）两种多模态对比学习架构，通过位置绑定实现多种未配对模态的联合嵌入学习。
Result: 两种方法在四个下游任务上匹配 SATCLIP 的性能，但增加模态数量未带来持续提升；MELT 训练稳定性和扩展性优于 SALT。
Conclusion: 多模态对比学习在技术上可行，但当前位置编码器的容量限制了性能，对比目标早期即达到饱和，未来需改进编码器设计。

papers.title: PRecover 1.0: Process Rate Recovery with Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Comprehensive information on cloud microphysical process rates from numerical simulations allows for better understanding of precipitation formation pathways and aerosol-cloud interactions. However, resource limitations often make it impractical to include all microphysical process rates in the model output, limiting in-depth analyses. To address this shortcoming, we introduce PRecover, a data-driven post-processing approach to recover microphysical process rates that are not stored during runtime from standard output of a numerical weather prediction model. In particular, we train random forests, gradient boosting models, and feed-forward neural networks to recover microphysical process rates from a two-moment bulk microphysics scheme in the ICOsahedral Nonhydrostatic (ICON) model. We use cloud variables as input, obtained from high-resolution simulations in a limited-area setup over Europe. Warm-rain and ice microphysical process rates are recovered with a two-step classification-regression approach for both instantaneous and accumulated process rates. As a physics-based baseline, we assess whether process rates can be directly recalculated from stored ICON output variables. Accurate recalculation is possible for process rates such as accretion and self-collection but not for the autoconversion, rain melting or heterogeneous ice nucleation rate. Using PRecover, we successfully recover most of the process rates that are accumulated over output time steps of 10 minutes or less, but the values are increasingly difficult to recover for rates accumulated over longer accumulation intervals. To quantify predictive uncertainty, we provide calibrated prediction intervals through conformalized quantile regression. We demonstrate spatial transferability of the models with two case studies over different regional domains and simulation settings unseen during training.
papers.comment: Prepared for submission to Geoscientific Model Development (GMD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRecover，一种基于机器学习的数据驱动后处理方法，用于从数值天气预报模型的标准输出中恢复未存储的微物理过程速率。使用随机森林、梯度提升和前馈神经网络，对ICON模型的双矩整体微物理方案进行恢复，采用两步分类-回归方法处理暖雨和冰相过程速率。结果表明，对于10分钟或更短时间步长累积的速率恢复效果良好，并通过共形分位数回归提供校准的预测区间，展示了模型的空间迁移性。
Motivation: 数值模拟中微物理过程速率的存储受资源限制，导致无法进行深入的降水形成路径和气溶胶-云相互作用分析。
Method: 使用随机森林、梯度提升和前馈神经网络，以云变量为输入，采用两步分类-回归方法恢复双矩整体微物理方案中的过程速率，并通过共形分位数回归量化预测不确定性。
Result: 成功恢复了10分钟以内时间步长累积的多数过程速率，但更长累积间隔的速率恢复困难；直接重算仅对部分速率可行，如增长和自收集，而自动转换、雨融化或异质冰核化速率则无法直接重算。
Conclusion: PRecover能有效恢复未存储的微物理过程速率，具有空间迁移性，但长累积间隔的恢复仍是挑战。
Relevance: 85

papers.title: MedRLM: Recursive Multimodal Health Intelligence for Long-Context Clinical Reasoning, Sensor-Guided Screening, Evidence-Grounded Decision Support, and Community-to-Tertiary Referral Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Real-world clinical decision support requires reasoning over heterogeneous and longitudinal patient information rather than answering isolated medical questions. However, current medical large language models and retrieval-augmented generation systems often rely on single-step prompting or retrieval, which can be fragile when clinical evidence is distributed across long electronic health records, medical images, sensor streams, guidelines, and referral constraints. This paper proposes MedRLM, a Recursive Multimodal Health Intelligence framework for long-context clinical reasoning, sensor-guided screening, and community-to-tertiary referral support. Instead of compressing all patient information into one prompt, MedRLM treats the patient case as an external clinical environment that can be recursively inspected, decomposed, retrieved, verified, and synthesized. The framework coordinates specialized agents for clinical text, longitudinal EHR, medical imaging, physiological sensor signals, guideline retrieval, uncertainty auditing, and referral planning. It further introduces a Clinical Evidence Graph Memory to connect patient-specific observations with retrieved evidence, standardized definitions, sensor-derived biomarkers, and referral criteria. A sensor-guided recursive triggering mechanism activates deeper reasoning when abnormal physiological or behavioral patterns are detected, while uncertainty-gated refinement supports clinician review for high-risk or low-confidence cases. We also outline a real-data evaluation design using public and credentialed clinical datasets spanning EHR, radiology, ECG, ICU time series, and referral-proxy outcomes. MedRLM aims to move medical AI from static question answering toward auditable, multimodal, and workflow-aware clinical decision support.

Result: 框架目前仅描述了真实数据评估设计，涉及公共和认证数据集（EHR、放射学、ECG、ICU时间序列和转诊代理结果），尚未报告具体实验结果。

papers.title: Implicit Semantic-Aware Communication Based on Hypergraph Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Semantic-aware communication has emerged as a transformative paradigm for next-generation communication systems, shifting the fundamental goal from transmitting bit-level symbols to reliably recovering and understanding the semantic meaning of information. Previous studies have demonstrated that representing the semantic content of source messages as graph-based structures can significantly improve communication efficiency and the accuracy of semantic inference at the receiver. However, existing solutions typically employ graphs that capture only pairwise relationships, thereby neglecting higher-order implicit correlations commonly observed in real-world scenarios, such as group interactions, multi-entity associations, and complex relational contexts. This limitation reduces semantic expressiveness and makes semantic inference susceptible to ambiguity and performance degradation, particularly under noisy or corrupted channel conditions. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel hypergraph-based implicit semantic reasoning framework, HISR, which leverages hypergraphs to represent complex multi-entity relationships among semantic knowledge entities. In HISR, entities and their associated higher-order relations are mapped into dedicated semantic subspaces tailored to distinct relational contexts. This design not only disentangles diverse semantic interactions to mitigate the over-smoothing effects commonly found in traditional graph embedding methods but also enables robust semantic inference even when partial information loss occurs during transmission. Numerical results show that the proposed HISR achieves up to a 36.6% improvement in implicit semantic interpretation accuracy over the state-of-the-art benchmarks.
papers.comment: This work is accepted at IEEE Transactions on Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于超图推理的隐式语义感知通信框架 HISR，利用超图表示语义知识实体间的高阶隐式关联，并通过解耦不同语义交互来缓解过平滑问题，在信道噪声下仍能进行鲁棒语义推理。实验表明，该框架在隐式语义解释准确率上比现有基准提升最高达 36.6%。
Motivation: 现有语义通信方法通常仅利用图结构捕获成对关系，忽略真实场景中的高阶隐式关联（如群体交互、多实体关联），导致语义表达力不足，尤其在噪声信道下性能下降。
Method: 提出 HISR 框架，将实体及其高阶关系映射到专用语义子空间，利用超图推理实现复杂多实体关系的隐式语义理解，并通过解耦不同关系上下文减轻图嵌入的过平滑问题。
Result: 在隐式语义解释准确率上，HISR 相比现有最优方法提升高达 36.6%。
Conclusion: 超图推理能有效增强语义通信系统对高阶隐式关联的表达能力和鲁棒性，为未来语义通信提供新思路。

papers.title: ARTEMIS: Agent-guided Reliability-aware Temporal Mask Evolution for Imperfectly Supervised Video Polyp Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Imperfectly supervised video polyp segmentation (VPS) aims to learn dense, temporally consistent masks from inexpensive supervision, including weak annotations (points, scribbles) and semi-supervision with few densely labeled frames. This setting is clinically valuable but challenging due to weak contrast, ambiguous boundaries, motion blur, and specular highlights, compounded by sparse pixel-level guidance. While SAM2 can generate dense masks from sparse inputs, direct pseudo-labeling often yields geometry-degraded masks with boundary leakage, underutilizes temporal consistency, and ignores reliability. To address these issues, we propose ARTEMIS, a unified framework for imperfectly supervised VPS driven by agent-guided reliability-aware temporal mask evolution. ARTEMIS initializes coarse masks from available supervision: SAM2 converts points/scribbles, while dense labels serve as reliable anchors. A debate-and-judge vision-language agent selects reliable temporal anchors under weak supervision, which are propagated bidirectionally with SAM2 to refine unreliable or unlabeled frames. Finally, ARTEMIS trains the segmenter using temporal reliability-aware robust learning, incorporating reliability-guided reference selection, a Reference Prototype Transport Module, and reliability-aware robust loss. These components assess mask reliability, evolve anchors over time, transport target identity across frames, and down-weight noisy supervision instead of discarding difficult samples. Experiments on SUN-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB-612 under scribble, point, and limited-label settings demonstrate that ARTEMIS achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/ARTEMIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARTEMIS框架，用于不完全监督的视频息肉分割，通过智能体引导的可靠性感知时间掩码演化方法，结合SAM2和视觉-语言智能体，在弱监督和半监督设置下提升分割性能，在SUN-SEG和CVC-ClinicDB-612数据集上达到最优。
Motivation: 现有不完全监督视频息肉分割方法存在边界泄露、时间一致性利用不足和可靠性忽略的问题，亟需一种统一框架来解决这些挑战。
Method: 提出ARTEMIS，包含三步：用SAM2从稀疏标注初始化粗略掩码；视觉-语言智能体通过辩论-判断机制选择可靠时间锚点并双向传播；使用时间可靠性感知鲁棒学习训练分割器，包括可靠性引导参考选择、参考原型传输模块和鲁棒损失。
Result: 在SUN-SEG和CVC-ClinicDB-612上，针对涂鸦、点和有限标注设置，ARTEMIS取得了最先进性能。
Conclusion: ARTEMIS有效整合了弱标注和半监督信息，通过可靠性感知机制提高了分割质量和时间一致性。

papers.title: Modularity-Free Conflict-Averse Training for Generalized PINNs
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have become a powerful framework for solving PDEs by embedding physical laws into differentiable objectives. Despite their advances, training PINNs remains fragile: recent conflict-averse optimization schemes alleviate gradient interference between residual and boundary losses, but we show that their effectiveness deteriorates as model capacity increases. In this paper, we identify a capacity-induced failure mode, where overparameterized networks undergo functional modularity, self-partitioning into task-exclusive modules that suppress cross-objective interaction and hinder convergence toward Pareto-stationary points. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework, Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync), which integrates structural optimization into conflict-averse training by penalizing task-exclusive connections while preserving interaction-promoting pathways. Extensive experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks demonstrate that ModSync consistently prevents capacity-driven failures, sustains robust cross-objective coupling, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. Codes are available at \url{https://github.com/heejokong/ModSync}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现过参数化PINN在冲突避免训练中会出现功能模块化（functional modularity），导致跨任务交互减弱和收敛变差。提出Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync)框架，通过对任务专属连接施加稀疏性惩罚并保留交互通路，在多个PDE基准上达到最先进准确率。
Motivation: 现有冲突避免优化方案在模型容量增大时效果下降，原因是过参数化网络会自组织成任务专属模块，抑制跨目标交互，阻碍收敛到Pareto最优。
Method: 提出ModSync，将结构优化融入冲突避免训练，惩罚任务专属连接同时保留促进交互的通路，实现模块稀疏同步。
Result: 在多样化的PDE基准上一致防止容量驱动的失败，维持鲁棒跨目标耦合，达到最先进准确率。
Conclusion: ModSync有效解决了过参数化PINN中的功能模块化问题，为广义PINN训练提供了新思路。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: NAMESAKES: Probing Identity Memorization in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models generate realistic likenesses of some individuals when prompted with their names, raising privacy concerns. However, distinguishing whether a generated face is memorized or fabricated currently requires ground-truth photos, access to training data, or white-box access to model internals, limiting applicability. We introduce a fully black-box behavioral probe that distinguishes between these regimes while requiring no reference photos or prior knowledge of training data. To benchmark this task, we present the NAMESAKES dataset of over one thousand names and faces of public figures spanning a wide range of fame levels, along with perturbed, less famous names. Experiments on state-of-the-art T2I models show that our probe substantially predicts identity memorization and separates memorized from unrecognized names, with further insights into differences across model families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种黑盒行为探测方法，用于区分文本到图像模型生成的人脸是记忆了训练数据中的真实身份还是随机生成的。同时构建了NAMESAKES数据集，包含上千名公众人物的姓名和面孔，涵盖不同知名度水平。实验表明该方法能有效预测身份记忆，并区分记忆与未记忆的名称。
Motivation: 现有方法需要真实照片、训练数据访问或白盒模型内部信息才能判断生成人脸是否被记忆，限制了隐私审计的实用性。
Method: 提出一种完全黑盒的行为探测方法，无需参考照片或训练数据先验知识，通过分析模型对输入名称的响应来区分记忆和生成。
Result: 在多个先进T2I模型上的实验表明，该方法能显著预测身份记忆，并有效分离记忆与未记忆的名称，还发现不同模型家族之间的差异。
Conclusion: 本文为评估T2I模型隐私风险提供了一种无需数据访问的实用工具，并揭示了模型记忆行为的差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Texts to Scores: Tracing the Emergence of Essay Quality Representations in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have substantially transformed Automated Essay Scoring (AES), yet the internal mechanisms underlying LLM-based scoring remain poorly understood. In this work, we systematically analyze the hidden representations of eight LLMs across two English essay datasets (ASAP++, CSEE) and one Portuguese dataset (ENEM). Using linear probing, cross-prompt generalization, dimensionality reduction, and neuron-level analyses, we find consistent evidence that essay quality information is encoded in a linearly accessible form within LLM representations. These representations emerge progressively across layers, remain robust across prompting strategies, and partially transfer across essay prompts despite differences in scoring rubrics. In addition, nonlinear probes provide only marginal and inconsistent improvements over linear probes, suggesting that most essay quality information is already linearly decodable. We further identify individual ``essay scoring neurons'' whose activations strongly correlate with essay scores and whose behavior is sensitive to targeted intervention. Moreover, the layer-wise distribution of these neurons systematically shifts with essay length, with longer essays relying more heavily on deeper layers. Overall, our findings provide evidence that LLMs encode structured representations related to essay quality and offer new insights into the interpretability of LLM-based AES systems.
papers.comment: This is a preprint of a manuscript currently under peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了八种大型语言模型（LLMs）在自动作文评分（AES）中的隐藏表示，通过线性探针、跨提示泛化、降维和神经元级分析，发现作文质量信息在LLM表示中以线性可访问的形式编码，这些表示逐层涌现，跨提示策略鲁棒，且部分跨提示迁移。还识别了“作文评分神经元”，其激活与分数强相关，且层分布随文章长度系统变化。
Motivation: 尽管LLM已在AES中取得显著进展，但其内部评分机制尚不明确，本文旨在揭示LLM如何表示作文质量信息。
Method: 对八个LLM在三个数据集（ASAP++, CSEE, ENEM）上使用线性探针、跨提示泛化测试、降维和神经元级分析。
Result: 发现作文质量信息在线性探针下可解码，非线性探针仅带来边际改进；识别出单个“作文评分神经元”，其激活与分数强相关，且层分布受文章长度影响。
Conclusion: 证明LLM编码了结构化作文质量表示，为LLM-based AES的可解释性提供新见解。

papers.title: Hybrid ANN-SNN Pipeline with Local Plasticity
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes a hybrid ANN-SNN pipeline that effectively leverages the rich embeddings of pretrained artificial neural networks (ANNs) to enable high-performance spiking neural networks (SNNs). The architecture couples a pretrained EfficientNet encoder with a CoLaNET spiking classifier. We convert the encoder's activations into spike trains via rate-coding and train the subsequent SNN classifier using local, biologically inspired learning rules, bypassing end-to-end gradient propagation. This approach achieves 99.09% accuracy on a 64-class ImageNet benchmark, demonstrating performance on par with conventional deep networks. The work presents a biologically plausible and efficient framework for adapting powerful pretrained encoders to downstream spiking neural network tasks.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: BIM-Edit: Benchmarking Large Language Models for IFC-Based Building Information Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to computer-aided design (CAD) to generate design artifacts from textual instructions. In engineering practice, this requires more than creating new geometry, models must also understand existing scenes, edit them correctly, and preserve semantics and relations. However, many CAD benchmarks focus on creating new models rather than editing existing ones, and mostly evaluate geometric correctness. We introduce BIM-Edit, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on natural-language editing of Building Information Models (BIM) represented in the Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) format. BIM provides a challenging testbed because building models encode geometry together with semantic and relational structure. BIM-Edit contains 324 editing tasks spanning 11 realistic building models and 36 synthetic scenes. Tasks are expressed using three instruction categories - direct, spatial, and topological - covering both explicit and scene-grounded edits. We evaluate outputs along three dimensions: geometric accuracy, semantic validity, and topological consistency. Across evaluated LLMs, the best-performing model achieves only 49.5% average score across the three metrics, and no model fully solves more than 3.4% of tasks. These results demonstrate a substantial gap between current LLM capabilities and the requirements of structured engineering design workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BIM-Edit基准，用于评估大语言模型在基于IFC的建筑信息模型上的自然语言编辑能力。包含324个编辑任务，覆盖11个真实建筑模型和36个合成场景，评估几何准确性、语义有效性和拓扑一致性。最佳模型平均得分仅49.5%，无模型完全解决超过3.4%的任务，表明LLM在结构化工程设计工作流中的能力存在显著差距。
Motivation: 现有CAD基准多关注创建新模型而非编辑现有模型，且主要评估几何正确性，忽略了语义和关系。BIM需要理解并正确编辑既有场景，保持语义和拓扑关系。
Method: 构建BIM-Edit基准，包含324个编辑任务，使用直接、空间和拓扑三类指令，评估几何、语义和拓扑三个维度。
Result: 最佳LLM在三个指标上的平均得分仅49.5%，完全解决的任务不超过3.4%。
Conclusion: 当前LLM能力与结构化工程设计工作流的要求之间存在巨大差距，需要进一步研究。

papers.title: HEad and neCK TumOR (HECKTOR) 2025: Benchmark of Segmentation, Diagnosis, and Prognosis in Multimodal PET/CT
papers.abstract_en: Head and neck cancers (HNC) represent a significant global health burden, with accurate tumor delineation being essential for effective radiotherapy planning. The complexity of the oropharyngeal anatomy, combined with the heterogeneous appearance of tumors on imaging, makes manual segmentation time-intensive and subject to inter-observer variability. Beyond segmentation, predicting long-term clinical outcomes, such as recurrence-free survival (RFS), and determining human papillomavirus (HPV) status from noninvasive imaging, remain challenging yet clinically valuable goals. The HECKTOR 2025 challenge addresses these needs by establishing a comprehensive benchmark for automated HNC analysis using multimodal PET/CT imaging and electronic health records. Building on previous editions (2020-2022), this challenge features an expanded multi-institutional dataset comprising over 1,100 patients from 10 centers worldwide. Participants were tasked with three complementary objectives: (1) segmenting primary gross tumor volumes (GTVp) and metastatic lymph nodes (GTVn), (2) predicting recurrence-free survival, and (3) classifying HPV status. The challenge attracted 35 registered teams, with 15 final submissions evaluated on a held-out test set. Top-performing algorithms achieved a mean Dice similarity coefficient of 0.75 for segmentation, a concordance index of 0.66 for survival prediction, and a balanced accuracy of 0.56 for HPV classification. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the submitted methodologies, evaluates their performance across different lesion characteristics, and discusses their implications for clinical translation in automated oncology workflows and decision support systems.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Overview paper for the HECKTOR 2025 challenge, held as a satellite event at MICCAI 2025. Challenge website: https://hecktor.grand-challenge.org/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍HECKTOR 2025挑战赛，旨在建立头颈癌多模态PET/CT分析基准，包含肿瘤分割、无复发生存预测和HPV状态分类三个任务。比赛使用来自10个中心超过1100名患者的数据，最终15个团队提交结果，最优算法在分割上达到平均Dice 0.75，生存预测C-index 0.66，HPV分类平衡准确率0.56。
Motivation: 头颈癌的精确肿瘤勾画对放疗至关重要，但手动分割耗时且存在观察者间变异。同时，从影像预测临床结局（如无复发生存）和HPV状态仍有挑战，需要综合基准评估。
Method: 挑战赛采用多中心多模态PET/CT数据集，设置三项任务：初级肿瘤体积和转移淋巴结分割、无复发生存预测、HPV状态分类。参赛团队提交算法，在留出测试集上评估性能。
Result: 最佳算法分割Dice均值0.75，生存预测C-index 0.66，HPV分类平衡准确率0.56。论文分析了不同病灶特征下的性能差异。
Conclusion: 本文总结了HECKTOR 2025的参赛方法、性能及临床转化意义，强调该基准对自动化肿瘤工作流和决策支持系统的推动作用。

papers.title: RACL: Reasoning-Agent Control Layers for Continuous Metaheuristic Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces RACL, a Reasoning-Agent Control Layer for metaheuristics. RACL places a reasoning agent above an existing optimizer. The agent does not replace the optimizer and does not modify business constraints. Instead, it controls the optimizer's internal search behavior by observing operational memory, reasoning over past behavior, formulating bounded hypotheses, testing interventions, evaluating outcomes, applying guardrails, consolidating useful policies and explaining its decisions. The experiment uses vehicle routing as a testbed, but the contribution is not a new routing solver, a particular ALNS configuration or a specific set of routing rules. The contribution is the RACL method: a way for a reasoning agent to discover, validate, consolidate and explain algorithmic control rules for a metaheuristic. In the current experimental setting, RACL improves or ties the Operational Memory Policy in 21 of 21 feasible cases and improves or ties a non-reasoning Stagnation-Triggered Policy in 18 of 21 feasible cases, with an average RACL vs STP cost delta of -0.641%. In the Sevilla-9/10 runtime sample, RACL improves average cost by -8.337% versus Fixed and -1.605% versus STP without showing material computational overhead. During the proof-of-concept, Codex was used as an in-the-loop reasoning agent observing executions, interpreting logs and proposing live bounded interventions. The policy proxy was later used only to make quantitative evaluation reproducible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RACL 是一个放置在现有元启发式优化器之上的推理代理控制层，通过观察运行内存、推理过去行为、提出有限假设、测试干预、评估结果、应用防护栏、巩固有用策略并解释决策，来动态调整优化器的内部搜索行为。在车辆路径问题的实验中，RACL 在21个可行案例中的21个上优于或持平操作内存策略，在21个中的18个上优于或持平停滞触发策略，平均成本比停滞触发策略低0.641%，在特定运行样本中比固定策略低8.337%，且未带来显著计算开销。
Motivation: 元启发式优化器内部搜索行为通常由固定或简单规则控制，缺乏自适应和推理能力，难以持续提升性能。
Method: 提出推理代理控制层（RACL），在优化器之上运行，通过观察、推理、假设干预、试验、评估、安全约束、策略巩固和解释等步骤，自动发现和优化控制规则。
Result: 实验表明，RACL 在21个可行案例中全部优于或持平操作内存策略，18个优于或持平停滞触发策略，平均成本降低0.641%，特定样本中改善更显著且计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: RACL 提供了一种通用方法，使推理代理能够为元启发式算法发现、验证、巩固和解释控制规则，且不依赖特定优化器或业务约束。

papers.title: SA-VIS: Sparse frame Annotations for training Video Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent online video instance segmentation (VIS) methods have achieved impressive results, thus becoming the preferred approach to segment instances in videos. Despite the resurgence of impressive single image models, the online (or semi-online) VIS approaches outperform single-image models (e.g., based on SAM) by using long sequences of densely annotated frames during training. However,such a training setup of VIS is expensive in the sense of compute as well as dense annotations required. In order to solve these major flaws, we argue that the effective modeling of the instances and their evolution in videos do not require densely annotated frames. To that end, we propose a simple and effective module, called Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP) which aggregates low-dimensional features from the image encoder of multiple frames. This simple low-compute module provides tremendous learning capability in using sparse video frame labels for end-to-end training. Combined with a light-weight frame-specific Instance Queries, our Sparse frame Annotation VIS (SA-VIS) significantly improves performance over its baseline. Most interestingly, our simple design that avoids complexities effectively bridges the gap in accuracy between training on sparsely and densely annotated video sequences. This translates to a mere 0.4% drop in performance of SA-VIS when using annotations for only 1/5 of the images in the dataset. Empirically, SA-VIS shows strong improvements over the baseline on YouTube-VIS 2019/2021/2022 and Occluded VIS (OVIS) and an over 1% improvement in AP on the state-of-the-art in a limited annotations scenario.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频实例分割（VIS）密集帧标注成本高的问题，提出Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP)模块，通过聚合多帧图像编码器的低维特征，实现使用稀疏帧标注进行端到端训练。该方法在YouTube-VIS 2019/2021/2022和OVIS数据集上显著提升基线性能，仅使用1/5标注帧时性能仅下降0.4%，在有限标注场景下AP提升超过1%。
Motivation: 现有在线VIS方法依赖密集帧标注进行训练，计算和标注成本高昂。论文认为有效建模实例及其演化不需要密集标注帧，旨在降低标注成本而不牺牲性能。
Method: 提出Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP)模块，聚合来自图像编码器的多帧低维特征，并结合轻量级的帧特定实例查询（Instance Queries），实现稀疏帧标注下的有效训练。
Result: 在YouTube-VIS 2019/2021/2022和OVIS数据集上，SA-VIS显著优于基线；仅使用1/5标注帧时AP下降仅0.4%，在有限标注场景下比现有最优方法AP提升超过1%。
Conclusion: 稀疏帧标注训练可达到与密集标注相近的性能，显著降低标注成本，为视频实例分割提供实用的轻量级训练方案。

papers.title: Learning to Prompt: Improving Student Engagement with Adaptive LLM-based High-School Tutoring
papers.abstract_en: LLMs can personalize education, although current static-prompt tutoring systems struggle to adapt to diverse academic disciplines. We develop and test a system with subject-aware prompting, based on 14 pedagogical features (e.g., tutor scaffolding, student understanding) extracted from raw transcripts. We first train a prompt routing model in a simulation environment, and then deploy it for online adaptation with actual high-school students. The simulation benchmark shows the router outperforming two static baselines ($0.694$ vs. $0.647$ and $0.64$, $p<0.001$). A/B testing ($N=656$ conversations from 359 students) shows sim-to-real transfer where the model switches from analytical to scaffolding learning strategies. Our adaptive prompt selection mechanism improves instructional efficiency, maintains pedagogical quality and reduces interactions by around 3 turns ($p=0.007$). While a greedy router achieves a comparable exercise conversion rate with the baseline ($19.1\%$ vs. $19.6\%$), a stochastic router that samples strategies leads to a higher conversion rate ($28.1\%$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于学科感知提示（subject-aware prompting）的自适应LLM辅导系统，通过从原始对话记录中提取14种教学特征（如教师脚手架、学生理解度），训练提示路由模型，并在模拟环境和真实高中生中测试。模拟基准测试显示路由模型优于两个静态基线（0.694 vs. 0.647和0.64，p<0.001）。A/B测试（359名学生，656次对话）展示了从模拟到真实的迁移，模型从分析策略切换到脚手架策略。自适应提示选择机制提高了教学效率，维持了教学质量，并减少了约3轮交互（p=0.007）。贪心路由器的练习转换率与基线相当（19.1% vs. 19.6%），而随机路由器的转换率更高（28.1%）。
Motivation: 现有静态提示辅导系统难以适应不同学科，需要一种能动态调整教学策略的自适应方法。
Method: 基于14种教学特征（如教师脚手架、学生理解度）训练提示路由模型，先在模拟环境中训练，再部署到真实高中学生中进行在线自适应。
Result: 模拟中路由模型优于静态基线（0.694 vs. 0.647和0.64，p<0.001）；A/B测试显示模拟到真实的迁移，减少约3轮交互（p=0.007），随机路由器实现更高转换率（28.1% vs. 19.6%）。
Conclusion: 自适应提示选择机制能提高教学效率并保持质量，随机路由策略比贪心策略更有效，但需要进一步研究平衡探索与利用。

papers.title: PASQA: Pitch-Accent-Focused Speech Quality Assessment Model Trained on Synthetic Speech with Accent Errors
papers.abstract_en: Existing mean opinion score (MOS) prediction models typically predict utterance-level naturalness MOS and can be insensitive to localized pitch-accent errors. We propose Pitch-Accent-focused Speech Quality Assessment (PASQA), which explicitly targets pitch-accent correctness. To train our model, we construct a controlled Japanese accent-error dataset by changing accent patterns using an accent-controllable text-to-speech system, and compute a pseudo accent-quality score from the accent-error rate. PASQA builds on self-supervised representations and employs mora-conditioned fusion, ranking loss, an auxiliary accent-error localization task, and speaker-invariant training. Experiments show that conventional models fail to preserve the ordering by accent-error severity, whereas PASQA achieves high ordering accuracy on both seen and unseen speakers. Further, PASQA shows stronger agreement with human accent-correctness judgments. The code is available at https://github.com/lycorp-jp/PASQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有平均意见得分（MOS）预测模型对局部音高重音错误不敏感的问题，提出了专注于音高重音正确性的语音质量评估模型PASQA。通过可控制重音的TTS系统构建日语重音错误数据集，并利用自监督表示、mora条件融合、排序损失、辅助重音错误定位任务和说话者不变训练，模型在重音错误严重性排序和与人类一致性上优于传统方法。
Motivation: 现有MOS预测模型通常预测语句级自然度，对局部音高重音错误不敏感，而重音错误在语音质量评估中很重要。
Method: 提出PASQA模型，基于自监督表示，采用mora条件融合、排序损失、辅助重音错误定位任务和说话者不变训练；同时通过可控制重音的TTS系统构建带重音错误标签的数据集，并计算伪重音质量分数。
Result: 传统模型无法按重音错误严重性保持顺序，而PASQA在见过的和未见过的说话者上均实现了高排序准确性，且与人类重音正确性判断的一致性更强。
Conclusion: PASQA有效针对音高重音正确性进行评估，弥补了现有MOS模型的不足，代码已开源。

papers.title: Frequency-Aware Flow Matching for Continuous and Consistent Robotic Action Generation
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has emerged as a standard paradigm for robotic manipulation owing to its strong expressive power for modelling complex, multimodal action distributions, alongside similar approaches like diffusion policy. However, existing methods rely on discretized action chunks, making them brittle to demonstrations collected at heterogeneous control frequencies and prone to temporally inconsistent actions that degrade control stability. In this paper, we propose Frequency-Aware Flow Matching (FAFM), which outputs continuous, temporally consistent actions. To handle heterogeneous frequency input, we transform discrete action sequences into the frequency domain with the discrete cosine transform (DCT), perform flow matching over the resulting coefficients, and reconstruct continuous actions via cosine basis expansion. To generate temporally consistent actions, we regularize the first-order temporal derivative to promote smooth actions. This corresponds to a Sobolev-type constraint that suppresses high-frequency errors and discourages abrupt action changes. Our FAFM is simple, introduces no additional network parameters and applies to standalone flow-matching policies and vision-language action models. Across synthetic toy benchmark, obstacle avoidance, LapGym, and LIBERO, FAFM improves success rates, multimodal expressivity, motion smoothness, convergence speed, robustness to mechanical bias and mixed-frequency input. These gains are consistent when deployed on a real-world Franka robot. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FAFM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出频率感知流匹配（FAFM），用于机器人操作中连续且时间一致的动作生成。现有方法依赖离散动作块，对异质控制频率鲁棒性差且动作时间不一致。FAFM通过离散余弦变换将动作序列转换到频域，在频域执行流匹配，并通过余弦基展开重建连续动作；同时引入一阶时间导数正则化（Sobolev约束）抑制高频误差与突变。方法无需额外参数，可应用于独立流匹配策略和视觉-语言动作模型。在合成玩具基准、避障、LapGym、LIBERO及真实Franka机器人上，FAFM提升了成功率、多模态表达能力、运动平滑性、收敛速度及对机械偏差和混合频率输入的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有流匹配方法基于离散动作块，难以处理异质控制频率采集的演示数据，且生成动作时间不一致，影响控制稳定性。
Method: 将离散动作序列通过离散余弦变换（DCT）映射到频域，对频域系数进行流匹配，再通过余弦基展开重建连续动作；同时用一阶时间导数正则化（Sobolev约束）促进动作平滑。
Result: 在合成避障、LapGym、LIBERO等基准及真实Franka机器人上，FAFM在成功率、多模态表达、运动平滑性、收敛速度、对机械偏差和混合频率输入的鲁棒性上均有提升。
Conclusion: FAFM是一种简单、无额外参数的流匹配改进方法，可生成连续且时间一致的动作，适用于多种机器人策略。

papers.title: TriFlow: Generating Artist-Like 3D Mesh Topology via Nearest-Vertex Vector Fields
papers.abstract_en: We present TriFlow, a new generative approach for producing compact 3D meshes with artist-like triangle topology directly from input geometry conditions such as signed distance fields. Our key insight is to represent mesh topology as a nearest-vertex vector field (NVF) defined over the surface, where each point encodes its association to the nearest triangle vertex in the local barycentric frame. We train a latent flow-matching model to synthesize this field, enabling topology generation conditioned on the input geometry. To extract a coherent mesh, we cluster surface regions using the generated NVF and guide a constrained quadric error metric (QEM) mesh simplification with topology-aware optimization. This yields output meshes that closely match the input geometry while exhibiting structured, artist-like connectivity. Experiments demonstrate that TriFlow achieves stronger generalization and significantly improved topology quality compared to state-of-the-art learning-based approaches, alongside 90% lower Chamfer Distance and an 8x speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TriFlow，一种从输入几何条件（如符号距离场）生成具有艺术家般三角形拓扑的紧凑3D网格的新方法。核心思想是将网格拓扑表示为表面上的最近顶点向量场（NVF），训练潜在流匹配模型合成该场，再通过聚类和约束二次误差度量（QEM）简化提取连贯网格。实验表明，相比现有基于学习的方法，TriFlow 泛化更强、拓扑质量更优，且 Chamfer 距离降低 90%、速度提升 8 倍。
Motivation: 现有方法难以自动生成紧凑且具有艺术家般连接性的3D网格拓扑，通常需要繁琐的手动调整或低效的后处理。
Method: 将网格拓扑建模为表面上的最近顶点向量场（NVF），每个点编码到最近三角形顶点的关联；训练潜在流匹配模型以输入几何为条件生成 NVF；随后通过聚类表面区域并引导约束 QEM 简化，拓扑感知优化提取最终网格。
Result: 在多个基准上，TriFlow 相比 SOTA 学习方法的 Chamfer 距离降低 90%，速度提升 8 倍，且拓扑质量更优、泛化性更强。
Conclusion: TriFlow 能有效从任意输入几何生成艺术家般的紧凑网格拓扑，无需手工干预。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAM3 Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained GOOSE 2D Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: We describe our 4th-place entry to the ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge, which reached a composite mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) of 69.73% on the official 1,815-image test set. Our model adapts the image encoder of a recent visual foundation model, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3), with a lightweight decoder. Beyond this, we contribute two techniques and one empirical finding: (i) a self-distillation scheme that re-uses SAM3 itself, prompted with ground-truth boxes, as a teacher on the classes where it outperforms our own model; (ii) an image-level multi-scale test-time augmentation scheme that restores multi-scale inference for a fixed-input-size model by rescaling the image rather than the model input; and (iii) the finding that an aggressive photometric distortion from a winning 2025 GOOSE 2D entry, transplanted onto our pipeline, is its single largest source of improvement.
papers.comment: 4th place in ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Semantic Segmentation Challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述了ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D精细语义分割挑战赛的第四名方案。该方法基于Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3)的图像编码器，搭配轻量级解码器，并提出了自蒸馏机制（利用SAM3本身作为教师）、图像级多尺度测试增强以及激进的光度失真数据增强。在官方1,815图像测试集上达到69.73% composite mIoU。
Motivation: 针对GOOSE 2D精细语义分割任务，需要提升模型在细粒度类别上的分割精度。
Method: 采用SAM3图像编码器+轻量级解码器；提出自蒸馏方案，在SAM3优于模型的类别上用其作为教师；引入图像级多尺度测试增强（通过缩放图像而非模型输入）；并移植了2025年获胜方案中的激进光度失真数据增强。
Result: 在官方测试集上达到69.73% composite mIoU，获得ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D语义分割挑战赛第四名。
Conclusion: 自蒸馏、多尺度测试增强和光度失真数据增强是主要贡献，其中光度失真增强是单一最大改进来源。

papers.title: The Correctness Illusion in LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for LLM-generated GPU kernels (KernelBench, TritonBench, GEAK) score correctness through fixed-shape, small-sample allclose-style checks. The number of inputs varies between benchmarks. The shape, dtype, and tolerance are fixed for each kernel. We test that oracle empirically. We construct a controlled corpus of 24 Triton and CPU stand-in kernels (15 correct controls and 9 LLM-style buggy variants seeded with documented transcription errors) and re-evaluate it under op-schema-aware seeded fuzzing with a high-precision (fp64) CPU reference and per-(op, dtype) absolute tolerances. The seeded oracle flags 9 of 9 buggy kernels and passes 15 of 15 correct controls, at zero precision cost on controls. We extend the corpus to 26 ops (adding a flash-attention pair) and re-run the same protocol on five GPU classes (RTX 3060, A10, L40S, A100 SXM4, H100 NVL). The verdicts are identical across all five GPUs: 10 of 10 illusions caught and 16 of 16 controls clean. The corpus result is about LLM-style transcription bugs that the allclose-on-one-shape oracle certifies as correct, not about the bug rate of any specific deployed LLM. Every flagged failure replays byte-for-byte from a stored seed.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, LNCS format. Companion papers to follow on arXiv next week; IDs will be added in a v2 replace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑LLM生成GPU内核基准测试（如KernelBench）中基于固定形状、小样本allclose检查的正确性。作者构建了24个Triton和CPU内核（15个正确控制、9个LLM风格的错误变体），并使用op-schema感知的种子模糊测试和fp64高精度参考重新评估，发现该种子oracle能正确识别所有错误和控制内核。扩展到26个操作和5种GPU，结果一致：所有10个错觉被捕获，16个控制通过。
Motivation: 现有LLM生成GPU内核的基准测试通过固定形状、小样本allclose检查判断正确性，可能将错误标记为正确，产生“正确性幻觉”，需要更鲁棒的评估方法。
Method: 构建一个包含24个Triton和CPU内核的控制语料库（15个正确控制，9个包含LLM风格转录错误的变体），使用基于操作模式感知的种子模糊测试（op-schema-aware seeded fuzzing），以fp64 CPU参考和每个操作及dtype的绝对容差重新评估。随后将语料库扩展到26个操作（增加flash-attention对），并在5种GPU（RTX 3060、A10、L40S、A100 SXM4、H100 NVL）上重复相同协议。
Result: 种子oracle在原始24个内核上零误差地识别了所有9个错误内核和15个正确控制。在5种GPU上扩展测试后，所有10个错误变体（“幻觉”）被捕获，16个正确控制通过，且判断结果在五种GPU上完全一致。
Conclusion: 该研究揭示了固定形状allclose检查可能掩盖LLM风格转录错误的问题，提出了一种更严格的评估协议，但该结果针对特定类型的转录错误，而非任何特定部署LLM的bug率。所有检测到的失败均可从存储的种子逐字节重放。

summary_sections.method: 构建一个包含24个Triton和CPU内核的控制语料库（15个正确控制，9个包含LLM风格转录错误的变体），使用基于操作模式感知的种子模糊测试（op-schema-aware seeded fuzzing），以fp64 CPU参考和每个操作及dtype的绝对容差重新评估。随后将语料库扩展到26个操作（增加flash-attention对），并在5种GPU（RTX 3060、A10、L40S、A100 SXM4、H100 NVL）上重复相同协议。
summary_sections.result: 种子oracle在原始24个内核上零误差地识别了所有9个错误内核和15个正确控制。在5种GPU上扩展测试后，所有10个错误变体（“幻觉”）被捕获，16个正确控制通过，且判断结果在五种GPU上完全一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该研究揭示了固定形状allclose检查可能掩盖LLM风格转录错误的问题，提出了一种更严格的评估协议，但该结果针对特定类型的转录错误，而非任何特定部署LLM的bug率。所有检测到的失败均可从存储的种子逐字节重放。

papers.title: ScaffoldAgent: Utility-Guided Dynamic Outline Optimization for Open-Ended Deep Research
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended deep research (OEDR) requires systems to acquire knowledge through multi-round retrieval and generate coherent long-form reports. The outline plays a central role as a structural scaffold that coordinates retrieval, evidence organization, and generation. However, existing methods either fix the outline before writing or refine it with local heuristics, leading to scaffold drift under continuous information accumulation and delayed feedback for evaluating outline modifications. We propose ScaffoldAgent, a utility-guided dynamic outline optimization framework for OEDR. ScaffoldAgent models outline evolution as a structured decision process with three operations: Expansion, Contraction, and Revision, enabling controlled updates to the report scaffold. It further introduces a utility-guided feedback mechanism that estimates the downstream value of each outline operation from retrieval gain, structural coherence, and trial-generation quality. The resulting utility signal guides node selection, operation scheduling, and termination during inference. Experiments on DeepResearch Bench and DeepResearch Gym show that ScaffoldAgent consistently improves long-form report generation and factual grounding over existing deep research agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ScaffoldAgent，一种基于效用的动态提纲优化框架，用于开放域深度研究（OEDR）。该框架将提纲演化建模为结构化决策过程，包含扩展、收缩和修订三种操作，并通过效用引导的反馈机制评估每次操作的下游价值，从而优化多轮检索和长文本生成。实验表明，ScaffoldAgent在DeepResearch Bench和DeepResearch Gym上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有OEDR方法在提纲更新上存在局限：要么固定提纲，要么依赖局部启发式调整，导致持续信息积累下提纲漂移且修改反馈延迟。
Method: 提出效用引导的动态提纲优化框架，将提纲演化建模为扩展、收缩、修订三种操作的决策过程，引入效用反馈机制，从检索增益、结构连贯性和试生成质量评估操作价值，指导节点选择、操作调度和终止。
Result: 在DeepResearch Bench和DeepResearch Gym基准上，ScaffoldAgent持续改进了长文本报告生成和事实基础。
Conclusion: 效用引导的动态提纲优化能有效协调检索与生成，避免提纲漂移，提升开放域深度研究的整体质量。

papers.title: Dual-Agent Framework for Cross-Model Verified Translation of Natural-Language Protocols into Robotic Laboratory Platform
papers.abstract_en: Biological experiment protocols are written in natural language, whereas automation systems rely on predefined control commands, creating a semantic gap that limits autonomous execution. Microplate-based automatic experiments are particularly challenging due to the need to simultaneously control well mapping, sample-reagent combinations, replicate placement, and parallel dispensing. This study proposes an agent-based protocol translation framework that converts natural-language microplate-based protocols into executable control commands for a robotic laboratory platform. A Parser Agent formalizes the natural-language protocol into a structured representation, and a rule-based mapping engine deterministically incorporates the operational constraints of the robotic laboratory platform to generate device-level control commands. A heterogeneous LLM Validation Agent verifies completeness, parameter accuracy, and execution order, and triggers a self-correction loop with structured feedback when errors are detected. A sweep involving 7 Parsers and 3 Validators on randomly selected ELISA protocols evaluates how model scale and Validator type affect translation accuracy and pass rates under cross-model verification. The accuracy-latency trade-off is further verified by comparing the rule-based mapping of the proposed framework with LLM end-to-end direct mapping. Finally, Bradford assay-based protein quantification using a microplate was demonstrated on a robotic laboratory platform, validating end-to-end autonomous execution from natural-language protocols to real-world experiments. The proposed framework provides a flexible approach to narrowing the semantic gap between natural-language protocols and microplate-based self-driving laboratories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个双智能体框架，将自然语言描述的微孔板生物实验协议转化为机器人平台的可执行控制命令。解析器将协议结构化，基于规则的映射引擎生成设备级命令，异构LLM验证器检查完整性和参数准确性并触发自纠错循环。在ELISA协议上评估了不同模型规模和验证器类型的影响，并在Bradford蛋白定量实验中验证了端到端自主执行。
Motivation: 生物实验协议以自然语言编写，而自动化系统依赖预定义控制命令，语义鸿沟限制了自主执行，尤其微孔板自动实验需要同时控制孔映射、样本试剂组合、重复排布和并行分配，增加了复杂性。
Method: 提出双智能体框架：解析器代理将自然语言协议形式化为结构化表示；基于规则的映射引擎确定性地融入机器人平台操作约束生成控制命令；异构LLM验证代理验证完整性、参数准确性和执行顺序，检测错误时触发自纠错循环。
Result: 在随机选取的ELISA协议上，通过7个解析器和3个验证器的扫描评估了模型规模和验证器类型对翻译准确率和通过率的影响；比较了规则映射与LLM端到端直接映射的精度-延迟权衡；在机器人平台上演示了Bradford法蛋白定量，验证了从自然语言到真实实验的端到端自主执行。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种灵活的方法来缩小自然语言协议与微孔板自驱动实验室之间的语义鸿沟。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pose6DAug: Physically Plausible Multi-view Object Swapping for Robot Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have shown strong potential for general-purpose manipulation, yet they often fail on novel, out-of-distribution objects whose appearance or geometry deviates from the training distribution. The standard remedy is to collect multi-view teleoperation data for every failure case, but this scales poorly in both cost and time. We introduce Pose6DAug, a failure-driven data augmentation framework that turns a policy's own successful episodes into targeted demonstrations for its failure modes, without any new data collection. Our key insight is that each successful episode already encodes a physically valid action trajectory together with calibrated multi-view observations. By swapping only the manipulated object while preserving this trajectory, we obtain new and physically grounded demonstrations. However, naive 2D video editing breaks multi-view consistency and physical plausibility, particularly under heavy occlusion and egocentric viewpoints. Our method instead operates directly in 3D, anchoring the target object with an explicit mesh driven by a temporally coherent 6D pose trajectory, ensuring geometrically consistent renderings across all camera views. Fine-tuning a VLA on data augmented by our method improves success rates by 16.5% relative to the state-of-the-art baseline on novel objects, while preserving in-distribution performance. These results show that multi-view and physically consistent augmentation is a practical path to scalable VLA generalization.

TL;DR: 提出 Pose6DAug 数据增强框架，利用成功轨迹中的 6D 位姿轨迹在 3D 空间交换物体，生成多视图一致的物理可行演示，用于微调 VLA 策略，无需额外数据收集。在新型物体上相对基线提升 16.5% 成功率。
Motivation: VLA 策略在分布外物体上泛化差，收集新数据成本高且效率低。
Method: 基于成功轨迹中的 6D 位姿轨迹，在 3D 空间锚定目标物体网格，进行时间一致的 6D 位姿追踪，确保多视图几何一致性渲染。
Result: 在新型物体上相对现有最佳基线提升 16.5% 成功率，且保持分布内性能。
Conclusion: 多视图物理一致的增强是扩缩 VLA 泛化的实用路径，无需新数据收集。

papers.title: When Calibration Fails the Vulnerable Hospital: Federated Conformal Risk Control via Risk-Curve Shrinkage
papers.abstract_en: Conformal risk control (CRC) provides distribution-free guarantees on segmentation quality by calibrating a prediction-set threshold on held-out data. In federated deployments, the standard approach pools calibration scores across sites into a single threshold. We provide the first quantification, on real multi-institutional brain tumor data (FeTS-2022, 1,251 subjects, 20 institutions), showing that this naive pooled CRC protects the average hospital but violates coverage at 40% of individual institutions, with the worst site exceeding the target false-negative rate by 7.8 percentage points. The naive alternative, per-site local CRC, largely restores coverage but inflates prediction sets by 83x, rendering them clinically useless. We propose a shrinkage-based federated CRC protocol: each site transmits only its empirical risk curve (G scalars) to a server, which computes a shrinkage-regularized threshold per site. A single hyperparameter n0 smoothly trades worst-case coverage for prediction-set efficiency; leave-one-site-out sensitivity analysis identifies n0=19, achieving 2.7/20 violations at 2.0x stretch. We further show that direct Lagrangian optimization of coverage budgets fails, concentrating risk on vulnerable hospitals, and that the finite-sample correction term is essential: removing it triples violations. The marginal CRC guarantee is preserved by construction under the stated site-mixture assumption; per-site coverage is validated across four targets with three seeds. No patient-level images, masks, or per-volume scores leave any site.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the DeCaF Workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在真实多机构脑肿瘤数据集（FeTS-2022，20家机构，1251例）上量化了联邦共形风险控制（CRC）中简单池化校准的失败：平均医院受到保护，但40%的个体机构违反覆盖，最差机构假阴性率超目标7.8个百分点。替代方案逐机构本地CRC虽恢复覆盖，但预测集膨胀83倍，临床不可用。作者提出基于收缩的联邦CRC协议，各机构仅传输经验风险曲线（G个标量）到服务器，服务器计算收缩正则化阈值，单个超参数n0平滑权衡最坏情况覆盖与预测集效率；留一机构敏感性分析确定n0=19，实现2.7/20违规且预测集仅扩大2.0倍。
Motivation: 标准联邦共形风险控制（CRC）通过池化各机构校准分数得到一个全局阈值，但在真实多机构数据上（FeTS-2022）被发现不能保护每个个体机构，导致部分机构（尤其是脆弱医院）覆盖不足，而逐机构本地CRC又会导致预测集过度膨胀，临床无用。
Method: 提出基于收缩的联邦CRC协议：每个机构只上传其经验风险曲线（G个标量值）到服务器，服务器使用收缩正则化为每个机构计算阈值。通过单个超参数n0平滑平衡最坏情况覆盖与预测集效率，并通过留一机构敏感性分析选择n0。
Result: 在FeTS-2022数据集上，所提方法（n0=19）实现2.7/20机构违规（即仅约2.7个机构违反覆盖），预测集仅扩大2.0倍；相比之下，池化CRC有40%机构违规，最坏机构假阴性率超目标7.8个百分点；本地CRC预测集扩大83倍。直接拉格朗日优化覆盖预算会失败，将风险集中在脆弱医院；有限样本修正项至关重要，移除它将使违规数量翻三倍。
Conclusion: 所提收缩联邦CRC协议在给定机构混合假设下保留了边际CRC保证，跨四个目标和三个种子验证了逐机构覆盖有效性。该方法不需要传输患者级图像、掩膜或每体积分数，保护了隐私。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Pixel-Level Residual Diffusion Transformer: Scalable 3D CT Volume Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-resolution 3D CT volumes with fine details remains challenging due to substantial computational demands and optimization difficulties inherent to existing generative models. In this paper, we propose the Pixel-Level Residual Diffusion Transformer (PRDiT), a scalable generative framework that synthesizes high-quality 3D medical volumes directly at voxel-level. PRDiT introduces a two-stage training architecture comprising 1) a local denoiser in the form of an MLP-based blind estimator operating on overlapping 3D patches to separate low-frequency structures efficiently, and 2) a global residual diffusion transformer employing memory-efficient attention to model and refine high-frequency residuals across entire volumes. This coarse-to-fine modeling strategy simplifies optimization, enhances training stability, and effectively preserves subtle structures without the limitations of an autoencoder bottleneck. Extensive experiments conducted on the LIDC-IDRI and RAD-ChestCT datasets demonstrate that PRDiT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models, such as HA-GAN, 3D LDM and WDM-3D, achieving significantly lower 3D FID, MMD and Wasserstein distance scores.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Fredy-Zhang/PRDiT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出像素级残差扩散 Transformer（PRDiT），一种可扩展的生成框架，用于直接体素级合成高质量 3D CT 体积。该方法采用两阶段训练架构：1) 基于 MLP 的局部盲估计器在重叠 3D 补丁上分离低频结构；2) 全局残差扩散 Transformer 利用内存高效注意力建模和精炼全体积的高频残差。在 LIDC-IDRI 和 RAD-ChestCT 数据集上，PRDiT 在 3D FID、MMD 和 Wasserstein 距离上显著优于 HA-GAN、3D LDM 和 WDM-3D 等现有模型。
Motivation: 高分辨率 3D CT 体积生成面临巨大的计算需求和优化困难，现有生成模型难以在保留细微结构的同时实现高质量生成。
Method: 提出两阶段粗到细建模：第一阶段使用 MLP 盲估计器在局部 3D 补丁上高效分离低频结构；第二阶段使用全局残差扩散 Transformer 对全体积的高频残差进行建模和精炼，采用内存高效注意力机制。
Result: 在 LIDC-IDRI 和 RAD-ChestCT 数据集上，PRDiT 在 3D FID、MMD 和 Wasserstein 距离指标上均优于 HA-GAN、3D LDM 和 WDM-3D 等最新模型。
Conclusion: 这种粗到细策略简化了优化过程，提升了训练稳定性，无需自编码器瓶颈即可有效保留细微结构。

papers.title: FrozenDrive: Zero-Shot Text-Guided Driving Scene Generation and Data Augmentation with Parameter-Free Frozen Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data for autonomous driving is surging, powered by diffusion models that promise scalable scene generation. Yet key obstacles remain, as enforcing multi-view and temporal consistency often relies on backbone fine-tuning or added layers, which erodes pre-trained knowledge and weakens text alignment. Models also stay close to the training distribution, struggling under adverse weather and unseen configurations, and fidelity favors frequent over rare classes. We address these gaps with FrozenDrive, a controllable generative framework that preserves a pretrained diffusion models knowledge while achieving strong consistency. FrozenDrive conditions on rich driving-stack signals and text prompts, and introduces knowledge-preserving spatio-temporal attention to impose cross-view alignment and temporal coherence in a single pass within a parameter-free frozen diffusion backbone. An additional object-focused constraint improves per-object fidelity for rare categories. Without any weather- or scene-specific fine-tuning, our model synthesizes globally coherent multi-view driving scenes from text, particularly under adverse and rare conditions, and surpasses prior baselines. On nuScenes, FrozenDrive augmented data significantly improves AD models performance, especially at night and in rain, demonstrating stronger robustness when trained with our scenario-targeted data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FrozenDrive，一个无需微调即可保持预训练扩散模型知识的可控生成框架，用于零样本文本引导的驾驶场景生成和数据增强。通过引入知识保留的时空注意力，在参数冻结的扩散骨干中实现多视图和时间一致性，并添加对象聚焦约束以改善罕见类别的每对象保真度。在nuScenes上，生成的增强数据显著提升夜间和雨天等恶劣条件下的自动驾驶模型性能。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型生成驾驶场景时，为保持多视图和时间一致性通常需要微调骨干或添加层，这会破坏预训练知识并削弱文本对齐；同时模型难以处理恶劣天气和罕见配置，且倾向于高频类别。
Method: 提出FrozenDrive框架，采用参数冻结的扩散模型，通过知识保留的时空注意力在单次前向传播中实现跨视图对齐和时间一致性，并引入对象聚焦约束提升罕见类别的保真度。
Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，FrozenDrive生成的增强数据显著提升了自动驾驶模型在夜间和雨天等条件下的性能，尤其在恶劣和罕见场景下优于先前基线。
Conclusion: 无需针对天气或场景微调，FrozenDrive能够从文本合成全局一致的驾驶场景，并有效提升自动驾驶模型的鲁棒性。

papers.title: EFIQA: Explainable Fundus Image Quality Assessment via Anatomical Priors
papers.abstract_en: Image quality control is vital for a wide range of downstream applications. Deep learning-based image quality assessment methods typically train classifiers on dataset-specific quality labels, inheriting two limitations: (1) generalization is tied to the labeling criteria of the training set and (2) these methods cannot provide spatial feedback on where the quality is degraded, lacking explainability. In this work, we propose EFIQA, a framework that requires no quality-related supervision and produces spatial quality maps by design. Rather than learning ``what is degradation" from human-annotated labels, EFIQA learns ``what should be there" by leveraging anatomical priors. For fundus photography, we instantiate this as a two-stage approach, by first training an unsupervised anomaly detector via masked anatomical inpainting to identify regions of missing vasculature, and then distilling this prior knowledge into a shallow adapter mapping features of a frozen foundation model to precise quality maps. External-dataset evaluation demonstrates that this label-free approach with minimal adaptation achieves better performance and explainability compared with supervised methods across benchmarks with different quality criteria, highlighting its potential for real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EFIQA，一种无需质量标签的眼底图像质量评估框架，通过解剖先验生成空间质量图。该方法先训练无监督异常检测器（基于掩膜解剖修复）识别缺失血管区域，再将先验知识蒸馏到浅层适配器中，利用冻结的视觉基础模型生成质量图。外部数据集评估表明，该无标签方法在多个不同质量标准的基准上性能优于有监督方法，且具备可解释性。
Motivation: 现有深度学习的图像质量评估方法依赖数据集特定的质量标签，导致泛化受限且缺乏空间反馈（无法指出质量退化位置）。
Method: 两阶段方法：先通过掩膜解剖修复（masked anatomical inpainting）训练无监督异常检测器，学习眼底解剖先验（如血管结构）；然后将先验知识蒸馏到一个浅层适配器中，该适配器将冻结的视觉基础模型特征映射为精确的质量图。
Result: 在外部数据集评估中，该无监督方法在多个不同质量标注标准的基准上，相较于有监督方法取得了更好的性能与可解释性。
Conclusion: EFIQA展示了利用解剖先验实现无需标签、可解释的图像质量评估的潜力，尤其适用于真实世界应用。

papers.title: Quantile of Means: A Bonus-Free Ensemble Method for Minimax Optimal Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Optimal Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms typically rely on carefully constructed count-based uncertainty estimates to drive exploration. Although theoretically sound, such estimates are hard to compute in practical settings and therefore offer limited insight for designing exploration heuristics. Meanwhile, ensembling has emerged as a practical approach, but remains without theoretical justification. Building on a recent ensemble-based method for Multi-Armed Bandits, we propose a quantile-based ensemble method for finite-horizon Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). Our simple count-free approach achieves optimal variance-dependent regret bounds, providing theoretical grounding for ensemble-based exploration in RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于分位数的集成方法（Quantile of Means）用于有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，无需显式的计数不确定性估计，即可实现最优的方差依赖遗憾界，为基于集成的探索提供了理论依据。
Motivation: 现有最优强化学习算法依赖精心构造的基于计数的不确定性估计，这些估计在实践中难以计算，而集成方法虽有实际效果但缺乏理论支持。
Method: 基于多臂老虎机中的分位数集成方法，将其扩展到有限时域MDP，提出一种无需计数、仅依赖分位数的集成探索策略。
Result: 该方法达到了最优的方差依赖遗憾界，证明了基于集成的探索在理论上的最优性。
Conclusion: 该工作为强化学习中基于集成的探索提供了第一个理论保证，表明无计数方法也能实现最优遗憾。

papers.title: Sensorimotor World Models: Perception for Action via Inverse Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Perception for action suggests that representations of the world should be shaped not by visual fidelity alone, but by their relevance for actions. At the same time, latent JEPA-style world models advocate learning compact predictive states from high-dimensional observations to facilitate the prediction of future states, but end-to-end training of these models is nontrivial because representations may collapse if our only goal is to construct a latent state that is easy to predict. We introduce a sensorimotor world model (SMWM): a latent world model trained end-to-end with inverse dynamics regularization. This single regularizer addresses both issues: it prevents representation collapse and induces action-aligned representations. By forcing latent states to preserve information about the action underlying a transition, it biases the model toward the controllable degrees of freedom of the environment while discarding uncontrollable distractors. This yields stable latent world models trained from offline, reward-free trajectories, without frozen encoders, exponential moving averages, or complex latent regularizers. Empirically, SMWM learns compact, interpretable latent spaces and enables competitive planning performance across simple 2D and 3D control tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出传感器运动世界模型（SMWM），一种通过逆动力学正则化端到端训练的潜空间世界模型。该正则化同时防止表征坍塌并诱导与动作对齐的表示，使模型偏向环境中的可控自由度，忽略不可控干扰，从而从离线、无奖励轨迹中学习稳定的潜空间。在简单2D和3D控制任务上，SMWM 学习到紧凑、可解释的潜空间，并实现有竞争力的规划性能。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 风格世界模型端到端训练时，若仅以预测未来潜状态为目标，容易导致表征坍塌；同时，感知应为行动服务的观点要求表示与动作相关，而不仅仅是视觉保真。
Method: 提出逆动力学正则化：在训练潜世界模型时，强制潜状态保留关于转移动作的信息，从而偏向环境的可控自由度，丢弃不可控干扰。无需冻结编码器、指数移动平均或复杂潜正则化器。
Result: 在简单2D和3D控制任务上，SMWM 学习到紧凑、可解释的潜空间，并取得有竞争力的规划性能。
Conclusion: 逆动力学正则化能同时解决表征坍塌和动作对齐问题，提供一种简单有效的端到端训练潜世界模型的方法。

papers.title: Geometry-Preserving in 3D Gaussian Splatting for LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Accurate LiDAR-camera calibration is essential for robust multi-modal perception. Targetless approaches avoid manual setup but remain limited by the scarcity of discriminative cross-modal features. Recent methods address this by reconstructing the scene within a differentiable model, enabling extrinsic optimization through dense photometric supervision. Among these, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has been widely adopted as a geometric proxy that bridges LiDAR and camera within a single differentiable framework. However, since 3DGS was originally designed for novel view synthesis, existing methods tend to prioritize rendering quality, causing the proxy geometry to drift from the true LiDAR structure. We propose a framework that preserves the metric geometry of the Gaussian proxy by aggregating multi-view LiDAR observations for dense depth supervision and blocking photometric gradients from updating the Gaussian spatial parameters. We validate our method on public driving datasets, where it consistently outperforms existing targetless methods in calibration accuracy.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 15 pages (excluding references), 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LiDAR-相机外参标定中现有3DGS方法因优先渲染质量导致代理几何偏离真实LiDAR结构的问题，提出一种几何保持框架。该框架通过聚合多视图LiDAR观测提供密集深度监督，并阻止光度梯度更新高斯空间参数，从而保持高斯代理的度量几何。在公开驾驶数据集上，该方法在标定精度上持续优于现有无靶标方法。
Motivation: 现有基于3DGS的无靶标标定方法因专注于渲染质量，使得代理几何偏离真实LiDAR结构，限制了标定精度。
Method: 提出框架通过聚合多视图LiDAR观测生成密集深度监督，并阻止光度梯度反向传播至高斯空间参数，从而保持高斯代理的度量几何。
Result: 在公开驾驶数据集上，该方法在标定精度上一致优于现有无靶标方法。
Conclusion: 保持高斯代理的度量几何能有效提升LiDAR-相机标定精度，验证了阻止光度梯度干扰空间参数的有效性。

papers.title: Hybrid Diffusion Transformer for Instruction-Guided Audio Editing via Rectified Flow
papers.abstract_en: Audio editing aims to modify specific content in an existing audio clip according to a natural language instruction while preserving the remaining acoustic content. Despite the remarkable progress of diffusion models, existing training-based editing methods mainly rely on the local inductive biases and cross-attention interaction in convolutional U-Net backbones, which often hinder long-range semantic alignment and precise understanding and localization of instructions. In contrast, diffusion transformers provide stronger global modeling and multimodal fusion, but existing editing architectures usually adopt a simple stack of MMDiT and DiT blocks. Applying joint attention over concatenated audio and text tokens in all blocks results in quadratic complexity with respect to token length. To balance editing performance and efficiency, we propose a hybrid two-stage diffusion transformer architecture for instruction-guided audio editing based on rectified flow matching. It performs joint attention over audio and text tokens to establish coarse semantic alignment at low-resolution stage, then switches to alternating joint-attention and cross-attention blocks to refine editing details at high-resolution stage. This coarse-to-fine strategy enables efficient and accurate instruction-guided audio editing. Experiments show that the proposed framework achieves notable performance gains on challenging editing tasks involving overlapping audio events and complex instructions, while substantially improving editing efficiency with a compact model.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于整流流匹配的混合两阶段扩散变压器架构，用于指令引导的音频编辑。该架构在低分辨率阶段对音频和文本令牌进行联合注意力以建立粗略语义对齐，在高分辨率阶段交替使用联合注意力和交叉注意力块来细化编辑细节，从而在保持编辑效率的同时提升性能。实验表明，该方法在涉及重叠音频事件和复杂指令的编辑任务上取得了显著性能提升。
Motivation: 现有基于训练的音频编辑方法多采用卷积U-Net骨干，其局部归纳偏置和交叉注意力交互限制了长距离语义对齐和指令的精确理解与定位；而现有扩散变压器架构简单堆叠MMDiT和DiT块，对所有令牌进行联合注意力导致二次复杂度，效率低下。
Method: 提出混合两阶段扩散变压器架构：低分辨率阶段执行音频和文本令牌的联合注意力以实现粗略语义对齐，高分辨率阶段切换为交替的联合注意力块和交叉注意力块以细化编辑细节。整个框架基于整流流匹配进行训练。
Result: 在涉及重叠音频事件和复杂指令的挑战性编辑任务上取得显著性能提升，同时以紧凑模型大幅提高编辑效率。
Conclusion: 该粗到细策略能有效平衡音频编辑的性能与效率，为指令引导音频编辑提供了一种新的高效架构。

papers.title: WeGenBench: A Multidimensional Diagnostic Benchmark towards Text-to-Image Model Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-image generation models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in synthesizing highly realistic images from text inputs alone. Although existing benchmarks can evaluate the generation capabilities of various models to some extent, they struggle to comprehensively and accurately measure performance across multiple dimensions, often failing to reveal the inherent deficiencies of models in specific categories. To address these limitations, we propose WeGenBench, a novel benchmark designed for the comprehensive, multi-perspective evaluation of text-to-image generation capabilities. Our benchmark comprises a total of 4,000 test prompts across two primary categories, meticulously balanced between Chinese and English to evaluate bilingual and cross-cultural generation capabilities. Beyond macroscopic scene classification, we annotate each prompt with multi-dimensional tags tailored to the distinct content and challenges of each language, thereby refining the generation tasks into more specific sub-categories. Through a cross-dimensional evaluation mechanism leveraging both scene classifications and multi-dimensional tags, WeGenBench can precisely pinpoint model shortcomings in specific generation categories. Furthermore, to measure generation quality more accurately, we design and validate several novel evaluation metrics by integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which assess model performance on domain-specific tasks from three core aspects. Crucially, our approach yields both the assessment outcomes and the detailed reasoning trajectories, facilitating a rigorous verification of the accuracy and soundness of the evaluation results. Finally, we conduct systematic benchmarking on current state-of-the-art methods and provide an in-depth analysis of the limitations present in existing models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WeGenBench，一个用于文本到图像生成模型的多维度诊断基准，包含4000个测试提示，覆盖中文和英文，并设计了基于视觉语言模型的新评估指标，能够精确指出模型在特定生成类别中的缺陷。
Motivation: 现有基准难以全面、准确地衡量文本到图像生成模型在多个维度上的性能，常无法揭示模型在特定类别中的固有缺陷。
Method: 构建包含4000个双语提示的基准，分两大类别，每个提示标注多维度标签，并利用视觉语言模型设计新评估指标，从三个核心方面评估模型性能，同时提供推理轨迹以验证评估结果的准确性。
Result: 对当前最先进方法进行了系统基准测试，并深入分析了现有模型的局限性。
Conclusion: WeGenBench能够通过交叉维度评估机制精确定位模型不足，且其评估结果和推理轨迹有助于验证评估的准确性和合理性。
