papers.title: Stitching and dimensionality effects on large artificially generated volume datasets
papers.abstract_en: Generating large images via deep learning requires patching input data to accommodate hardware memory limitations, then assembling output patches, a process that can introduce stitching artifacts when neighboring patches do not align at borders. While these artifacts are known to affect segmentation tasks, their impact on generative models for style-transfer remains poorly understood. We investigated three stitching approaches and two patch dimensionalities (2D vs 3D) using cycleGAN models trained on cryo-electron microscopy datasets. We evaluated both perceptual quality and performance on downstream mitochondria segmentation. Our key findings reveal that: (1) FID scores fail to detect subtle stitching artifacts that significantly impact downstream segmentation performance, (2) 3D models with artifact-free stitching marginally outperform 2D models on downstream tasks, though the improvement barely justifies the computational cost, and (3) 2D models train more stably due to larger batch sizes. Additionally, we demonstrate that ensembling predictions from three orthogonal directions can improve low-quality volumes but provides no benefit for high-quality outputs. These results demonstrate that maximizing generative model performance on large scientific datasets requires careful consideration and mitigation of stitching artifacts, and that perceptual metrics alone are insufficient for evaluating domain adaptation quality in biomedical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了深度学习生成大图像时由分块拼接引入的伪影问题。使用cycleGAN模型在冷冻电镜数据集上比较了三种拼接方法和2D/3D patch维度，发现FID评分无法检测影响下游分割任务的细微伪影，3D模型在下游任务上略优但计算成本高，2D模型训练更稳定。集成正交方向预测对低质量体积有改善但对高质量无益。
Motivation: 拼接伪影已知影响分割任务，但对风格转换生成模型的影响尚不清楚。
Method: 使用cycleGAN训练于cryo-electron microscopy数据集，比较三种拼接方法和2D/3D patch维度，评估感知质量和下游线粒体分割性能。
Result: (1) FID评分无法检测显著影响下游分割的细微拼接伪影；(2) 3D模型在下游任务上略优于2D模型，但计算成本增加不显著；(3) 2D模型因更大批大小训练更稳定。集成三方向预测可提升低质量体积，但对高质量输出无益。
Conclusion: 最大化生成模型在大型科学数据集上的性能需仔细考虑和缓解拼接伪影，仅凭感知指标不足以评估生物医学图像中的域自适应质量。

papers.title: MakeupMirror: Improving Facial Attribute Preservation in Diffusion Models for Makeup Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Makeup transfer models enable fun augmented reality (AR) experiences as well as virtual try-on (VTO) for online makeup shopping. While recent state-of-the-art diffusion based solutions such as Stable-Makeup dramatically improve the accuracy and realism of makeup transfer, they still face limitations in identity and skin color preservation, making production-level VTO for makeup shopping unrealistic. In this work, we propose MakeupMirror, a diffusion-based approach to makeup transfer that makes significant progress towards preserving facial features and skin tone. We introduce several technical innovations over Stable-Makeup: (1) integration of facial geometry conditioning with ControlNets to maintain facial fidelity; (2) region-specific makeup transfer control to enable precise makeup application across facial regions such as skin, eyes and lips; (3) skin tone-based makeup transfer modulation that prevent skin tone alteration in cross-subject transfer scenarios; and (4) integration of a Levenberg-Marquardt Langevin sampler to speed up inference while maintaining generation quality. Our experiments on CPM-Real, Makeup Wild, and (herein newly collected, more diverse) MakeupSelfies datasets show that MakeupMirror improves relative facial recognition similarity by +60%, reduces relative skin tone difference by -50% over Stable-Makeup, with a latency of 0.7s, while achieving expert acceptance rate of 94% across core facial identity preservation criteria.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MakeupMirror，一种基于扩散模型的化妆迁移方法，在Stable-Makeup基础上通过引入面部几何条件、区域特定控制、肤色调制和加速采样等技术，显著提升了面部特征和肤色保持的效果。实验表明，相比Stable-Makeup，相对面部识别相似度提升60%，肤色差异降低50%，推理延迟0.7秒，专家接受率达到94%。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在化妆迁移中仍存在身份和肤色保持不足的问题，使得生产级的虚拟试妆不够真实。
Method: 在Stable-Makeup基础上集成ControlNets实现面部几何条件、区域特定化妆控制、基于肤色的调制，并采用Levenberg-Marquardt Langevin采样器加速推理。
Result: 在CPM-Real、Makeup Wild和新收集的MakeupSelfies数据集上，相比Stable-Makeup，相对面部识别相似度提升60%，肤色差异降低50%，推理延迟0.7秒，专家接受率达94%。
Conclusion: MakeupMirror在保持面部特征和肤色方面取得了显著进展，使得扩散模型在化妆迁移任务中更接近生产级虚拟试妆应用。

papers.title: EventVLA: Event-Driven Visual Evidence Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Memory remains a critical bottleneck for long-horizon robotic manipulation, as standard Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often fail when task-relevant cues become occluded or unobservable over time. While existing memory-augmented methods utilize historical context, they either suffer from severe information bottlenecks, incur high latency via decoupled dual systems, or rely on unselective buffers that accumulate massive visual redundancies. To address these limitations, we introduce EventVLA, an end-to-end framework founded on the concept of sparse visual evidence memory that comprises two core components: foundational visual anchors to retain initial and short-term contexts, and a dynamic Keyframe Evidence Memory (KEM) module. Specifically, KEM directly predicts future keyframe probabilities from the VLA's latent embeddings to autonomously capture and store sparse, task-critical visual events. This foresight-driven mechanism empowers the policy to dynamically evaluate the future causal utility of current observations, preserving transient visual evidence before it becomes unobservable. Furthermore, we propose RoboTwin-MeM, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate non-Markovian manipulation tasks with interactive visual evidence. Extensive evaluations show that across 17 memory-requiring simulation tasks and 4 real-world bimanual tasks, EventVLA achieves an average success rate improvement of +40% over state-of-the-art memory-augmented VLAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EventVLA，一种用于长时域机器人操作的端到端视觉-语言-行动策略，通过稀疏视觉证据记忆机制（包括基础视觉锚点和动态关键帧证据记忆模块）来缓解标准 VLA 在任务相关线索被遮挡或不可观察时的失败问题。实验表明，在 17 个需要记忆的仿真任务和 4 个真实世界双机械臂任务上，EventVLA 相比现有记忆增强 VLA 平均成功率提升 40%。
Motivation: 现有记忆增强的 VLA 策略在处理长时域操作时存在信息瓶颈、高延迟或累积视觉冗余等问题，导致任务相关线索随时间消失时性能下降。
Method: 提出 EventVLA 框架，包含两个核心组件：基础视觉锚点用于保留初始和短期上下文；动态关键帧证据记忆（KEM）模块，从 VLA 的潜在嵌入直接预测未来关键帧概率，自主捕获并存储稀疏的任务关键视觉事件。
Result: 在 17 个需要记忆的仿真任务和 4 个真实世界双机械臂任务上，EventVLA 的平均成功率相比现有记忆增强 VLA 提升 40%。
Conclusion: EventVLA 通过前瞻性的稀疏视觉证据记忆机制，有效提升了 VLA 策略在长时域机器人操作中的表现，但主要面向机器人操作领域。

papers.title: IHUBERT: Vector-Based Semantic Deduplication and Domain-Balanced Pretraining for Persian Resources
papers.abstract_en: Persian pretrained language models (PLMs) are still limited by the scarcity of large-scale, high-quality pretraining corpora and by insufficient evaluation beyond standard classification and NER tasks. We present IHUBERT, a monolingual Persian PLM trained from scratch with the RoBERTa-base encoder (125M parameters) on a 45 GB curated subset of the Sepahr-Danesh collection (about 7-8B tokens). To improve corpus quality and reduce redundancy, we employ a multi-stage preprocessing pipeline that includes normalization, exact and near-duplicate removal, anonymization, and vector-database-based semantic deduplication for distribution balancing control across domains and registers. We additionally train a 139k-vocabulary BPE tokenizer on the full pretraining corpus to better capture Persian morphology and orthographic variation. IHUBERT is evaluated on seven Persian NLU benchmarks covering NER, sentiment analysis, topic classification, NLI, extractive question answering, and relation extraction, using task-standard metrics (entity-level F1, Macro-F1, EM/F1). IHUBERT achieves its strongest gains on extractive QA, ranking first on both PQuAD (F1 88.3542) and ParsiNLU-RC (F1 49.0987), and attains the best result on FarsTail (Macro-F1 0.8350). On NER and topic classification, it remains competitive (e.g., 0.8308 F1 on ParsTwiNER; 0.7953 Macro-F1 on DigiMag), while relation extraction remains the main remaining gap (0.6684 Macro-F1 on PERLEX). A controlled tokenizer ablation on the IHUBERT pretraining corpus shows that BPE yields slightly lower subword fragmentation than WordPiece at matched vocabulary size, supporting our tokenization design. Overall, IHUBERT advances Persian language modeling through semantically curated large-scale pretraining and broad evaluation across both classification and comprehension-oriented tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IHUBERT是一个从零训练的波斯语单语预训练语言模型（RoBERTa-base, 125M参数），在45GB的Sepahr-Danesh语料子集（约70-80亿token）上训练。采用多阶段预处理流水线，包括标准化、精确/近似去重、匿名化以及基于向量数据库的语义去重和领域分布平衡控制。训练了139k词表的BPE分词器以更好地捕获波斯语形态和拼写变体。在七个NLU基准上评估，涵盖NER、情感分析、主题分类、NLI、抽取式QA和关系抽取，在抽取式QA上取得最强结果（PQuAD F1 88.3542, ParsiNLU-RC F1 49.0987），在FarsTail上取得最佳结果（Macro-F1 0.8350），关系抽取仍是主要差距（PERLEX Macro-F1 0.6684）。分词器消融实验表明BPE子词碎片化程度略低于WordPiece。
Motivation: 波斯语预训练语言模型受限于大规模高质量预训练语料的稀缺，以及缺乏超越标准分类和NER任务的充分评估。
Method: 提出多阶段预处理流水线：标准化、精确和近似去重、匿名化，并引入基于向量数据库的语义去重以控制领域和语域分布平衡。训练139k词表的BPE分词器。采用RoBERTa-base架构（125M参数），在45GB波斯语语料上训练。

papers.title: Multi-Head Attention-Based Feature Extractor Integration with Soft Actor-Critic for Porosity Prediction and Process Parameter Optimization in Additive Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Additive manufacturing process optimization requires precise parameter control to minimize defects such as porosity. Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) approaches using discrete action spaces suffer from slow convergence and susceptibility to local optima, limiting their effectiveness for high-precision manufacturing tasks. This study addresses these limitations by employing a continuous action space combined with a novel architecture that integrates a multi-head attention mechanism with the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm. The attention-based feature extractor enhances the agent's ability to capture subtle variations in low-dimensional input features, enabling more effective exploration-exploitation balance for navigating value spaces with local minima. We validate our approach on porosity prediction and process parameter optimization in laser powder bed fusion, demonstrating faster convergence and higher final reward values compared to standard RL methods including DQN, PPO, TD3, and vanilla SAC. The proposed methodology achieves a convergence value of 322.79 within 14 episodes, outperforming existing approaches while maintaining stability throughout training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对增材制造中孔隙率预测与工艺参数优化问题，提出一种将多头注意力机制（multi-head attention）与软演员-评论家（Soft Actor-Critic, SAC）算法结合的连续动作空间方法。注意力特征提取器增强了智能体对低维输入特征细微变化的捕捉能力，改善了探索-利用平衡。在激光粉末床熔融（laser powder bed fusion）验证中，该方法在14个回合内达到322.79的收敛值，优于DQN、PPO、TD3和标准SAC。
Motivation: 传统强化学习方法采用离散动作空间，收敛速度慢且易陷入局部最优，难以满足高精度制造任务的需求。
Method: 引入连续动作空间，并将多头注意力机制集成到SAC算法的特征提取器中，通过注意力权重聚焦输入特征的关键变化，提升对价值空间局部极值的导航能力。
Result: 在激光粉末床熔融的孔隙率预测与参数优化任务中，所提方法在14个回合内达到收敛值322.79，收敛速度与最终奖励均超过DQN、PPO、TD3和标准SAC。
Conclusion: 连续动作空间与注意力增强的SAC在增材制造参数优化中展现出更快收敛和更高稳定性，但摘要未明确讨论泛化性等局限性。

papers.title: Residual-Space Evolutionary Optimization via Flow-based Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Data editing with generative methods typically requires differentiable objectives and gradient-based search. However, these assumptions break down in flow-based settings, where edits are performed through forward and backward integration and often involve non-differentiable or black-box objectives. We introduce residual-space evolutionary optimization, a model-agnostic framework that addresses this gap by combining flow-based generative editing with evolutionary algorithms. Building on the observation that conditional flow matching (CFM) can disentangle condition-controlled factors from instance-specific residuals, our framework directly operates in residual space and separates two complementary search regimes: self-pollination performs local exploitation through feature-preserving residual refinement, and cross-pollination promotes broader exploration by recombining residuals across heterogeneous samples. As a proof of concept, we validate on MorphoMNIST, a benchmark dataset for counterfactual generation, and on crystal data, demonstrating that this exploration--exploitation decomposition provides a useful mechanism for balancing target alignment, instance preservation, and diversity, and extends beyond images to real-world scientific domains.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICML 2026 Workshop SPIGM, 5 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出残差空间进化优化框架，结合流式生成模型与进化算法，解决非可微目标的生成编辑问题。通过自花授粉（局部利用）和异花授粉（全局探索）两种搜索机制，在MorphoMNIST和晶体数据上验证了方法在目标对齐、实例保持与多样性之间的平衡能力。
Motivation: 现有基于梯度的生成编辑方法要求可微目标，无法处理流式生成模型中的黑箱或非可微目标。
Method: 基于条件流匹配（CFM）解耦条件控制因子与实例特定残差，在残差空间中分离自花授粉（残差细化）与异花授粉（残差重组）两种搜索策略。
Result: 在MorphoMNIST反事实生成和晶体数据上展示了探索-利用分解有助于平衡目标对齐、实例保持与多样性。
Conclusion: 该方法可扩展至图像以外的真实科学领域，但当前验证限于二维图像和晶体数据。

papers.title: Holo-World: Unified Camera, Object and Weather Control for Video World Model
papers.abstract_en: Video world models are moving toward preserving an observed world under controllable camera and object motion while allowing its environmental state to change. Yet these controls remain isolated, and weather generation typically relies on a source video or reconstructed scene that already specifies future structure. We study a first-frame-anchored source-to-state setting, where the model starts from a single image and follows explicit camera and object controls and an optional weather instruction, then generates a video that either preserves the source world or transfers it to a target weather state. To address these challenges, we first build HoloStateData, a state video dataset that turns diverse videos into unified control samples for camera, object, and weather supervision. Second, we introduce Holo-World, a unified controllable video world model that jointly controls scene from a single image. Its Unified Scene Adapter factorizes world preservation and weather transfer into distinct parameter subspaces, using rendered background, geometry buffers, and object controls to maintain controlled scene structure while modeling weather-dependent appearance and particle effects. Additionally, Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG guides scene and weather residuals separately, strengthening target weather effects without over-amplifying the full condition. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that Holo-World maintains precise camera and object control with consistent scene structure while transferring scenes into diverse target weather state, outperforming video-to-video weather editing baselines on weather-state generation. Our project page is available at \url{https://xiangchenyin.github.io/Holo-World/}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Holo-World，一个统一的视频世界模型，能够从单张图像开始，通过显式的相机、物体控制和可选的天气指令生成视频，同时保持或转换场景的天气状态。构建了 HoloStateData 数据集，并提供 Unified Scene Adapter 和 Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG 技术，在天气编辑任务上超越了视频到视频的基线方法。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型对相机、物体和天气的控制相互孤立，且天气生成通常依赖已有视频或重建场景，缺乏从单张图像出发的统一可控框架。
Method: 提出 Holo-World，包含 Unified Scene Adapter 将世界保持和天气转换分解到不同参数子空间，利用渲染背景、几何缓冲和物体控制维持场景结构，同时建模天气相关外观和粒子效果；并采用 Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG 分别引导场景和天气残差。
Result: 实验表明 Holo-World 能保持精确的相机和物体控制，同时将场景转换为多种目标天气状态，在天气状态生成上优于视频到视频的天气编辑基线。
Conclusion: Holo-World 实现了从单张图像到受控视频的统一生成，支持相机、物体和天气控制，为视频世界模型提供了更灵活的控制范式。

papers.title: Beyond Averaging in John Ellipsoid Approximation: High-Accuracy Algorithms in the Leverage-Score Model
papers.abstract_en: The John ellipsoid of a symmetric polytope $P=\{\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^d:\|\mathbf{A}\mathbf{x}\|_\infty\le1\}$, $\mathbf{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$, is computed by a long line of leverage-score algorithms, from Cohen, Cousins, Lee and Yang (COLT 2019) to its successors [WY24, CLS+25], all reaching a $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation in $Θ(\varepsilon^{-1}\log(n/d))$ iterations. We separate this complexity into three costs the modern line conflates (certification, identification, and accuracy) and locate the historical $\varepsilon^{-1}$ in the first alone. In the equivalent D-optimal-design form $\min_{\mathbf{p}\inΔ_n}-\log\det(\sum_i p_i\mathbf{a}_i\mathbf{a}_i^\top)$, the leverage-score oracle is exactly the first-order oracle and the $(1+\varepsilon)$-John guarantee the Frank-Wolfe gap $g(\mathbf{p})\le\varepsilon d$; through this dictionary the costs come apart. The $\varepsilon^{-1}$ is a certification artifact: the uniform average of the iterates, the certificate used throughout the line, has gap exactly $Θ(1/T)$, however cheap each iteration is made. Pointed instead at the last iterate the same oracle is fast: a warm-started accelerated method reaches the guarantee in $C(\mathbf{A})+O(\sqrtκ\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries after an $\varepsilon$-independent setup $C(\mathbf{A})$, and once the optimal face is identified the facial problem is an unconstrained self-concordant minimization whose Hessian the oracle recovers exactly, so damped Newton needs only $O(\log\log(1/\varepsilon))$ steps, for a total of $C(\mathbf{A})+O(d^2\log\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries. The accuracy dependence is thus doubly logarithmic after an $\varepsilon$-independent, condition-dependent setup; the open problem is the remaining identification cost (a condition-free bound on reaching the optimal face) and lower bounds. Accuracy is not the obstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对称多面体 John 椭球的高精度逼近问题，将传统杠杆分数算法的复杂度分解为认证、识别和精度三个部分，发现现有算法中的 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 项仅来自认证成本。通过将问题等价为 D-最优设计形式，提出结合暖启动加速方法和阻尼牛顿法的新算法，在 $\varepsilon$ 无关的设置后仅需 $O(d^2 \log\log(1/\varepsilon))$ 次查询即可达到 $(1+\varepsilon)$-逼近，实现双对数精度依赖。
Motivation: 现有杠杆分数算法均需 $\Theta(\varepsilon^{-1} \log(n/d))$ 次迭代才能达到 $(1+\varepsilon)$-逼近，且 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 项被认为是精度主导成本。作者旨在分离认证、识别与精度三种成本，证明精度本身并非瓶颈。
Method: 将问题转化为 D-最优设计形式 $\min_{\mathbf{p}\in\Delta_n} -\log\det(\sum_i p_i \mathbf{a}_i\mathbf{a}_i^\top)$，利用杠杆分数预言作为一阶预言。先通过暖启动加速方法在 $C(\mathbf{A})$ 次查询后达到 $g(\mathbf{p})\le \varepsilon d$，一旦最优面被识别，则使用阻尼牛顿法（Hessian 由预言精确恢复）以 $O(\log\log(1/\varepsilon))$ 步完成精度提升。
Result: 总查询复杂度为 $C(\mathbf{A}) + O(d^2 \log\log(1/\varepsilon))$，其中 $C(\mathbf{A})$ 是 $\varepsilon$ 无关的条件相关初始化成本，精度依赖被降至双对数。
Conclusion: 精度不是约翰椭球逼近的障碍；剩余开放问题是最优面的识别成本（无条件的上界）以及下界。

papers.title: The Hidden Evolution of Disguised Visual Context inside the VLM
papers.abstract_en: Visual tokens enter Large Language Models (LLMs) as raw, foreign signals. How they are transformed into meaningful representations and interact with the language space depends entirely on the integration architecture. Whether by treating visual tokens as in-context prompts within the input sequence or injecting them directly into the LLM's intermediate layers. A controlled comparison and understanding of how these architectural choices affect visual information and its internal transformation to integrate with the LLM remains underexplored. We provide a fair comparison by evaluating in-context and layer-wise injection VLM integration paradigms under identical training conditions across single image, multi-image, and video benchmarks. In doing so, we uncover a hidden evolution where visual tokens enter the LLM as disguised visual context, raw representations lacking linguistic structure, but are progressively reshaped depending on the integration paradigm, each capturing fundamentally different frequency characteristics of the visual signal. We show that this evolution inside the LLM determines what visual features the VLM can utilize effectively, how visual representations align with the language space, and ultimately how each paradigm performs across different tasks. We further demonstrate that attention allocation alone is insufficient, and that performance is driven by the quality of visual representations at each layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了两种视觉语言模型（VLM）集成范式（上下文提示与层间注入），发现视觉令牌进入大语言模型（LLM）时最初是伪装视觉上下文（缺乏语言结构的原始表示），随后根据集成范式逐渐重塑，捕捉不同的频率特征。这种内部演化决定了VLM能有效利用的视觉特征、视觉表示与语言空间的对齐程度，以及每种范式在不同任务上的表现。研究表明，仅关注注意力分配不足，各层的视觉表示质量才是性能关键。
Motivation: 视觉令牌作为原始、外来信号进入LLM，其如何转化为有意义的表示并与语言空间交互取决于集成架构，但不同架构选择对视觉信息内部转换的影响缺乏受控比较和理解。
Method: 在相同训练条件下，评估上下文提示和层间注入两种VLM集成范式，在单图、多图和视频基准上进行公平比较，分析视觉令牌在LLM内部的演化过程及频率特征变化。
Result: 发现视觉令牌在LLM内部存在隐藏演化：从原始、无语言结构的伪装视觉上下文逐渐重塑，不同范式捕捉视觉信号的不同频率特征；注意力分配不足以解释性能，各层视觉表示质量才是决定性因素。

papers.title: Variable-Length Tokenization via Learnable Global Merging for Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) have become dominant in visual synthesis, but their quality-compute trade-off is largely constrained by the tokenizer's fixed compression ratio. Variable-length tokenizers (VLTs) promise adaptive compression by varying token counts, allowing diffusion models to flexibly balance quality and compute. However, conventional VLTs modulate length by truncating ordered token sequences, which makes token semantics depend on token position and breaks representational alignment across lengths. This leads to a cross-length shift in the latent distribution that hinders a single variable-length diffusion model from operating effectively. To address this, we propose a novel variable-length tokenizer that modulates length by merging tokens. We show that encouraging similar tokens to merge enables direct cross-length representation alignment when the diffusion transformer operates according to the merging pattern. Since conventional merging methods are data-dependent, making the merging pattern inaccessible during generation, we introduce learnable global merging, which is data-independent, to ensure compatibility with diffusion transformers. On ImageNet 256$\times$256 generation, our merging-based variable-length tokenizer integrated with a diffusion transformer achieves a superior gFID-compute trade-off compared to prior VLT methods. Code is available at [this https URL](https://github.com/movinghoon/lgm)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于token合并的可变长度分词器，通过可学习的全局合并策略，使扩散Transformer能自适应改变token数量以平衡生成质量和计算开销。在ImageNet 256×256生成任务上，该方法在gFID和计算量之间取得了比先前可变长度Tokenizer更好的权衡。
Motivation: 现有可变长度Tokenizer通过截断有序token序列来改变长度，导致token语义依赖于位置，产生跨长度的潜表示偏移，阻碍单一可变长度扩散模型的有效运行。
Method: 提出合并式可变长度分词器，通过鼓励相似token合并来实现跨长度表示对齐；并引入数据无关的可学习全局合并，使合并模式在生成阶段可重复。
Result: 在ImageNet 256×256生成任务上，集成了该分词器的扩散Transformer在gFID-计算权衡上优于先前的可变长度Tokenizer方法。
Conclusion: 通过合并token而非截断序列，可有效解决可变长度Tokenizer的表示对齐问题，为扩散模型提供灵活的压缩率。

papers.title: What Makes Effective Supervision in Latent Chain-of-Thought: An Information-Theoretic Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) internalizes reasoning within continuous hidden states, offering a promising alternative to verbose discrete reasoning traces. However, robust latent reasoning remains difficult because outcome supervision provides weak learning signals and leaves latent trajectories prone to semantic drift. In this work, we analyze Latent CoT from an information-theoretic perspective and identify this failure as a dual collapse: gradient attenuation along the optimization path and representational drift in the latent space. We further decompose process supervision into two complementary dimensions: Trajectory Supervision, which injects dense stepwise reasoning signals, and Space Supervision, which preserves the semantic structure of the latent manifold. Our analysis shows that rigid geometric compression can collapse the reasoning space, whereas generative reconstruction provides a more flexible semantic anchor that better preserves information capacity. To measure these effects, we introduce the Unified Latent Probe (ULP), which quantifies the mutual information between latent trajectories and explicit reasoning steps. Experiments reveal a clear Information-Performance Binding: reasoning accuracy depends on the information fidelity preserved in the latent chain. These findings provide a principled framework for latent reasoning supervision and suggest shifting from geometric imitation toward mutual information maximization. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Supervision-in-Latent-CoT}{this repository}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息论角度分析潜在思维链（Latent CoT）中的监督机制，指出结果监督导致梯度衰减和表示漂移的双重崩溃。将过程监督分解为轨迹监督（密集逐步推理信号注入）和空间监督（潜在流形语义结构保持），并证明生成式重建优于刚性几何压缩。引入统一潜在探针（ULP）量化互信息，实验显示推理准确度依赖于潜在链中保存的信息保真度。
Motivation: 潜在CoT的结果监督信号弱，导致潜在轨迹易发生语义漂移，难以实现稳健的潜在推理。现有缺乏对有效监督形式的理论理解。
Method: 从信息论角度分析，识别双重崩溃（梯度衰减和表示漂移）。将过程监督分解为轨迹监督和空间监督两个互补维度，提出用统一潜在探针（ULP）衡量互信息。
Result: 实验揭示信息-性能绑定关系：推理准确度取决于潜在链中保存的信息保真度。生成式重建提供更灵活的语义锚点，优于刚性几何压缩。
Conclusion: 为潜在推理监督提供原则性框架，建议从几何模仿转向互信息最大化。

papers.title: Evaluation of EEG Foundation Models for Event-Based Burst-Suppression Detection in ICU
papers.abstract_en: Burst suppression (BS) is a clinically relevant electroencephalographic (EEG) pattern used to monitor sedation depth and brain activity in critically ill patients, particularly during induced coma in Intensive Care Units (ICUs). Automatic burst detection remains challenging because BS patterns vary substantially between patients and annotated datasets are scarce. Recently, EEG Foundation Models (FMs) have shown promise across several downstream EEG applications, but their usefulness for BS detection remains unexplored. We present the first study to evaluate EEG FMs for burst detection in reduced-montage ICU EEG without patient-specific calibration. We compare REVE-base, LUNA-large and LuMamba-Tiny with an adaptive thresholding baseline and a task-specific EEGNet baseline. Additionally, we complement conventional EEG window-based classification with event-based burst detection evaluation. This helps assessing clinically whether burst episodes are correctly detected, reducing the impact of expected annotation variability. The best model, REVE-base, achieved the highest event-based F1-score ($0.868 \pm 0.167$) and reduced burst-per-minute error by 52.1% and 36.2% compared to EEGNet and adaptive thresholding respectively, supporting FMs for scalable EEG monitoring in ICU. Ablation experiments showed that full fine-tuning was the most effective adaptation strategy with respect to frozen-backbone training, two-step fine-tuning, and LoRA-based adaptation, improving event-based F1-score over frozen-backbone training by up to $+0.102$ for LUNA-large. With reduced labeled datasets, pretrained REVE-base outperformed random initialization by $+0.723$ event-based F1 points at 25% of the cohort, demonstrating the benefit of pretraining FM representations when adapted to burst detection with limited labeled data.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 figure. Code available upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次评估了EEG基础模型（Foundation Models）在ICU中用于爆发抑制（burst suppression）检测的性能，无需患者特定校准。比较了REVE-base、LUNA-large和LuMamba-Tiny与自适应阈值基线和任务特定EEGNet基线。REVE-base在事件级F1分数上达到0.868±0.167，并将每分钟爆发错误率分别降低52.1%和36.2%。实验表明全微调是最有效的适配策略，且预训练基础模型在标签数据有限时显著优于随机初始化。
Motivation: 爆发抑制模式在患者间差异大且标注数据稀缺，限制了自动检测的临床实用性。EEG基础模型在其它下游任务中表现良好，但其在爆发抑制检测中的潜力尚未被探索。
Method: 采用事件级爆发检测评估框架，对比三种EEG基础模型（REVE-base、LUNA-large、LuMamba-Tiny）与自适应阈值基线和EEGNet。进行消融实验，比较全微调、冻结骨干训练、两步微调和LoRA适配等策略。
Result: REVE-base取得最高事件级F1分数（0.868±0.167），BPM（每分钟爆发次数）误差较EEGNet降低52.1%、较自适应阈值降低36.2%。全微调使LUNA-large的F1比冻结骨干训练提升0.102。使用25%标注数据时，预训练REVE-base比随机初始化F1高0.723。
Conclusion: EEG基础模型可用于ICU中减少导联的EEG爆发检测，无需患者特异性校准，全微调是最佳适配策略。在有限标注数据下预训练表示显著提升检测性能。

papers.title: Process-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Theorem Proving via Lean
papers.abstract_en: While reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically has relied on a single binary verification signal, symbolic proof assistants in formal reasoning offer rich, fine-grained structured feedback. This gap between structured processes and unstructured rewards highlights the importance of feedback that is both dense and sound. In this work, we demonstrate that the Lean proof assistant itself can serve as a symbolic process oracle, supplying both outcome-level and fine-grained tactic-level verified feedback during training. Proof attempts are parsed into tactic sequences, and Lean's elaboration marks both locally sound steps and the earliest failing step, yielding dense, verifier-grounded credit signals rooted in type theory. We incorporate these structured rewards into a GRPO-style reinforcement learning objective with first-error propagation and first-token credit methods that balances outcome- and process-level advantages. Experiments with STP-Lean and DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5 show that tactic-level supervision outperforms outcome-only baselines in most settings, delivering improvements on benchmarks such as MiniF2F and ProofNet. Beyond empirical gains, our study highlights a broader perspective: symbolic proof assistants are not only verifiers at evaluation time, but can also act as process-level reward oracles during training. This opens a path toward reinforcement learning frameworks that combine the scalability of language models with the reliability of symbolic verification for formal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用 Lean 证明过程作为过程验证信号，在强化学习训练中提供细粒度策略级奖励，提升定理证明性能。实验表明，策略级监督优于仅结果基线，在 MiniF2F 和 ProofNet 上取得改进。
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 只使用二进制结果信号，忽略了形式证明过程中丰富的结构化反馈。
Method: 将证明尝试解析为策略序列，利用 Lean 的 elaboration 获取每个策略的正确/失败信号，设计首错误传播和首令牌信度方法，集成到 GRPO 目标中。
Result: 在 STP-Lean 和 DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5 上，策略级监督在多数设置中优于仅结果基线，在 MiniF2F 和 ProofNet 上取得改进。
Conclusion: 符号证明助手不仅可作为评估时的验证器，也可作为训练时的过程级奖励预言机，为结合语言模型可扩展性与符号验证可靠性的强化学习框架开辟道路。

papers.title: Optimal Coarse Correlated Equilibria in Mean Field Games: Linear Programming and No-Regret Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce optimal coarse correlated equilibria for continuous-time mean field games. A coarse correlated equilibrium is a randomized recommendation scheme from which no player can gain by ignoring the recommendation and switching to an alternative strategy. The problem is as follows: a moderator selects, among all mean-field coarse correlated equilibria, one that optimizes a prescribed performance criterion, which may differ from the representative player's objective. After formulating the problem, we develop a linear programming (LP) formulation, prove the existence of optimal LP coarse correlated equilibria, and relate the LP characterization to the original probabilistic setting. Building on this characterization, we design a no-regret primal-dual algorithm, based on an equivalent Lagrangian formulation of the external-regret constraint, for learning such equilibria. We provide explicit convergence rates for the learning algorithm, and numerical examples illustrate the method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续时间平均场博弈，定义了最优粗相关均衡。作者提出了一个线性规划（LP）公式化，证明了最优LP粗相关均衡的存在性，并将其与原始概率设定联系起来。基于该公式，设计了一个基于外部遗憾约束的拉格朗日等价形式的无遗憾原-对偶学习算法，并给出了明确的收敛速率和数值示例。
Motivation: 在平均场博弈中，传统均衡概念（如纳什均衡）难以计算或实现。粗相关均衡提供了更灵活的解决方案，但如何选择最优的一个以满足外部性能标准尚未充分研究。
Method: 首先将最优粗相关均衡问题形式化为线性规划，证明存在性并建立LP与概率描述的关系。然后利用外遗憾约束的拉格朗日对偶，设计无遗憾原-对偶学习算法来逼近最优均衡。
Result: 摘要报告了算法的明确收敛速率，并通过数值例子验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 线性规划公式为平均场博弈中的最优粗相关均衡提供了可处理的计算框架，无遗憾学习算法为实际求解提供了可行的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Autonomous Event-Driven Multi-Agent Orchestration for Enterprise AI at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise AI aims to move toward continuous event monitoring, detection, and action across specialist agents, yet existing multi-agent systems largely assume discrete request-response workflows and remain underexplored at enterprise scale. We evaluate DAG Plan and Execute and ReAct across 208 production-derived enterprise scenarios spanning Persona (<10 agents), Department (20-80), and Enterprise (200) scales, and introduce a Task Manager for continuous operation via priority inference, related-event merging, and preemption. Results show that scale, not task complexity, dominates orchestration performance: both architectures perform well at small scale but degrade at enterprise scale as agent discovery noise becomes the primary bottleneck, with simple tasks degrading more sharply than complex ones. DAG Plan and Execute offers higher precision and structured parallelization at smaller scales, but its higher overhead worsens at enterprise scale; ReAct is more robust by handling failures incrementally. The Task Manager reduces high-priority queue latency by 14-75% and improves related-event correctness by over 20 percentage points at enterprise scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了两种多智能体编排架构（DAG Plan and Execute和ReAct）在企业级规模下的性能，并引入Task Manager用于连续操作。在最多200个智能体的场景中，发现规模而非任务复杂度主导性能；两种架构在小规模表现良好，但在企业级规模下代理发现噪声成为瓶颈。提出的Task Manager将高优先级队列延迟降低14-75%，相关事件正确性提升超过20个百分点。
Motivation: 企业AI需要向连续事件监控、检测和行动发展，但现有多智能体系统大多假设离散的请求-响应工作流，且在企业规模下的探索不足。
Method: 在208个生产衍生场景中评估DAG Plan and Execute和ReAct两种架构，覆盖Persona（<10代理）、Department（20-80）和Enterprise（200）规模；并引入Task Manager，通过优先级推断、相关事件合并和抢占实现连续操作。
Result: 规模而非任务复杂度主导编排性能；两种架构在小规模表现良好，但在企业规模下代理发现噪声成为主要瓶颈，简单任务下降更剧烈。Task Manager在高优先级队列延迟上降低14-75%，相关事件正确性提升超过20个百分点。
Conclusion: Task Manager在企业规模下显著降低延迟并提升正确性，但两种基础架构在规模增大时都面临代理发现噪声瓶颈。

papers.title: PaAno+: Multiscale Encoding and Cross-Variable Attention for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time-series anomaly detection has significant practical value for industrial and medical monitoring, as well as other critical domains. Current Transformer- and large-model-based detection approaches incur excessive computational overhead, while existing lightweight alternatives are constrained by insufficient feature extraction and inadequate modeling of dependencies across multivariate variables. To mitigate the above drawbacks, this study develops a lightweight, efficient anomaly detection model, dubbed PaAno, within the patch-oriented representation learning paradigm. In the encoder module, a multiscale feature-extraction backbone is constructed using convolutional kernels with differentiated receptive fields to capture hierarchical temporal characteristics; subsequent cross-scale adaptive attention aggregation, combined with residual connection optimization, further stabilizes feature representation learning. A cross-variable fusion attention module is embedded to explicitly characterize inter-variable correlations, empowering the model to identify anomalous patterns amid intricate operational conditions. Moreover, a novel pretext task based on temporal patch-window sorting is customized to uncover intrinsic structural properties of time series, and triplet loss is leveraged to optimize the patch embedding space for enhanced feature discrimination. Extensive experiments on the TSB-AD benchmark demonstrate that the proposed PaAno achieves state-of-the-art detection accuracy on both univariate and multivariate tasks, yielding significant performance gains across evaluation metrics, including VUS-PR, relative to the original PaAno. Leveraging a compact network design, the presented model achieves favorable computational efficiency, enabling deployment on resource-limited terminals for real-time anomaly inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PaAno（基于 patch 表示学习的时间序列异常检测模型），通过多尺度卷积骨干提取层级时间特征、跨尺度自适应注意力聚合与残差连接，以及跨变量融合注意力显式建模变量间相关性。同时设计基于时间 patch 窗口排序的预文本任务并结合三重损失优化嵌入空间。在 TSB-AD 基准上，单变量与多变量任务均取得 SOTA 结果，VUS-PR 等指标显著提升，且紧凑网络设计支持资源受限终端的实时推理。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 与大型模型方法计算开销过高，轻量级替代方案则受限于特征提取不充分以及多变量间依赖关系建模不足。
Method: 构建多尺度特征提取骨干（不同感受野卷积核），配合交叉尺度自适应注意力聚合与残差连接；嵌入跨变量融合注意力模块显式刻画变量间相关性；提出基于时间 patch 窗口排序的预文本任务，并利用三重损失优化 patch 嵌入空间以提高特征判别力。
Result: 在 TSB-AD 基准上，所提 PaAno 在单变量与多变量任务中均达到 SOTA 检测精度，在 VUS-PR 等指标上获得显著性能增益；依赖紧凑网络设计，计算效率高，可部署于资源受限终端进行实时异常推理。
Conclusion: PaAno 以轻量级架构实现了时间序列异常检测准确率与计算效率的良好平衡，尤其适合实时应用场景。

papers.title: Comparative Study of Neural Surrogate Architectures for Autoregressive Prediction of Internal Battery States
papers.abstract_en: The Doyle-Fuller-Newman (DFN) model resolves internal electrochemical states in lithium-ion batteries with high fidelity. However, the numerical solution of its governing equations is computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment, limiting scalability from individual cells to pack and fleet-scale applications. While machine learning surrogates can substantially reduce inference latency through GPU acceleration, most existing approaches learn solution approximations tied to specific operating conditions rather than learning generalizable state-evolution dynamics. This work presents a systematic comparison of four neural network architectures (MLP, ResNet, U-Net, FNO) formulated as autoregressive state-transition operators that predict full DFN internal states across a wide range of operating conditions. To ensure a controlled architectural comparison, all models are trained under a unified framework using multi-step unrolling and current-conditioning, isolating the impact of spatial inductive bias. Results demonstrate that the U-Net's multi-scale feature hierarchy achieves a mean final-step nRMSE of 3% averaged across all internal state variables after 300-step autoregressive rollouts, while providing a 5.38x speed-up over the numerical solver. These findings highlight spatial inductive bias as a critical determinant of surrogate performance, advancing the development of surrogates for internal state observability for next-generation battery management systems and digital twins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了四种神经网络架构（MLP、ResNet、U-Net、FNO）作为自回归状态转移算子，用于预测锂离子电池Doyle-Fuller-Newman（DFN）模型的内部状态。在统一训练框架下，通过多步展开和电流条件化，隔离空间归纳偏置的影响。结果表明，U-Net在300步自回归后平均最终步nRMSE为3%，且相比数值求解器加速5.38倍。
Motivation: DFN模型计算成本高，不适合实时部署；现有机器学习代理通常学习特定操作条件下的近似解，而非可泛化的状态演化动力学。
Method: 将MLP、ResNet、U-Net、FNO四种架构设计为自回归状态转移算子，在统一框架下进行多步展开和电流条件化训练，以比较空间归纳偏置的影响。
Result: U-Net在300步自回归后平均最终步nRMSE为3%，并提供5.38倍的速度提升。
Conclusion: 空间归纳偏置是代理性能的关键决定因素，该研究有助于开发用于下一代电池管理系统和数字孪生的内部状态可观测性代理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhanced Gulf Stream Path Variability Under Intensified Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Increased upper-ocean stratification is an unavoidable consequence of global warming and will strongly impact the structure of ocean currents. Using a high-resolution ocean model, we show that intensification of stratification leads to the loss of coherence of the Gulf Stream Extension, replacing its steady eastward path with vigorous, chaotic meanders. This regime shift persists independently of changes in the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation and surface wind forcing. Enhanced meandering under intensified stratification also proves to be a robust feature across both idealized and realistic ocean models that resolve mesoscale eddies, but is not captured by coarse-resolution models that parameterize eddies. The presented findings therefore highlight the need for improved representations of oceanic turbulence in climate projections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用高分辨率海洋模型，展示上层海洋层结增强会导致湾流延伸体失去连贯性，从稳定东向路径变为剧烈混沌的弯曲。该转变独立于大西洋经向翻转环流和表面风场变化，在解析中尺度涡的模型中稳健出现，但粗分辨率参数化模型无法捕捉。结果强调气候预测需改进海洋湍流表示。
Motivation: 全球变暖导致上层海洋层结增强，将强烈影响海流结构，但此前对湾流路径变化的理解不足。
Method: 使用高分辨率海洋模型模拟层结增强情景，并对比理想化和实际海洋模型，解析中尺度涡。
Result: 层结增强导致湾流延伸体失去相干性，出现剧烈混沌弯曲，且不受AMOC和风场变化影响；该特征在解析涡的模型中稳健，但在粗分辨率参数化模型中缺失。
Conclusion: 气候预测需要改进海洋湍流表示，以捕捉层结变化对湾流路径的影响。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: See-and-Reach: Precise Vision-Language Navigation for UAVs within the Field of View
papers.abstract_en: UAV Vision-Language Navigation (UAV-VLN) is typically formulated as a holistic search-and-reach problem, where long-range target discovery and final target approach are optimized and evaluated jointly. This formulation makes it difficult to assess a critical capability of aerial embodied agents, namely whether a UAV can accurately ground a visible target and translate vision-language evidence into precise 3D motion once the target enters its field of view. To address this limitation, we introduce UAV-VLN-FOV, a target-visible navigation task that isolates the see-and-reach stage and enables a more diagnostic evaluation of terminal reaching ability. We further propose 3DG-VLN, a vision-language waypoint prediction framework guided by dynamic 3D direction cues to enhance fine-grained visual grounding and spatial direction alignment for precise target reaching. Specifically, 3DG-VLN adaptively processes high-resolution front-view and downward-view observations to preserve fine-grained visual and geometric details for target grounding. It also updates the target-relative direction online during closed-loop navigation, allowing the agent to maintain spatial alignment with the target and reduce accumulated direction drift. To support this task, we construct a dedicated high-resolution benchmark which contains 2,717 trajectories with target-oriented high-level instructions, high-resolution front-view and downward-view egocentric observations, and continuous 3D waypoint annotations. Experiments show that 3DG-VLN outperforms competitive UAV-VLN baselines, achieving a 13.82\% improvement in success rate. Real-world trials further demonstrate the potential of 3DG-VLN for practical see-and-reach navigation. The source code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/xuefanfu/3DG-VLN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机视觉语言导航（UAV-VLN）中目标进入视野后的精确到达能力难以评估的问题，提出了UAV-VLN-FOV目标可见导航任务，并推出3DG-VLN框架。该框架利用动态3D方向线索进行视觉语言航点预测，在构建的高分辨率基准上提升成功率13.82%，真实世界实验验证了其实用性。
Motivation: 现有UAV-VLN将长距离搜索与最终接近联合优化评估，难以单独诊断无人机在目标进入视野后能否精确定位并转换为3D运动，限制了终端到达能力的评估。
Method: 提出3DG-VLN框架，自适应处理高分辨率前视和下视观测以保留细粒度视觉几何细节，并在闭环导航中在线更新目标相对方向，减少方向漂移，实现精确目标到达。
Result: 在包含2717条轨迹的高分辨率基准上，3DG-VLN相比竞争基线提升成功率13.82%，真实世界实验进一步验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: 分离see-and-reach阶段进行诊断性评估有助于提升无人机终端到达能力，3DG-VLN展示了精确目标到达的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FUSE: Frequency-domain Unification and Spectral Energy Alignment for Multi-modal Object Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Despite significant progress in multi-modal Re-Identification (ReID), existing methods tend to emphasize low-frequency cues. Consequently, they focus on attributes such as color, illumination, and coarse appearance, while overlooking mid and high-frequency structures that encode geometric, textural, and identity-discriminative details. This imbalance leads to incomplete spectral representations and unstable cross-modal alignment. To overcome these limitations, we introduce FUSE, a frequency-domain framework that reformulates multi-modal ReID as a two-stage process of spectral disentanglement and energy alignment. The proposed Spectral Decomposition Module (SDM) adaptively partitions features into low, mid, and high-frequency subspaces, enabling hierarchical spectral modeling. The Cross-Modal Alignment Module (CAM) further enforces energy alignment and subspace complementarity across modalities via frequency-consistency regularization. In addition, FUSE incorporates learnable frequency modulation to enhance robustness under varying illumination and heterogeneous sensor conditions. Extensive experiments on RGBNT201, RGBNT100, and MSVR310 show that FUSE achieves 9.1\% mAP and 9.5\% Rank-1 improvements, establishing an interpretable frequency-domain paradigm for multi-modal representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态目标重识别（ReID）中现有方法过度依赖低频线索（颜色、光照等）而忽略中高频几何与纹理细节的问题，提出FUSE频域框架，通过频谱分解模块（SDM）将特征自适应划分为低、中、高频子空间，并利用跨模态对齐模块（CAM）进行能量对齐和子空间互补，引入可学习频率调制增强鲁棒性。在RGBNT201、RGBNT100和MSVR310数据集上，FUSE分别取得9.1% mAP和9.5% Rank-1的提升，建立了可解释的频域多模态表示范式。
Motivation: 现有多模态ReID方法偏重低频信息，忽略中高频结构所包含的几何、纹理等身份鉴别性细节，导致频谱表示不完整且跨模态对齐不稳定。
Method: 提出两阶段频率域方法：SDM模块自适应划分特征为低、中、高频子空间实现层次化频谱建模；CAM模块通过频率一致性正则化强制执行能量对齐和子空间互补；此外引入可学习频率调制应对光照和传感器异质变化。
Result: 在RGBNT201、RGBNT100和MSVR310数据集上，FUSE平均mAP提升9.1%，Rank-1提升9.5%。
Conclusion: FUSE为多模态表示学习提供了可解释的频率域范式，通过频谱解缠与能量对齐有效改善了模态间对齐和特征鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AI Economist Agent: An Agentic Framework for Model-Grounded Economic Analysis with RAG, Knowledge Graphs, and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a model-grounded RAG-based AI economist with an agentic framework for economic scenario analysis using large language models (LLMs) and knowledge graphs. While LLMs can generate fluent economic narratives, economists are often required to make economic claims grounded by economic theory and real-world data. Based on this motivation, this study proposes an RAG-based AI economist, which utilizes knowledge graphs including economic data and theory and LLM-based agents to plan the analysis, retrieve relevant evidence, select appropriate models, and generate reports. In our framework, we do not produce quantitative claims directly with the language model alone; instead, we generate narratives grounded in explicit model-based computations and linked to the retrieved evidence via AI agents. We refer to our framework as an AI economist agent. We evaluate the AI economist agent in two applications: economist report generation for U.S. inflation persistence and Federal Reserve policy, and bank stress-test narrative generation for U.S. commercial real estate refinancing stress. The results illustrate how grounding the generated reports improves their economic coherence and traceability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个基于RAG的AI经济学家代理框架，利用知识图谱和大语言模型进行经济场景分析。该框架通过AI代理规划分析、检索证据、选择模型并生成报告，确保经济声明基于理论和数据。在美国通胀和银行压力测试两个应用中验证了方法的有效性和可追溯性。
Motivation: 大语言模型能生成流畅的经济叙述，但经济学家需要基于经济理论和真实数据的主张。现有方法缺乏这种基础，因此需要一种将模型计算和检索证据结合的经济分析框架。
Method: 提出AI经济学家代理框架，结合RAG、知识图谱和大语言模型。代理负责规划分析、检索相关证据（经济数据和理论）、选择适当模型并生成报告，避免直接使用语言模型生成量化主张，而是通过显式模型计算和证据链接来支撑叙述。
Result: 在两项评估中（美国通胀与美联储政策报告生成、美国商业房地产再融资压力下的银行压力测试叙事生成）表明，所生成的报告在经济学一致性和可追溯性方面得到改善。
Conclusion: 所提框架通过将经济报告建立在检索证据和模型计算之上，提升了生成内容的可靠性和可解释性。

papers.title: Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis using a Multimodal Approach with 3D MRI and PET
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is an irreversible neurodegenerative disorder and a leading cause of death worldwide. Early diagnosis plays an important part especially at the Mild Cognitive Impairment stage, where timely intervention can help slow its progression before it advances to AD. Neuroimaging data, like Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Positron Emission Tomography (PET) scans, can help detect brain changes early by providing structural and functional brain changes related to the disease. Yet, many multimodal models still fuse MRI and PET with static concatenation and apply identical computation to all subjects, which limits robustness to patient/site heterogeneity and can waste computation. To address these limitations, we present the first study of combining 3D convolutional feature extractors with three fusion strategies - concatenation, Gated Multimodal Unit (GMU), and gated self-attention - and a sparsely gated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) classifier that performs input-adaptive routing, activating only the most informative experts per case. Finally, we utilize Grad-CAM to visualize disease-related regions, ensuring model interpretability. Experiments are performed across three binary classification tasks (NC vs. MCI, MCI vs. AD, and NC vs. AD). Results show that GMU achieves accuracies of 80.46 % (NC vs. MCI) and 95.47 % (NC vs. AD), while gated self-attention attains 82.08 % on MCI vs. AD. Ablations show that removing the MoE consistently degrades accuracy across all tasks. These findings underscore the value of input-adaptive, multimodal modeling for AD diagnosis by leveraging the complementary nature of MRI and PET.

Method: 首次结合3D卷积特征提取器与三种融合策略（拼接、GMU、门控自注意力），并使用稀疏门控混合专家分类器进行输入自适应路由，仅激活每个病例最相关的专家，最后用Grad-CAM可视化。

papers.title: PU-UNet: Stable Multiplicative Interactions for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Many dense prediction networks rely on additive feature transformations and model higher-order feature interactions only implicitly. Product units provide an explicit mechanism for multiplicative feature modeling, but their logarithmic--exponential formulation can cause numerical instability, which has limited their use in deep dense prediction networks. In this work, we propose Product-Unit U-Net (PU-UNet), a residual U-Net that integrates stable product-unit residual blocks into rich low-resolution stages for medical image segmentation. The proposed formulation combines smooth positivity mapping with log-domain clipping, enabling stable multiplicative feature learning with negligible computational overhead. On ISIC 2018, Kvasir-SEG, and BUSI, PU-UNet achieves Dice scores of 0.942, 0.959, and up to 0.925, respectively. Compared with a matched Residual U-Net baseline, PU-UNet consistently improves Dice and IoU while keeping parameters, FLOPs, and inference latency nearly unchanged, and reduces the image-level false-positive rate on normal BUSI cases from 0.077 to zero. Ablation studies suggest that the gains are associated with product-unit interactions, are strongest under low-resolution placement, and benefit from the proposed stabilization design. These results suggest that stable product-unit residual learning can be an effective way to enhance U-Net-style segmentation networks with explicit multiplicative interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PU-UNet，一种将稳定的乘积单元（product units）集成到残差U-Net低分辨率阶段的医学图像分割网络。通过在ISIC 2018、Kvasir-SEG和BUSI数据集上的实验，该方法在几乎不增加参数和计算量的情况下提升了Dice和IoU指标，并降低了正常病例的假阳性率。
Motivation: 现有密集预测网络主要依赖加性特征变换，对高阶特征交互的建模是隐式的；乘积单元虽能显式建模乘法交互，但对数-指数形式易导致数值不稳定，限制了其在深度密集预测网络中的应用。
Method: 提出PU-UNet，基于Residual U-Net架构，在低分辨率阶段引入稳定的乘积单元残差块；通过平滑正性映射和对数域裁剪实现稳定的乘法特征学习，且计算开销可忽略。
Result: 在ISIC 2018、Kvasir-SEG和BUSI数据集上Dice分别达到0.942、0.959和最高0.925；相比匹配的Residual U-Net基线一致提升Dice和IoU，参数量、FLOPs和推理延迟几乎不变，并将BUSI正常病例的图像级假阳性率从0.077降至零。
Conclusion: 稳定的乘积单元残差学习能有效增强U-Net风格分割网络的显式乘法交互能力。

papers.title: Exploring the potential of AlphaEarth and TESSERA embeddings for Fine-scale Local Climate Zone Mapping: A case study across five cities in Switzerland
papers.abstract_en: Understanding urban spatial morphology is critical for climate modeling, risk assessment, and sustainable urban design, and Local Climate Zone (LCZ) mapping provides the basic framework for this. However, many cities still use coarse ~100-m resolution LCZ records, which are unsuitable for fine-scale urban research. In this study, precomputed embeddings from TESSERA (Feng et al., 2025) and AlphaEarth (Brown et al., 2025) are compared to traditional Sentinel-1/2 (S1S2) composites in five Swiss cities to see if they can upscale coarse LCZ maps to 10-m resolution using an attention-based U-Net. Three experiments assess multi-city transferability, the impact of higher-resolution reference data, and temporal robustness to year-to-year phenology changes. We find that all datasets achieve strong performance with test data Intersection-over-Union (IoU) ranging from 0.59-0.69 and 0.77-0.82 in the first two experiments. TESSERA consistently outperforms both S1S2 and AlphaEarth across both settings As expected, we find that the transfer of embedding-based models from one year to another remains an open challenge. Overall, however, our results demonstrate the promising potential of embeddings derived from EO foundation models to reduce time consuming preprocessing, respectively, manual feature engineering tasks and to guide a universal deep learning-based LCZ mapping workflow. When combined with a simple location-aware attention U-Net architecture, the embeddings enhance regional transferability and scalability, supporting the development of comprehensive and reproducible fine-scale LCZ maps for global urban climate applications Improving reference data quality remains the strongest lever for further accuracy gains.

TL;DR: 本文比较了两种预计算嵌入（TESSERA和AlphaEarth）与传统的Sentinel-1/2复合数据，在瑞士五座城市中利用注意力U-Net将粗分辨率局部气候区（LCZ）地图提升至10米分辨率。结果显示TESSERA在两个实验中持续优于其他数据集，IoU达到0.59-0.69和0.77-0.82，但跨年迁移仍具挑战。
Motivation: 许多城市的LCZ记录分辨率粗（~100米），不适用于精细尺度的城市研究，亟需一种高效、可迁移的降尺度方法。
Method: 使用TESSERA和AlphaEarth的预计算嵌入作为输入，替代传统Sentinel-1/2复合数据，结合位置感知的注意力U-Net架构进行LCZ降尺度映射。
Result: 所有数据集在实验中表现良好，IoU范围0.59-0.82；TESSERA在两个实验中均优于Sentinel-1/2和AlphaEarth；跨年迁移仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 地球观测基础模型的嵌入有潜力减少预处理和特征工程工作，促进通用LCZ映射流程，但提升参考数据质量仍是进一步提高精度的关键。

papers.title: ReA-OVCD: Reliability-Aware Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Semantic and Spatial Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Unlike traditional remote sensing change detection that relies on predefined categories, Open-Vocabulary Change Detection (OVCD) identifies land cover changes flexibly using arbitrary text prompts. However, existing methods suffer from an inherent trade-off when modeling changes: instance-level comparison overlooks fine-grained semantic variations (e.g., partial building extensions), while direct pixel comparison proves unreliable, yielding unstable responses and boundary artifacts due to semantic ambiguity and spatial inconsistency. To this end, we propose an efficient training-free Reliability-Aware Open-Vocabulary Change Detection (ReA-OVCD) framework. It first derives candidate change regions from pixel-wise semantic discrepancies to ensure flexible and detailed localization. To ensure reliability, it subsequently introduces a collaborative refinement strategy to explicitly model change validity from both semantic and spatial perspectives. Specifically, we develop a Semantic Change Reasoning (SCR) module that reassesses changes by jointly analyzing distributional divergence and response variation, enabling the suppression of incidental inconsistencies while preserving reliable semantic shifts. In addition, a Boundary-aware Change Refinement (BCR) module is designed to mitigate artifacts stemming from boundary misalignment and uncertainty through validating whether candidate regions are supported by reliable interior pixels. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets (LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, DSIFN, and SECOND) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving $\mathrm{F}_{1}^{C}$ improvements of 2.13\% to 9.75\% with higher computational efficiency. The code is publicly available at \https://github.com/Funny0101/ReA-OVCD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReA-OVCD，一种训练无关的开放词汇变化检测框架，通过先像素级语义差异生成候选区域，再通过语义变化推理（SCR）和边界感知变化精化（BCR）模块进行协同精化，提升可靠性和精度。在多个遥感变化检测数据集上超越了现有方法，F1_C提升2.13%-9.75%。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇变化检测在实例级比较和像素级比较之间存在权衡，无法同时捕捉精细语义变化并保证可靠性，导致边界伪影和响应不稳定。
Method: 提出训练无关的ReA-OVCD框架，包含两个阶段：先由像素级语义差异生成候选变化区域；再通过SCR模块（联合分析分布差异和响应变化）和BCR模块（验证候选区域是否由可靠内部像素支持）进行语义和空间协同精化。
Result: 在LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD、DSIFN和SECOND四个数据集上，F1_C提升2.13%到9.75%，且计算效率更高。
Conclusion: 作者强调该训练无关方法通过显式建模变化有效性，在开放词汇变化检测中兼顾了定位灵活性和结果可靠性，代码已开源。

papers.title: A Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Efficient Pathfinding in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic environmental changes, confined workspaces, and stringent real-time constraints make pathfinding in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems (RMFS) a challenging problem for conventional search- and rule-based methods, which typically suffer from high computational complexity and long decision latency. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful alternative, deploying learned policies with extreme energy efficiency on resource-constrained hardware remains an open challenge. We present SDQN-RMFS, an end-to-end framework that achieves high-fidelity deployment of an RL-trained policy from a full-precision artificial neural network (ANN) through to a neuromorphic chip. By computing only when triggered by sparse events, this framework unlocks ultra-low-power RMFS pathfinding. Our full-stack pipeline operates as follows: an ANN policy is first efficiently trained via a collision-allowing strategy to densify informative trajectories, and then converted into a spiking neural network (SNN) via a hard-label knowledge distillation approach. This effectively addresses the output distribution mismatch, preserving policy capability across the ANN-to-SNN pipeline while substantially reducing inference latency. Hardware experiments demonstrate up to 11,281$\times$ energy savings and a nearly two-fold reduction in latency compared to a high-performance GPU baseline, while maintaining decision quality on par with the original trained policy. These results establish physical neuromorphic inference as a practical and energy-sustainable pathway for large-scale RMFS operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人移动履约系统（RMFS）中的路径规划问题，提出SDQN-RMFS框架，将强化学习策略从全精度人工神经网络（ANN）高效部署到神经形态芯片。通过碰撞允许策略训练ANN，再经硬标签知识蒸馏转换为脉冲神经网络（SNN），实现仅由稀疏事件触发的超低功耗推理。硬件实验表明，相比GPU基线，该方法节省高达11281倍能耗并降低近一半延迟，同时保持决策质量不变。
Motivation: 传统搜索和规则方法在动态变化、空间受限的RMFS中计算复杂且延迟高；强化学习虽有效，但难以在资源受限硬件上实现高能效部署。
Method: 提出端到端SDQN-RMFS框架：先使用碰撞允许策略（collision-allowing strategy）训练ANN以增密有效轨迹，再通过硬标签知识蒸馏（hard-label knowledge distillation）将ANN转换为SNN，仅在稀疏事件触发时计算，降低推理延迟。
Result: 硬件实验显示，与高性能GPU基线相比，能量节省高达11281倍，延迟降低近两倍，且决策质量与原始训练策略相当。
Conclusion: 该工作表明物理神经形态推理（physical neuromorphic inference）是大规模RMFS中实现实用且可持续低能耗路径的关键技术。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QG-MIL: A Gated Transformer Aggregator for Domain-Agnostic Multiple Instance Learning in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Attention-based Multiple Instance Learning aggregators in medical imaging are prone to attention concentration, producing overconfident and unstable predictions. We introduce QG-MIL, a gated transformer aggregator that addresses this through four synergistic architectural components: RMSNorm-based pre-normalization, per-head QK normalization, fine-grained attention output gating, and SwiGLU-style feed-forward modules. Together, these design choices stabilize training and distribute attention more uniformly across instances without auxiliary losses, masking, or multi-stage regularization. We evaluate QG-MIL across six benchmarks spanning whole-slide pathology and cell-level hematology, covering two fundamentally different MIL scales. The best-performing QG-MIL variants outperform leading baselines on all six benchmarks, with an average improvement of +6.1 mean macro F1 points. Attention overlays and attention mass analysis confirm more distributed instance weighting. Ablation studies show that while individual components can match the full model on specific datasets, the QG-MIL design provides the most consistent cross-domain performance and tightest variance when compared to selected baselines. We release a configurable implementation to support reproducibility at: https://github.com/unica-visual-intelligence-lab/QG-MIL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QG-MIL，一种用于医学影像中多实例学习（MIL）的门控Transformer聚合器，通过RMSNorm预归一化、每头QK归一化、细粒度注意力输出门控和SwiGLU风格前馈模块四个组件，解决注意力集中导致的预测过拟合和不稳定问题。在涵盖全切片病理和细胞级血液学的六个基准上，最佳变体平均提升+6.1 macro F1，注意力分布更均匀。
Motivation: 现有基于注意力的MIL聚合器在医学影像中容易出现注意力集中，导致预测过拟合和不稳定，影响跨领域泛化。
Method: 引入门控Transformer聚合器QG-MIL，包含RMSNorm预归一化、每头QK归一化、细粒度注意力输出门控和SwiGLU风格前馈模块，无需辅助损失或掩码即可稳定训练并均匀分配注意力。
Result: 在六个基准上，最佳QG-MIL变体优于所有基线，平均提升+6.1 macro F1；注意力覆盖和注意力质量分析证实实例权重分配更均匀。
Conclusion: QG-MIL提供最一致的跨域性能和最低方差，且代码已开源以支持可重复性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: When Lower Privileges Suffice: Investigating Over-Privileged Tool Selection in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents increasingly select tools autonomously, their choices among tools with different privileges become safety-relevant. However, prior tool-selection studies focus on safety-agnostic metadata preferences, leaving privilege-sensitive choices underexplored. To address this gap, we study over-privileged tool selection, in which an agent selects or escalates to a higher-privilege tool despite a sufficient lower-privilege alternative. We introduce ToolPrivBench to evaluate whether agents choose higher-privilege tools despite sufficient lower-privilege alternatives, measuring both initial selection and escalation after transient tool failures. Across eight domains and five recurring risk patterns, we find that over-privileged tool selection is common among mainstream LLM agents and is further amplified by transient failures. We further find that general safety alignment does not reliably transfer to least-privilege tool choice, while prompt-level controls provide only limited mitigation under transient failures. We therefore introduce a privilege-aware post-training defense that teaches agents to prefer sufficient lower-privilege tools and escalate only when necessary. Our mitigation experiments show that this defense substantially reduces unnecessary high-privilege tool use while preserving general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM智能体在工具选择中的过特权问题，即智能体在存在足够低权限替代方案时，仍选择或升级到高权限工具。作者引入ToolPrivBench基准，涵盖8个领域和5种风险模式，发现主流LLM智能体普遍存在过特权工具选择，且暂时故障会加剧这一问题。通用安全对齐无法可靠迁移到最小权限原则，提示控制也只能提供有限缓解。为此提出特权感知后训练防御，显著减少不必要的高权限工具使用，同时保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有工具选择研究侧重于安全无关的元数据偏好，忽视了权限敏感的选择。智能体自动选择工具时，过特权选择可能带来安全风险，这一问题尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建ToolPrivBench基准，评估智能体在初始选择和暂时故障后的升级行为；提出特权感知后训练防御，教导智能体优先选择足够低权限的工具，仅在必要时升级。
Result: 主流LLM智能体普遍存在过特权工具选择，暂时故障会加剧该行为；通用安全对齐无法可靠转移到最小权限原则，提示控制仅在无故障时有效；提出的防御显著降低不必要的高权限工具使用，且不损害通用能力。
Conclusion: 过特权工具选择是LLM智能体中的常见问题，需要专门的防御机制；特权感知后训练是一种有效缓解方法。

papers.title: Stochastic Linear Contextual Bandits with Bounded Noise: A Set-Membership Approach
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers stochastic linear contextual bandits (SLCB) with bounded reward noise. Existing works typically assume sub-Gaussian reward noise and bounded expected rewards, under which the optimal regret bound scales as $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ in terms of horizon $T$. However, in many applications, realized/observed rewards are also naturally bounded, implying bounded reward noise. Bounded noise is more informative than the sub-Gaussian condition but has not been leveraged explicitly in the SLCB literature. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm SME-OFU by utilizing an uncertainty quantification method called set-membership estimation (SME) and applying the principle of optimism in the face of uncertainty (OFU). Our algorithm enjoys an improved regret bound $O(\log T)$. Notice that this does not contradict the existing optimal bound $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ for sub-Gaussian noise because bounded noise is a stronger condition. Finally, simulations show empirical improvements of SME-OFU over a benchmark algorithm designed for sub-Gaussian noise when the reward noise is bounded.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有有界奖励噪声的随机线性上下文bandit问题，提出SME-OFU算法，利用集员估计（SME）和乐观面对不确定性（OFU）原则，实现O(log T)的遗憾界，优于传统亚高斯噪声假设下的~O(√T)。仿真表明在噪声有界时算法性能优于基准。
Motivation: 现有线性上下文bandit工作通常假设亚高斯噪声，但实际应用中的奖励观测自然有界，有界噪声条件更强却未被充分利用。
Method: 提出SME-OFU算法，结合集员估计（SME）进行不确定性量化，并采用乐观面对不确定性（OFU）原则进行决策。
Result: 理论证明算法在水平T上达到O(log T)的遗憾界，仿真显示在有界噪声下优于针对亚高斯噪声设计的基准算法。
Conclusion: 有界噪声条件能带来更紧的遗憾界，SME-OFU有效利用了该条件。

papers.title: Adaptive Distance-Aware Trunk Deep Operator Learning for Long-Span Roadway Bridges
papers.abstract_en: Long-span roadway bridges exhibit highly localized structural responses under vehicular loading, making repeated FE analysis computationally expensive for applications such as influence surface generation and structural digital twins. Existing SciML approaches struggle to accurately capture these localized responses. To address this challenge, this study proposes an adaptive-trunk DeepONet for localized structural response prediction in large-scale bridge systems. The framework dynamically constructs a load-dependent learning domain using a KNN strategy, allowing the network to focus on structural influence zones. The trunk network is further enhanced using distance-aware features that encode the geometric relationship between the load and structural nodes. A physics-based full-field reconstruction is incorporated through a stiffness-informed Schur complement formulation, enabling predictions at adaptive nodes to be extended to the entire structural domain. To enable scalable training, response data are generated using a reduced-order equivalent shell model that preserves the dominant global behavior while significantly reducing computational cost. The proposed framework is validated on both a benchmark bridge model and the real-world Mussafah Bridge. Results show that the method achieves FEM-level accuracy with relative errors below 5%, while reducing the total response evaluation time (including full-field reconstruction) by approximately 60x; excluding the post-processing reconstruction step, the AD-DeepONet inference is up to four orders of magnitude faster than FEM. In addition, the framework enables rapid generation of full-field responses, influence lines, and influence surfaces under arbitrary vehicular loading configurations, demonstrating strong potential for large-scale bridge analysis and digital twin applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应距离感知主干深度算子网络（AD-DeepONet），用于长跨度公路桥梁在车辆荷载下的局部结构响应预测。该方法通过KNN动态构建荷载相关学习域，利用距离感知特征编码荷载与节点的几何关系，并结合基于刚度的Schur补全实现全场重构。在基准桥和Mussafah桥上验证，相对误差低于5%，推理速度比有限元法快约60倍（不含后处理），且能快速生成任意荷载下的全场响应和影响面。
Motivation: 长跨度桥梁在车辆荷载下呈现高度局部化结构响应，重复有限元分析计算成本高，现有科学机器学习方法难以准确捕捉局部响应。
Method: 提出自适应主干DeepONet，采用KNN策略动态构建荷载依赖学习域，增强主干网络的距离感知特征；结合刚度信息Schur补全实现物理信息全场面重构；使用等效壳模型降阶生成训练数据。
Result: 在基准桥和Mussafah桥上，相对误差低于5%；总响应评估时间（含全场重构）减少约60倍，纯推理速度比有限元法快四个数量级。
Conclusion: 该方法能快速生成任意车辆荷载下的全场响应、影响线和影响面，适用于大规模桥梁分析和数字孪生应用。

papers.title: Hierarchical Control in Multi-Agent Games: LLM-based Planning and RL Execution
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved strong performance in sequential decision-making, yet scaling to complex multi-agent environments remains challenging due to sparse rewards, large state-action spaces, and the difficulty of learning coordinated strategies. We propose a hierarchical architecture where a pretrained large language model (LLM) acts as a centralized strategic controller that selects among specialized RL skill policies for a team of agents, while RL policies handle reactive low-level execution. We evaluate this hybrid system in a competitive 2v2 King of the Hill environment against behavior tree (BT) and \emph{``Flat''} RL (end-to-end training without skill decomposition) baselines. The LLM+RL system achieves task performance statistically equivalent to hand-crafted BT (46.4\% vs 51.5\% win rate, $p=0.103$) while both significantly outperform Flat RL trained without skill decomposition. A user study ($n=15$) reveals that 60\% of participants perceive LLM+RL agents as the most human-like ($p=0.027$), citing behavioral adaptability and tactical variability. These results demonstrate that pretrained LLM reasoning can effectively orchestrate pretrained RL skills, achieving competitive multi-agent coordination and superior perceived believability without manual rule engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种分层架构，在竞争性2v2多智能体游戏中，预训练大语言模型（LLM）作为中央战略控制器选择专门的RL技能策略，而RL策略处理反应式底层执行。与手工行为树（BT）和端到端训练的扁平RL基线相比，LLM+RL系统在任务性能上与BT统计等价（46.4% vs 51.5%胜率，p=0.103），两者均显著优于扁平RL。用户研究（n=15）显示60%参与者认为LLM+RL智能体最像人类（p=0.027），归因于行为适应性和战术可变性。
Motivation: 强化学习在复杂多智能体环境中面临稀疏奖励、大状态-动作空间和协调策略学习困难等问题，现有方法难以扩展。
Method: 提出分层架构：预训练LLM作为集中式战略控制器，从多个预训练的RL技能策略中选择执行，RL策略负责低层反应式执行。在2v2 King of the Hill环境中评估。

papers.title: Self-Adaptive Scale Handling for Forecasting Time Series with Scale Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Current time series forecasting (TSF) research predominantly focuses on scale-homogeneous data, where different time series share similar numerical magnitude ranges. However, in real-world industrial scenarios such as financial product sales, different time series often differ by orders of magnitude (scale heterogeneity). Since these series share similar temporal patterns, joint modeling is desirable for better data utilization, yet existing scaling methods either compress low-scale signals (global normalization) or destroy semantic discriminability and amplify inverse-scaling errors (window-based scaling). This paper proposes a self-Adaptive Scale-handling (AS) module that learns adaptive scale factors tailored to each input, preserving semantic discriminability while reducing inverse-scaling errors. AS consists of Scale Calibrating (SC), which calibrates prior mean scaling factors through neural networks, and Scaling Selection (SS), which decides whether to apply calibration or retain the original factor, avoiding over-calibration. Experiments on real-world fund sales datasets from Ant Fortune and Alipay show that AS seamlessly integrates into popular TSF models and consistently improves their performance. The code and dataset are available at the link https://github.com/Meteor-Stars/ASTSF.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列预测中不同序列尺度差异大的问题，提出自适应尺度处理模块（AS），包括尺度校准（SC）和尺度选择（SS），在保留语义判别性的同时减少逆缩放误差。在蚂蚁财富和支付宝的基金销售数据集上，AS模块能无缝集成到主流预测模型中并持续提升性能。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测主要研究尺度同质数据，但真实工业场景（如金融产品销售）中不同序列量级差异大（尺度异质性）。现有缩放方法（全局归一化压缩低尺度信号，窗口缩放破坏语义并放大逆缩放误差）无法有效处理这一问题。
Method: 提出自适应尺度处理（AS）模块：包含尺度校准（SC）通过神经网络学习校准先验均值缩放因子，以及尺度选择（SS）决定是否应用校准或保留原因子，避免过度校准。
Result: 在蚂蚁财富和支付宝的基金销售数据集上，AS模块可无缝集成到主流TSF模型（如Transformer、LSTM等）中，并持续提升预测性能。
Conclusion: AS模块通过自适应学习尺度因子，兼顾语义判别与逆缩放误差控制，为尺度异质时间序列预测提供了一种通用且有效的预处理方法。

papers.title: VIMPO: Value-Implicit Policy Optimization for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a central tool for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but current methods face a trade-off between simplicity and credit assignment. Group-relative methods such as GRPO avoid training a critic, but typically assign a trajectory-level advantage to every token. Actor-critic methods provide denser learning signals, but require a learned value function with its own training instability. We introduce VIMPO, a critic-free policy optimization method that derives a policy-implied value function from the optimality conditions of KL-regularized reinforcement learning. For autoregressive generation, the resulting value recurrence can be written in terms of policy-reference log-ratios and anchored by the terminal condition that no future reward remains at the end of a trajectory. This gives a simple value loss that incorporates outcome-level verifiable rewards without training a critic. The same derivation also yields a critic-free actor advantage, allowing VIMPO to separate reward incorporation through the value loss from policy improvement through a PPO-style actor update. On mathematical RLVR benchmarks, VIMPO improves over GRPO across MATH-500, AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and OlympiadBench, with especially larger gains on competition-style evaluations. Under noisy rewards, VIMPO retains a consistent advantage over GRPO, suggesting that policy-implied value optimization can provide finer credit assignment while preserving the practical simplicity of critic-free training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VIMPO，一种无需批评网络的策略优化方法，通过KL正则化强化学习的最优条件推导策略隐含的价值函数，实现细粒度信用分配。在数学推理基准MATH-500、AIME 2024/2025和OlympiadBench上，VIMPO优于GRPO，尤其在竞赛级评估中提升更大，且在噪声奖励下保持优势。
Motivation: 现有LLM强化学习方法在简单性与信用分配之间存在权衡：GRPO等群组相对方法简单但分配轨迹级优势；演员-评论家方法提供密集信号但需训练价值函数且不稳定。
Method: VIMPO从KL正则化强化学习的最优条件推导策略隐含的价值函数，利用自回归生成中的价值递归（基于策略-参考对数比和终端条件），定义无批评网络的价值损失和演员优势，将奖励融入价值损失与策略改进分离。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，VIMPO在MATH-500、AIME 2024、AIME 2025和OlympiadBench上均优于GRPO，尤其在竞赛级评估中提升更大；在噪声奖励下仍保持优势。
Conclusion: VIMPO通过策略隐含的价值优化提供更细的信用分配，同时保持无批评训练的实际简洁性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StreamKL: Fast and Memory-Efficient KL Divergence for Boosting Attention Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Attention distillation, which trains one attention distribution to match another by minimizing their Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, is widely used in knowledge distillation, model compression, continual learning, and sparse-attention LLM training. However, existing approaches materialize both attention distributions before computing the KL reduction, incurring $O(N_QN_K)$ memory and IO costs that become prohibitive at long context lengths. We present StreamKL, the first fused GPU primitive for attention KL divergence that eliminates this quadratic materialization. StreamKL derives a novel online formulation for the coupled two-distribution KL reduction, enabling a single one-pass forward kernel that streams query-key tiles through on-chip SRAM. For the backward pass, StreamKL recomputes attention probabilities tile-by-tile, avoiding storage of quadratic intermediates. We further design and implement efficient GPU kernels with dedicated optimizations. Experiments show StreamKL delivers up to $43\times$ and $14\times$ speedups over baseline methods in the forward and backward passes, respectively. Most importantly, StreamKL reduces the extra HBM footprint of attention distillation from $O(N_QN_K)$ to $O(1)$, enabling long-context distillation on a single GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了StreamKL，首个融合GPU原语用于注意力KL散度计算，消除了传统方法中O(N_Q N_K)内存占用和IO开销。通过新颖的在线公式和单次前向流式处理，StreamKL在长上下文中实现高达43倍前向加速和14倍反向加速，并将注意力蒸馏的额外HBM占用从O(N_Q N_K)降低到O(1)。
Motivation: 现有注意力蒸馏方法需物化两个注意力分布后再计算KL散度，导致二次内存和IO开销，在长上下文场景下难以承受。
Method: 提出StreamKL，基于在线公式设计单次前向内核，通过流式查询-键块在片上SRAM中计算KL散度；反向传播时逐块重计算注意力概率，避免存储二次中间结果，并针对GPU进行了专用优化。
Result: 实验表明，StreamKL在前向和反向传播中分别比基线方法快43倍和14倍，并将额外HBM占用从O(N_Q N_K)降至O(1)，使得长上下文蒸馏可在单GPU上完成。
Conclusion: StreamKL通过融合GPU原语和在线计算消除了注意力蒸馏的内存瓶颈，为长上下文场景下的知识蒸馏、模型压缩等应用提供了高效解决方案。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Connect the Dots: Training LLMs for Long-Lifecycle Agents with Cross-Domain Generalization Via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a general framework for training large language models (LLMs) to "Connect the Dots" (CoD), a meta-capability required by long-lifecycle agents: as an LLM-based AI agent gets deployed in an environment, it solves a long sequence of tasks while continuously exploring the environment, learning from its own experiences, and iteratively self-updating its context about the environment, thereby achieving progressively better performance on future tasks conditioned on the updated context. Major components of the CoD framework include: (1) algorithm design and infrastructure for end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) with long rollout sequences interleaving solve-task and update-context episodes; (2) tasks and environments for incentivizing and eliciting the targeted meta-capability in LLMs during training, as well as for faithfully measuring progress during evaluation. We present proof-of-concept implementations of the CoD framework, including a GRPO-style RL algorithm with fine-grained credit assignment, as well as tasks and environments tailored to the targeted meta-capability (rather than domain-specific LLM capabilities or standard task-by-task RL). Empirical results validate the efficacy of end-to-end RL training in the CoD setting, and demonstrate the potential for out-of-distribution generalization -- within the training domains, across different domains, and from CoD to Ralph-loop settings -- of the elicited meta-capability. Our investigation of CoD connects several lines of prior works, and opens up new opportunities for advancing LLMs and AI agents. To facilitate further research and applications, we release our implementations at \url{https://github.com/agentscope-ai/Trinity-RFT/tree/research/cod/examples/research_cod}.
papers.comment: Work in progress; we will continuously update the codebase and arXiv version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“Connect the Dots”(CoD)框架，用于训练大语言模型（LLM）具备长生命周期智能体所需的元能力：在长期部署中连续解决任务、探索环境、学习经验并迭代更新上下文，从而在新任务上取得更好性能。框架包括端到端强化学习（RL）算法（GRPO风格，细粒度信用分配）和专门设计的任务环境。实验验证了RL训练的有效性，并展示了跨领域泛化潜力。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体缺乏在长期部署中持续学习并更新上下文的能力，无法实现跨域泛化，需要统一框架来训练这种元能力。
Method: 提出CoD框架，包括：(1)端到端RL算法，使用长回滚序列交织solve-task和update-context片段，并采用GRPO风格的细粒度信用分配；(2)专门设计的任务和环境，用于激励和测量目标元能力。代码已开源。
Result: 实证结果验证了端到端RL训练在CoD设置中的有效性，并展示了分布外泛化潜力——在训练域内、跨不同域、以及从CoD到Ralph-loop设置中。
Conclusion: CoD框架连接了多项先前工作，为推进LLM和AI智能体开辟了新机会。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Tri-Info: Generalizable, Interpretable Failure Prediction for VLA Models via Information Theory
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly deployed across diverse tasks, yet they remain black boxes whose physical interactions can cause irreversible harm, making generalizable and interpretable failure detection essential. We observe that successful and failed rollouts carry systematically different information-theoretic signatures. Building on this, we formalize VLA control as a closed-loop information pipeline and derive the Triple Information-theoretic (Tri-Info) signals that capture whether actions remain diverse, temporally consistent, and coupled to state transitions. Across six VLA models and three benchmark environments, Tri-Info matches the strongest baselines in-domain. Moreover, Tri-Info transfers across architectures, environments, and the sim-to-real gap without retraining, reaching 83\% accuracy on real-world tasks where prior detectors collapse to chance. This establishes Tri-Info as a simple yet powerful method that not only detects failures with strong cross-domain generalization, but also delivers interpretable diagnostics of the underlying failure modes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的失败预测问题，从信息论角度提出Tri-Info方法，通过三种信息论信号（动作多样性、时间一致性、状态转移耦合度）检测失败。在六个VLA模型和三个基准环境中，Tri-Info在域内匹配最强基线，并能跨架构、跨环境、甚至跨sim-to-real迁移，无需重新训练即在真实世界任务中达到83%准确率，同时提供可解释的失败模式诊断。
Motivation: VLA模型作为黑箱在物理交互中可能造成不可逆伤害，需要通用且可解释的失败检测方法，但现有方法泛化性差且缺乏可解释性。
Method: 将VLA控制形式化为闭环信息管道，推导三种信息论信号（Tri-Info）：动作多样性、时间一致性和状态转移耦合度，用于量化失败。
Result: 在六个VLA模型和三个基准环境中，Tri-Info域内性能匹配最强基线；跨架构、环境和sim-to-real无需再训练，在真实世界任务中达83%准确率，而基线方法退化为随机。
Conclusion: Tri-Info是一种简单而强大的方法，不仅具有强跨域泛化能力检测失败，还能提供可解释的失败模式诊断。

summary_sections.method: 将VLA控制形式化为闭环信息管道，推导三种信息论信号（Tri-Info）：动作多样性、时间一致性和状态转移耦合度，用于量化失败。
summary_sections.result: 在六个VLA模型和三个基准环境中，Tri-Info域内性能匹配最强基线；跨架构、环境和sim-to-real无需再训练，在真实世界任务中达83%准确率，而基线方法退化为随机。
summary_sections.conclusion: Tri-Info是一种简单而强大的方法，不仅具有强跨域泛化能力检测失败，还能提供可解释的失败模式诊断。

papers.title: Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR): Function-Preserving SVD Compression for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: We present Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR), an SVD-based LLM compression framework that guides each weight matrix's low-rank approximation with a backward-signal influence metric. Starting from the activation-aware optimum of SVD-LLM(W), AIR runs a single closed-form alternating least squares (ALS) sweep that integrates influence element-wise under a monotone-descent guarantee. AIR is layer-local and composes orthogonally with end-to-end methods: alone it exceeds ACIP, and AIR+LoRA outperforms it further. AIR improves perplexity over SVD-LLM(W) by >18% at <=60% parameter retention, matches its quality with ~90% less calibration data, and turns parameter savings into FLOP, peak-memory, and per-token latency gains.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference (AdaptFM), Seoul, South Korea (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR)，一种基于SVD的LLM压缩框架。它利用反向信号影响度量指导每个权重矩阵的低秩近似，通过单次封闭形式交替最小二乘（ALS）扫描逐元素集成影响，并保证单调递减。AIR是层局部的，可与端到端方法正交组合：单独使用超过 ACIP，AIR+LoRA 表现更优。在参数保留 ≤60% 时，AIR 相对 SVD-LLM(W) 将困惑度改善 >18%，匹配其质量时所需校准数据减少约90%，并将参数节省转化为FLOP、峰值内存和每token延迟的收益。
Motivation: 现有SVD-based LLM压缩方法在低秩近似时未充分考虑激活值分布和反向传播信号的影响，导致近似质量受限。AIR通过引入后向信号影响度量来改进低秩近似的精度。
Method: 从激活感知最优起点（SVD-LLM(W)）出发，执行单次封闭形式交替最小二乘（ALS）扫描，该扫描逐元素集成反向信号影响，并在单调递减保证下更新近似。
Result: 在参数保留 ≤60% 时，AIR 的困惑度比 SVD-LLM(W) 改善 >18%；达到相同质量时，校准数据需求减少约90%；参数压缩转化为 FLOP、峰值内存和逐token延迟的降低。
Conclusion: AIR是一种层局部、与端到端方法正交组合的压缩框架，单独性能优于 ACIP，且与 LoRA 结合可进一步提升。

papers.title: Beyond Static Endpoints: Tool Programs as an Interface for Flexible Agentic Web Services
papers.abstract_en: In the agentic web era, LLM-based agents increasingly invoke web services as tools, yet most interfaces remain \emph{static endpoints} that poorly express long-horizon workflows with loops, conditionals, joins, and retries. We present ToolPro, which represents an agent's tool intent as an \emph{executable tool program} that compactly encodes multi-step service interactions with explicit effect types. ToolPro combines constraint-guided program construction, effect-aware replay for exactly-once state-modifying calls, and a profile-driven policy that decides when program execution outperforms stepwise calling. We instantiate ToolPro over MCP-style services with WebAssembly sandboxing and evaluate it on diverse workflows of real-world applications. ToolPro reduces end-to-end latency by up to 53.4\% and client-side traffic by up to 96.1\%, with larger gains under higher network latency and workflow complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ToolPro，将代理的工具意图表示为可执行工具程序，以紧凑编码多步服务交互，包含显式效果类型。ToolPro 结合约束引导的程序构造、效果感知重放以实现恰好一次的状态修改调用，以及基于配置文件的策略，决定何时程序执行优于逐步调用。在 MCP 风格服务上实验，ToolPro 将端到端延迟降低最多 53.4%，客户端流量降低最多 96.1%。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的代理调用 web 服务时，多数接口是静态端点，难以表达包含循环、条件、连接和重试的长周期工作流。
Method: ToolPro 将代理的工具意图表达为可执行工具程序，通过约束引导的程序构造生成多步交互，使用效果感知重放保证恰好一次语义，并通过配置文件策略自适应选择执行方式。
Result: 在真实世界应用的不同工作流上，ToolPro 比基线方法降低端到端延迟最高 53.4%，客户端流量最高 96.1%，且在更高网络延迟和更复杂工作流下收益更大。
Conclusion: 将工具调用抽象为可执行程序可以显著提升代理式 web 服务的效率和鲁棒性，尤其适合复杂网络环境。
Relevance: 5
