papers.title: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
papers.abstract_en: While RL has become a promising tool for refining world models, existing methods largely rely on conservative rollouts near the training distribution, limiting exploration, behavioral diversity, and richer dynamic discovery. In this work, we challenge this conservative paradigm. We argue that the core limitation is not exploration itself, but the lack of reliable verification strategies to support broader exploration. Without reliable verification, expanded exploration becomes highly susceptible to reward hacking, where policies exploit imperfect rewards without achieving genuine improvement. To evaluate this motivation, we instantiate our method in embodied world models, where physical plausibility, and task completion provide a rigorous testbed for scalable RL under complex dynamics. On the verification side, we introduce Reward as an Agent, an agentic reward framework that actively evaluates generated behaviors to provide robust reward signals and mitigate reward hacking under distribution shifts. On the exploration side, we introduce Dynamic-Aware Rollout Diversification through DynDiff-GRPO, which explicitly expands action-space exploration to diversify trajectories, broaden state-action coverage, and encourage richer embodied behaviors beyond conservative rollout regimes. By unifying Reward as an Agent with DynDiff-GRPO, we enable RL on a more reliable reward foundation with substantially diversified sampling, effectively mitigating reward hacking while yielding significant accuracy gains across multiple open-source world models, thereby demonstrating that broader exploration can scale successfully when grounded in robust verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了现有强化学习世界模型中保守rollout的范式，认为核心限制并非探索本身，而是缺乏可靠的验证策略。为此提出Reward as an Agent框架，主动评估生成行为以提供鲁棒奖励信号，并结合DynDiff-GRPO扩展动作空间探索，在具身世界模型上缓解奖励破解并提升准确率。
Motivation: 现有RL世界模型方法依赖保守rollout，限制了探索和行为多样性，且无可靠验证的广泛探索易导致奖励破解。
Method: 提出Reward as an Agent奖励框架，主动评估行为以提供鲁棒信号；引入DynDiff-GRPO实现动态感知的rollout多样化，扩大动作空间探索。
Result: 在多个开源世界模型上，该方法有效缓解奖励破解，并取得显著准确率提升。
Conclusion: 本文表明，在稳健验证基础上进行更广泛的探索是可行的，为RL世界模型提供了更可靠的奖励基础。

papers.title: Online Dynamic Batching with Formal Guarantees for LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM training breaks a core assumption behind offline batch samplers: the true training cost of a sample is only observable after preprocessing, augmentation, templating, tokenization, and multimodal visual-token expansion. Unless one pays for a preprocessing- and augmentation-dependent length cache, batch construction is therefore blind to the quantity that determines padding, memory use, and GPU saturation. We introduce Online Dynamic Batching (ODB), a DataLoader-side drop-in system that moves batch formation to this point of accurate observability while preserving DDP step alignment. We formalize this synchronization requirement as the Distributed Group Alignment Problem and prove deadlock-free bounded termination with default join-mode identity coverage and opt-in non-join sample-quota closure. ODB requires no model, optimizer, or attention-kernel changes and is released as online-dynamic-batching with lightweight trainer adapters. Across public 2B/8B Qwen3-VL runs on UltraChat/LLaVA/ShareGPT4o, ODB improves literal emitted-sample throughput vs. fixed-batch Standard by 1.58-2.51x on single-node Full FT/LoRA and 1.71-3.78x on two-node Full FT, with Standard-comparable quality; production MM-Mix reaches 4.43x. Against GMT/BMT offline token-budget oracles, ODB is within 15% on UltraChat/LLaVA and faster on high-CV ShareGPT4o: 2.24-2.39x single-node Full FT/LoRA and 3.06-3.69x two-node Full FT. Together, ODB occupies the online/drop-in regime for high-heterogeneity LLM fine-tuning: large throughput gains at Standard-comparable quality, formal DGAP guarantees, and no length-cache precompute or kernel rewrites.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出在线动态批处理（ODB），一种在数据加载器端动态构建批次的方法，解决LLM训练中样本预处理后长度未知导致的批处理效率问题。ODB在保持分布式数据并行（DDP）步对齐的同时，将批次构建推迟到预处理后，实现更高的吞吐量。在Qwen3-VL模型上的实验表明，相比固定批次，ODB将单节点全参数微调/LoRA的吞吐量提升1.58-2.51倍，两节点全参数微调提升1.71-3.78倍，且质量相当。
Motivation: LLM训练中，样本的真实成本（如填充、内存使用）仅在预处理后可知，而传统离线采样器在预处理前构建批次，导致效率低下。现有方法需要预处理长度缓存，但增加开销。
Method: 提出Online Dynamic Batching（ODB），在数据加载器侧动态构建批次，并形式化为分布式组对齐问题（DGAP），证明其无死锁的有界终止性。ODB无需修改模型或注意力核，作为轻量级适配器集成。
Result: 在Qwen3-VL模型上，ODB相比固定批次（Standard）实现单节点全参数微调提升1.58-2.51倍吞吐量，两节点提升1.71-3.78倍；相比离线长度预算方法（GMT/BMT），在高度异质的数据集上提升2.24-3.69倍。
Conclusion: ODB在LLM微调中实现了显著的吞吐量提升，达到与标准方法相当的质量，并提供了正式的分布式对齐保证，无需预计算长度缓存或重写内核。

papers.title: Vision-Reasoning-Guided Occlusion Removal from Light Fields
papers.abstract_en: Occlusion-robust scene recovery remains a major challenge in computational imaging, particularly in natural environments where dense foreground vegetation severely limits visibility. We propose a vision-reasoning-guided light field occlusion removal framework that combines the visibility recovery capability of light field integration (LFI) with the semantic reasoning capacity of vision-language models (VLMs). Multi-view observations are first integrated via LFI to suppress foreground occlusions and produce an initial visibility-enhanced representation. A VLM is then incorporated as a conditional semantic prior to restore degraded structures and recover fine details, guided by the observed measurements. To improve recovery consistency and reduce hallucination artifacts, we introduce a multi-sample fusion strategy that aggregates multiple generated hypotheses into a unified estimate. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, achieving the highest average SSIM across four synthetic light field benchmark scenes (4-Syn) and strong generalization across structured and unstructured acquisition settings. These results highlight the effectiveness of combining physical imaging constraints with vision-language reasoning for robust perception under severe occlusion, with applicability to search-and-rescue and exploratory robotic navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种视觉-推理引导的光场遮挡去除框架，结合光场积分（LFI）和视觉语言模型（VLM），先通过LFI抑制前景遮挡，再由VLM提供语义先验恢复细节，并采用多样本融合策略减少幻觉。在合成和真实数据集上达到SOTA，平均SSIM最高。
Motivation: 自然环境中密集前景植被严重限制可见性，现有遮挡鲁棒场景恢复方法在复杂环境下效果有限。
Method: 框架分两步：首先用LFI（光场积分）从多视角观测中抑制前景遮挡，生成初步增强表示；然后引入VLM作为条件语义先验，指导恢复退化结构和细节，最后通过多样本融合策略聚合多个生成假设。
Result: 在4个合成光场基准场景（4-Syn）上取得最高平均SSIM，在结构和非结构化采集场景中均展现强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 结合物理成像约束和视觉语言推理可有效提升严重遮挡下的鲁棒感知，适用于搜救和探索性机器人导航。

papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Reservoir Computing
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir computing offers a lightweight framework for forecasting dynamical systems but may struggle to capture long-range dependencies due to limited representational capacity. Conventional reservoir computing recurrently uses trainable reservoirs with hyperparameter sensitivity, while the next-generation reservoir computing removes recurrence at the cost of rapidly growing feature dimensions. Here, we develop Kolmogorov-Arnold Reservoir Computing (KARC), which replaces reservoirs with explicit basis-function expansions inspired by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem. We rigorously show that KARC is a lightweight design of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs), preserving the potential expressive capacity of KANs while admitting efficient closed-form training of reservoir computing. At comparable cost, KARC outperforms existing reservoir computing methods on challenging benchmarks including partial differential equations. It can also be integrated with generative diffusion models for text-to-image generation. This work thus establishes a principled bridge between reservoir computing and KANs, enabling efficient and high-fidelity dynamical system forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Kolmogorov-Arnold Reservoir Computing (KARC)，用显式基函数展开替换传统水库，是一种轻量化的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络设计。理论证明其保留KAN的表达能力且支持闭式训练，在偏微分方程等挑战性基准上超越现有水库计算方法，并可集成扩散模型用于文本到图像生成。
Motivation: 传统水库计算难以捕获长程依赖且超参数敏感，下一代水库计算虽去除递归但特征维度快速增长，需更高效可靠的方法。
Method: 基于Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理，用可学习的基函数展开构建水库，实现闭式训练，避免递归和维度爆炸。
Result: 在偏微分方程等基准上，KARC以相当计算成本取得优于现有水库计算方法的预测性能。
Conclusion: KARC建立了水库计算与KAN之间的理论桥梁，为高效高保真的动态系统预测提供了新范式。

papers.title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
papers.abstract_en: Achieving dexterous robotic manipulation in the real world heavily relies on human supervision and algorithm engineering, which becomes a central bottleneck in the pursuit of general physical intelligence. Although emerging coding agents can generate code to automate algorithm search, their successes remain largely confined in digital environments. We conjecture that the missing abstraction to automate robotics research is a repeatable feedback loop for real-world policy improvement: reset the scene, execute a policy, verify the outcome, and refine the next iteration. To bridge this gap, we introduce ENPIRE, a harness framework for coding agents that instantiates this physical feedback routine with four core modules: an Environment module (EN) for automatic reset and verification, a Policy Improvement module (PI) that launches policy refinement, a Rollout module (R) to evaluate policies with one or multiple physical robots operating in parallel, and an Evolution module (E) in which coding agents analyze logs, consult literature, improve training infrastructure and algorithm code to address failure modes. This closed-loop system transforms real-world manipulation learning into a controllable optimization procedure, minimizing human effort while allowing fair ablations across training recipe and agent variants. Powered by ENPIRE, frontier coding agents can autonomously train a policy to achieve a 99% success rate on challenging, dexterous manipulation tasks, such as organizing a pin box, fastening a zip tie, and tool use, a process that further accelerates when we dispatch an agent team on a robot fleet. Our results suggest a practical and scalable path toward deploying coding agents to autonomously advancing robotics in the physical world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ENPIRE 框架，让编码代理在真实世界中通过闭环物理反馈循环自主改进机器人操作策略。该框架包含环境重置与验证、策略改进、并行评估和代码进化四个模块，在复杂灵巧操作任务上达到 99% 的成功率。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作依赖大量人工监督和算法工程，缺乏可重复的物理反馈循环，成为实现通用物理智能的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 ENPIRE 框架，由环境模块 (EN)、策略改进模块 (PI)、评估模块 (R) 和进化模块 (E) 组成，形成闭环系统，自动执行场景重置、策略执行、结果验证和下一轮改进。
Result: 在整理针盒、拉紧扎带、工具使用等灵巧操作任务上，前沿编码代理自主训练策略达到 99% 成功率，且通过机器人集群加速。
Conclusion: ENPIRE 提供了一种实用且可扩展的路径，将真实世界操作学习转化为可控优化过程，减少人类工作量，支持训练方案和代理变体的公平消融。

papers.title: The Algorithmic-Human Manager: AI, Apps, and Workers in the Indian Gig Economy
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of artificial intelligence and digital technologies on the blue-collar gig economy in India, focusing on algorithmic management. This paper examines the impact of artificial intelligence and digital technologies on the blue collar gig economy in India, focusing on algorithmic management he use of automated systems to allocate, monitor, and evaluate work in location-based services such as ride sharing and delivery. Using a social justice framework and a mixed-methods approach comprising interviews with 16 gig workers and 21 key stakeholders, the study uncovers a dual reality: while AI-powered systems expand access to work and generate operational efficiencies, they simultaneously introduce significant challenges related to fairness, transparency, and worker dignity. Key findings reveal that algorithmic systems are opaque by design, produce inequitable outcomes, and are not structured to reward additional labour with proportionate pay. The study advocates for a pragmatic hybrid governance model an Algorithmic Human Manager framework in which technological efficiency and human accountability operate together rather than in opposition. The findings carry implications for policymakers, platform companies, and civil society organizations working to design equitable AI governance frameworks for the gig economy in India and across the Global South.
papers.comment: Published by the Centre for Responsible AI (CeRAI) at IIT Madras
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人工智能和数字技术对印度蓝领零工经济的影响，聚焦算法管理。通过混合方法（16名零工工人和21名利益相关者的访谈），揭示了算法系统在扩大工作机会和提升运营效率的同时，也带来了公平性、透明度和工人尊严方面的挑战。研究倡导一种务实的混合治理模型——算法-人类管理者框架（Algorithmic Human Manager framework），实现技术效率与人类问责制的协同。
Motivation: 现有研究较少关注印度等全球南方国家零工经济中算法管理的实际影响，特别是对蓝领工人的公平性和尊严问题。
Method: 采用社会正义框架和混合方法，包括对16名零工工人和21名关键利益相关者的半结构化访谈，分析算法分配、监控和评估工作的机制。
Result: 算法系统设计不透明，产生不公平结果，且额外劳动无法获得成比例报酬；同时系统扩大了工作准入并提升了效率。
Conclusion: 提出算法-人类管理者混合治理模型，强调技术效率与人类问责制并重，为政策制定者、平台公司和公民社会提供AI治理启示。

papers.title: CrossFlow: One-Step Generation Across Latent and Pixel Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Most diffusion and flow-matching generators define the prior, probability path, and prediction target in the same representation space. Latent diffusion improves efficiency by moving this path into an autoencoder latent space, but the final sample is still produced by a separately trained decoder. This separation creates a mismatch: the generator is optimized for latent-space prediction, while final quality depends on how the decoder handles generated latents that may differ from clean encoder outputs. We introduce CrossFlow, a cross-space flow formulation that maps noisy latent inputs directly to pixel-space images. The key technical step is a velocity-free one-step objective: the latent trajectory defines the training path, but the supervised prediction is an image rather than a latent displacement. This lets one model act both as a one-step latent-to-pixel generator and as a decoder replacement for latent diffusion pipelines. On class-conditional ImageNet-1k at $256\times256$, CrossFlow-XL achieves 1.62 FID with one function evaluation. Ablations show that the latent encoder and pixel-space perceptual and adversarial losses are important for fidelity. These results indicate that cross-space flow objectives can combine the efficiency of latent representations with direct pixel-space supervision, without requiring a separate decoder at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CrossFlow，一种跨潜在空间和像素空间的流模型，通过一步目标函数直接将噪声潜在向量映射为像素级图像，替代了传统潜在扩散中分离的解码器。在ImageNet-1k 256×256上，CrossFlow-XL以单次函数评估达到1.62 FID。消融实验表明潜在编码器、像素空间感知损失和对抗损失对保真度至关重要。
Motivation: 现有潜在扩散方法将生成过程压缩到自编码器潜在空间，但最终样本仍需单独的解码器，导致训练优化与最终质量之间的失配：生成器针对潜在空间预测优化，而解码器需处理可能偏离干净编码器输出的生成潜在变量。
Method: 提出跨空间流公式，定义噪声潜在输入直接到像素空间图像的映射。关键步骤是免速度的一步目标：潜在轨迹定义训练路径，但监督预测是图像而非潜在位移，使一个模型同时充当一步潜在-像素生成器和潜在扩散管线的解码器替换。
Result: 在类别条件ImageNet-1k 256×256上，CrossFlow-XL以一次函数评估取得1.62 FID。
Conclusion: 跨空间流目标能够结合潜在表示的高效性与像素级空间监督的直接性，无需推理时使用单独的解码器。潜在编码器、像素空间感知损失和对抗损失对保真度重要。

papers.title: Semantic-Anchored Evidential Fusion for Domain-Robust Whole-Slide Survival Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are widely used for computational cancer prognosis. However, most existing methods primarily focus on in-domain performance and fail to generalize across clinical centers. This limitation stems from their reliance on pixel-derived representations that are highly susceptible to domain-specific artifacts caused by staining protocols and scanner hardware. We hypothesize that high-level pathology semantics, such as tumor grade and micro-environmental architecture, provide a domain-invariant semantic representation that mirrors the robust diagnostic logic of human pathologists. Therefore, we propose a Semantic-Anchored Evidential Fusion Survival (SAEFS) framework, where SAEFS derives semantic anchors from WSIs via Visual Question Answering (VQA), employs a dual-stream WSI evidence extraction architecture, uses Dirichlet-based Subjective Logic to model uncertainty, and fuses semantic and visual evidence through a cautious conjunction rule to avoid overconfident fusion from correlated sources. Trained exclusively on one source domain and evaluated zero-shot across four unseen domains, SAEFS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models both in prediction accuracy and reliability, improving the average C-index by 10.2%. Quantitative analyses further show that VQA-derived semantic features exhibit significantly lower cross-center divergence than pixel-derived features, highlighting their robustness for cross-center clinical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全切片图像（WSI）在癌症预后分析中跨中心泛化性差的问题，提出语义锚定证据融合生存分析框架（SAEFS）。该框架通过视觉问答（VQA）提取语义锚点，采用双流证据提取架构和狄利克雷主观逻辑建模不确定性，并利用谨慎合取规则融合语义与视觉证据。在零样本跨域评估中，SAEFS的平均C-index提升10.2%，且VQA语义特征跨中心差异显著低于像素特征。
Motivation: 现有WSI生存分析方法主要关注域内性能，因依赖易受染色协议和扫描仪伪影影响的像素级特征，难以泛化至不同临床中心。
Method: 提出SAEFS框架：通过VQA从WSI中提取语义锚点；使用双流架构提取证据；基于狄利克雷主观逻辑建模不确定性；采用谨慎合取规则融合语义与视觉证据，避免过自信融合。
Result: 在单一源域训练、四个未见域零样本评估中，SAEFS在预测准确性和可靠性上均超越现有方法，平均C-index提升10.2%。
Conclusion: VQA提取的语义特征比像素特征具有更低的跨中心差异，表明其鲁棒性，有助于跨中心临床应用。

papers.title: ROSE: Benchmarking the Perception-to-Action Gap in Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to act on visual information, yet the same scene may require different actions under different task contexts. How reliably can a model turn the same visual evidence into the action required by the current context? To answer this question, we introduce \textsc{ROSE} (\textbf{R}eference-conditioned \textbf{O}ddity and \textbf{S}ymbolic \textbf{E}xecution), a controlled benchmark that holds the visual scene fixed while varying region constraints and required symbolic outputs. Through coupled counting and coordinate-action tasks, \textsc{ROSE} tests whether models can infer an implicit majority reference and act on the resulting fine-grained visual evidence under changing contexts. Across nine recent MLLMs, performance drops by as much as 44.5 percentage points from counting-oriented tasks to region-conditioned action, despite 98.8\% human performance. The gap persists on paired scenes and regions for which the same model returns the correct count, while global-click and matched local controls show that coordinate grounding explains only part of the loss, revealing a distinct, model-dependent bottleneck in turning shared visual evidence into context-specific actions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ROSE基准，用于评估多模态大模型（MLLMs）在固定视觉场景下根据上下文改变动作的能力。通过成对的计数和坐标-动作任务，发现从计数到区域条件动作性能下降高达44.5个百分点，而人类准确率为98.8%。进一步分析表明，坐标定位仅部分解释性能损失，存在模型相关的感知-行动差距。
Motivation: 当前MLLMs被期望基于视觉信息行动，但同一场景在不同任务下需要不同动作，缺乏衡量模型将视觉证据转为上下文特定动作可靠性的基准。
Method: 提出ROSE基准，包含成对的计数和坐标-动作任务，固定视觉场景，变化区域约束和符号输出要求，测试模型推断隐含多数参考并基于上下文行动的能力。
Result: 在9个近期MLLMs上，从计数任务到区域条件动作性能下降最高44.5个百分点，人类为98.8%；差距在正确计数的相同场景和区域上依然存在，且全局点击和匹配局部控制显示坐标定位只解释部分损失。
Conclusion: 摘要揭示存在模型相关的感知-行动瓶颈，即共享视觉证据转化为上下文特定动作的困难，坐标定位不能完全解释该差距。

papers.title: Low-Energy Reduced RISC-V Instruction Subset Processor for Tsetlin Machine Inference at the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Tsetlin Machine (TM) is a logic-based machine learning approach that relies on simple bitwise operations and finite-state automata, which makes it attractive for edge AI deployments. Recent work has focused on co-processor and accelerator designs based on Tsetlin Machines (TMs). Although these designs achieve high performance, they typically depend on tightly coupled interfaces, microcode-style programming, and external host processors, limiting flexibility and ease of programming. In this work, we present a domain-specific RISC-V microprocessor architecture and design flow tailored for TM inference. Leveraging the modular structure of RISC-V, we design a reduced instruction subset processor that retains programmability while targeting improved performance and lower energy consumption for TM workloads. Instruction profiling is employed to guide instruction reduction, followed by datapath and control path simplifications tailored to TM inference. Both the baseline RV32IM core and the proposed reduced core are evaluated across multiple datasets and compared with Binarized Neural Networks (BNNs), which serve as a hardware-efficient baseline due to their reliance on bitwise operations during inference. Results show that TM achieves comparable or higher accuracy (e.g., up to 88.18% on CIFAR-2 compared to 60.0% for BNN) while reducing execution time by up to 98% across multiple datasets. Furthermore, the proposed design achieves an average $29.7\times$ reduction in energy consumption, demonstrating its effectiveness for programmable and efficient edge AI systems.

papers.title: Addressing Detail Bottlenecks in Latent Diffusion for RGB-to-SWIR Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable efficient image-to-image translation but discard fine spatial details during compression, degrading downstream perception tasks. We identify two bottlenecks: the autoencoder, which loses spatial information, and the conditioning pathway, which further degrades the source signal through naive downsampling. We propose two lightweight, backbone-agnostic fixes: a Source-Conditioned Autoencoder (SCAE) that injects high-resolution source features into the decoder via skip connections, and a Learnable Guidance Encoder (LGE) that replaces naive downsampling with a learned conditioning signal. Evaluated on RGB-to-SWIR translation for driving scenes with two denoiser backbones (U-Net and DiT), our approach improves detection mAP by up to 2x over the latent diffusion baseline, with up to 3.4x gains on small objects (COCO-small, <32^2 px^2), while achieving state-of-the-art FID. We further show that FID and detection performance are poorly correlated, motivating multi-axis evaluation. Results generalise zero-shot to the public RASMD benchmark. We will publicly release test data with annotations, all checkpoints, and training code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜扩散模型（LDM）在RGB到SWIR图像翻译中丢失细节瓶颈的问题，提出两种轻量级改进：源条件自编码器（SCAE）通过跳跃连接向解码器注入高分辨率源特征，以及可学习引导编码器（LGE）替代朴素下采样。在驾驶场景的RGB-to-SWIR翻译任务上，使用U-Net和DiT两种去噪骨干网络，该方法在检测mAP上比潜扩散基线提升最高2倍，小目标（COCO-small, <32^2像素）提升最高3.4倍，并达到最先进FID。实验还表明FID与检测性能相关性差，需多轴评估。结果零样本泛化到公开RASMD基准。
Motivation: 潜扩散模型在压缩过程中丢失精细空间细节，影响下游感知任务，而现有方法未充分解决自动编码器和条件路径中的信息退化问题。
Method: 提出两个与骨干网络无关的改进模块：源条件自编码器（SCAE）在解码器中使用跳跃连接注入高分辨率源特征；可学习引导编码器（LGE）用学习到的条件信号替代朴素下采样。
Result: 在驾驶场景RGB-to-SWIR翻译中，检测mAP提升最高2倍，小目标检测mAP提升最高3.4倍，FID达到最先进水平，且零样本泛化到RASMD基准。
Conclusion: 本文方法有效修复潜扩散模型中的细节瓶颈，并强调FID与检测性能相关性弱，需要多轴评估；代码和模型将公开。

papers.title: SketchKeyAnime: Reference-anchored Sparse Key-Sketch Animation Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Traditional animation production relies heavily on manual drawing and iterative refinement, particularly for key-pose design, in-betweening, and character coloring. While existing animation and video generation methods have made notable progress, they typically depend on RGB boundary frames, dense frame-wise conditions, or complete sketch sequences, limiting their applicability under low-cost input conditions. We present SketchKeyAnime, a video diffusion framework for generating structurally controllable, appearance-consistent, and temporally coherent animations from sparse key-sketch inputs. Given a single reference RGB image and a few temporally indexed key sketches, SketchKeyAnime introduces a dual-branch conditioning mechanism to encode local geometric constraints alongside semantic-temporal context. It leverages Sketch Cross Attention to fuse reference image and sketch conditions with learnable gating, and incorporates an Adaptive Weighted Loss to strengthen supervision on key-sketch frames and line-art regions. Experimental results on the Aesthetic subset of Sakuga-42M show that our approach consistently outperforms representative animation interpolation and sketch-guided generation baselines. Compared to the best-performing baseline, SketchKeyAnime reduces EDMD by 31.9\% and FVD by 9.5\%, demonstrating superior sketch fidelity and temporal coherence, while achieving the best overall performance across most quantitative metrics. These results validate the proposed framework and highlight its potential for low-cost, highly controllable animation creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SketchKeyAnime，一个基于视频扩散的框架，能够从稀疏的关键草图输入生成结构可控、外观一致且时间连贯的动画。该框架引入双分支条件机制、草图交叉注意力和自适应加权损失，在 Sakuga-42M 数据集上优于多个基线。
Motivation: 传统动画制作依赖大量人工绘制和迭代优化，现有方法通常需要 RGB 边界帧、密集帧级条件或完整草图序列，限制了低成本输入下的适用性。
Method: 提出双分支条件机制编码局部几何约束和语义-时间上下文，利用草图交叉注意力融合参考图像和草图条件（可学习门控），并采用自适应加权损失增强关键草图帧和线条区域的监督。
Result: 在 Sakuga-42M 美学子集上，相比最佳基线，EDMD 降低 31.9%，FVD 降低 9.5%，在多数指标上达到最优。
Conclusion: 验证了该框架在低成本、高可控动画创作中的潜力。

papers.title: Towards Graph-Based Deep Learning for Map Generalization: Insights from Building Footprints Simplification and Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Map generalization remains one of the fundamental tasks in cartography, especially for the simplification and aggregation of complex building footprints. This study presents the first exploratory application of graph-based deep learning to both tasks, reformulating simplification as node movement prediction and aggregation as link prediction within a unified graph learning framework. We evaluate representative graph neural network architectures (GCN, GAT, and GraphSAGE) on multi-scale building datasets, showing that GraphSAGE demonstrates relative strengths in link prediction accuracy, while also revealing persistent challenges in precise node movement prediction. Beyond quantitative performance, the results highlight that aggregation poses greater complexity and challenges than simplification, underscoring the difficulty of capturing higher-level spatial relationships in map generalization with current deep learning approaches. Although limitations such as data imbalance and the need for post-processing remain, the study provides valuable insights and methodological directions for advancing automated map generalization with deep learning approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次探索将图深度学习应用于地图概括中的建筑物轮廓简化与聚合任务，将简化重定义为节点移动预测，聚合重定义为链接预测。在多个尺度的建筑数据集上评估了GCN、GAT和GraphSAGE，结果显示GraphSAGE在链接预测上表现较好，但节点移动预测仍面临挑战；聚合比简化更复杂。
Motivation: 地图概括是制图学的基本任务，特别是复杂建筑物轮廓的简化与聚合，现有深度学习方法尚未充分探索图结构在该领域的潜力。
Method: 将建筑物轮廓构建为图，简化任务转化为预测每个节点的移动偏移量，聚合任务转化为预测节点之间的链接是否存在；使用GCN、GAT、GraphSAGE等图神经网络架构进行训练和评估。
Result: GraphSAGE在链接预测任务上表现出相对优势，但节点移动预测的精度仍不理想；聚合任务比简化任务复杂度更高，揭示出现有深度学习方法在高层次空间关系捕捉上的困难。
Conclusion: 研究指出数据不平衡和需要后处理等局限性，但为利用深度学习方法推进自动化地图概括提供了见解和方法方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Investigating Human-Model Discrepancies in Speech Quality Assessment via Acoustic and Prosodic Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Mean opinion score (MOS) prediction models are widely used as proxy metrics in text-to-speech (TTS) research, yet their ability to capture quality differences beyond acoustic fidelity remains unclear. We investigate this via controlled perturbations on speech: acoustic degradation, prosodic errors, and manipulation of speaker-specific characteristics such as pitch and speaking rate. We obtained MOS predictions for these speech samples from both human listeners and the model, and analyzed the differences in their perceptual characteristics. Results show that most models track acoustic degradation well, while all are insensitive to prosodic errors despite large subjective score drops. For speaker characteristics, models exhibit a double dissociation: strong mean fundamental frequency (F0) biases absent in human ratings, yet insensitivity to speaking rate and F0 variability that humans notice. These findings highlight limitations of scalar MOS prediction beyond acoustic fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过声学退化、韵律错误和说话者特征操纵等控制扰动，比较了人类听者和MOS预测模型在语音质量评估中的差异。结果显示大多数模型能跟踪声学退化，但对韵律错误不敏感，且在说话者特征上存在双重分离现象。
Motivation: MOS预测模型在TTS研究中被广泛使用，但它们在捕捉声学保真度之外的质量差异方面的能力尚不清楚。
Method: 对语音施加受控扰动（声学退化、韵律错误、音高和语速等说话者特征操纵），从人类听者和模型获取MOS预测，分析感知特征差异。
Result: 大多数模型能很好地跟踪声学退化，但所有模型对韵律错误不敏感（尽管主观评分大幅下降）。对于说话者特征，模型表现出双重分离：强烈的平均基频（F0）偏差（人类没有），但对语速和F0变异性不敏感（人类能注意到）。
Conclusion: 这些发现突显了标量MOS预测在声学保真度之外的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Confidence Calibration for Multimodal LLMs: An Empirical Study through Medical VQA
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show great potential in medical tasks, but their elicited confidence often misaligns with actual accuracy, potentially leading to misdiagnosis or overlooking correct advice. This study presents the first comprehensive analysis of the relationship between accuracy and confidence in medical MLLMs. It proposes a novel method that combines Multi-Strategy Fusion-Based Interrogation (MS-FBI) with auxiliary expert LLM assessment, aiming to improve confidence calibration in Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA). Experiments demonstrate that our method reduces the Expected Calibration Error (ECE) by an average of 40\% across three Medical VQA datasets, significantly enhancing MLLMs' reliability. The findings highlight the importance of domain-specific calibration for MLLMs in healthcare, offering a more trustworthy solution for AI-assisted diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次全面分析了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在医学视觉问答（VQA）中的置信度校准问题，发现其置信度与实际准确率存在偏差。提出一种结合多策略融合查询（MS-FBI）与辅助专家LLM评估的新方法，在三个医学VQA数据集上将期望校准误差（ECE）平均降低40%，显著提升了模型可靠性。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在医学任务中虽潜力巨大，但其置信度常与实际准确率不匹配，可能导致误诊或忽略正确建议，亟需领域特定的置信度校准方法。
Method: 提出多策略融合查询（MS-FBI）结合辅助专家LLM评估的框架，通过多角度提问和外部验证来改进置信度校准。
Result: 在三个医学VQA数据集上，期望校准误差（ECE）平均降低40%，表明该方法有效提升了MLLM的可靠性。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了在医疗AI中领域特定置信度校准的重要性，为更可信的AI辅助诊断提供了方案。

papers.title: Advancing DialNav through Automatic Embodied Dialog Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: For embodied agents capable of physical interaction, the capability to create and understand dialog is crucial to ensure both safety and effectiveness. While DialNav~\cite{han2025dialnav} provides a framework for holistic evaluation of the dialog--execution loop in photorealistic indoor navigation, its performance remains limited by a critical scarcity of training data (2K episodes). To address this, we propose an automatic generation pipeline, and construct the \textbf{RAINbow} dataset, a large-scale training dataset with 238K episodes for DialNav. Our pipeline converts existing VLN datasets into multi-turn dialog and creates cost-efficient and high-quality dataset. Then, we introduce two additional complementary advances to unlock the data's full potential: (1) Dual-Strategy Training, a navigation training scheme to align the navigation training with the dynamic dialog-navigation loop, and (2) a localization model that leverages VLN knowledge. By combining these complementary solutions, our model substantially outperforms the baseline in success rate on both \textbf{Val Seen} (58.24, \textbf{+89\%}) and \textbf{Val Unseen} (29.05, \textbf{+100\%}) splits, establishing a new state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对DialNav框架训练数据稀缺（仅2K episodes）的问题，提出自动生成管线，构建了包含238K episodes的RAINbow数据集。通过将现有VLN数据集转换为多轮对话，并结合双策略训练方案和利用VLN知识的定位模型，在Val Seen和Val Unseen分割上分别提升成功率89%和100%，达到新最优。
Motivation: DialNav为具身对话导航提供了评估框架，但受限于训练数据严重不足（仅2K episodes），性能受限。
Method: 提出自动生成管线，将VLN数据集转换为多轮对话，构建大规模RAINbow数据集（238K episodes）；引入双策略训练方案对齐导航训练与动态对话导航循环，以及利用VLN知识的定位模型。
Result: 在Val Seen上成功率58.24（+89%），Val Unseen上29.05（+100%），均大幅超越基线，达到新最优。
Conclusion: 通过自动数据增强和互补训练策略，可有效提升具身对话导航性能。

papers.title: QMaxCal: Path-Space Regularization for Open Quantum Control via Girsanov's Theorem
papers.abstract_en: Reliable quantum control in the presence of decoherence requires policies that combat the effect of environmental noise on the controlled dynamics. Open quantum systems under continuous monitoring generate classical measurement records whose drift depends on the noise experienced by the system; the records of two evolutions sharing the same decoherence channels differ only in this drift, so Girsanov's theorem yields a closed-form, differentiable estimator of the KL divergence between their trajectory distributions. We instantiate this estimator with two physically motivated reference measures, yielding two regularizers that both drive the system toward states where the effects of decoherence are minimal: the Wiener KL (KL_W), which is empirically more effective under certain conditions on the noise model, and the drift-variance regularizer (R_DV), which works for all noise models. Both are qualitatively distinct from existing penalties on control fluence or smoothness: they penalize the observable consequences of control on the decoherence channels rather than the control amplitude itself. The regularizers outperform unregularized gradient-based and reinforcement-learning baselines across a range of open quantum systems -- including single- and multi-qubit benchmarks and a multi-qubit chain calibrated to a published snapshot of the IBM Kingston processor -- along several axes of evaluation: final-state fidelity, robustness to mismatch in the assumed noise model (gains grow from +17 pp at training noise to +27 pp under 2.5x noise mismatch), and occupation of forbidden states. The regularizers reduce infidelity by up to 50%, with ~16% gains on the calibrated IBM Kingston chain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 Girsanov 定理为开放量子控制系统提出路径空间正则化方法 QMaxCal，通过可微的 KL 散度估计器惩罚退相干通道上的控制效应，而非控制幅度本身。实验表明，该方法在单/多量子比特基准和校准的 IBM Kingston 量子处理器链上相对于未正则化的基线在最终保真度、噪声鲁棒性等方面有显著提升。
Motivation: 开放量子系统中退相干效应严重影响控制可靠性，现有正则化方法多惩罚控制幅度或平滑度，而未能直接针对噪声引起的轨迹分布差异。
Method: 基于 Girsanov 定理推导连续监测下开放量子系统轨迹分布间的 KL 散度闭式可微估计量，并实例化为两种正则化项：Wiener KL (KL_W) 和 drift-variance 正则化 (R_DV)，前者在特定噪声模型下更有效，后者适用于所有噪声模型。
Result: 在多个开放量子系统上，所提正则化器优于未正则化的梯度方法和强化学习基线：最终态保真度提升、对噪声模型失配的鲁棒性增强（训练噪声下 +17 pp，2.5 倍失配下 +27 pp），并减少禁止态占据；保真度损失降低 50%，在校准的 IBM Kingston 链上提升约 16%。
Conclusion: 路径空间正则化通过直接退相干通道上的控制效应惩罚，提供了与现有控制幅度惩罚定性不同的有效正则化手段，且在多种系统上验证了其优越性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GEMS: Geometric Constraints Enable Multi-Semantic Superposition in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering controls model behavior by modifying intermediate hidden states at inference time without retraining. Existing methods handle only single-direction injection; when multiple semantic directions are superposed without constraints, the model collapses. We show that this collapse decomposes into two independently acting sources: distributional deviation, where additive perturbations accumulate in norm across layers and drive activations outside the training distribution, and directional interference, where non-orthogonal semantic vectors mutually dampen when superposed. These two sources define the design constraints that any training-free multi-directional intervention must address. As one instantiation of these principles, we propose GEMS, a training-free method that maps each source to a corresponding geometric constraint: norm-preserving weighted superposition and targeted attention-pathway injection for distributional deviation, and real-time orthogonalization for directional interference. On GSM8K, injecting three concurrent non-mathematical directions preserves accuracy at 98% (baseline 92%), while unconstrained addition collapses to 4%; on Wikitext-2, the same injection incurs only 2.2% PPL increase. Component ablation isolates the causal role of each constraint, and layer-level probes confirm that orthogonalized signals survive the FFN pathway and reach the output distribution with semantic specificity. Qualitative steering effects transfer across architectures from 3B to 31B.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables. Code and logs are available at: https://github.com/LuLu663939/gems-multi-semantic-steering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了激活控制（activation steering）中多语义方向叠加导致模型崩溃的问题，揭示了分布偏差和方向干扰两个独立因素，并提出GEMS方法，通过几何约束实现无需训练的多方向干预。实验表明，在GSM8K上注入三个非数学方向时准确率保持98%，而基线加法崩溃至4%。
Motivation: 现有激活控制方法仅支持单一方向注入，多语义方向叠加时模型崩溃，缺乏理论分析和无训练解决方案。
Method: 提出GEMS，针对分布偏差采用范数保持加权叠加和针对注意力路径的注入，针对方向干扰采用实时正交化。
Result: 在GSM8K上注入三个非数学方向，准确率98%（基线92%，加法崩溃至4%）；在Wikitext-2上PPL仅增加2.2%。组件消融验证了每种约束的因果作用，层级探针确认正交化信号保留语义特异性。
Conclusion: 论文强调几何约束（范数保持、正交化）是实现无训练多方向干预的关键，且效果跨架构（3B至31B）迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Timage: A Generative Text-in-Image Paradigm for Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often lose track of the right image regions during fine-grained spatial reasoning, because a textual query rarely carries any explicit geometric anchor into the pixel domain. Prevailing remedies either rewire the model's weights or pad the prompt with verbose instructions, yet neither reliably pins the language to the correct visual coordinates without eroding the backbone's general competence. We introduce Timage, a paradigm that recasts multimodal understanding as an alignment problem solved at the input: the query is drawn, as a typeset overlay, onto the image itself. The placement and appearance of this overlay are produced by a Constrained Schrödinger Bridge (cSB), an entropic optimal-transport sampler that factorizes layout synthesis into two coupled stochastic stages. The first stage, Region Search, transports noise toward query-aligned image zones while obeying a hard occlusion barrier that protects salient foreground content; the second stage, Appearance Shaping, sizes the glyphs through an ``ink-budget'' regularizer so that the rendered text stays legible and visually balanced. The resulting overlay behaves as an explicit attention beacon that channels the model's focus along spatial semantics. On the VMCBench suite, Timage paired with a modest 7B backbone clearly overtakes far larger proprietary systems as well as parameter-tuned baselines. The study positions deliberate input reconstruction as a powerful, architecture-neutral lever for strengthening multimodal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Timage，一种将文本查询作为排版覆盖直接绘制到图像上的范式，以解决多模态大语言模型在细粒度空间推理中丢失正确图像区域的问题。Timage 使用约束薛定谔桥（cSB）生成覆盖的布局和外观，包括区域搜索和外观塑造两个阶段，使覆盖作为显式注意力信标引导模型关注空间语义。在 VMCBench 上，7B 参数的 Timage 超越了更大的专有系统和参数微调基线。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在细粒度空间推理中常因文本查询缺乏几何锚点而丢失正确图像区域，而权重调整或冗长指令提示无法可靠地将语言与视觉坐标对齐，同时保持主干模型的通用能力。
Method: 提出 Timage 范式，将多模态理解转化为输入层对齐问题：通过约束薛定谔桥（cSB）将查询绘制为图像上的排版覆盖。cSB 分解为两个随机阶段：区域搜索阶段在硬遮挡屏障约束下将噪声传输到查询对齐区域；外观塑造阶段通过“墨水预算”正则化调整字形大小以保证可读性。
Result: 在 VMCBench 套件上，Timage 配合 7B 骨干模型显著超越了更大的专有系统和参数微调基线。
Conclusion: 研究指出，精心设计的输入重构是一种强大的、架构无关的手段，可用于增强多模态推理能力。

papers.title: SIMBA: ABidirectional Retrieval Forward Simulation Framework for Modeling FY-4A GIIRS Hyperspectral Infrared Radiances Toward NWP Applications
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral infrared observations are an important data source for numerical weather prediction (NWP) because they provide rich information on the vertical structure of atmospheric temperature and humidity. However, most existing deep learning methods mainly focus on one-way retrieval from radiances to atmospheric profiles, while the reverse radiance simulation process and the consistency between atmospheric state space and radiance observation space are insufficiently considered. In this study, we propose SIMBA, a unified bidirectional retrieval-forward simulation framework for FY-4A GIIRS hyperspectral infrared radiance modeling toward NWP applications. The framework jointly performs atmospheric profile retrieval and radiance reconstruction, introduces a cycle-consistency constraint to strengthen the coupling between the two processes, and employs a bidirectional Mamba state-space module to capture long-range dependencies along pressure levels. Using collocated FY-4A GIIRS observations and ERA5 reanalysis data, the proposed method is evaluated for temperature retrieval, specific humidity retrieval, long-wave radiance reconstruction, and medium-wave radiance reconstruction. Experimental results show that SIMBA outperforms several representative deep learning baselines across both retrieval and reconstruction tasks, while ablation experiments confirm the contribution of the bidirectional design and cycle-consistency mechanism. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework is effective for joint atmospheric profile retrieval and hyperspectral infrared radiance modeling, and suggest potential for future Jacobian-related analysis and NWP-oriented extensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SIMBA框架，用于FY-4A GIIRS超光谱红外辐射的双向检索-正向模拟，联合进行大气剖面反演和辐射重建，并引入循环一致性约束和双向Mamba状态空间模块。在FY-4A GIIRS观测和ERA5再分析数据上，SIMBA在温度/湿度反演和长/中波辐射重建任务上优于多个深度学习基线。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法主要关注从辐射到大气剖面的单向反演，忽视了反向辐射模拟过程以及大气状态空间与辐射观测空间之间的一致性。
Method: 提出统一的双向检索-正向模拟框架，包含联合大气剖面反演和辐射重建、循环一致性约束以增强两个过程的耦合，以及双向Mamba状态空间模块以捕捉沿气压层的长程依赖。
Result: 在FY-4A GIIRS观测与ERA5再分析数据上，SIMBA在温度反演、比湿反演、长波辐射重建和中波辐射重建任务上均优于多个代表性深度学习基线；消融实验证实了双向设计和循环一致性机制的贡献。
Conclusion: 该框架有效实现了联合大气剖面反演和超光谱红外辐射建模，有潜力用于未来的雅可比分析及NWP方向扩展。
Relevance: 70

papers.title: Compositionality Emerges in a Narrow Depth-Connectivity Regime: Architecture Constraints and Solution Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Compositionality is believed to be the foundation for generalization, enabling models to reuse meaningful primitives in novel combinations. Yet, models trained with standard gradient-based optimization rarely, and often only weakly, exhibit compositional internal structure, and it remains unclear how or why such compositionality forms. In this work, we show that compositionality emerges in a narrow connectivity-depth sweet spot. Along the connectivity axis, compositionality only appears in some specifically sparse networks, heavily depends on which connections remain rather than on weights' sparsity alone. Along the depth axis, compositionality emerges within a narrow, target-dependent regime, peaking at specific depths, while both shallower and deeper networks fail. When either the depth or connectivity condition is violated, gradient descent silently converges to fractured solutions rather than compositional ones. To discover and exploit this emergence, we introduce (i) similarity-based pruning (SP) to recover compositional connectivity and (ii) a heuristic depth predictor to estimate where compositionality is most likely to appear. Finally, we support these empirical findings with a theoretical framework based on compositional sparsity, volume-ratio arguments, and feature-interference bounds, explaining why compositional solutions are reachable only in a narrow depth-connectivity regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络中组合性（compositionality）的涌现条件，发现组合性仅出现在一个窄的深度-连接性窗口内：沿连接性轴仅在特定稀疏网络中，沿深度轴在特定深度达到峰值。作者提出基于相似性的剪枝（SP）恢复组合连接，以及启发式深度预测器估计组合性最可能出现的深度，并用组合稀疏性、体积比论证和特征干扰边界等理论框架支持实验发现。
Motivation: 标准梯度优化训练的网络很少表现出组合内部结构，且不清楚组合性如何形成，本文旨在揭示组合性涌现的条件。
Method: 通过实验探索连接性和深度对组合性的影响，提出相似性剪枝（SP）和深度预测器；理论方面用组合稀疏性、体积比论证和特征干扰边界等框架。
Result: 组合性仅在窄深度-连接性窗口出现；违反条件时梯度下降收敛到破碎解而非组合解；SP可恢复组合连接。
Conclusion: 组合性在窄深度-连接性区间涌现，解释了标准训练难以获得组合性的原因，并提供了实现组合性的指导和理论。

papers.title: DiffMath: Symbol- and Graph-Aware Latent Diffusion Transformer for Handwritten Mathematical Expression Generation
papers.abstract_en: Handwritten Mathematical Expression Generation (HMEG) is challenging due to the complex two-dimensional layouts and long-range structural dependencies of mathematical expressions. Existing methods typically rely on explicit spatial supervision, such as symbol-level bounding boxes, which incurs high annotation costs and limits scalability. In this work, we propose DiffMath, a symbol- and graph-aware latent diffusion framework that leverages the hierarchical structure inherent in LaTeX as a structural prior, eliminating the need for positional supervision. First, we design a Relational Abstract Syntax Tree (RelAST), a generation-oriented representation that distills MathML trees into compact triplet sequences [S, R, D], where each token directly encodes a symbol identity, spatial relation, or nesting depth. Second, we introduce MathVAE, which learns structure-preserving latent representations through symbol-aware and relation-aware perceptual regularization, ensuring that the latent space captures both character semantics and spatial topology. Third, MathDiT performs conditional denoising in this structured latent space, further guided by a global symbol-count prior via Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN) to improve structural coherence. Experiments show that DiffMath produces structurally consistent handwritten expressions, achieves superior performance over existing methods, and improves the accuracy of downstream OCR models through synthetic data augmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiffMath，一种符号与图感知的隐式扩散Transformer框架，用于手写数学表达式生成（HMEG）。该方法通过关系抽象语法树（RelAST）和MathVAE学习结构保持的隐表示，并在MathDiT中进行条件去噪，避免了对符号级边界框等位置监督的依赖。实验表明DiffMath能生成结构一致的手写表达式，性能优于现有方法，并可通过数据增强提升下游OCR模型的准确率。
Motivation: 现有手写数学表达式生成方法通常需要符号级边界框等显式空间监督，标注成本高且可扩展性差。
Method: 设计RelAST（关系抽象语法树）将MathML树转化为紧凑三元组序列[S,R,D]；提出MathVAE通过符号感知和关系感知正则化学习结构保持的隐表示；采用MathDiT在结构化隐空间中进行条件去噪，并利用自适应层归一化（AdaLN）引入全局符号计数先验。
Result: 生成的表达式结构一致性优于现有方法，通过合成数据增强能提升下游OCR模型的准确率。
Conclusion: DiffMath通过符号和图形感知的隐扩散框架消除了位置监督需求，为手写数学表达式生成提供了有效途径。

papers.title: Triangular Consistency as a Universal Constraint for Learning Optical Flow
papers.abstract_en: We propose triangular consistency as a first-principled constraint for optical flow, which is agnostic to network architecture, supervision type, and dataset, and applies to both image-pair and multi-frame settings. This simple but powerful constraint is to compose two flows to induce a third flow and enforce consistency among the three. The composed flows may arise from (i) image pairs, yielding cycle consistency; (ii) multiple video frames, producing longer-range motion through temporal chaining; or (iii) image pairs combined with controlled synthetic transformations, which becomes data augmentation. This triangular consistency introduces negligible computational overhead and requires no additional annotations. Since it is derived directly from the geometry of optical flow, it does not rely on model-specific assumptions and serves as a ``universal'' plug-and-play component for optical flow training. Experiments show consistent improvement across supervised, unsupervised, and transfer learning settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三角一致性作为光流学习的第一性原理约束，该约束与网络架构、监督类型和数据集无关，适用于图像对和多帧设置。三角一致性通过组合两个光流诱导第三个光流并强制三者一致，可用于循环一致性、时间链式运动或数据增强。实验表明，该约束在监督、无监督和迁移学习设置中均带来一致改进。
Motivation: 现有光流学习方法依赖于特定模型假设或需要额外标注，缺乏通用约束。三角一致性直接从光流几何推导，提供了一种与架构无关、无需额外标注的通用正则化方法。
Method: 三角一致性约束：对两个光流进行合成，得到第三个光流，并强制三者之间的几何一致性。该约束可应用于图像对（循环一致性）、多帧视频（时间链式运动）或结合合成变换（数据增强），且计算开销极小。
Result: 在监督、无监督和迁移学习设置中，三角一致性约束均能持续提升光流估计性能。
Conclusion: 三角一致性是一种通用、轻量且有效的光流训练组件，不依赖模型假设，易于集成。

papers.title: PhysDrift: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in Humanoid Co-Speech Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots require co-speech motions that are not only expressive and speech-aligned, but also physically executable under embodiment constraints. Existing co-speech generation pipelines are predominantly human-centric: motions are first generated in human-body representations such as SMPL-X and subsequently retargeted to humanoid robots. In this work, we identify a fundamental embodiment gap in this paradigm, where the mismatch between human motion manifolds and humanoid embodiment constraints disrupts embodiment consistency during motion transfer and physical execution. Through extensive analysis, we show that although retargeting can preserve coarse motion semantics, it significantly compresses motion diversity and weakens prosody-motion synchronization, limiting expressive humanoid behaviors. To address this problem, we first propose IK-EER, a prosody-preserving humanoid motion curation framework that jointly optimizes kinematic feasibility and speech-motion temporal alignment during retargeting. Building upon the curated robot-native motion dataset, we further introduce PhysDrift, an embodiment-aware co-speech motion generation framework that directly predicts executable humanoid joint trajectories from speech without relying on intermediate human-body representations. Unlike conventional human-centric pipelines, PhysDrift maintains embodiment consistency throughout both training and inference while incorporating physical regularization to stabilize robot motion dynamics. Extensive experiments and real-world humanoid deployment demonstrate that embodiment-aware robot-native generation substantially improves speech-motion alignment, physical plausibility, motion smoothness, inference efficiency, and real-time interaction capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhysDrift框架，用于人形机器人生成与语音同步且符合物理约束的运动。通过分析发现传统先在人形表达（如SMPL-X）生成运动再重定向到机器人的方法会导致运动多样性下降和韵律-运动同步减弱。为了解决这一具身鸿沟，作者先提出IK-EER数据筛选框架，再构建PhysDrift直接预测机器人关节轨迹，不需要中间人形表示。实验和真实部署表明该方法提升了语音-运动对齐、物理合理性、平滑性和推理效率。
Motivation: 现有共语运动生成主要针对人体，再重定向到人形机器人时存在具身鸿沟：人体运动流形与机器人具身约束不匹配，导致运动多样性压缩和韵律同步减弱。
Method: 首先提出IK-EER，一个保留韵律的人形运动筛选框架，联合优化运动学可行性和语音-运动时间对齐。然后基于筛选的机器人原生运动数据集，提出PhysDrift，一个具身感知的共语运动生成框架，直接预测可执行的机器人关节轨迹，无需中间人形表示，并在训练和推理中保持具身一致性，加入物理正则化。
Result: 大量实验和真实人形机器人部署表明，具身感知的机器人原生生成显著改善了语音-运动对齐、物理合理性、运动平滑性、推理效率和实时交互能力。
Conclusion: 本文强调具身感知的机器人原生运动生成优于传统人类中心流水线，有望提升人形机器人与人交互的自然度和物理可行性。

papers.title: Speeding up the annotation process in semantic segmentation industrial applications
papers.abstract_en: Current machine learning models commonly require large and well-annotated datasets. However, the annotation process often becomes a bottleneck, with increased complexity leading to higher chances of human errors. Within this context, our goal in this paper is to leverage unsupervised algorithms to improve data annotation efficiency for complex semantic segmentation problems in industrial materials science. Previous research has quantified labeling time and others explored unsupervised methods. However, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to quantify how much unsupervised algorithms accelerate the labeling process. We aim to validate the extent to which this laborious process can be accelerated, focusing on semantic segmentation tasks that involve annotating each pixel of high-resolution images, such as the microstructure characterization challenge in materials science. Specifically, we demonstrate that by using unsupervised computer vision algorithms, the time required for the labeling process can be reduced from 170 hours to 37 hours, achieving an approximate reduction of 78\%. The dataset we work with includes large images of dimensions 1280x959 and 960x703, which further increases the complexity of the annotation task. Despite these challenges, we create and share the largest public steel microstructure segmentation dataset to date, available under MIT License with permanent DOI, contributing a fully annotated, high-resolution dataset to the field. Additionally, this is the first work to compare the labeling time from scratch (a common approach in previous studies) to the labeling time when using these unsupervised algorithms as a pre-annotation step. Furthermore, we provide a Deep Learning model trained on this dataset, validated by field experts, and deployed in an industrial setting, serving as an initial benchmark for this public dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用无监督计算机视觉算法加速工业材料科学中语义分割任务的标注过程。实验表明，该方法将标注时间从170小时减少至37小时（降低约78%），并创建了迄今最大的公开钢显微结构分割数据集。
Motivation: 当前机器学习模型依赖大规模高质量标注数据，但标注过程耗时且易出错，尤其是在工业材料科学的高分辨率图像语义分割任务中。
Method: 使用无监督计算机视觉算法作为预标注步骤，与从头标注进行时间对比，并训练深度学习模型作为基准。
Result: 标注时间从170小时降至37小时（减少78%），创建了最大的公开钢显微结构分割数据集（MIT许可），并提供了经专家验证的工业部署模型。
Conclusion: 无监督算法可显著加速工业语义分割标注，但本文方法仅针对特定材料科学场景验证，其他领域需进一步评估。

papers.title: Spatial-Aware Reduction Framework: Towards Efficient and Faithful Visual State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Mamba demonstrates strong efficiency in modeling long visual sequences. However, when token reduction is applied to structurally enhanced Mamba variants, these models exhibit a severe performance collapse. We attribute this degradation to the spatially agnostic nature of existing reduction methods, which violate the two-dimensional structural premise required by the selective scanning mechanism. In this work, we propose STORM, a spatial-aware token reduction framework designed to maintain structural integrity throughout the compression process. STORM reformulates reduction into a structured operation on spatial units, enforcing localized constraints to maintain both grid topology and neighborhood coherence. As a plug-and-play module, STORM equips existing reduction pipelines with explicit spatial awareness without any training. Empirical results demonstrate that STORM achieves state-of-the-art pruning accuracy across diverse vision Mamba backbones under training-free settings. Notably, STORM delivers a substantial accuracy recovery on VMamba, outperforming prior methods by up to 63.3\% in top-1 accuracy. Meanwhile, STORM incurs only a 1.0\% accuracy drop on PlainMamba, achieving performance comparable to ViT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STORM，一种空间感知的令牌缩减框架，用于解决视觉状态空间模型（如 Mamba）在令牌缩减时的性能崩溃问题。STORM 通过对空间单元施加结构化操作，保持网格拓扑和邻域连贯性，无需训练即可提升多种 Mamba 变体的剪枝精度。
Motivation: 现有的令牌缩减方法具有空间无关性，违反了选择性扫描机制所需的二维结构前提，导致 Mamba 变体在缩减令牌时性能严重下降。
Method: STORM 将令牌缩减重新表述为对空间单元的结构化操作，施加局部约束以保持网格拓扑和邻域连贯性，作为无需训练的即插即用模块。
Result: 在无训练设置下，STORM 在多种视觉 Mamba 骨干上达到最先进的剪枝精度，在 VMamba 上 top-1 准确率恢复高达 63.3%，在 PlainMamba 上仅下降 1.0%，性能与 ViT 相当。
Conclusion: STORM 通过引入空间感知实现了高效的令牌缩减，且无需训练，为视觉状态空间模型的压缩提供了新思路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CARE: Competence-Aware Reward Shaping for Adaptive Reasoning Length in Video-MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: In multimodal video reasoning, reinforcement learning-based methods typically rely on simplistic and inflexible reasoning-length control strategies that fail to adapt to the model's evolving competence. This mismatch may suppress necessary exploration at early stages, while encouraging redundant reasoning and inefficient decoding once the model becomes more competent. In this paper, we propose CARE, a competence-aware reward shaping framework for adaptive reasoning length optimization in multimodal reasoning. Specifically, CARE maintains a smoothed competence estimate via an exponential moving average of pass rates, and uses it to route training into progressive stages that shift the reward preference from exploration-oriented long-form reasoning to efficiency-oriented concise reasoning. To avoid conflating verbosity with intrinsic task complexity, CARE further normalizes reasoning effort with batch-level statistics, and introduces a posterior amplifier to strengthen reward signals for unexpectedly strong performance on historically difficult samples. The proposed mechanism is seamlessly integrated into the GRPO training pipeline and incurs no additional inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that CARE consistently improves reasoning accuracy, stabilizes reinforcement learning, and significantly enhances token efficiency. Moreover, CARE exhibits a characteristic inverted-U trajectory of reasoning length during training, and yields shorter yet more informative reasoning traces at convergence, indicating effective adaptive allocation of reasoning budget. We provide the source code for our proposed CARE framework and experiments at https://github.com/1Pansy/Video-CARE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CARE，一种基于能力感知的奖励塑造框架，用于自适应优化视频多模态大语言模型（Video-MLLMs）的推理长度。CARE通过指数移动平均通过率维护平滑的能力估计，并据此将训练分为多个阶段，从探索性长推理过渡到高效短推理。同时采用批次级归一化处理推理努力，并引入后验放大器增强困难样本的信号。该方法无缝集成到GRPO训练流程中，不增加推理开销。在多个视频推理和理解基准上，CARE一致提升了推理准确率，稳定了强化学习训练，并显著提高了token效率。训练过程中推理长度呈现倒U型轨迹，收敛时生成更短但信息更丰富的推理链。
Motivation: 现有的强化学习方法在视频推理中采用简单固定的推理长度控制策略，无法适应模型能力的动态变化，导致早期探索不足、后期冗余推理和低效解码。
Method: CARE框架包含三个核心组件：1）通过指数移动平均通过率估计模型能力，并据此将训练路由到从探索性长推理到高效短推理的渐进阶段；2）利用批次级统计量归一化推理努力，避免将冗长与任务复杂性混淆；3）引入后验放大器，对历史困难样本上的意外强表现给予额外奖励。整个框架集成到GRPO中，无额外推理开销。
Result: 在多个视频推理和通用视频理解基准上，CARE一致提升了推理准确性，稳定了强化学习训练，并显著提高了token效率。训练过程中推理长度呈现倒U型轨迹，收敛时生成的推理链更短但信息更丰富，表明推理预算得到了有效自适应分配。
Conclusion: CARE通过能力感知的奖励塑造，实现了视频MLLMs推理长度的自适应优化，在保持或提升准确性的同时大幅提升token效率，且不引入推理时额外开销。

papers.title: The Tao of Agency: Autotelic AI, Embedded Agency and Dissolution of the Self
papers.abstract_en: Most artificial intelligence systems are built on the assumption that goals are exogenous and specified by the designer. Exploring what happens when an agent begins generating its own goals opens the field of autotelic AI. Agents are expected not merely to pursue objectives but to discover them. In this article, we trace its consequences through intrinsic motivation, resource-driven priors, causal-interventional learning, homeostasis, and embeddedness; the last of which is found to be a necessary but not sufficient condition for autotelic agency. Embeddedness individuates the agent at the cost of revealing that the individuation is non-unique, such that the same dynamics admit many valid partitions, each defining a different candidate self. The deepest problem with autotelic AI is therefore not how the agent generates goals, but how it generates and relativizes the self to which the goals are assigned. The agent must believe in its own boundary in order to act, and see through that boundary in order to understand. We consolidate these developments into a single framework and extend it along three directions: a quantum formulation in which the agent-environment cut becomes physical, a philosophical reading against non-dual contemplative traditions, and a concrete LLM-based agentic instantiation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨自生长人工智能（autotelic AI），即智能体自主生成目标而非由设计者指定的范式。通过内在动机、嵌入性、稳态等概念分析，指出嵌入性是必要条件但个体化非唯一，核心问题在于智能体如何生成并相对化自我边界。论文将相关思想整合为统一框架，并扩展至量子公式化、非二元哲学和LLM实例化三个方向。
Motivation: 现有AI系统大多假设目标由设计者外生指定，限制了智能体的自主性。本文旨在探索智能体自主生成目标的可能性及其深层挑战，特别是自我边界问题。
Method: 从内在动机、资源驱动先验、因果干预学习、稳态和嵌入性等角度梳理自生长智能，整合为统一框架，并进一步扩展到量子力学中智能体-环境划分的物理表述、非二元哲学解读以及基于LLM的具体实现。
Result: 证明嵌入性是自生长智能的必要但非充分条件；揭示嵌入性导致个体化非唯一性，同一动力学可对应多种有效自我划分。自生长AI的真正难题不在于目标生成，而在于自我生成与相对化。
Conclusion: 智能体必须相信自身边界才能行动，同时必须看穿该边界才能理解。本文整合了相关进展并沿三个方向推进：量子表述、哲学解读和LLM实例化。

papers.title: eCNNTO: A Highly Generalizable ConvNet for Accelerating Topology Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes an element-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to accelerate density-based Topology Optimization (TO), termed eCNNTO. TO generally undergoes a large number of iterations, where finite element analysis is performed in every iteration, leading to the efficiency bottleneck especially when dense meshes are used to achieve high-resolution designs. To address this limitation, eCNNTO is proposed to build upon Kallioras et al. (2020), where a Deep Belief Network (DBN) was trained for every element to predict its near-optimal density from its early history, thereby skipping the great majority of iterations and significantly accelerating the TO procedure. However, the method lacks spatial correlations among neighboring elements and may lead to disconnected features in the final structure. The proposed method employs CNN with residual connections to address this issue. On top of it, a novel training strategy is introduced to further enhance the optimization efficiency, where the training dataset consists of the final stage density histories rather than early ones. This change can also help reduce the required training data size. eCNNTO requires only a small dataset to train and yet it can be generalized to problems with largely different boundary conditions, loading cases, design domain geometries, mesh resolutions, as well as non-design domains. In the end, the generalization capabilities and efficiency of eCNNTO are demonstrated through a variety of examples in two and three dimensions, achieving up to 90% and 97% reduction of iterations, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 eCNNTO，一种基于元素的卷积神经网络（CNN）方法，用于加速密度拓扑优化（TO）。该方法通过预测每个元素的近最优密度来跳过大部分迭代，采用残差连接保持空间相关性，并提出新的训练策略（使用最终阶段密度历史而非早期历史）以减少数据需求。在二维和三维示例中，迭代次数减少高达 90% 和 97%，且对边界条件、载荷、几何形状、网格分辨率等具有良好泛化能力。
Motivation: 拓扑优化每次迭代都需要进行有限元分析，密集网格下计算效率极低。现有基于深度置信网络（DBN）的方法缺乏相邻元素的空间相关性，可能导致结构不连续。
Method: eCNNTO 使用带有残差连接的 CNN 预测元素密度，训练数据采用最终阶段密度历史而非早期历史，从而在减少数据量的同时提高效率。
Result: 在二维和三维示例中，迭代次数分别减少高达 90% 和 97%，且泛化到不同边界条件、载荷、几何形状、网格分辨率等问题。
Conclusion: eCNNTO 仅需小数据集即可训练，并能显著加速拓扑优化，且保持结构连续性，适用于多种设计问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep-Unfolded Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Distributed optimization is a highly scalable and structurally transparent technique to solve multi-agent robotics problems; however, such methods often suffer from the need for highly-specialized, problem-specific hyperparameter tunings. In this work, we propose Deep Coordinator, a deep-unfolding framework that learns to dynamically adjust the hyperparameters of ADMM-DDP, a popular distributed solver for robotics tasks, at solve-time in response to optimizer performance. Our architecture consists of unrolling a fixed number of ADMM-DDP iterations into a neural network with learnable functions between layers mapping the optimizer state to the next hyperparameters. To the best of our knowledge, Deep Coordinator is the first deep-unfolding framework to adapt the penalty parameters of a non-convex optimizer at solve-time; we show that the mainstream supervised approach can yield degenerate solutions when training such models, and propose an unsupervised learning scheme. On simulations with fleets of cars and quadrotors, Deep Coordinator produces trajectories of comparable quality 6.18-9.44x faster than conventional solvers. Furthermore, Deep Coordinator retains its performance benefits when deployed to systems up to 8x larger than trained on.
papers.comment: The second and third authors contributed equally (equal second authorship). 35 pages (10 pages main text), 17 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Deep Coordinator，一种深度展开框架，用于在求解时动态调整分布式优化器ADMM-DDP的超参数，以解决传统方法需要手动调参的问题。该框架将固定次数的ADMM-DDP迭代展开为神经网络，并在层间学习可调整的函数，将优化器状态映射到下一步的超参数。这是首个在非凸优化器求解时自适应惩罚参数的深度展开框架，并采用无监督学习以避免有监督方法的退化问题。在车队和四旋翼仿真中，Deep Coordinator生成轨迹的速度比常规求解器快6.18-9.44倍，且性能优势可扩展到训练规模的8倍。
Motivation: 分布式优化在多智能体机器人问题中有优势，但需要高度专业化和问题特定的超参数调优，限制了其普适性和自动化程度。
Method: 提出了Deep Coordinator框架，将ADMM-DDP迭代展开为神经网络，在层间引入可学习函数，根据优化器状态动态调整下一步的惩罚参数。采用无监督学习方案以避免有监督训练导致的退化解。
Result: 在车队和四旋翼仿真中，Deep Coordinator生成轨迹质量与常规求解器相当，但速度提升6.18-9.44倍，并且性能可扩展到训练时未见过的8倍规模系统。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了深度展开方法在自动调整分布式优化器超参数方面的潜力，尤其适用于多智能体机器人任务，且具有良好的泛化能力。

papers.title: ADaPT: Token-Level Decoupling for Efficient Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought to achieve strong performance, but applying such reasoning uniformly incurs high computational cost. Existing efficiency-oriented methods attempt to shorten or mix reasoning strategies, yet often degrade reasoning capability. We identify the root cause as sequence-level coupling between efficiency incentives and correctness optimization, which implicitly penalizes long but correct reasoning trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Adaptive Dual-Process Thinking (ADaPT), a token-level dual-process framework that explicitly decouples efficiency and correctness signals during training. ADaPT introduces a mode-selection token to control fast and slow reasoning, applying efficiency-related rewards exclusively to this token to avoid penalizing correct long reasoning while encouraging efficiency when appropriate. Moreover, ADaPT enables precise and continuous control over the efficiency-performance trade-off at inference time: by adjusting the generation probability of the mode-selection token, a single trained model can smoothly move along the efficiency-performance Pareto frontier. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ADaPT significantly reduces inference cost while maintaining strong reasoning performance across multiple benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ADaPT，一种token级别的双过程框架，用于解耦大推理模型中的效率与正确性信号。ADaPT通过引入模式选择token来控制快速与慢速推理，仅在模式选择token上应用效率相关奖励，从而避免惩罚正确但长的推理轨迹，并在推理时通过调节模式选择token的生成概率实现效率-性能帕累托边界的平滑控制。实验表明ADaPT能在保持推理性能的同时显著降低计算成本。
Motivation: 现有大推理模型依赖长思维链实现强性能，但统一应用长推理导致高计算成本。已有的效率导向方法通过缩短或混合推理策略，常导致推理能力下降，根源在于效率激励与正确性优化在序列级别的耦合，隐含地惩罚了长而正确的推理轨迹。
Method: 提出自适应双过程思考（ADaPT），一种token级别的双过程框架，显式解耦训练中的效率与正确性信号。引入模式选择token控制快速与慢速推理，仅对该token应用效率相关奖励，避免惩罚正确长推理，同时在推理时通过调整模式选择token的生成概率实现效率-性能帕累托边界的连续控制。
Result: 在多个基准上，ADaPT显著降低推理成本，同时保持强推理性能。
Conclusion: ADaPT通过token级解耦实现了效率与正确性的平衡，允许单模型在推理时灵活调节效率-性能权衡，有望推动大推理模型的高效部署。

summary_sections.method: 提出自适应双过程思考（ADaPT），一种token级别的双过程框架，显式解耦训练中的效率与正确性信号。引入模式选择token控制快速与慢速推理，仅对该token应用效率相关奖励，避免惩罚正确长推理，同时在推理时通过调整模式选择token的生成概率实现效率-性能帕累托边界的连续控制。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准上，ADaPT显著降低推理成本，同时保持强推理性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: ADaPT通过token级解耦实现了效率与正确性的平衡，允许单模型在推理时灵活调节效率-性能权衡，有望推动大推理模型的高效部署。

papers.title: SpatialSV: Internalizing Interpretable 3D Spatial Awareness in MLLMs via Task-Oriented Visual Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Unlocking the spatial intelligence of multimodal large language model (MLLMs) is crucial for understanding and interacting with the 3D world. Prevailing approaches typically inject spatial priors via external tools, which impose significant inference overhead, or rely on latent feature distillation, which remains uninterpretable and lacks fine-grained geometric constraints. To address these issues, we propose SpatialSV, a framework designed to internalize robust 3D spatial awareness within MLLMs while simultaneously offering inherent interpretability. Deviating from passive feature imitation, SpatialSV employs task-oriented visual supervision, compelling the model to actively lift its 2D visual features into explicit 3D representations, including depth maps, camera poses, and point clouds. Crucially, this 2D-to-3D lifting process provides a transparent window into the model's representations: the resulting 3D reconstructions serve as an intuitive proxy for visualizing and diagnosing the quality of the model's intrinsic spatial knowledge. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of SpatialSV in enhancing and interpreting MLLMs' spatial intelligence. Furthermore, the framework exhibits strong generalization in semi-supervised settings, validating its potential to leverage unlabeled visual data for scalable, interpretable spatial representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpatialSV框架，通过任务导向的视觉监督将MLLMs的2D视觉特征显式提升为3D表示（深度图、相机位姿、点云），从而内部化可解释的3D空间意识。实验证明该方法能有效增强MLLMs的空间智能，并在半监督设置下展现良好泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖外部工具注入空间先验导致推理开销大，要么依赖潜在特征蒸馏但缺乏可解释性和细粒度几何约束。本文旨在让MLLMs内部化鲁棒的3D空间意识同时保持可解释性。
Method: 采用任务导向的视觉监督，迫使模型将2D视觉特征显式提升为3D表示（深度图、相机位姿、点云），此过程提供了透明窗口以可视化和诊断模型内部空间知识质量。
Result: 在多种模型和基准上验证了SpatialSV在增强和解释MLLMs空间智能方面的有效性，并在半监督设置下表现出强泛化性，表明其利用未标注视觉数据进行可扩展、可解释空间表示学习的潜力。
Conclusion: SpatialSV通过显式2D到3D提升过程实现了可解释的内部化3D空间意识，为可视化诊断空间知识质量提供了新途径，并在半监督学习中展现潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Co-policy: Responsive Human-Robot Co-Creation for Musical Performances
papers.abstract_en: Art has long stood as a pivotal expression of human creativity. Embodied artificial intelligence offers a route for generative models to participate in that creativity through physical action rather than disembodied digital content. In robotic music co-creation, it is challenging to connect semantic musical understanding with real-time and physically executable performance. We present Co-policy, a framework for human-robot musical co-creation that separates semantic intent grounding, constrained musical variation, and visuomotor execution. To ground musical semantics, Co-policy uses pre-inference semantic anchors and a fine-tuned Qwen-vl planner (F-Qwen) to transform speech, live musical seeds, and visual observations into structured co-creation plans. To support low-latency execution, Co-policy introduces a Gaussian-Mixture Visuomotor Policy (GMP), implemented as a conditional mixture-density policy that maps target notes and visual context to multimodal robot actions in a single forward pass. Unlike robotic playback systems that merely reproduce user-specified notes, Co-policy generates complementary musical responses under both musical and physical constraints. Real-robot chime experiments, ablations, and expert evaluation show improved intent alignment, execution accuracy, and response frequency over diffusion-policy and ablated baselines, supporting physically grounded action generation as a key requirement for embodied human-AI co-creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-policy 框架，用于人机音乐协同创作，将语义意图、受约束的音乐变体和视动执行分离。使用预推理语义锚和微调 Qwen-vl 规划器 (F-Qwen) 实现语义理解，引入高斯混合视动策略 (GMP) 进行低延迟执行。真实机器人钟琴实验表明，在意图对齐、执行准确性和响应频率上优于扩散策略等基线。
Motivation: 现有机器人音乐系统多为被动播放，无法在实时物理约束下生成互补性音乐响应，缺乏连接语义理解与物理执行的有效方法。
Method: 提出 Co-policy 框架，包含三个模块：1) 基于预推理语义锚和微调 Qwen-vl 规划器 (F-Qwen) 的语义意图接地；2) 音乐变体生成；3) 高斯混合视动策略 (GMP) 实现单次前向传递中的条件混合密度映射，输出多模态机器人动作。
Result: 在真实机器人钟琴实验中，相比扩散策略和消融基线，Co-policy 在意图对齐、执行准确性和响应频率上均有提升。
Conclusion: 物理接地动作生成是具身人机协同创作的关键要求，Co-policy 验证了分离语义与执行的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure-Oriented Randomized Neural Networks for Poisson-Nernst-Planck and Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes Systems
papers.abstract_en: We develop a structure-oriented randomized neural network framework, termed SO-RaNN, for the Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP) system and the Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes (PNP-NS) system. The decoupled linearized subproblems are solved iteratively by randomized neural networks in a space-time framework. For the concentration variables, a pointwise cut-off is used to enforce positivity at the value level, and discrete mass-scaling factors are computed at selected correction instants and interpolated in time, so as to ensure exact mass matching at those instants and to promote approximate mass preservation between them. To introduce an auxiliary discrete dissipation mechanism, we further employ an SAV-type post-processing correction, which yields monotonicity of the SAV auxiliary variable under the ideal SAV update. For the PNP-NS system, a structure-preserving randomized neural network (SP-RaNN) is used for the velocity field, so that the velocity approximation satisfies the incompressibility constraint pointwise by construction. On the theoretical side, we derive residual-based estimates for the raw, uncorrected RaNN solvers of the linearized subproblems, formulate a conditional local-in-time convergence result for the raw outer Picard iteration of the PNP system, and analyze the value-level positivity correction together with the mass-correction and SAV post-processing steps. For the PNP-NS system, we establish an approximation result for the SP-RaNN space and provide a conditional error statement for the corresponding linearized Oseen-type problem. Numerical experiments demonstrate approximation accuracy in the source-driven manufactured tests and illustrate the intended value-level positivity correction, selected-time mass matching, computed free-energy curves based on the final gauge-fixed potential, and divergence-free approximation in benchmark tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构导向随机神经网络（SO-RaNN）框架，用于求解 Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP) 和 Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes (PNP-NS) 系统。该框架在时空框架中迭代求解解耦线性化子问题，通过点截断保证浓度正值，通过质量校正因子和 SAV 后处理确保质量守恒和耗散。理论方面推导了残差估计和收敛结果，数值实验展示了精度和预期特性。
Motivation: 现有数值方法在处理 PNP 和 PNP-NS 系统时面临保正性、质量守恒和计算效率等挑战，需要一种保结构的随机神经网络方法。
Method: 采用结构导向随机神经网络，包含点截断浓度、离散质量缩放因子和 SAV 型后处理；对速度场使用保结构随机神经网络保证点态不可压缩性。
Result: 数值实验通过源驱动制造解验证了逼近精度，并展示了正值校正、选定时刻质量匹配、自由能曲线和无散速度场逼近。
Conclusion: 提出框架能有效求解 PNP 和 PNP-NS 系统，同时保持物理结构（正值、质量守恒、不可压缩性）和理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Agent Transactive Memory
papers.abstract_en: The decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities across diverse tasks motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts to support human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agent populations. We extend retrieval-augmented generation - which demonstrates the value of human-authored artifacts to individual agents - to retrieval of agent-generated artifacts supporting a population of agents. In particular, agent trajectories encode reusable procedural knowledge, yet these artifacts are typically discarded after a single use or retained only by the producing agent, forcing newly instantiated agents to repeatedly rediscover existing solutions. We propose Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM), a framework for population-level storage and retrieval of agent-generated trajectories, where producer agents contribute trajectories to a shared repository and consumer agents retrieve them to improve task execution. We focus on interactive environments (ALFWorld and WebArena), where trajectories are long and encode especially rich procedural structure. Our experiments demonstrate that retrieving trajectories from MATM improves downstream task performance and reduces interaction steps without coordination or joint training. These results position MATM as a design pattern for population-level experience sharing in open agent ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多智能体交互记忆（Multi-Agent Transactive Memory, MATM）框架，用于群体级别的智能体轨迹存储与检索。在 ALFWorld 和 WebArena 等交互环境中，MATM 通过共享仓库使生产智能体贡献轨迹，消费智能体检索轨迹，从而提升下游任务性能并减少交互步骤，无需协调或联合训练。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在执行任务后产生的轨迹通常被丢弃或仅由产生智能体保留，导致新智能体需反复发现已有解决方案，缺乏群体级知识共享机制。
Method: 提出 Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM) 框架：生产智能体将轨迹存入共享仓库，消费智能体通过检索系统获取相关轨迹以辅助任务执行，在 ALFWorld 和 WebArena 环境中验证。
Result: 实验表明，MATM 在下游任务上提升了性能，并减少了交互步骤，且无需智能体间的协调或联合训练。
Conclusion: MATM 可作为开放智能体生态中实现群体级经验共享的一种设计模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gaussian Process Prior Variational Autoencoder for Endoscopic Videos
papers.abstract_en: Endoscopic video analysis is essential for gastrointestinal diagnosis and computer-assisted interventions, but video sequences are routinely degraded by specular reflections, motion artifacts, and missing frames. These transient corruptions can distract clinicians, reduce image interpretability, and disrupt downstream tasks such as 3D reconstruction and navigation. Effective restoration therefore requires methods that exploit temporal continuity rather than treating frames in isolation. We introduce a Gaussian Process Prior Variational Autoencoder (GPVAE) framework for endoscopic video restoration that replaces the standard factorized latent prior with a temporal Gaussian process prior, enabling interpolation of missing frames with uncertainty-aware reconstruction. The framework combines endoscopy-specific encoders, including a convolutional EndoVAE backbone and pretrained Vision Transformer encoders from GastroNet-5M, with two scalable GP approximations: Hierarchical Prior Approximation (HPA) and Sparse Precision Approximation (SPA). Specular reflections are handled using a DUCKNet-based masking pipeline that excludes corrupted pixels from the reconstruction objective. On the C3VDv2 colonoscopy dataset, the best GPVAE variants reduced image reconstruction RMSE by 21.9\% on average, and by up to 26.1\%, relative to matched VAE baselines. Downstream trajectory RMSE was reduced by 12.7\% on average across classical visual odometry and a pretrained PoseNet, at an average increase of 27.3\% in training time per epoch. Finally, the GP posterior provides per-frame uncertainty estimates that reflect temporal support and offer a confidence signal for restored frames.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高斯过程先验变分自编码器（GPVAE）框架用于内窥镜视频修复，通过用时间高斯过程先验替代标准因子化先验，实现缺失帧的插值和不确定性感知重建。结合内窥镜专用编码器和两种可扩展GP近似（HPA和SPA），在C3VDv2结肠镜数据集上，最佳变体将图像重建RMSE平均降低21.9%（最高26.1%），下游轨迹RMSE平均降低12.7%，同时训练时间每epoch增加27.3%。
Motivation: 内窥镜视频序列常受镜面反射、运动伪影和缺失帧等瞬态噪声干扰，现有逐帧处理方法缺乏时间连续性，修复效果有限。
Method: 提出GPVAE框架，使用时间高斯过程先验对潜在变量建模，结合卷积EndoVAE骨干和预训练Vision Transformer编码器，并采用分层先验近似（HPA）和稀疏精度近似（SPA）两种可扩展GP近似方法；镜面反射通过DUCKNet掩码管线从重建目标中排除。
Result: 在C3VDv2数据集上，GPVAE的最佳变体将图像重建RMSE平均降低21.9%（最高26.1%），下游视觉里程计和PoseNet的轨迹RMSE平均降低12.7%，训练时间每epoch增加27.3%。
Conclusion: GP后验提供逐帧不确定性估计，反映时间支持，并为修复帧提供置信信号。

papers.title: Linear Recurrent Unit with Semantic Modulation for Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Linear recurrent unit (LRU), designed with a principled formulation for stable linear recurrence, has demonstrated promising accuracy and robustness on long-range dependency tasks. However, its static parameterization and single-scan method limits its applicability to 2D vision tasks. In this study, we propose a LRU-based restoration network with a semantic modulating unit (SMU) to achieve a harmonious balance between performance and efficiency in single-image super-resolution. The SMU plays three key roles: LRU modulation, spatial categorization, and feature enhancement through learned prototype. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method quantitatively and qualitatively surpasses recent state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our approach achieves superior performance with computational complexity on par with existing methods. The source code and models are available at https://github.com/MingyuChoi-run/LSM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于线性循环单元（LRU）和语义调制单元（SMU）的图像超分辨率网络，通过LRU调制、空间分类和特征增强，在单图像超分辨率任务上取得优于现有方法的性能，且计算复杂度与当前方法相当。
Motivation: LRU在长程依赖任务中表现出色，但其静态参数化和单扫描方式限制了在2D视觉任务中的应用，需要针对图像超分辨率进行改进。
Method: 提出LRU与SMU结合的恢复网络：SMU负责LRU调制、空间分类和基于学习原型的特征增强。
Result: 定量和定性实验表明，该方法在多个超分辨率基准上超越近期最先进方法，且计算复杂度与现有方法持平。
Conclusion: LRU结合语义调制可有效适配图像超分辨率任务，实现性能与效率的平衡。

papers.title: Measuring Biological Capabilities and Risks of AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses a rapidly emerging policy challenge: how to generate and interpret credible evidence about the biological capabilities and risks of AI scientists, or agentic AI systems capable of autonomously or collaboratively performing multi-step scientific tasks. As these systems enter real research workflows, decision-makers increasingly face evaluation results whose meaning depends on underlying design choices that are often implicit or under-documented. We synthesize current evidence on AI-enabled biological risks and introduce biological agentic evaluations as a promising, but interpretation-sensitive, tool for assessing these systems. Our central contribution is a set of practical, experience-grounded considerations -- drawing from our own evaluations -- that show how choices around defining, designing, running, scoring, and documenting evaluations materially shape what results do and do not imply about risk. The analysis is intended to help policymakers interpret biological evaluation outputs with appropriate caution; guide public and private funders toward high-leverage investments in AI-biology evaluation research; and support biosecurity practitioners assessing emerging AI systems. A secondary audience includes researchers designing or conducting agentic evaluations within frontier AI labs, AI providers, scientific institutions, and third-party evaluation organizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI智能体在生物学研究中的能力与风险评估问题，提出了一套基于实践经验的考虑因素，指导如何设计、运行、评分和记录生物学智能体评估，以帮助政策制定者和从业者正确解读评估结果。
Motivation: 随着自主AI系统进入真实研究流程，决策者面临评估结果的意义取决于隐含设计选择的问题，而目前缺乏系统的解释框架。
Method: 作者综合现有AI生物风险证据，引入生物学智能体评估作为工具，并从自身评估经验出发，提出了一系列关于定义、设计、运行、评分和记录评估的实用考虑因素。
Result: 论文强调选择相关因素如何实质性塑造评估结果对风险的启示，但未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该分析旨在帮助政策制定者谨慎解读生物学评估输出，指导资助者优先投资AI-生物学评估研究，并支持生物安全从业者评估新兴AI系统。
