papers.title: The Hidden Environmental Cost of Poor Coding Practices in TensorFlow and Keras Applications: A Study on Resource Leaks and Carbon Emissions
papers.abstract_en: Efficiency and sustainability are critical considerations in the development and deployment of machine learning (ML) applications. Among the factors influencing sustainability, resource leaks in ML code can introduce hidden inefficiencies that elevate energy consumption and CO2 emissions. Despite this, empirical evidence quantifying their environmental impact remains limited. This emerging results paper presents an initial empirical investigation of two common resource-leak smells, namely Improper Model Reuse (IMR) and Unreleased Tensor References (UTR), and their impact on energy consumption and CO2 emissions in TensorFlow and Keras workloads. Controlled experiments were conducted for each smell by executing identical training tasks while comparing against a smell-free baseline. Our preliminary results show that both smells consistently increase estimated electricity usage and carbon emissions. IMR and UTR increased electricity consumption by approximately 32% and 46%, respectively, with proportional increases in CO2 emissions. Paired statistical tests indicate that these differences are systematic and statistically significant, providing initial empirical evidence that resource-leak smells may degrade ML energy efficiency and environmental sustainability. These findings suggest that resource-leak smells pose measurable risks to both software quality and sustainability, emphasizing the importance of integrating resource-lifecycle management and energy-efficiency considerations into ML development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过可控实验，实证研究了TensorFlow和Keras应用中两种常见资源泄漏“坏味道”——不当模型复用（IMR）和未释放张量引用（UTR）对能耗和碳排放的影响。初步结果表明，IMR和UTR分别使电力消耗增加约32%和46%，碳排放相应增加，且差异具有统计显著性。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏量化ML代码中资源泄漏对环境影响的经验证据，论文旨在填补这一空白，揭示资源泄漏对软件质量和可持续性的潜在风险。
Method: 对每种资源泄漏“坏味道”分别进行可控实验，执行相同的训练任务，并与无泄漏的基线对比，测量电力和碳排放差异，并使用配对统计检验验证显著性。
Result: IMR和UTR分别使电力消耗增加约32%和46%，碳排放呈比例增加；统计检验表明差异是系统性且显著的。
Conclusion: 资源泄漏“坏味道”对ML能效和环境可持续性构成可测量的风险，强调在ML开发中应集成资源生命周期管理和能效考虑。

papers.title: Improving End-to-End Speech Recognition for Dysarthric Speech through In-Domain Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Dysarthric speech recognition is crucial for facilitating effective communication among individuals with dysarthria. However, accurately recognizing dysarthric speech poses significant challenges due to varying severity levels and limited data availability. In this paper, we explore data augmentation techniques for dysarthric automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems by fine-tuning the End-to-End pre-trained Wav2Vec2 model, with a specific focus on severity levels. To address the challenges of data scarcity and the need for extensive data in fine-tuning pre-trained ASR systems for dysarthric speech, we investigate four prominent data augmentation methods: Speaking-Rate Modification (SRM), Pitch Modification (PM), Formant Modification (FM), and vocal tract Length Perturbation (VTLP), tailored to different aspects of dysarthria. The study uses individually fine-tuned Wav2Vec2 models for each severity class as baseline systems. Additionally, we conducted severity-specific fine-tuning of the ASR model using augmented data. Results demonstrate distinct efficacy patterns for each augmentation technique across severity levels. The best WERs were achieved with SRM ($s$=0.8) for \textit{low} (9.02\%) and \textit{medium} (38.11\%) severities, and with PM ($τ$=0.8) for \textit{high} severity (55.15\%), reflecting relative improvements of 30.02\%, 16.64\%, and 15.47\%, respectively. These results confirm the effectiveness of the augmentation methods in improving dysarthric ASR performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对构音障碍语音识别中数据稀缺和严重程度多样性的问题，探索了四种数据增强方法（语速修改、音高修改、共振峰修改、声道长度扰动）在Wav2Vec2模型微调中的效果。实验表明，不同增强方法对不同严重程度的构音障碍效果不同，最佳词错误率在低、中、高严重程度上分别达到9.02%、38.11%、55.15%，相对改进分别为30.02%、16.64%、15.47%。
Motivation: 构音障碍语音识别面临数据量有限和不同严重程度变化大的挑战，现有端到端ASR系统难以准确识别，需要有效的数据增强方法。
Method: 使用预训练Wav2Vec2模型，针对低、中、高三种严重程度分别微调，并应用四种数据增强技术：语速修改、音高修改、共振峰修改和声道长度扰动，利用增强数据进行严重程度特定的微调。
Result: 低严重程度使用语速修改（s=0.8）达到WER 9.02%（相对改进30.02%）；中等严重程度同样使用语速修改达到38.11%（相对改进16.64%）；高严重程度使用音高修改（τ=0.8）达到55.15%（相对改进15.47%）。
Conclusion: 摘要确认了数据增强方法在改善构音障碍ASR性能上的有效性，且不同技术对不同严重程度具有不同的疗效模式。

papers.title: Agentic Electronic Design Automation: A Handoff Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Electronic design automation (EDA) is inherently multi-stage and handoff-heavy. Design artifacts, flow scripts, and engineering decisions cross tool, session, and organizational boundaries before final implementation, signoff, or release. Each transfer carries explicit and implicit requirements that may not be fully captured by stage-local checks. LLM-based agents now invoke EDA tools directly, embed retrieved knowledge in executable scripts, and hand off state across sessions and stages. Once their outputs condition downstream engineering decisions, the transferred object must satisfy a handoff contract and meet the assumptions of its next consumer. This survey introduces handoff validity as its organizing principle. A handoff is valid when the transferred object satisfies the consumer's acceptance conditions and carries sufficient context, evidence, and provenance for downstream use. We review 82 systems and classify them into three boundary classes. Stage-Bound systems establish validity within a single EDA stage or bounded verification task. Flow-Bound systems preserve coherent workflow state across tools, invocations, and sessions. Organization-Bound systems maintain source grounding, provenance, scope, and admissibility across knowledge and authority boundaries. For each class, we analyze handoff contracts, handoff objects, coordination mechanisms, and open questions. These analyses motivate a five-layer EDA agent communication protocol (EACP), covering the agent discovery, agent message, tool invocation, workflow orchestration, and security and IP protocols. We aim to provide a common vocabulary and research agenda for trustworthy agentic EDA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从交接（handoff）视角对基于LLM代理的电子设计自动化（EDA）系统进行综述，提出交接有效性作为组织原则，将现有82个系统分为阶段边界、流程边界和组织边界三类，并设计五层EDA代理通信协议（EACP）。目标是提供可信代理EDA的通用词汇和研究议程。
Motivation: 传统EDA流程多阶段、多交接，设计工件和决策在工具、会话和组织间传递，隐含需求可能未被充分捕获。基于LLM的代理直接调用EDA工具并传递状态，但交接的有效性缺乏系统化分析。
Method: 通过调查82个系统，以交接有效性为原则，将系统分为阶段边界、流程边界和组织边界三类，分析每类的交接契约、对象和协调机制，并基于此提出五层EDA代理通信协议（EACP）。
Result: 论文本身是综述，未报告具体实验结果，主要成果是分类框架和提出的EACP协议。
Conclusion: 旨在为可信代理EDA提供通用词汇和研究议程，强调交接有效性是组织未来工作的关键视角。

papers.title: Systematic Study of Dysarthric Speech Recognition: Spectral Features and Acoustic Models
papers.abstract_en: The challenge associated with recognizing dysarthric speech primarily arises from pronounced acoustic variability attributed to impaired articulatory precision. Past research has demonstrated improved recognition through the use of hybrid DNN/HMM sequence discriminative training. This paper presents a comprehensive investigation of various combinations of acoustic features tailored to different Acoustic Models, offering suitable feature selections for each. The incorporation of Pitch features notably improved recognition performance, especially for sentence recognition tasks involving dysarthric speech. Through a systematic examination of the TORGO database, we have demonstrated the potential to enhance the performance of the state-of-the-art Factorized Time Delay Neural Network (F-TDNN) model for recognizing dysarthric speech. Our methods, implemented with the F-TDNN model, resulted in a 4.65\% relative improvement in isolated word recognition and a 4.63\% relative improvement in sentence recognition for dysarthric speech, compared to previous research. This improvement effectively compensates for speech variability, attributable to our deliberate selection of the number of overlapping frames between consecutive training example chunks.

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了构音障碍语音识别的声学特征与声学模型组合，重点考察基频特征对识别性能的提升。在TORGO数据库上，基于F-TDNN模型的孤立词和句子识别分别获得4.65%和4.63%的相对改进。
Motivation: 构音障碍语音因发音精度受损导致声学变异大，现有研究虽已使用混合DNN/HMM序列判别训练，但特征与模型的系统组合尚未充分探索。
Method: 对多种声学特征（包括基频特征）与不同声学模型进行系统组合，并基于TORGO数据库，使用F-TDNN模型，优化连续训练样本块之间的重叠帧数。
Result: 相比先前研究，孤立词识别相对改进4.65%，句子识别相对改进4.63%。
Conclusion: 合理选择重叠帧数能有效补偿构音障碍语音的变异性，基频特征对句子识别任务尤其有益。

papers.title: CombEval: A Framework for Evaluating Combinatorial Counting in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present CombEval, a dynamic benchmark for evaluating combinatorial counting in large language models. CombEval represents each problem as a typed Cofola specification over entities, combinatorial objects, object dependencies, and constraints, enabling controlled generation of natural-language counting problems with exact solver-verified answers. Unlike static collections, CombEval supports systematic variation of object type, entity scale, constraint count, and reasoning depth. We evaluate 11 LLMs under direct and code-augmented settings and find that models remain brittle on ordered objects, indistinguishable elements, relatively positional constraints, and nested object dependencies. Error analysis further identifies failures in constraint interpretation and counting principles. CombEval provides a diagnostic testbed for studying when and why LLMs fail at combinatorial reasoning. The code and generated benchmark suites are publicly available at \url{https://github.com/YuxuZhou-CN/combination-problem-generation}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CombEval，一个用于评估大语言模型组合计数能力的动态基准。它通过类型化 Cofola 规范表示问题，支持对象类型、实体规模、约束数量等系统变化，并通过精确求解器验证答案。在 11 个 LLM 上的评估显示模型在有序对象、不可区分元素等任务上表现脆弱。
Motivation: 现有静态基准无法系统性测试大语言模型在不同组合计数维度上的推理能力，缺乏对错误类型和失败原因的诊断能力。
Method: CombEval 使用类型化 Cofola 规范将组合计数问题分解为实体、组合对象、对象依赖和约束，支持自动生成自然语言问题并附带精确验证的答案，同时允许对对象类型、实体规模、约束数量和推理深度进行系统变化。
Result: 对 11 个大语言模型在直接推理和代码辅助两种设置下的评估显示，模型在处理有序对象、不可区分元素、相对位置约束和嵌套对象依赖时表现脆弱；错误分析揭示了约束解释和计数原则方面的失败。
Conclusion: CombEval 为研究大语言模型何时以及为何在组合推理上失败提供了诊断测试平台，代码和生成的基准套件已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ORAgentBench: Can LLM Agents Solve Challenging Operations Research Tasks End to End?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for multi-step tasks in executable environments, yet their ability to perform realistic operations research (OR) work remains unclear. Existing OR evaluations often decouple modeling from solving, rely on pre-formalized or text-only instances, and rarely test the full workflow from operational artifacts to validated decisions. In this work, we introduce ORAgentBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for evaluating autonomous agents on challenging end-to-end operations research tasks. It contains 107 human-reviewed tasks across diverse operational scenarios, each packaged in an isolated environment with a natural-language brief, multi-file data, configuration artifacts, and a required submission schema. Agents must write and run solution code, and their submissions are evaluated by hidden validators for schema validity, hard-constraint feasibility, and normalized objective quality. Experiments with fourteen frontier agent-model configurations show that current agents remain far from reliable OR practice. The best agent passes only 35.51% of all tasks and 20.59% of hard tasks, and many feasible submissions still fall below the required quality threshold. Failure analysis further shows that errors are dominated by strategic weaknesses, including missed operational rules, brittle formulations, weak feasible-solution construction, and insufficient solution improvement. OR-specific procedural skills increase hard-task feasibility, but do not reliably improve solution quality or pass rate. These results suggest that progress in OR agents requires moving beyond plausible optimization code toward dependable, high-quality operational decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ORAgentBench，一个面向运算研究（OR）任务的端到端自主智能体评估基准。该基准包含107个人工审核的OR任务，覆盖多种运营场景，要求智能体基于自然语言描述、多文件数据和配置工件编写并运行求解代码，并通过隐藏验证器评估方案的有效性、约束可行性和目标质量。实验表明，当前最先进的LLM智能体仅通过35.51%的任务（困难任务20.59%），失败主要源于策略性弱点如遗漏规则、脆弱公式和缺乏改进。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体评估常将OR问题建模与求解分离，依赖预形式化或纯文本实例，缺乏对完整工作流的测试。需要真实执行环境下的基准来评估智能体解决实际OR任务的能力。
Method: 构建ORAgentBench基准，包含107个多样性OR任务，每个任务提供自然语言说明、多文件数据、配置工件和提交模板。智能体需自主编写并运行代码，提交结果由隐藏验证器检查模式合法性、硬约束可行性和标准化目标质量。测试14种前沿智能体-模型配置。
Result: 最佳智能体总体通过率35.51%，困难任务20.59%；许多可行方案未达质量阈值。失败主要由策略性错误导致，如遗漏规则、公式脆弱、可行解构建不足。OR专用程序技能能提高困难任务可行性，但未显著改善方案质量或通过率。
Conclusion: 当前LLM智能体在端到端OR任务中远未可靠，需从生成合理优化代码转向可靠、高质量的操作决策。

papers.title: AgentFinVQA: A Deployable Multi-Agent Pipeline for Auditable Financial Chart QA
papers.abstract_en: Financial chart question answering in regulated settings demands more than accuracy: practitioners must know which answers to trust before acting on them, and many institutions cannot send client data to external model providers. Yet existing chart-QA agents are accuracy-focused and opaque, and most assume proprietary API access; to our knowledge, none combines auditability with on-premise deployability without significant accuracy compromise. We present AgentFinVQA, a multi-agent pipeline that decomposes each query into planning, OCR, legend grounding, visual inspection, and verification, recording every step in a traceable Model Evaluation Packet (MEP) per sample. On FinMME, AgentFinVQA improves $+7.68$ pp over a primary-backbone matched zero-shot baseline with a proprietary backbone (Gemini-3 Flash; 71.24% vs. 63.56%, McNemar $p \approx 1.1 \times 10^{-16}$), and $+4.84$ pp with open-weights Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 served locally. The verifier's verdict also serves as a useful confidence signal (68.2% vs. 55.6% exact accuracy on confirmed vs. revised answers), enabling human-in-the-loop review routing. Error analysis shows that question misunderstanding, legend confusion and extraction error account for nearly two-thirds of failures and are the categories least detected by the verifier, identifying clear directions for future work. Together these results show that auditable, on-premise financial chart QA is practical and that the open-weights system keeps most of the accuracy gains while enabling full data residency. We release our code to support reproducible evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentFinVQA 是一个用于可审计金融图表问答的多智能体管道，将查询分解为规划、OCR、图例定位、视觉检查和验证步骤，每一步记录在可追踪的模型评估包中。在 FinMME 基准上，使用专有骨干 Gemini-3 Flash 时相比零样本基线提升 7.68 个百分点（71.24% vs 63.56%），使用开放权重 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 本地部署时提升 4.84 个百分点。验证器的判定可作为置信信号，有助于人力审核路由。
Motivation: 现有金融图表问答系统只关注准确率且不透明，大多依赖专有 API，无法满足受监管场景中对可审计性和本地部署的需求。
Method: 提出多智能体管道 AgentFinVQA，将查询分解为规划、OCR、图例定位、视觉检查和验证五个子任务，每个样本生成可追踪的模型评估包。
Result: 在 FinMME 上，专有骨干基线提升 7.68 个百分点，开放权重本地部署提升 4.84 个百分点；验证器对确认答案的准确率为 68.2%，对修订答案为 55.6%。
Conclusion: 可审计、可本地部署的金融图表问答是可行的，开放权重系统在保持大部分精度提升的同时实现完整数据驻留。

papers.title: Towards Engineering Scaling Laws with Pretraining Data Composition
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling laws describe how model performance improves as a power law in compute, model size, and dataset size. While well-established for large language models, these relationships are emerging for large models in particle physics. As with language, empirical studies show that the performance scales as a power law. However, unlike natural language or image domains, fundamental physics has high-fidelity simulators that produce synthetic data cheaply. This favors scaling regimes where additional data is cheaper than additional parameters, and allows the pretraining dataset itself to be engineered to influence the scaling. For the task of classifying hadronic jets produced in collisions of high-energy particle beams, we show that the scaling behavior can be engineered towards requiring more data rather than larger models by inclusion of pretraining data which is more diverse and better aligned with the downstream classification task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究粒子物理中神经网络缩放定律的工程化。通过在夸克喷注分类任务上改变预训练数据的多样性和下游对齐程度，展示可以调控缩放行为，使得增加数据量比增加模型参数更有效。
Motivation: 现有缩放定律主要针对大语言模型，物理领域虽然有类似发现，但可以利用低成本合成数据来工程化缩放行为。
Method: 在粒子物理高能喷注分类任务中，通过改变预训练数据的多样性和与下游任务的对齐程度，观察缩放行为的变化。
Result: 摘要报告显示，包含更多样化且与下游分类任务更好对齐的预训练数据，可以使缩放偏向于需要更多数据而非更大模型。
Conclusion: 在物理领域，通过工程化预训练数据组成可以影响神经网络缩放定律，使数据扩展比参数扩展更划算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Stochastic-Thermodynamic Constraint on the Seasonal Phase Locking of the El Niño-Southern Oscillation
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the seasonal phase locking of the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) in a linear stochastic recharge oscillator (SRO), a damped oscillator with additive noise and a time-dependent growth rate. Phase locking is reflected in the seasonality of the variance of the sea surface temperature anomaly (SSTA). In general, energy drives such a change, whereas entropy governs whether it occurs; phase locking is thus subject to both an energy- and an entropy-based constraint. We quantify this entropy-based constraint using a thermodynamic uncertainty relation (TUR), a fundamental inequality in stochastic thermodynamics. The TUR constrains the tendency of the SSTA variance by the partial entropy production rate, which is dominated by the ratio of forward and backward transition probabilities and quantifies the irreversibility of SSTA transitions. The growth rate governs this irreversibility: its extrema occur in boreal autumn and late winter, and the entropy production rate peaks at both times. These peaks relax the TUR constraint on the tendency of the SSTA variance, so that the variance itself can peak in boreal winter, consistent with observed ENSO phase locking. Conversely, when irreversibility is insufficient, ENSO cannot grow or decay. If this irreversibility were interpreted as dissipated energy, the constraint on ENSO growth and decay would require this dissipation to be exported from the equatorial Pacific. A more realistic model is needed to test this hypothesis and to further explore the physical connection between entropy and dissipated energy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用线性随机充放电振子（SRO）模型，从随机热力学角度研究ENSO的季节锁相现象。通过热力学不确定关系（TUR）约束海表温度异常（SSTA）方差的季节性变化，发现熵产生率在秋季和冬末峰值，松弛了TUR约束，使得SSTA方差在冬季达到峰值，与观测锁相一致。
Motivation: ENSO的季节锁相机制尚未完全理解，传统能量约束不足以解释其发生时机，需要引入熵基约束。
Method: 采用带加性噪声和时间依赖增长率的线性随机充放电振子模型，利用随机热力学中的热力学不确定关系（TUR）量化熵基约束，通过计算前后向跃迁概率比的熵产生率分析锁相机制。
Result: 熵产生率在秋末和冬末达到峰值，松弛TUR对SSTA方差变化率的约束，使SSTA方差在冬季最大，与观测的ENSO锁相一致；当可逆性不足时，ENSO无法增长或衰减。
Conclusion: ENSO的季节锁相同时受能量和熵约束，熵产生率的峰值允许方差冬季峰值，但可逆性不足会限制ENSO发展；未来需更真实模型验证熵与耗散能的物理联系。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Occ-VLM: Occupancy Grounded Vision Language Model for Indoor Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recently, vision-language models (VLMs) have made significant progress in 3D scene understanding, driving advances in applications such as embodied intelligence and robotic vision. However, existing approaches typically either rely directly on explicit 3D inputs (e.g., point clouds or RGB-D sequences), or introduce an additional 3D geometry encoder to derive 3D-aware visual tokens from 2D images. Such designs structurally decouple 3D geometric perception from the rich 2D semantics learned via vision-language pre-training, hindering the development of a unified 3D vision-language representation. In this work, we propose Occ-VLM, a novel framework for 3D scene understanding that operates purely on posed RGB images and employs a single 2D vision encoder. Specifically, Occ-VLM reconstructs 3D scene occupancy as an auxiliary geometric prior, which is utilized to spatially associate foreground 2D tokens with 3D space. These tokens are then decoded by a Large Language Model (LLM) for unified scene understanding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Occ-VLM achieves both accurate geometric perception and robust vision-language reasoning: it attains state-of-the-art performance on multi-view occupancy prediction, while performing on par with 3D-input VLMs on 3D Visual Question Answering (VQA) and 3D dense captioning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Occ-VLM，一种仅使用带位姿的 RGB 图像进行 3D 室内场景理解的框架。它通过重建 3D 场景占用作为几何先验，将前景 2D  token 与 3D 空间关联，并由大语言模型解码实现统一场景理解。实验表明，该方法在多视角占用预测上达到最先进水平，在 3D VQA 和密集描述任务上与基于 3D 输入的 VLM 性能相当。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在 3D 场景理解中要么直接依赖显式 3D 输入，要么引入额外的 3D 几何编码器，导致 3D 几何感知与 2D 语义学习解耦，阻碍了统一的 3D 视觉-语言表示。
Method: 提出 Occ-VLM 框架，仅使用带位姿的 RGB 图像，通过重建 3D 场景占用作为辅助几何先验，利用该先验将前景 2D token 空间关联到 3D 空间，再由大语言模型解码进行统一场景理解。
Result: 在多视角占用预测任务上达到最先进性能；在 3D VQA 和 3D 密集描述基准上，与基于 3D 输入的 VLM 性能相当。
Conclusion: 证明仅依赖 2D 视觉编码器和占用先验可以实现准确的几何感知和鲁棒的视觉-语言推理，为 3D 场景理解提供了一种无需显式 3D 输入的新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Entropy: Learning from Token-Level Distributional Deviations for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning; however, it faces a fundamental optimization instability: uniform token updates precipitate entropy collapse, leading to premature convergence to suboptimal strategies, whereas excessive Shannon Entropy maximization can cause entropy explosion, driving blind exploration toward incoherent reasoning chains. To resolve this dichotomy, we introduce the Independent Combinatorial Tokens (ICT) framework, which shifts the optimization focus from scalar uncertainty to the distributional properties of token logits. By leveraging the Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence between token logits distributions, ICT identifies tokens with distinctive distributional patterns as critical branching points for guiding effective exploration in LLM reasoning. Our theoretical analysis, grounded in both Shannon and second-order Rényi entropy, proves that selectively updating on these tokens regulates policy concentration: it reduces the overall distribution uncertainty measured by Shannon entropy, while controlling probability concentration captured by second-order Rényi entropy. This dual effect prevents over-concentrated token generation from weakening exploration and effectively stabilizes the training landscape. Empirical results demonstrate that updating only the top 10% of unique tokens on Qwen2.5 (0.5B/1.5B/7B) models yields an average pass@4 improvement of 4.58%, with a maximum gain of 14.9%, over GRPO, 20-Entropy, and STAPO baselines across seven benchmarks spanning math, commonsense, and Olympiad-level problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）在大语言模型推理中因均匀更新导致熵崩溃或熵爆炸的优化不稳定性，提出独立组合token（ICT）框架。该方法通过计算token对数几率分布的Jensen-Shannon散度，识别具有独特分布模式的token作为关键分支点，并仅对这些token进行选择性更新。理论分析结合香农熵和二阶Rényi熵证明，该策略能降低总体分布不确定性并控制概率集中度，从而防止过度集中token生成并稳定训练。实验在Qwen2.5（0.5B/1.5B/7B）上，仅更新前10%的独特token，在数学、常识和奥赛级问题的七个基准上平均pass@4提升4.58%，最高提升14.9%，超过GRPO、20-Entropy和STAPO基线。
Motivation: RLVR在大语言模型推理中面临优化不稳定：均匀更新导致熵崩溃，过早收敛到次优策略；而过度最大化香农熵会导致熵爆炸，引发盲目探索和推理链不连贯。
Method: 引入Independent Combinatorial Tokens (ICT)框架，将优化焦点从标量不确定性转向token对数几率分布的分布特性。利用Jensen-Shannon散度识别具有独特分布模式的token作为关键分支点，指导有效探索。
Result: 在Qwen2.5 (0.5B/1.5B/7B)上仅更新前10%的独特token，在七个基准（数学、常识、奥赛级问题）上平均pass@4提升4.58%，最高14.9%，优于GRPO、20-Entropy和STAPO基线。
Conclusion: 选择性更新关键token能同时降低香农熵度量的总体分布不确定性和控制二阶Rényi熵度量的概率集中度，防止过度集中token生成，稳定训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Information Theoretic Framework for Graph Novelty Generation via Latent Mixture Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We propose an information-theoretic framework for graph novelty generation, which aims to generate data that are distinct from existing patterns while preserving global structural consistency. Our approach embeds data into a latent space, models the latent distribution using finite mixture models, and generates novel samples by imposing explicit novelty and reliability conditions formulated in terms of description length. Specifically, novelty is enforced by requiring generated samples to be poorly explained by all existing mixture components, while reliability constrains their impact on the overall mixture structure under the Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that, with appropriate threshold choices, the probabilities of misclassifying non-novel or unreliable samples converge to zero with explicit rates. Experiments on synthetic and benchmark graph datasets demonstrate that the proposed method enables principled novelty generation with quantifiable risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于信息论的图新颖性生成框架，通过将数据嵌入潜在空间并用有限混合模型建模，在最小描述长度（MDL）原则下施加新颖性和可靠性条件，生成与现有模式不同但保持全局结构一致性的图数据。理论分析表明，在适当阈值下，误分类非新颖或不可靠样本的概率以显式速率收敛到零。在合成和基准图数据集上的实验验证了该方法能实现可量化风险的原则性新颖性生成。
Motivation: 现有图生成方法主要关注生成与训练数据相似的结构，缺乏生成与已有模式明显不同但仍保持结构一致性的新颖图数据的能力，且难以控制生成样本的可靠性和风险。
Method: 将图数据嵌入潜在空间，用有限混合模型（finite mixture model）估计潜在分布；通过描述长度（description length）定义新颖性（样本被所有现有混合成分的解释程度低）和可靠性（样本对整体混合结构的影响受MDL约束），并据此生成新样本。
Result: 理论分析证明误分类概率以显式速率收敛到零；实验在合成和基准图数据集上展示了该方法能产生新颖且可靠的图样本。
Conclusion: 该框架为图新颖性生成提供了基于信息论的理论基础，能够量化生成风险，但实验仅涵盖合成数据和基准图数据集，实际应用效果需进一步验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Data Standards for Humanoid Robotics: The Missing Infrastructure for Physical AI
papers.abstract_en: The scalability of humanoid robots will depend not only on models and hardware, but also on whether physical experience can accumulate across robots, tasks, organizations, and time. Drawing on the authors' work in developing ISO/WD 26264-1, Humanoid robot datasets -- Part 1: General requirements, within ISO/TC 299/WG 16, this article argues that data standards are becoming foundational infrastructure for Physical AI. We develop three insights. First, humanoid robot data is embodied interaction data, not a collection of isolated digital samples; a useful dataset must preserve the relationship among robot body, action, task, scene, execution trace, and outcome. Second, its value depends on physical coherence: multimodal streams are reusable only when timing, coordinate frames, calibration, kinematics, units, and synchronization assumptions remain inspectable. Third, the main bottleneck is not only data scarcity, but non-cumulative data caused by high collection costs, data silos, and inconsistent evaluation. We argue that humanoid robot data standards address these bottlenecks by making embodied experience interpretable, shareable, traceable, and reusable. A general standard should provide horizontal infrastructure for lifecycle management, metadata, provenance, quality, versioning, and traceability, while capability-specific parts should define domain grammar for manipulation, locomotion, human-robot interaction, cognition, and future humanoid capabilities. As AI moves from screens into bodies, data standards must evolve from organizing digital information to structuring physical interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于作者参与制定ISO人形机器人数据标准（ISO/WD 26264-1）的经验，论证数据标准是人形机器人可扩展性的关键基础设施。作者提出三个观点：人形机器人数据是具身交互数据，必须保留身体、动作、任务、场景、执行轨迹和结果之间的关系；其价值取决于物理一致性，包括时间、坐标系、标定、运动学、单位和同步假设的可检查性；主要瓶颈不仅是数据稀缺，更是数据不可累积，源于高采集成本、数据孤岛和不一致的评估。文章主张数据标准应提供生命周期管理、元数据、溯源、质量、版本和可追溯性的横向基础设施，并为操作、移动、人机交互、认知等能力特定部分定义领域语法。
Motivation: 人形机器人的可扩展性依赖于物理经验在机器人、任务、组织间和跨时间的积累，但目前缺乏统一的数据标准，导致数据不可累积且评估不一致，阻碍了具身智能的发展。
Method: 本文不是提出具体技术方法，而是从标准制定视角提出框架：横向标准覆盖数据生命周期管理、元数据、溯源、质量、版本和可追溯性；能力特定标准（如操作、移动、人机交互）定义领域语法。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，而是从理论层面论证标准对数据可解释性、可共享性、可追溯性和可复用性的促进作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为随着AI从屏幕走向实体，数据标准必须从组织数字信息演进为结构化物理交互，而人形机器人数据标准正是解决当前数据瓶颈的基础设施。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为随着AI从屏幕走向实体，数据标准必须从组织数字信息演进为结构化物理交互，而人形机器人数据标准正是解决当前数据瓶颈的基础设施。

papers.title: Contour-Constrained Deformable Registration with Parameter Characterization for Head and Neck Surgical Guidance
papers.abstract_en: With 890,000 annual new cases globally, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma has one of the highest recurrence rates among solid malignancies. Although frozen section analysis is the standard of care for intraoperative margin assessment, accurately relocating detected positive margins on the resection bed remains challenging due to imprecise alignment between resected specimens and their resection bed, compounded by post-resection mucosal tissue shrinkage. We present a biomechanics-driven deformable registration framework that corrects post-resection tissue deformation to provide intraoperative guidance. Our approach registers 3D specimen meshes to intraoperative resection bed point clouds using a deformable registration approach based on regularized Kelvinlet basis functions. The registration matches surface point clouds, fiducial landmarks, and boundary contour constraints that directly penalize perpendicular distance-to-agreement between specimen and resection bed boundaries. Across nine specimens from skin, buccal mucosa, and tongue sites, the overall mean target registration error was $11.11 \pm 4.07$ mm using rigid registration, which decreased to $8.20 \pm 2.68$ mm (26.19\% reduction) using deformable registration without contour constraint. The proposed contour-constrained deformable registration further reduced the error to $5.62 \pm 2.28$ mm, a 49.41\% reduction relative to rigid registration. We observed the largest reduction in the most clinically challenging tongue specimens. We also performed a systematic two-stage parameter search to characterize the relative importance of surface alignment, fiducial correspondences, contour constraint, and strain energy regularization. This search revealed that contour weighting dominates registration accuracy for tissue types with large lateral deformation, while the algorithm operates over a broad range of parameter combinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对头颈部鳞状细胞癌手术中标本与切除床之间的后切除变形配准问题，提出一种基于正则化Kelvinlet基函数的生物力学驱动可变形配准框架。该方法加入轮廓约束，直接惩罚标本与切除床边界之间的垂直距离误差。在9个标本上，轮廓约束可变形配准将平均目标配准误差从刚体配准的11.11 mm降至5.62 mm（降低49.41%），并在最难处理的舌标本上效果最显著。
Motivation: 头颈癌手术中，冰冻切片分析虽为标准，但切除标本与切除床之间对齐不精确，加之组织收缩，导致阳性切缘定位困难。
Method: 提出基于正则化Kelvinlet基函数的可变形配准方法，将3D标本网格与切除床点云配准，同时匹配表面点云、基准标记和边界轮廓约束，并系统进行两阶段参数搜索以表征不同项的相对重要性。
Result: 在9个标本（皮肤、颊黏膜、舌）上，轮廓约束可变形配准将平均目标配准误差从刚体配准的11.11±4.07 mm降至5.62±2.28 mm（降低49.41%）。舌标本改善最大。
Conclusion: 轮廓权重在具有较大横向变形的组织类型中主导配准精度，且算法在较宽参数范围内有效。

papers.title: Optimal Scheduling in a Question-Answering Forum of Knowledge Workers
papers.abstract_en: As individuals turn to the Internet to find answers to questions they may have, several Question Answering (QA) forums have evolved, where users knowledgeable in certain topics can contribute their expertise to answering these requests for information. While these are currently volunteer based, we consider a future version employing knowledge workers who are experts in certain topics. In such a system, the request-answer processes forming the queuing system may utilize schedulers that assign requests in different topics to the experts in the forum, who may be able to answer them according to their expertise levels in different topics. With this model, we calculate the capacity of the system for handling the requests while keeping the system stable, and design schedulers that achieve capacity. We also investigate how collaboration between experts in answering requests can potentially increase capacity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究知识工作者在问答论坛中的最优调度问题，提出一种排队模型，计算系统容量并设计达到容量的调度器，同时探讨专家间协作对容量提升的潜在影响。
Motivation: 当前问答论坛依赖志愿者，本文考虑未来使用知识工作者的场景，需要设计调度器以保持系统稳定并最大化请求处理容量。
Method: 建立请求-答案排队系统模型，基于专家在多个主题上的专业水平分配请求，计算系统稳定性条件下的容量，并设计调度策略实现该容量。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称能够计算系统容量并设计达到容量的调度器，同时协作可提升容量。
Conclusion: 本文表明在知识工作者问答论坛中，通过合理的调度和协作可以提升系统处理请求的能力。

papers.title: SafeSpec: Fast and Safe LLM via Dynamic Reflective Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Speculative inference accelerates large language model (LLM) decoding but provides no inherent safety guarantees. Existing safety defenses are largely incompatible with speculative inference: they either introduce additional computation or disrupt the draft-verify mechanism, negating acceleration benefits. This reveals a fundamental incompatibility between current safety methods and speculative decoding. We propose SafeSpec, a safety-aware speculative inference framework that integrates risk estimation directly into the verification process. SafeSpec attaches a lightweight latent safety head to the target model to jointly evaluate semantic validity and safety in a single forward pass. When unsafe generations are detected, SafeSpec applies rollback and safety-guided reflective multi-sampling to recover safe continuations rather than terminating generation. We model jailbreak attacks as distributional shifts over generative trajectories, where adversarial prompts increase the probability of harmful continuations without eliminating safe ones. Under this model, SafeSpec performs risk-aware trajectory recovery within the speculative decoding process. Across multiple models and adversarial benchmarks, SafeSpec achieves a substantially improved safety-efficiency trade-off. On Qwen3-32B, SafeSpec reduces attack success rates by 15% while preserving a 2.06x inference speedup on benign workloads, demonstrating that speculative acceleration and inference-time safety can be jointly optimized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SafeSpec，一个安全感知的推测性推理框架，通过在验证过程中集成风险估计，在不牺牲加速效果的前提下提升LLM生成的安全性。该方法在目标模型上附加轻量级安全头，联合评估语义有效性和安全性，并在检测到不安全生成时执行回滚和安全引导的反射式多采样。实验表明，在Qwen3-32B上，SafeSpec将攻击成功率降低15%，同时保持2.06倍的推理加速。
Motivation: 现有推测性推理加速LLM解码但缺乏安全保证，而安全防御方法与推测性推理不兼容，要么增加计算量要么破坏机制，导致加速收益丧失。
Method: 在目标模型上附加轻量级安全头，在单次前向传播中联合评估语义有效性和安全性；检测到不安全生成时，执行回滚和安全引导的反射式多采样以恢复安全延续。
Result: 在多个模型和对抗基准上，SafeSpec显著改善了安全-效率权衡；在Qwen3-32B上，攻击成功率降低15%，同时在良性负载上保持2.06倍推理加速。
Conclusion: 推测性加速和推理时安全可以联合优化，SafeSpec通过风险感知轨迹恢复实现了更好的安全-效率折衷。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning universal approximations for partial differential equations with Physics-Informed Broad Learning System
papers.abstract_en: Partial differential equations (PDEs) play a central role in modeling complex physical, biological, and engineering systems. While traditional numerical solvers are robust, they often incur prohibitive computational costs due to mesh dependencies, whereas recent Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a mesh-free alternative but frequently suffer from slow convergence and optimization instability. To bridge this gap, this article proposes the Physics-Informed Broad Learning System (PIBLS), a novel backpropagation-free framework that reformulates PDE solving as a direct least-squares optimization. We improved an algorithm within this framework to handle nonlinear PDEs efficiently and provide a rigorous mathematical proof establishing the universal approximation property of PIBLS for these equations. Experiments on linear and nonlinear PDEs demonstrate that PIBLS is one to three orders of magnitude faster than conventional PINNs while achieving significantly higher solution accuracy. This framework provides a computationally efficient paradigm for scientific machine learning, offering a practical, high-speed alternative for real-time simulation and design optimization tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理信息宽学习系统（PIBLS），一种无反向传播的框架，将偏微分方程求解转化为直接最小二乘优化，并证明了其通用逼近性质。实验表明，PIBLS在求解线性和非线性PDE时，比传统PINNs快一到三个数量级，精度更高。
Motivation: 传统PDE数值求解器依赖网格，计算成本高；物理信息神经网络（PINNs）虽无网格但收敛慢且优化不稳定。需要一种更高效、稳定的替代方法。
Method: 提出PIBLS，利用宽学习系统（Broad Learning System）结构，将PDE求解转化为直接最小二乘优化，避免反向传播。改进算法以处理非线性PDE，并给出通用逼近性质的数学证明。
Result: 在线性和非线性PDE基准上，PIBLS比常规PINNs快1-3个数量级，同时获得更高的解精度。
Conclusion: PIBLS为科学机器学习提供了计算高效的范式，适用于实时仿真和设计优化等需高速求解的任务。

papers.title: Grounded Inference: Principles for Deterministically Encapsulated Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: The incorporation of generative models into traditional computational systems presents both enormous opportunity and tremendous peril. Although many early adopters have realized these perils at great expense, the field still requires foundational frameworks to de-risk incorporation of AI into traditional systems. This manuscript establishes this foundation through the definition of four specific primitives of AI blended architecture, designed to enable deterministic encapsulation of probabilistic models. It further establishes two overarching anti-patterns broadly represented across industry to serve as warnings for engineers in this field. This framework was designed to enable successful integration of AI into traditional systems while providing a foundation upon which generative model providers could build the next generation of generative model interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对将生成式AI集成到传统计算系统中存在的风险，提出了确定性封装概率模型（Deterministically Encapsulated Probabilistic Models）的四个基本原语（primitives），并指出了两个常见的反模式（anti-patterns）。该框架旨在降低AI集成的风险，为生成模型提供者构建下一代接口奠定基础。
Motivation: 早期采用者在将生成式AI融入传统系统时付出了巨大代价，但领域仍缺乏基础性框架来降低风险。本文通过定义原语和反模式来填补这一空白。
Method: 理论分析：定义了四个AI混合架构的原语，以实现概率模型的确定性封装；并归纳了业界两种广泛存在的反模式。
Result: 提出了一套可用于指导AI系统集成的基础原则，但摘要中未报告具体的实验结果或量化指标。
Conclusion: 该框架能够促进AI成功集成到传统系统中，并为生成模型提供者设计下一代接口提供依据。

papers.title: Temporal Self-Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robot manipulation policies trained with reward shaping can still exploit dense rewards through inefficient interaction, while rare efficient behaviors may be forgotten during training. We argue that temporal efficiency itself provides a powerful and underutilized source of self-supervision for reinforcement learning. We introduce Temporal Self-Imitation Learning (TSIL), a reinforcement learning framework that mines temporally efficient successful trajectories generated during learning and converts them into reusable supervision for future policy improvement. TSIL progressively refines learning using configuration-conditioned adaptive temporal targets derived from fast successful trajectories, while preserving and replaying efficient behaviors through efficiency-weighted self-imitation learning. Across 15 distinct long-horizon manipulation tasks, TSIL consistently improves learning efficiency, task-completion efficiency, revisitation of fast successful behaviors, and robustness to unstable training conditions. More broadly, our results suggest that the temporal structure of successful behavior itself provides a scalable self-supervisory signal for reinforcement learning beyond manually engineered reward shaping alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时间自模仿学习（Temporal Self-Imitation Learning, TSIL），一种利用机器人操作任务中时间高效的成功轨迹作为自监督信号的强化学习框架。在15种长周期操作任务中，TSIL提升了学习效率、任务完成效率和对不稳定训练的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有的奖励塑形策略会导致机器人通过低效交互利用密集奖励，而高效行为可能被遗忘，因此需要利用时间效率本身作为自监督信号。
Method: TSIL框架从学习过程中挖掘时间高效的成功轨迹，将其转换为可重用的监督信号，并通过效率加权的自模仿学习保留和重放高效行为，逐步优化学习。
Result: 在15种不同的长周期操作任务中，TSIL一致提高了学习效率、任务完成效率、快速成功行为的重访频率以及对不稳定训练条件的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 成功行为的时间结构本身提供了超越手工奖励塑形的可扩展自监督信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Manifold Bandits: Bayesian Curriculum Learning over the Latent Geometry of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a central approach for improving reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs), where training efficiency depends critically on how problems are sampled during optimization. Existing adaptive curriculum learning methods typically prioritize prompts of intermediate difficulty, treating problem selection as a standard bandit problem with independent arms and overlooking the structured, heterogeneous nature of the task space. In this work, we frame problem sampling as a manifold-structured bandit problem with endogenous non-stationarity: problems are related through the model's latent representation space, and sampling decisions can steer how learning signals evolve across that space. To operationalize this perspective, we introduce Bayesian Manifold Curriculum (BMC), a structure-aware framework that organizes problems into a hierarchical task tree and applies Bayesian learning to guide sampling. Empirically, we find that different sampling strategies induce non-trivial tradeoffs between productivity (learning signal), diversity (coverage of the task manifold), and utility (evaluation relevance). These results show that prioritizing difficulty alone is insufficient for strong downstream performance, highlighting the importance of incorporating structure and type-awareness into problem sampling.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Benchmarking Agentic Review Systems
papers.abstract_en: A new class of agentic review systems are emerging as a remedy to the pressure placed on peer review systems by AI-assisted research, but it is unclear how they should be evaluated. We evaluate two open-source systems (OpenAIReview and coarse), one proprietary system (Reviewer3), and a zero-shot baseline, across six LLMs spanning frontier and efficient models. First, we study whether AI reviews on ICLR/NeurIPS papers track with papers' quality as approximated by external signals such as citations and acceptance decisions. Every system performs above chance in pairwise accuracy, and the best is OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5 at 83.0%. Second, to test whether systems can catch errors with known ground truth, we construct a perturbation benchmark that injects four categories of errors into papers across eight arXiv subject classes and measure detection recall. The strongest configuration (OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5) catches 71.6% of injected errors, leaving substantial room for improvement. The union of detections across six models reaches 83.3% recall, suggesting different models detect different errors and better harness design can potentially increase performance. Beyond these benchmarks, we study a public deployment of OpenAIReview with real users. Votes on its comments skew positive at 1.44 to 1, and the most common complaints are about false positives and minor nitpicks. Together, by evaluating full review systems backed by state-of-the-art models on real research papers, we show that while AI reviews still have room for improvement, they can already track human quality judgments well, catch important errors, and earn positive feedback from real users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自动化审稿系统（Agentic Review Systems），包括 OpenAIReview、Reviewer3 等开源和商业系统。通过在 ICLR/NeurIPS 论文上的测试，发现最佳系统（OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5）在配对准确性上达到 83.0%，在捕捉注入错误方面召回率为 71.6%，表明AI评审已能较好跟踪人类质量判断并发现重要错误，但仍有改进空间。
Motivation: AI辅助研究给同行评审系统带来压力，新兴的自动化审稿系统缺乏统一的评估标准。
Method: 构建评估框架，使用两个基准：一是基于论文引用和录用决策的配对准确性测试，二是注入四类错误（扰动基准）并测量检测召回率。同时进行真实用户部署研究。
Result: 最佳系统（OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5）配对准确性 83.0%，错误检测召回率 71.6%；六模型联合检测召回率可达 83.3%。用户投票正向比例 1.44:1，常见抱怨为误报和小问题。
Conclusion: AI评审系统已能有效跟踪质量判断、捕捉错误并获得用户正向反馈，但仍有提升空间，尤其是错误检测和减少误报方面。

papers.title: A Comparative Study of Pretrained Transformer Models for Quranic ASR: Speech Representations, Label Formats, and Dataset Composition
papers.abstract_en: Quran Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) aims to convert Quranic recitation into text, enabling applications such as aided memorisation tools and Quranic search engines. However, existing ASR models often exhibit high Word Error Rates (WER) on user-recited verses and lack full coverage of the Quranic corpus. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of domain-specific fine-tuning of pretrained Transformer-based models for Quranic ASR, using advanced speech feature extraction methods: Wav2Vec2.0, HuBERT, and XLS-R. These models apply self-supervised learning by masking portions of input audio and using Transformer architectures to learn context-aware speech features. The pretrained models are fine-tuned on a filtered Quranic dataset exceeding 870 hours of professional and user recitations. Through comprehensive ablation studies across feature extractors, output label formats, training strategies, and clip durations, we identify the key factors that affect transcription accuracy in this domain. Our best-performing configuration achieves a WER of 0.08 on the EveryAyah subset and 0.11 on the combined EveryAyah+Tarteel setting, representing roughly a five-percentage-point gain over the Citrinet baseline (WER = 0.163) while reducing combined-model training time from 140 hours to 40 hours. Arabic text without diacritics yields the best fine-tuning results, and Wav2Vec2-XLSR-53 provides the strongest overall representation. Future work includes improving dataset quality and developing phoneme-aware models to extract deeper speech feature representations for Tajweed-sensitive applications.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables, Submitted to International Journal of Speech Technology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了基于预训练Transformer模型（Wav2Vec2.0、HuBERT、XLS-R）在古兰经自动语音识别（ASR）上的微调效果，使用超过870小时的诵读数据。通过消融实验发现，Wav2Vec2-XLSR-53搭配无变音符号的阿拉伯文本标签在EveryAyah子集上达到0.08的词错误率（WER），在更大集合上达到0.11，训练时间从140小时降至40小时，优于Citrinet基线（WER=0.163）。
Motivation: 现有古兰经ASR模型在用户诵读片段上词错误率高，且未完整覆盖古兰经语料库，亟需针对该领域的系统调优研究。
Method: 使用Wav2Vec2.0、HuBERT、XLS-R三种自监督语音表示模型，在过滤后的870+小时专业及用户诵读数据集上微调，并比较输出标签格式、训练策略和音频片段长度的影响。
Result: 最佳配置在EveryAyah子集上WER为0.08，在EveryAyah+Tarteel组合上为0.11，相比Citrinet基线（WER=0.163）提升约5个百分点，同时训练时间从140小时缩短至40小时。
Conclusion: 无变音符号的阿拉伯文本标签最适合微调，Wav2Vec2-XLSR-53提供最强的整体表示；未来需改进数据集质量并开发音素感知模型以支持Tajweed敏感的语音特征。

papers.title: Beyond Uniform Forgetting: A Study of Sequential Direct Preference Optimization Across Preference Settings
papers.abstract_en: Aligning language models with human preferences often requires optimising multiple behavioural objectives. A practical approach is to apply these objectives sequentially using preference optimisation methods such as Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO), but it remains unclear whether later training uniformly degrades preferences learned earlier or whether the effect depends on the relationship between objectives. We study sequential DPO across four preference settings covering distributional conflict, multi-attribute interaction, strong safety signal, and compatible response-quality objectives. Using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with LoRA adapters, we evaluate all objectives after every stage with a fixed base-model reference. We find that sequential DPO does not produce a single forgetting pattern; preference change ranges from partial degradation to stability, pair-level redistribution, or positive transfer depending on objective relationship, signal strength, and training order. Pair-level analysis using length-normalised policy margins shows that aggregate metrics can mask heterogeneous changes across preference pairs, whereas quartile decomposition reveals that high-confidence pairs can either degrade or improve depending on the setting. Mechanistic diagnostics show that Stage~2 gradients and adapter updates are near-orthogonal to the previous objective across all settings, providing little evidence that direct gradient opposition is the primary driver. These findings suggest that future sequential alignment pipelines should account for objective compatibility and signal strength, rather than assuming that later objectives affect earlier preferences uniformly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型顺序对齐过程中，后续偏好优化是否均匀地遗忘先前学到的偏好。通过在四个偏好设置（分布冲突、多属性交互、强安全信号、兼容响应质量）上对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct进行顺序DPO训练，发现遗忘模式并非均匀：偏好变化包括部分退化、稳定、成对重新分配或正迁移，取决于目标关系、信号强度和训练顺序。成对分析和机制诊断表明，梯度正交性不是主要驱动因素，未来对齐管道应考虑目标兼容性和信号强度。
Motivation: 实际中常用顺序偏好优化实现多目标对齐，但后续训练是否均匀破坏先前学到的偏好尚不清楚，且影响因素未知。
Method: 在四种偏好设置（分布冲突、多属性交互、强安全信号、兼容响应质量）下，对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct使用LoRA适配器进行顺序DPO训练，每个阶段后评估所有目标，并采用长度归一化策略边际进行成对分析及四分位数分解。
Result: 顺序DPO不产生单一遗忘模式；偏好变化包括部分退化、稳定、成对重新分配或正迁移。高置信度偏好对在不同设置下可能退化或改善。第二阶段梯度和适配器更新与前一目标近似正交，表明直接梯度对抗不是主要驱动。
Conclusion: 未来顺序对齐管道应基于目标兼容性和信号强度设计，而非假设后续目标均匀影响先前偏好。

papers.title: Interpreting Neural Combinatorial Optimization via Evolving Programmatic Bottlenecks
papers.abstract_en: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) achieves strong performance, yet its black-box nature remains a key roadblock to deployment and scientific diagnosis. Standard interpretability tools, such as Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs), are ill-equipped for NCO, whose decisions are dynamic, state-dependent, and lack proper concept vocabulary definition. To close this gap, we introduce Evolving Programmatic Bottlenecks (EPB), to our knowledge, the first framework for interpreting NCO policies by distilling black-box NCO models into human-readable program portfolios. EPB employs an LLM to autonomously evolve a bank of programs, where each program's per-step action distribution serves as the bottleneck. EPB works through an iterative framework: Block I fixes program bank capacity and introduces a hybrid textual-numerical gradient descent scheme that couples numerical gradients for student router updates and textual gradients for LLM-based program revision; Block II dynamically adapts bank capacity via fault-targeted expansion and redundancy pruning. Extensive experiments demonstrate EPB's effectiveness and broad applicability, where the distilled program portfolios largely match original performance. EPB also reveals that NCO behavior shifts across optimization stages and can be approximated as a composition of classic heuristic variants. Our work advances interpretable NCO and establishes EPB as a promising tool for interpreting sequential decision-making models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经组合优化（NCO）黑盒模型的可解释性问题，提出演化编程瓶颈（EPB）框架，通过将黑盒NCO策略蒸馏为人类可读的程序组合。EPB利用LLM自主演化程序库，结合混合文本-数值梯度下降和动态库容量调整，在多个组合优化问题上保持接近原模型性能，并揭示了NCO行为随优化阶段变化，可近似为经典启发式变体的组合。
Motivation: 神经组合优化（NCO）虽然性能强，但其黑盒特性阻碍了部署和科学诊断。现有可解释性工具（如概念瓶颈模型CBM）不适用于NCO，因为NCO决策是动态的、状态依赖的，且缺乏合适的概念词汇定义。
Method: 提出演化编程瓶颈（EPB）框架，包含两个模块：模块I固定程序库容量，引入混合文本-数值梯度下降方案（数值梯度用于学生路由器更新，文本梯度用于LLM驱动的程序修订）；模块II通过故障导向扩展和冗余剪枝动态调整库容量。
Result: 实验表明EPB蒸馏的程序组合在多任务上与原NCO模型性能基本匹配，并揭示了NCO行为在优化不同阶段的变化，可近似为经典启发式变体的组合。
Conclusion: EPB是首个通过程序瓶颈解释NCO策略的框架，适用于多种组合优化问题，也是解释序列决策模型的有前景工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Calibration without labels in multiple testing
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale hypothesis testing supports probability claims about individual hypotheses, as in empirical Bayes methods for estimating local false discovery rates. We study how such claims can be interpreted as approximately calibrated forecasts of the null hypothesis, yielding interpretable error probabilities even under model misspecification. Our approach draws conceptual inspiration from probabilistic forecasting but addresses a different challenge: unlike forecasting, where labels are eventually observed, in multiple testing the ground truth is never revealed, so calibration must be assessed stochastically and established indirectly. We address this challenge by constructing a set of pseudo-labels, derived from the spacings of ordered $p$-values, which have the local false discovery rate as their regression target. Our construction unlocks existing tools for assessing and performing post-hoc calibration in multiple testing. Notably, we find on a large-scale empirical survey of published psychology and neuroscience literature that the $q$-value, a popular error measure based on the false discovery rate, can be severely miscalibrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大规模假设检验中概率声明的校准问题，提出使用有序p值的间隔构造伪标签，使局部假发现率成为回归目标，从而实现对多重检验的后验校准。在心理学和神经科学文献的调查中发现，基于错误发现率的q值可能存在严重校准偏差。
Motivation: 多重检验中真实标签从未揭示，因此校准必须随机评估并间接建立，而现有方法可能因模型误设导致校准偏差。
Method: 从有序p值的间隔构造一组伪标签，以局部假发现率为回归目标，利用现有工具进行多重检验的后验校准。
Result: 在心理学和神经科学的大规模实证调查中发现，流行的错误度量q值可能存在严重校准偏差。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种无标签的多重检验校准方法，并发现实际文献中q值校准不佳。

papers.title: VFACamou: View-Fused Adversarial Camouflage for Environment-Adaptive Physical Evasion
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial camouflage in the physical world remains highly challenging, particularly under UAV reconnaissance where targets undergo continuous geometric changes and extreme illumination variations. Existing methods either optimize 2D digital perturbations that fail to generalize to dynamic viewpoints or produce visually unnatural textures that cannot be deployed in real scenarios. Therefore, we propose an end-to-end framework for adversarial camouflage generation that automatically produces wearable adversarial patterns and maintains stable attack performance in real physical environments with changing viewpoints, poses, and lighting conditions. Our method integrates UV-volume rendering with a diffusion-based texture generator, enabling consistent appearance under varying scales, poses, and lighting conditions. To ensure environmental realism, we propose an illumination color consistency estimator that extracts dominant background attributes and guides a natural texture loss to align the generated UV texture with the surrounding environment. A multi-scale dynamic training strategy further enhances robustness against viewpoint shifts and body deformation. Extensive experiments across multiple mainstream detectors demonstrate that our method achieves strong and stable physical attack performance while maintaining high perceptual naturalness, reducing human detection rates without introducing unnatural artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端的对抗性伪装生成框架VFACamou，用于在物理世界中躲避无人机侦察。该方法结合UV体积渲染与基于扩散的纹理生成器，并引入光照颜色一致性估计和多尺度动态训练，使得生成的伪装图案在不同视角、姿态和光照条件下保持稳定攻击性能。实验表明该方法能有效降低人类检测率且不引入不自然伪影。
Motivation: 现有物理对抗伪装方法难以处理动态视角和极端光照变化，生成的二维扰动或纹理不自然，无法在真实场景中部署。
Method: 提出融合UV体积渲染和扩散纹理生成器的端到端框架，并设计光照颜色一致性估计器提取背景属性，引导自然纹理损失；采用多尺度动态训练策略增强对视角变化和身体变形的鲁棒性。
Result: 在多个主流检测器上的实验表明，该方法实现了强大且稳定的物理攻击性能，同时保持高视觉自然度，降低了人类检测率而不引入不自然伪影。
Conclusion: 该框架能自动生成可穿戴的对抗图案并在真实物理环境中保持稳定攻击性能，适用于无人机侦察等场景。

papers.title: GLARE: A Natural Language Interface for Querying Global Explanations
papers.abstract_en: While global explanations are crucial for understanding vision models across datasets, classes, and decision contexts, their complex and monolithic nature often hinders practical exploration. Because users typically seek targeted answers to specific questions rather than static artifacts, we present an LLM-based interactive interface that provides natural language access to global explanations for black-box image classifiers. The system's core LLM acts as a mediator, translating natural language questions into structured SQL queries over local explanation data. This enables flexible aggregation without exposing users to low-level representations. For each query, the interface outputs statistics-augmented natural language responses, supporting local explanations, and intent-aligned visualizations. We evaluate the system on intent interpretation, query mapping accuracy, generalization to novel queries and datasets, and robustness to linguistic errors. Our results demonstrate that LLM-mediated querying substantially improves the accessibility and usability of global explanations for human-centered XAI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GLARE，一种基于 LLM 的自然语言接口，用于查询黑盒图像分类器的全局解释。系统核心的 LLM 将用户问题翻译为 SQL 查询，聚合局部解释数据，返回统计增强的自然语言响应和可视化。评估表明该方法在意图理解、查询映射准确率、对新查询和数据集的泛化性以及鲁棒性上表现良好，显著提升了全局解释的可访问性和可用性。
Motivation: 现有的全局解释在视觉模型理解中通常以复杂、静态的形式呈现，难以满足用户针对具体问题的定向探索需求，因此需要一种交互式自然语言接口来提升可用性。
Method: 使用 LLM 作为中介，将用户的自然语言问题转换为结构化 SQL 查询，作用于局部解释数据（如 SHAP 值），从而实现灵活聚合并生成统计增强的自然语言响应与视觉化结果。
Result: 在意图解释、查询映射准确率、对新查询和新数据集的泛化性以及对抗语言错误的鲁棒性上进行了评估，结果表明 LLM 中介的查询方法显著改善了全局解释的可访问性和易用性。
Conclusion: LLM 驱动的自然语言接口能有效弥合用户意图与复杂全局解释之间的鸿沟，提升人机交互体验，但文中未对模型规模、计算开销或局限性进行详细讨论。

papers.title: Federated Bilevel Performative Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Federated bilevel optimization is widely used for nested learning problems across distributed clients, such as federated hyperparameter tuning and meta-learning under privacy and communication constraints. Most existing formulations assume fixed client data distributions, which can be violated by performativity, where deployed decisions reshape client behavior and data collection, inducing client-specific, decision-dependent distribution shift. We study federated bilevel performative prediction, where both upper-level (UL) and lower-level (LL) objectives are evaluated under client-dependent, decision-dependent distributions. We formalize the federated bilevel performatively stable (FBPS) point under a decoupled-risk perspective and provide sufficient conditions for its existence and uniqueness. We then develop two federated methods to compute the FBPS solution: FBi-RRM, which converges linearly under a contraction condition, and FBi-SGD, a communication-efficient stochastic method based on federated hypergradient estimation with convergence guarantees under diminishing step sizes when sensitivities are sufficiently small. Experiments on strategic regression and meta strategic classification validate the predicted stability thresholds and demonstrate improved meta-generalization over non-performative baselines, and CNN-based classification further demonstrates the practical effectiveness of the proposed methods in nonconvex neural network settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦双层执行性预测（federated bilevel performative prediction），其中上层和下层目标均依赖于客户端特定且决策相关的分布。形式化了联邦双层执行稳定点（FBPS），并提出了两种求解方法：FBi-RRM（线性收敛）和FBi-SGD（通信高效随机优化）。实验验证了稳定性阈值，并在战略回归和元战略分类任务上展示了优于非执行性基线的元泛化性能。
Motivation: 现有联邦双层优化假设客户端数据分布固定，但实际中部署的决策会改变客户端行为和数据收集，导致分布偏移（performativity），需要新的框架处理这种客户端特异的、决策依赖的分布变化。
Method: 提出两种联邦方法：FBi-RRM在收缩条件下线性收敛到FBPS；FBi-SGD基于联邦超梯度估计，在递减步长和敏感性足够小时提供收敛保证。
Result: 在战略回归和元战略分类实验中，方法预测了稳定性阈值并改善了元泛化性能；CNN分类实验进一步展示了在非凸神经网络设置中的有效性。
Conclusion: 论文为联邦双层优化中的执行性问题提供了理论框架和求解方法，实验验证了其优势，但尚未涉及更复杂的实际场景。

papers.title: QueryGaussian: Scalable and Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently retrieving specific 3D instances from large-scale scenes via natural language prompts remains a formidable challenge in multimedia analysis. Existing approaches predominantly follow a "scene-level embedding" paradigm, which requires distilling high-dimensional semantic features into every 3D primitive. This strategy suffers from a fundamental architectural bottleneck: memory and computational costs scale linearly with scene complexity, inevitably triggering out-of-memory (OOM) failures in city-scale environments. To address this barrier, we propose QueryGaussian, a training-free framework for expeditious and scalable open-vocabulary 3D instance retrieval. Unlike holistic semantic distillation, QueryGaussian employs an instance-level query mechanism that decouples semantic understanding from geometric representation. Specifically, we leverage pre-trained 2D vision models to interpret user prompts and lift segmentation masks into 3D via a concurrent maximum-weight association strategy, ensuring semantic-visual consistency. To mitigate projection ambiguity, we introduce a temporal fusion module with multi-stage adaptive density clustering. Experimental results demonstrate that QueryGaussian not only matches the accuracy of state-of-the-art methods but also delivers a decisive efficiency leap, reducing GPU memory usage by over 70% and accelerating inference by 180x. Crucially, QueryGaussian enables expeditious instance retrieval on city-scale scenes containing tens of millions of Gaussians using consumer-grade hardware.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QueryGaussian提出了一种无需训练的开放词汇3D实例检索框架，通过实例级查询机制解耦语义与几何表示，利用预训练2D模型提升分割掩码到3D，结合时序融合模块缓解投影模糊。实验表明，该方法在匹配现有方法精度的同时，GPU内存降低70%以上，推理加速180倍，可在城市级场景（数千万高斯点）上高效运行。
Motivation: 现有3D实例检索采用场景级嵌入范式，内存和计算成本随场景复杂度线性增长，导致城市级场景中出现显存溢出（OOM）失败。
Method: 提出QueryGaussian，一种无需训练的框架：通过预训练2D视觉模型理解用户提示，利用并发最大权重关联策略将分割掩码提升至3D；引入时序融合模块和多阶段自适应密度聚类来缓解投影模糊。
Result: 在多个基准上匹配最先进方法的精度，同时GPU内存降低70%以上，推理速度提升180倍，能在消费级硬件上处理数千万高斯点的城市级场景。
Conclusion: QueryGaussian通过实例级查询机制实现了可扩展、高效的开放词汇3D实例检索，解决了场景级嵌入的计算瓶颈。

papers.title: VOiLA: Vectorized Online Planning with Learned Diffusion Model for POMDP Agents
papers.abstract_en: Planning under uncertainty is an essential capability for autonomous robots. The Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) provides a powerful framework for such a capability. Although POMDP-based planning has advanced significantly, its application to real-world problems is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining faithful POMDP models. We present Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents (VOiLA), a framework that learns task-agnostic POMDP models for online planning under uncertainty. VOiLA learns transition and observation samplers using conditional diffusion models and learns observation-likelihood models for particle-based belief updates. To enable efficient online planning, the diffusion samplers are distilled into compact feedforward generators and integrated with Vectorized Online POMDP Planner (VOPP), an online POMDP planner designed to leverage GPU parallelization. Experimental results indicate the distillation strategy reduces sampling cost by up to nearly three orders of magnitude, making learned generative POMDP models practical for online planning. Evaluation of VOiLA on three benchmark problems indicate that VOiLA achieves equal or better performance than Recurrent Soft Actor Critic while using less than 10% training data, and generalizes much better to unseen environment configurations. Physical robot evaluation indicates VOiLA uses the models learned using only simulated data and generates a policy that successfully accomplish the task in 10 of 10 runs.
papers.comment: Submitted to the 2026 International Symposium of Robotics Research (ISRR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VOiLA框架，利用条件扩散模型学习POMDP的转移和观测模型，通过蒸馏将扩散采样器压缩为前馈生成器，并集成到向量化在线规划器中。实验表明，蒸馏将采样成本降低近三个数量级，在三个基准任务上使用少于10%的训练数据达到了优于或等于循环软演员-评论家（R-SAC）的性能，且泛化性更好；物理机器人10次运行全部成功。
Motivation: POMDP在现实机器人应用中受限于难以获得精确的模型，亟需一种任务无关的在线规划框架。
Method: 使用条件扩散模型学习转移和观测采样器，并学习观测似然模型用于粒子滤波；通过蒸馏将扩散采样器转化为紧凑的前馈生成器，并与利用GPU并行化的向量化在线POMDP规划器（VOPP）集成。
Result: 蒸馏策略使采样成本降低近三个数量级；在三个基准问题上，VOiLA使用少于10%的训练数据达到与R-SAC相当或更优的性能，且对未见环境配置具有更好的泛化能力；物理机器人实验10/10次成功。
Conclusion: 结果表明，结合蒸馏的学习生成式POMDP模型能够有效用于实际在线规划，降低了模型获取难度并保持了高性能。

papers.title: Bidirectional Tutoring for Developmental Motor Learning in Robots: Co-Developed Interaction Dynamics Support Stable Learning
papers.abstract_en: Infants are well known to develop their motor skills through dense interaction with caregivers. Although such social interaction is crucial for human development, motor-skill learning in robots is often treated as a unidirectional process in which robots passively receive demonstrations from tutors. This overlooks a key property of social interaction: it is inherently bidirectional, with tutor and learner dynamically adapting to each other. In such interactions, the robot's past experiences may function as prior constraints that shape the dynamics of their co-developed trajectories. We hypothesize that bidirectional tutoring allows such constraints to guide the formation of consistent behavioral patterns that preserve behavioral coherence and support generalization, whereas unidirectional interaction lacks such constraints and leads to broader, less consistent behavioral patterns. To examine this hypothesis, we conducted two experiments with a physical humanoid robot performing an object manipulation task: one involving human-robot interaction and another employing an AI tutor interacting with the real robot through an adaptive intervention mechanism designed to examine whether similar effects would emerge under more controlled conditions. We implement the developmental learning framework using a free-energy-principle-based neural network extended with generative replay, which supports stable sequence-by-sequence learning from single tutored episodes. Across both settings, bidirectional tutoring fostered consistent behaviors and stage-wise generalization, while the robot gradually required less tutor guidance. These results suggest that bidirectional tutoring, as an embodied and socially grounded approach, provides an effective scaffold for developmental motor learning in robots.

papers.title: NRITYAM: Language Models Meet Art and Heritage of Dance
papers.abstract_en: Language models have become essential tools in shaping modern workflows. However, their global effectiveness hinges on a nuanced understanding of local socio-cultural contexts. To address this gap, we present NRITYAM, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the cultural comprehension capabilities of language models in the context of global dance traditions. NRITYAM comprises 9,260 carefully curated question-answer pairs spanning 12 languages, making it the largest dataset dedicated to evaluating cultural knowledge in dance. The dataset has been developed from the ground up through close collaboration with native dance artists and native speakers of the languages, who authored and validated culturally relevant questions specific to their regions. We evaluate a broad set of models, including large language models, small language models, multimodal large language models, and small multimodal language models. As a multilingual and multicultural benchmark, NRITYAM sets a new standard for evaluating the ability of AI systems to understand and reason about traditional performing arts. Detailed dataset samples are available at~\url{https://github.com/niladrighosh03/NRITYAM}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NRITYAM 是一个用于评估语言模型对全球舞蹈传统文化理解能力的基准测试，包含 9,260 个涵盖 12 种语言的文化相关问题-答案对，由本土舞蹈艺术家和母语者创建并验证。该基准测试评估了多种语言模型（包括大语言模型、小语言模型、多模态模型）在传统表演艺术理解上的表现。
Motivation: 现有语言模型缺乏对本地社会文化背景的细粒度理解，特别是在舞蹈等传统艺术领域。需要构建一个专门评估模型文化知识的数据集。
Method: 构建了一个包含 9,260 个问答对的多语言（12种语言）基准数据集，通过与本土艺术家和母语者合作手工制作问题，并评估多个模型类别的表现。
Result: NRITYAM 提供了评估 AI 系统对传统表演艺术理解和推理能力的新标准，是目前最大的舞蹈文化知识评估数据集。
Conclusion: 该基准测试强调了文化背景在语言模型评估中的重要性，并为多语言和多文化 AI 系统设定了新标准。

papers.title: Library-Aware Doubles and Iterative Repair for Large Language Model-Generated Unit Tests in OpenSIL Firmware
papers.abstract_en: Validating changes in low-level C firmware is expensive because unit tests (UTs) are fragile under strict build constraints, where missing headers, unresolved symbols, and dependency mismatches frequently prevent compilation and linking. This study introduces an automated UT authoring workflow for the Open-Source Silicon Initialization Library (openSIL) firmware codebase maintained by Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) that reduces manual effort through a large language model (LLM) guided multi-agent pipeline. The workflow combines automated generation of test scaffolds, library-aware creation or reuse of stubs, mocks, and fakes, and an iterative compile-dispatch repair loop driven by build logs and line-coverage feedback. We evaluate the approach using compilation success, repair iterations, dispatch success, and line coverage, with time, cost, and token usage as secondary measures. Across 76 functions under test, the workflow generated compilable UTs for 73 functions. In a configuration without line coverage guidance or retrieval augmentation, mean line coverage reached 73.9%. On a 48-function subset evaluated under both configurations, mean line coverage reached 98.8% with line-coverage guidance alone and reached 94.7% when combined with vector-database retrieval. Results show that automated generation-and-repair pipelines can substantially improve UT creation efficiency and coverage for constrained firmware environments while reducing manual debugging effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低层C固件单元测试脆弱、编译困难的问题，提出一个基于LLM的多智能体自动化单元测试生成工作流，适用于AMD的openSIL固件代码库。该工作流结合测试支架自动生成、库感知的桩/模拟/伪造的创建或复用，以及由构建日志和行覆盖率反馈驱动的迭代编译-分派修复循环。在76个函数上测试，73个生成了可编译的单元测试，平均行覆盖率在无行覆盖率引导或检索增强时达到73.9%，在48个函数子集上，仅用行覆盖率引导达到98.8%，结合向量数据库检索达到94.7%。
Motivation: 低层C固件变更的验证昂贵，因为单元测试在严格的编译约束下脆弱，缺失头文件、未解析符号和依赖不匹配频繁导致编译和链接失败。
Method: 提出自动化单元测试生成工作流，包括：自动生成测试支架；库感知地创建或重用桩、模拟和伪造；迭代的编译-分派修复循环，利用构建日志和行覆盖率反馈。
Result: 在76个函数中，73个生成了可编译的单元测试。无行覆盖率引导或检索增强时平均行覆盖率73.9%；在48个函数子集上，仅用行覆盖率引导时平均行覆盖率98.8%，结合向量数据库检索时平均行覆盖率94.7%。
Conclusion: 自动化生成与修复流水线能显著提高受限固件环境中单元测试的创建效率和覆盖率，同时减少手动调试工作。

papers.title: OnDeFog: Online Decision Transformer under Frame Dropping
papers.abstract_en: In challenging real-world reinforcement learning applications, communication delays or sensor failures often cause frame dropping, in which the agent cannot receive the dropped states and associated rewards. To address the performance degradation caused by frame dropping, the Decision Transformer under Random Frame Dropping (DeFog) was developed by incorporating additional mechanisms into the decision transformer to tackle frame dropping. Although DeFog can mitigate performance degradation in frame-dropping environments, since DeFog is an offline learning method, it struggles to effectively generalize to novel states not adequately represented in the training dataset. In this study, we propose OnDeFog, which integrates the mechanisms in DeFog with the online decision transformer (ODT), an online reinforcement learning method that learns policies through direct environmental interaction. Comprehensive experimental evaluation demonstrates that our proposed OnDeFog achieves superior performance compared to ODT in environments characterized by high dropping frame rate and outperforms DeFog on datasets containing a large amount of low-reward data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中因通信延迟或传感器故障导致的帧丢失问题，提出OnDeFog，即在线决策变换器（ODT）与DeFog机制的集成。实验表明，在高丢帧率环境下OnDeFog优于ODT，在包含大量低奖励数据的数据集上优于DeFog。
Motivation: 现有DeFog作为离线方法难以泛化到训练集中未充分表示的新状态，而ODT虽是在线方法但未专门处理帧丢失。
Method: 将DeFog中处理帧丢失的额外机制集成到在线决策变换器（ODT）中，形成OnDeFog，通过直接环境交互学习策略。
Result: 在丢帧率高的环境中，OnDeFog性能优于ODT；在包含大量低奖励数据的数据集上，OnDeFog优于DeFog。
Conclusion: OnDeFog结合了在线学习的泛化能力和帧丢失处理机制，在特定条件下表现更优。

papers.title: Closing the Calibration Gap in Semantic Caching
papers.abstract_en: Semantic caching cuts LLM inference costs by serving a cached response to semantically similar queries. Standard practice evaluates these systems using PR-AUC, a metric that only measures how well scores rank and ignores whether they are usable at a fixed threshold. We show this mismatch leads to systematically poor deployment choices, as models with the highest PR-AUC are often the worst in operation. We introduce Precision-Cache Hit Ratio (P-CHR) AUC, a cache-aware metric that measures precision across cache utilization levels, and Calibration Retention Rate (CRR), which captures how much offline ranking quality survives at deployment. We decompose the operational gap between offline and deployed quality into a recoverable calibration component and an irreducible structural component fixed by the dataset's positive rate. Our experiments show that the calibration gap is governed by the training objective rather than data scale, and post-hoc calibration only partially closes it. Ultimately, model selection for semantic caching is a calibration problem, not a ranking one, and measuring it is the first step to closing the gap.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 2 figures. Source code: https://github.com/aditeyabaral/calibration-gap-semantic-caching ; Models and Datasets: https://huggingface.co/redis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出语义缓存系统常用 PR-AUC 评估指标忽略了固定阈值下的可用性，导致离线表现优秀的模型在部署时反而更差。为此，作者提出缓存感知的 P-CHR AUC 和校准保持率 CRR，并将离线与部署的差距分解为可恢复的校准部分和不可约的结构部分。实验表明校准差距主要由训练目标决定，后验校准只能部分弥补，因此模型选择本质上是校准问题而非排序问题。
Motivation: 现有标准评估指标 PR-AUC 仅衡量排序质量，忽略了固定阈值下的实际可用性，导致部署选择不佳。
Method: 引入 Precision-Cache Hit Ratio (P-CHR) AUC 和 Calibration Retention Rate (CRR) 两个新指标，将运营差距分解为可恢复的校准组件和由数据集正例率固定的不可约结构组件。
Result: 实验发现校准差距由训练目标主导而非数据规模，后验校准仅能部分缩小这一差距。
Conclusion: 语义缓存的模型选择本质上是校准问题而非排序问题，准确测量校准差距是改进的第一步。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: One-Shot Novel View and Pose Human Image Synthesis via 3D Prior Guided Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenge of one-shot novel view and pose human image synthesis. The existing methods transfer the reference human image to a target pose using a set of 2D pose keypoints or synthesize human images based on generalizable human NeRF which uses human model priors to extract point-wise features. However, pose transfer based methods can not handle complex human pose using ambiguous 2D pose as the condition, while generalizable human NeRFs may be inaccurate to recover occluded/invisiable human parts without extracted reliable features. To solve these problems, we propose a novel approach for novel view and pose synthesis from a singe human image via conditional denoising diffusion model. Our diffusion model divides the novel view and pose synthesis problem into a sequence of conditional denoising steps. Specifically, to generate humans with complex and arbitrary poses, we introduce 3D human priors, i.e., 3D normal map and color prompt, as geometry and color conditions into the generation process. By transferring the reference human into the target human with a series of diffusion steps, our diffusion model enables high-quality synthesis including the occluded/invisible parts. Further, we propose a self-reconstruction based customized refinement to enhance fine details when tested on novel persons.Experimental results on different public datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms previous methods and also shows better generalization ability across datasets. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Yankeegsj/3DPGDM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散模型的单张人体图像新视角与姿态合成方法。通过引入3D人体先验（法线图和颜色提示）作为几何与颜色条件，模型能够生成复杂姿态下包括遮挡部分的高质量人体图像。进一步提出了基于自重建的定制化精炼模块，以增强细节。在多个公开数据集上，该方法显著优于以往方法，并表现出更好的跨数据集泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法或依赖2D姿态关键点难以处理复杂姿态，或基于通用人体NeRF在恢复遮挡部位时因缺乏可靠特征而不准确。本文旨在解决单张图像到任意新视角和姿态的高质量人体合成问题。
Method: 使用条件去噪扩散模型，将新视角和姿态合成分解为一系列条件去噪步骤。引入3D人体先验（3D法线图和颜色提示）作为几何与颜色条件，指导生成过程；并提出自重建定制的精炼模块以增强细粒度的外观细节。
Result: 在多个公开数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法在合成质量上显著优于先前方法，并展现出更好的跨数据集泛化能力。
Conclusion: 通过3D先验引导扩散模型，可以有效生成复杂姿态和遮挡区域的高质量人体图像，且模型具有一定的泛化性。代码已开源。

papers.title: AURA: Adaptive Uncertainty-aware Refinement for LLM-as-a-Judge Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges for open-ended generation, as large-scale human evaluation is often expensive and difficult to scale, yet their preferences remain imperfect proxies for human judgment. Existing auditing pipelines often assume that a reliable subset of examples or clean supervision signals are available beforehand, for example from human annotation, heuristic filtering, or the outputs of strong judges. In LLM evaluation, this assumption is fragile: the initial split may inherit judge bias, while human verification is typically too scarce to define stable groups at scale. We propose AURA, an adaptive uncertainty--aware refinement framework for auditing pairwise LLM--as--a--judge decisions under selected human verification. AURA iteratively learns a human-consistency signal, propagates reliable evidence, and prioritizes uncertain comparisons for human review. The key idea is to treat trust in a judge as a latent quantity that is progressively refined as evidence accumulates. We provide a compact formulation, a stable refinement procedure, and a comprehensive evaluation on both synthetic and real pairwise LLM-answer data.

Motivation: 现有LLM作为裁判的审计管线通常假设可靠的子集或干净监督信号可用（如人工标注、启发式过滤），但该假设因裁判偏差和人工验证稀缺而脆弱。
Method: 提出AURA框架，通过迭代学习人一致性信号、传播可靠证据、并优先选择不确定性高的比较进行人工审查，进而精炼对裁判的信任估计。
Result: 在合成和真实成对LLM答案数据上的评估表明，AURA能有效审计和提升LLM裁判决策的可靠性。

papers.title: Efficient Neural Network Model Selection for Few-Class Application Datasets
papers.abstract_en: While much effort has focused on developing and benchmarking high-performance neural networks, less attention has been given to how dataset properties, known to practitioners, can guide efficient model selection. Neural models are typically evaluated on datasets with thousands of classes, yet many real-world applications involve fewer than ten. To address this understudied but common setting, we develop a measure of classification difficulty based on data-side properties and show how it enables more efficient model selection for few-class datasets, where traditional approaches are less effective. We term this phenomenon "few-class distinctiveness". Our metric allows comparison of models and datasets 6 to 29$\times$ faster than repeated training and testing. Leveraging this insight, we extend scaled model families below the smallest published models, achieving greater efficiency at similar accuracy, for example models up to 42% smaller than YOLOv5-nano for a mobile robot task. Targeting resource-constrained applications, we demonstrate few-class model selection across mobile robot, drone, and IoT scenarios, highlighting practical gains in efficiency without sacrificing performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对实际应用中常见的少类别（few-class）数据集（通常少于10类）的神经网络模型选择问题，提出了一种基于数据侧属性的分类难度度量方法，称为“少类别区分度”（few-class distinctiveness）。该方法能在不进行完整训练和测试的情况下，快速比较模型和数据集，速度提升6到29倍。基于此，作者进一步将缩放模型家族扩展到最小已发表模型以下，在保持相似精度的同时实现更高的效率，例如在移动机器人任务上模型比YOLOv5-nano小42%。
Motivation: 现有神经网络模型通常在大规模多类别数据集上评估，但许多实际应用只有少量类别（少于10类），而针对这一场景的高效模型选择研究不足。传统方法在此场景下效率较低。
Method: 提出一种基于数据侧属性的分类难度度量（few-class distinctiveness），通过该度量快速比较模型和数据集，无需重复训练和测试。同时将缩放模型家族扩展到小于已发表的最小模型，以适配少类别资源受限场景。
Result: 所提度量方法使模型和数据集比较速度比重复训练测试快6到29倍；在移动机器人任务上，可实现比YOLOv5-nano小42%的模型且精度相似。
Conclusion: 论文强调少类别场景下利用数据属性指导模型选择可以显著提升效率，适用于移动机器人、无人机和物联网等资源受限应用，且不牺牲性能。

papers.title: A Differentiable Composite Approximation Framework for Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Maneuvering Modeling from Sea-Trial Data
papers.abstract_en: Field-based modeling from onboard measurements can produce autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) maneuvering models that reflect real operating characteristics. From an approximation perspective, conventional maneuvering models use predefined constraint polynomial bases, whereas data-driven models use data-adaptive bases. Motivated by this basis-function view, this paper presents a differentiable composite-approximation formulation, in which the polynomial-basis component and the data-adaptive basis component are treated as differentiable parts of a single predictor and calibrated jointly. A gradient-based co-calibration method is developed for full-scale AUV maneuvering prediction, where a sensitivity-aware mechanism regulates bounded polynomial updates while the neural residual captures remaining nonlinear discrepancies under a shared prediction objective. To account for ocean-current effects in field data, a turning-motion-based current estimation and compensation procedure is incorporated to construct current-compensated learning targets for training and rollout. The framework is evaluated using sea-trial data collected from a 7-meter AUV under multiple maneuvering conditions. Results show that the proposed method improves recursive trajectory and velocity prediction compared with polynomial-only, neural-only, and frozen-prior hybrid baselines, demonstrating its applicability to field-data-based AUV maneuvering modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可微组合近似框架，用于从海试数据建立自主水下潜航器（AUV）机动模型。该框架将多项式基分量和数据自适应基分量视为可微部分进行联合校准，并融合基于转向运动的洋流估计与补偿，以提高递归轨迹和速度预测的准确性。在海试数据上相比纯多项式、纯神经网络及冻结先验混合基线均有改进。
Motivation: 传统机动模型使用预定义多项式基，数据驱动模型使用数据自适应基，两者各有局限。本文旨在结合两者优势，提出可微组合近似框架以更好地从海试数据建模AUV机动特性。
Method: 提出可微组合近似公式，将多项式基分量与数据自适应（神经网络）分量视为单个预测器的可微部分并联合校准。开发梯度协同校准方法，采用敏感性感知机制约束多项式更新，神经网络残差捕获剩余非线性差异。还包含基于转向运动的洋流估计与补偿程序，构建补偿后的学习目标。
Result: 使用7米AUV在多种机动条件下的海试数据进行评估，结果显示该方法在递归轨迹和速度预测上优于纯多项式、纯神经网络以及冻结先验的混合基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法适用于基于海试数据的AUV机动建模。
