papers.title: The Autonomy Tax: Defense Training Breaks LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external tools (file operations, API calls, database transactions) to autonomously complete complex multi-step tasks. Practitioners deploy defense-trained models to protect against prompt injection attacks that manipulate agent behavior through malicious observations or retrieved content. We reveal a fundamental \textbf{capability-alignment paradox}: defense training designed to improve safety systematically destroys agent competence while failing to prevent sophisticated attacks. Evaluating defended models against undefended baselines across 97 agent tasks and 1,000 adversarial prompts, we uncover three systematic biases unique to multi-step agents. \textbf{Agent incompetence bias} manifests as immediate tool execution breakdown, with models refusing or generating invalid actions on benign tasks before observing any external content. \textbf{Cascade amplification bias} causes early failures to propagate through retry loops, pushing defended models to timeout on 99\% of tasks compared to 13\% for baselines. \textbf{Trigger bias} leads to paradoxical security degradation where defended models perform worse than undefended baselines while straightforward attacks bypass defenses at high rates. Root cause analysis reveals these biases stem from shortcut learning: models overfit to surface attack patterns rather than semantic threat understanding, evidenced by extreme variance in defense effectiveness across attack categories. Our findings demonstrate that current defense paradigms optimize for single-turn refusal benchmarks while rendering multi-step agents fundamentally unreliable, necessitating new approaches that preserve tool execution competence under adversarial conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示防御训练（designed to protect against prompt injection）在提升LLM Agent安全性的同时系统性地破坏其多步任务执行能力，表现为三种偏差：Agent incompetence bias（良性任务工具执行崩溃）、Cascade amplification bias（早期失败级联放大导致99%超时率，基线13%）、Trigger bias（防御后安全性能反而下降）。分析表明模型过度学习表面攻击模式（shortcut learning），而非语义理解。
Motivation: 现有防御训练针对单轮拒绝的基准优化，但忽略了多步Agent场景下安全性与任务能力的矛盾，导致Agent在实际多步任务中不可靠。
Method: 在97个Agent任务和1000个对抗提示上，比较防御训练模型与未防御基线的行为差异，并通过三类偏差系统刻画防御对Agent能力的破坏。
Result: 防御模型在良性任务中立即出现工具执行错误；早期错误通过重试循环级联，使超时率从13%升至99%；触发偏差导致防御模型在直白攻击下表现比未防御基线更差。
Conclusion: 当前防御范式使多步Agent从根本上不可靠，需要能兼顾工具执行能力与对抗鲁棒性的新方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units
papers.abstract_en: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECML-PKDD 2026. 18 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. This work was funded by the European Commission as part of the MANOLO project under the Horizon Europe programme Grant Agreement No.101135782
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PrototypeNAS，一种零成本神经架构搜索方法，用于快速设计适合微控制器单元（MCU）的深度神经网络。该方法通过三步搜索：设计包括多种架构类型、剪枝和量化的搜索空间；使用集成零成本代理；利用超体积子集选择从Pareto前沿提取最佳权衡的架构。在12个数据集（图像分类、时间序列分类、目标检测）上评估，能在几分钟内找到足够小、可部署于MCU且精度接近大模型的DNN。
Motivation: 现有NAS方法资源密集、耗时，且未考虑目标系统的资源约束，尤其是MCU上的部署困难。
Method: 提出三步零成本NAS方法：1）构建包含多种架构类型、剪枝和量化配置的搜索空间；2）使用集成零成本代理而非单一代理进行优化；3）采用超体积子集选择从多目标优化的Pareto前沿中提取架构。
Result: 在12个数据集上，PrototypeNAS能在几分钟内找到适合MCU的模型，精度接近大模型。
Conclusion: 该方法加速了MCU上DNN的选择、压缩和定制，避免了从头训练大量网络。

papers.title: EndoCoT: Scaling Endogenous Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely integrated into diffusion frameworks primarily as text encoders to tackle complex tasks such as spatial reasoning. However, this paradigm suffers from two critical limitations: (i) MLLMs text encoder exhibits insufficient reasoning depth. Single-step encoding fails to activate the Chain-of-Thought process, which is essential for MLLMs to provide accurate guidance for complex tasks. (ii) The guidance remains invariant during the decoding process. Invariant guidance during decoding prevents DiT from progressively decomposing complex instructions into actionable denoising steps, even with correct MLLM encodings. To this end, we propose Endogenous Chain-of-Thought (EndoCoT), a novel framework that first activates MLLMs' reasoning potential by iteratively refining latent thought states through an iterative thought guidance module, and then bridges these states to the DiT's denoising process. Second, a terminal thought grounding module is applied to ensure the reasoning trajectory remains grounded in textual supervision by aligning the final state with ground-truth answers. With these two components, the MLLM text encoder delivers meticulously reasoned guidance, enabling the DiT to execute it progressively and ultimately solve complex tasks in a step-by-step manner. Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks (e.g., Maze, TSP, VSP, and Sudoku) achieve an average accuracy of 92.1%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 8.3 percentage points. The code and dataset are publicly available at https://internlm.github.io/EndoCoT/.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 18 figures, The code and dataset are publicly available at https://internlm.github.io/EndoCoT/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EndoCoT 框架，通过在扩散模型（Diffusion Transformer, DiT）中激活多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的内生思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理，解决现有 MLLM 文本编码器推理深度不足和引导不变的问题。该方法包括迭代思维引导模块和终端思维接地模块，在 Maze、TSP、VSP、Sudoku 等基准上平均准确率达 92.1%，超越最强基线 8.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 文本编码器在扩散框架中作为引导时，单步编码无法激活思维链过程，导致复杂任务引导不准确；且引导在去噪过程中保持不变，阻碍 DiT 逐步分解复杂指令。
Method: 提出内生思维链（EndoCoT），包含两个模块：1) 迭代思维引导模块，通过迭代细化潜在思维状态激活 MLLM 推理潜力；2) 终端思维接地模块，将最终状态与真实答案对齐，确保推理轨迹受文本监督约束。
Result: 在 Maze、TSP、VSP、Sudoku 等基准上平均准确率 92.1%，比最强基线提升 8.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 该框架首次在扩散模型中激活了 MLLM 的思维链推理，使 DiT 能够逐步执行复杂任务，代码和数据集已开源。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 MLLM 文本编码器在扩散框架中作为引导时，单步编码无法激活思维链过程，导致复杂任务引导不准确；且引导在去噪过程中保持不变，阻碍 DiT 逐步分解复杂指令。
summary_sections.method: 提出内生思维链（EndoCoT），包含两个模块：1) 迭代思维引导模块，通过迭代细化潜在思维状态激活 MLLM 推理潜力；2) 终端思维接地模块，将最终状态与真实答案对齐，确保推理轨迹受文本监督约束。
summary_sections.result: 在 Maze、TSP、VSP、Sudoku 等基准上平均准确率 92.1%，比最强基线提升 8.3 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架首次在扩散模型中激活了 MLLM 的思维链推理，使 DiT 能够逐步执行复杂任务，代码和数据集已开源。

papers.title: Automated Standardization of Legacy Biomedical Metadata Using an Ontology-Constrained LLM Agent
papers.abstract_en: Scientific metadata are often incomplete and noncompliant with community standards, limiting dataset findability, interoperability, and reuse. Even when standard metadata reporting guidelines exist, they typically lack machine-actionable representations. Producing FAIR datasets requires encoding metadata standards as machine-actionable templates with rich field specifications and precise value constraints. Recent work has shown that LLMs guided by field names and ontology constraints can improve metadata standardization, but these approaches treat constraints as static text prompts, relying on the model's training knowledge alone. We present an LLM-based metadata standardization system that queries standard reporting guidelines and authoritative biomedical terminology services in real time to retrieve canonically correct standards on demand. We evaluate this approach on 839 legacy metadata records from the Human BioMolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP) using an expert-curated gold standard for exact-match assessment. Our evaluation shows that augmenting the LLM with real-time tool access consistently improves prediction accuracy over the LLM alone across both ontology-constrained and non-ontology-constrained fields, demonstrating a practical approach to automated standardization of biomedical metadata.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于LLM代理的系统，通过实时查询标准化报告指南和生物医学术语服务来自动标准化遗留生物医学元数据。在HuBMAP的839条记录上评估，发现实时工具访问能一致提升预测准确性，优于仅依赖LLM自身知识的方法。
Motivation: 科学元数据常不完整且不符合社区标准，限制了数据集的查找、互操作和复用。现有方法将约束作为静态文本提示，依赖模型训练知识，无法动态获取规范标准。
Method: 构建LLM代理系统，在标准化过程中实时查询标准报告指南和权威生物医学术语服务，按需获取规范标准，用于元数据字段的填充和验证。
Result: 在HuBMAP的839条遗留元数据记录上，使用专家策展的金标准进行精确匹配评估，结果表明实时工具访问的LLM在有无本体约束的字段上均比仅用LLM有更高预测准确率。
Conclusion: 实时工具访问增强了LLM的能力，提供了一种实用的生物医学元数据自动化标准化方法。

papers.title: Stabilizing Bandits using Regularization: Precise Regret and A Quantitative Central Limit Theorem
papers.abstract_en: Statistical inference with bandit data presents fundamental challenges owing to adaptive sampling, which violates the independence assumptions underlying classical asymptotic theory. Recent work has identified stability~\citep{laiwei82} as a sufficient condition for valid inference under adaptivity. This paper first provides a refined stability condition, stated in terms of the iterates of an online algorithm, and shows that a large class of regularized stochastic-mirror-descent-style algorithms satisfy it. This refined condition allows us to strengthen the asymptotic results of~\citet{laiwei82} in several ways. First, we derive a non-asymptotic Berry--Esseen bound for the empirical reward estimates under adaptive sampling. Second, we derive matching non-asymptotic upper and lower bounds on the regret of the proposed algorithm, yielding a precise characterization of its regret. Third, we show that these regularized algorithms preserve asymptotic normality and valid inference under a prescribed level of adversarial corruption. Finally, we show that regularization is necessary rather than incidental: Lai--Wei stability is incompatible with the optimal $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret rate -- the rate attained by unregularized algorithms such as EXP3 -- so that a controlled, polylogarithmic inflation in regret is the price of valid inference.
papers.comment: Updated rate of convergence and precise regret in version 2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自适应采样下Bandit数据的统计推断，提出了精细化的Lai-Wei稳定性条件，证明一类正则化随机镜像下降算法满足该条件。提供了非渐近Berry-Esseen界、匹配的遗憾上下界（精确刻画遗憾），并证明在对抗腐败下渐近正态性仍成立。关键结论：正则化是实现有效推断的必要条件，但会引入多对数级遗憾通胀，与最优O(√T)遗憾率不兼容。
Motivation: 自适应采样破坏了经典渐近理论的独立同分布假设，现有Lai-Wei稳定性条件是有效推断的充分条件，但缺乏精细刻画和理论保证。
Method: 提出精细化的Lai-Wei稳定性条件（基于算法迭代），证明一类正则化随机镜像下降算法满足该条件；利用该条件推导非渐近Berry-Esseen界、匹配遗憾上下界（精确刻画），并分析对抗腐败下的渐近正态性。
Result: 得到非渐近Berry-Esseen界（量化收敛速度）；匹配上下界精确表征算法遗憾；证明正则化是必要的——Lai-Wei稳定性与O(√T)最优遗憾率不兼容，需以多对数级遗憾通胀为代价来保证有效推断。
Conclusion: 正则化是实现自适应数据有效推断的核心，但必须接受略高的遗憾作为代价；理论结果适用于广义的Bandit设置。

papers.title: Class-Incremental Motion Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Motion forecasting enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate scene evolution by predicting the future trajectories of dynamic agents. However, existing approaches typically assume a closed-world setting with a fixed object taxonomy and access to high-quality perception, limiting their applicability in the real world where perception is imperfect, and new object classes may emerge over time. In this work, we introduce class-incremental motion forecasting, a novel setting in which new object classes are sequentially introduced over time and future object trajectories are predicted directly from camera images. We propose the first end-to-end framework for this setting, which adapts to newly introduced classes while mitigating catastrophic forgetting of previously learned ones. Our method generates motion forecasting pseudo-labels for known classes and matches them with 2D instance masks from an open-vocabulary segmentation model. This 3D-to-2D keypoint voting mechanism filters inconsistent and overconfident predictions, while a query feature variance-based replay strategy samples informative past sequences to preserve prior knowledge. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 show that our approach successfully preserves performance on known classes while effectively adapting to novel ones. We further demonstrate zero-shot transfer to real-world driving and show that the framework extends naturally to open- and closed-loop end-to-end class-incremental planning on nuScenes and NeuroNCAP. Code and models will be made publicly available at https://omen.cs.uni-freiburg.de.
papers.comment: V3: Change title. Add further experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出类增量运动预测（class-incremental motion forecasting）的新设定，即新物体类别随时间顺序引入，且从相机图像直接预测未来轨迹。作者提出了首个端到端框架，通过生成3D运动预测伪标签并与开放词汇分割模型的2D实例掩码匹配，以及基于查询特征方差的重放策略，缓解灾难性遗忘。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上的实验表明，该方法在已知类别上保持性能，同时有效适应新类别，并能零样本迁移到真实驾驶场景及扩展到端到端规划。
Motivation: 现有运动预测方法通常假设固定物体类别和完美感知，限制了在真实世界中的应用，其中感知不完美且新物体类别可能随时间涌现。
Method: 提出首个端到端框架，包括：1）3D-to-2D关键点投票机制，生成运动预测伪标签并与开放词汇分割模型的2D实例掩码匹配，过滤不一致和过度自信的预测；2）基于查询特征方差的重放策略，采样信息量大的历史序列以保留先前知识。
Result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上，该方法在已知类别上保持性能，同时有效适应新类别；零样本迁移到真实驾驶场景，并扩展到开环和闭环端到端类增量规划。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架成功解决了类增量运动预测问题，并能自然扩展到规划任务，代码和模型将公开。

papers.title: HY-WU (Part I): An Extensible Functional Neural Memory Framework and An Instantiation in Text-Guided Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are transitioning from offline predictors to deployed systems expected to operate over long time horizons. In real deployments, objectives are not fixed: domains drift, user preferences evolve, and new tasks appear after the model has shipped. This elevates continual learning and instant personalization from optional features to core architectural requirements. Yet most adaptation pipelines still follow a static weight paradigm: after training (or after any adaptation step), inference executes a single parameter vector regardless of user intent, domain, or instance-specific constraints. This treats the trained or adapted model as a single point in parameter space. In heterogeneous and continually evolving regimes, distinct objectives can induce separated feasible regions over parameters, forcing any single shared update into compromise, interference, or overspecialization. As a result, continual learning and personalization are often implemented as repeated overwriting of shared weights, risking degradation of previously learned behaviors. We propose HY-WU (Weight Unleashing), a memory-first adaptation framework that shifts adaptation pressure away from overwriting a single shared parameter point. HY-WU implements functional (operator-level) memory as a neural module: a generator that synthesizes weight updates on-the-fly from the instance condition, yielding instance-specific operators without test-time optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HY-WU (Weight Unleashing) 框架，一种记忆优先的适应方法，通过功能（算子级）记忆模块从实例条件动态合成权重更新，生成实例特定的算子，避免在持续学习和个性化中覆盖共享权重导致的干扰。该框架在文本引导图像编辑任务上进行了实例化。
Motivation: 现有方法采用静态权重范式，将训练或适应后的模型视为单一参数点，导致不同目标间的折中、干扰或过度专业化，损害已学行为。
Method: 提出 HY-WU 框架，将适应压力从覆盖单一共享参数点转移到功能（算子级）记忆。该记忆作为神经模块，根据实例条件（如用户意图、域等）即时合成权重更新，生成实例特定的算子，无需测试时优化。
Conclusion: HY-WU 框架通过实例条件生成权重更新，避免了共享权重覆盖，适用于持续学习和个性化场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZeSTA: Zero-Shot TTS Augmentation with Domain-Conditioned Training for Data-Efficient Personalized Speech Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the use of zero-shot text-to-speech (ZS-TTS) as a data augmentation source for low-resource personalized speech synthesis. While synthetic augmentation can provide linguistically rich and phonetically diverse speech, naively mixing large amounts of synthetic speech with limited real recordings often leads to speaker similarity degradation during fine-tuning. To address this issue, we propose ZeSTA, a simple domain-conditioned training framework that distinguishes real and synthetic speech via a lightweight domain embedding, combined with real-data oversampling to stabilize adaptation under extremely limited target data, without modifying the base architecture. Experiments on LibriTTS and an in-house dataset with two ZS-TTS sources demonstrate that our approach improves speaker similarity over naive synthetic augmentation while preserving intelligibility and perceptual quality. Audio samples are available on our web page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZeSTA，一种基于领域条件训练的框架，利用零样本TTS（ZS-TTS）合成语音来增强低资源个性化语音合成。通过轻量级领域嵌入区分真实与合成语音，并结合真实数据过采样，在保持可懂度和感知质量的同时，提升说话人相似度。在LibriTTS和内部数据集上的实验验证了该方法优于朴素合成增强。
Motivation: 低资源个性化语音合成中，真实录音有限，而合成增强虽然能增加语音多样性和丰富性，但大量混合合成语音会导致微调时说话人相似度下降。
Method: 提出ZeSTA框架，包含领域条件训练（通过轻量级领域嵌入区分真实与合成语音）和真实数据过采样，无需修改基础架构即可稳定适应极度有限的真实数据。
Result: 在LibriTTS和内部数据集上，使用两个ZS-TTS源进行实验，结果显示该方法在说话人相似度上优于朴素合成增强，同时保持了可懂度和感知质量。
Conclusion: ZeSTA通过简单有效的领域条件训练和过采样策略，解决了合成增强中说话人相似度退化的问题，为低资源个性化语音合成提供了一种实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The MAMA-MIA Challenge: Advancing Generalizability and Fairness in Breast MRI Tumor Segmentation and Treatment Response Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Breast cancer is the most frequently diagnosed malignancy among women worldwide and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality. Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging plays a central role in tumor characterization and treatment monitoring, particularly in patients receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy. However, existing artificial intelligence models for breast magnetic resonance imaging are typically developed and evaluated using heterogeneous datasets, study populations, and assessment protocols, making direct comparison difficult and limiting understanding of model robustness across institutions and clinically relevant patient subgroups. The MAMA-MIA Challenge was designed to address these challenges by providing a standardized benchmark for the joint evaluation of primary tumor segmentation and prediction of pathologic complete response using pre-treatment magnetic resonance imaging only. The training cohort comprised 1,506 patients from multiple institutions in the United States, while evaluation was conducted on an external test set of 574 patients from three independent European centers to assess cross-continental and cross-institutional generalization. A unified scoring framework combined predictive performance with subgroup consistency across age, menopausal status, and breast density. Twenty-six international teams participated in the final evaluation phase. Results demonstrate substantial performance variability under a common external evaluation framework and reveal trade-offs between overall accuracy and subgroup fairness. The challenge provides standardized datasets, evaluation protocols, and public resources to promote the development of robust and equitable artificial intelligence systems for breast cancer imaging.

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了MAMA-MIA挑战赛，旨在标准化乳腺MRI中肿瘤分割和病理完全缓解预测的评估，使用来自美国多机构的1506例患者训练集和574例欧洲患者测试集，评估模型的泛化性和公平性。
Motivation: 现有AI模型在乳腺MRI上因数据集和评估协议不一致而难以比较，且缺乏对跨机构及亚组公平性的考量。
Method: 通过MAMA-MIA挑战赛提供统一基准，联合评估肿瘤分割和病理完全缓解预测，采用兼顾预测性能和亚组一致性（年龄、绝经状态、乳腺密度）的评分框架。
Result: 26个团队参与，结果显示模型性能和亚组公平性之间存在权衡，且跨机构泛化性差异大。
Conclusion: 挑战赛提供了标准化数据集和评估协议，以促进稳健且公平的乳腺癌成像AI系统开发。

papers.title: RC-GeoCP: Geometric Consensus for Radar-Camera Collaborative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative perception (CP) enhances scene understanding through multi-agent information sharing. While LiDAR-centric systems offer precise geometry, high costs and performance degradation in adverse weather necessitate multi-modal alternatives. Despite dense visual semantics and robust spatial measurements, the synergy between cameras and 4D radar remains underexplored in collaborative settings. This work introduces RC-GeoCP, the first framework to explore the fusion of 4D radar and images in CP. To resolve misalignment caused by depth ambiguity and spatial dispersion across agents, RC-GeoCP establishes a radar-anchored geometric consensus. Specifically, Geometric Structure Rectification (GSR) aligns visual semantics with geometry derived from radar to generate spatially grounded, geometry-consistent representations. Uncertainty-Aware Communication (UAC) formulates selective transmission as a conditional entropy reduction process to prioritize informative features based on inter-agent disagreement. Finally, the Consensus-Driven Assembler (CDA) aggregates multi-agent information via shared geometric anchors to form a globally coherent representation. We establish the first unified radar-camera CP benchmark on V2X-Radar and V2X-R, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance with significantly reduced communication overhead. Code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RC-GeoCP，首个将 4D 雷达与图像融合用于协同感知（CP）的框架。针对多智能体间深度模糊与空间散乱导致的错位问题，建立以雷达锚定的几何一致性（Geometric Consensus）。通过几何结构校正（GSR）对齐视觉语义与雷达几何，不确定性感知通信（UAC）基于条件熵减少选择传输特征，共识驱动装配器（CDA）聚合多智能体信息。在 V2X-Radar 和 V2X-R 上构建首个雷达-相机 CP 基准，实现低通信开销下的最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有协同感知多基于 LiDAR，成本高且恶劣天气性能下降。4D 雷达与相机的融合在协同设置中尚未被探索，且深度模糊与空间散乱导致多智能体间特征错位。
Method: 提出雷达锚定的几何一致性框架：GSR 利用雷达几何校正视觉语义；UAC 将选择性传输建模为条件熵减少过程；CDA 通过共享几何锚点聚合全局表示。
Result: 在 V2X-Radar 和 V2X-R 基准上取得最先进性能，同时显著降低通信开销。
Conclusion: 验证了雷达-相机协同感知的可行性，几何一致性策略可有效解决多模态多智能体融合中的错位问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Legibility Tax with Decoupled Prover-Verifier Games
papers.abstract_en: As large language models become increasingly capable, it is critical that their outputs can be easily checked by less capable systems. Prover-verifier games can be used to improve checkability of model outputs, but display a degradation in accuracy compared to a baseline trained only to maximize correctness -- a phenonemon named legibility tax. We propose a solution by decoupling the correctness from the checkability condition and instead training a "translator" model that turns a fixed solver model's solution into a checkable form. This allows us to first train the solver to maximize correctness, and then train the translator to translate the solver into a checkable form while retaining the solver's answer. To accommodate this new objective of translation, we formulate a decoupled prover-verifier game (DPVG) where the equilibria correspond to faithful and checkable translators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型输出可检查性中的可读性税问题，提出解耦的证明者-验证者博弈（Decoupled Prover-Verifier Game, DPVG）。通过将正确性与可检查性条件解耦，先训练求解器最大化正确性，再训练翻译器将求解器输出转化为可检查形式，从而在不牺牲准确率的前提下提升可检查性。
Motivation: 现有证明者-验证者博弈虽能提升模型输出的可检查性，但会导致准确率下降（可读性税）。需要在不影响正确性的情况下实现可检查性。
Method: 提出解耦的证明者-验证者博弈（DPVG），先独立训练一个求解器（solver）以最大化正确性，再训练一个翻译器（translator）将求解器的输出转化为可检查形式，同时保留求解器的答案。博弈的均衡对应忠实且可检查的翻译器。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅指出该方法通过解耦正确性与可检查性，有望消除可读性税。
Conclusion: DPVG框架为在不牺牲准确率的前提下提升模型输出可检查性提供了一种新思路，均衡条件保证了翻译器的忠实性与可检查性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Gaussian Splatting for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Capturing 4D spatiotemporal scene structure is crucial for the safe and reliable operation of robots in dynamic environments. However, existing approaches typically address only part of the problem: they either provide coarse geometric tracking via bounding boxes or detailed 3D occupancy estimates that lack explicit temporal association and instance-level reasoning. In this work, we present Latent Gaussian Splatting (LaGS) for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking (4D-POT). We revisit the underlying representation and model 3D features as a sparse set of feature-bearing Gaussians. These act as dynamic, volume-oriented keypoints that enable spatially continuous, distance-weighted aggregation of multi-view features before being splatted into a voxel grid for decoding. This point-centric formulation enables flexible, data-dependent receptive fields and long-range spatial interactions that are difficult to capture with local and dense voxel-based operators. A hierarchical Gaussian representation further enables multi-scale reasoning by combining global context from coarse super-points with fine-grained detail from higher-resolution streams. Extensive experiments on Occ3D nuScenes and Waymo demonstrate state-of-the-art performance for 4D-POT. We provide code and models at https://lags.cs.uni-freiburg.de/.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Gaussian Splatting (LaGS) 用于 4D 全景占用跟踪 (4D-POT)，将 3D 特征建模为稀疏特征高斯体，通过距离加权聚合多视图特征并投射到体素网格解码，实现灵活的感受野和长程空间交互，在 Occ3D nuScenes 和 Waymo 上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法要么通过边界框提供粗略几何跟踪，要么提供缺乏时序关联和实例级推理的 3D 占用估计，无法同时满足动态环境中对时空场景结构的完整捕获需求。
Method: 采用特征承载的高斯体作为动态、体积导向的关键点，通过距离加权聚合多视图特征后投影到体素网格，并设计分层高斯表示以融合粗超点全局上下文和高分辨率细节。
Result: 在 Occ3D nuScenes 和 Waymo 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在 4D 全景占用跟踪任务上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该工作强调点为中心的高斯表示能够实现灵活的数据相关感受野和长程空间交互，优于局部密集体素算子，并已开源代码和模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Agents Distinguish Visually Hard-to-Separate Diseases in a Zero-Shot Setting? A Pilot Study
papers.abstract_en: The rapid progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has led to increasing interest in agent-based systems. While most prior work in medical imaging concentrates on automating routine clinical workflows, we study an underexplored yet clinically significant setting: distinguishing visually hard-to-separate diseases in a zero-shot setting. We benchmark representative agents on two imaging-only proxy diagnostic tasks, (1) melanoma vs. atypical nevus and (2) pulmonary edema vs. pneumonia, where visual features are highly confounded despite substantial differences in clinical management. We introduce a multi-agent framework based on contrastive adjudication. Experimental results show improved diagnostic performance (an 11-percentage-point gain in accuracy on dermoscopy data) and reduced unsupported claims on qualitative samples, although overall performance remains insufficient for clinical deployment. We acknowledge the inherent uncertainty in human annotations and the absence of clinical context, which further limit the translation to real-world settings. Within this controlled setting, this pilot study provides preliminary insights into zero-shot agent performance in visually confounded scenarios.
papers.comment: Code available at https://github.com/TruhnLab/Contrastive-Agent-Reasoning. Accepted by MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型（MLLM）驱动的代理系统在零样本设置下区分视觉上难以分离的疾病（黑色素瘤 vs. 非典型痣、肺水肿 vs. 肺炎）的能力。提出基于对比裁决的多代理框架，实验结果显示在皮肤镜数据上准确率提升11个百分点，但整体性能尚不足以临床部署。
Motivation: 现有医学影像代理工作主要关注自动化常规工作流，而临床中视觉特征高度混淆但治疗差异大的疾病（如黑色素瘤与非典型痣）的零样本区分问题尚未被充分研究。
Method: 引入多代理框架，基于对比裁决（contrastive adjudication）进行决策，代理之间通过对比推理相互纠正。
Result: 在两项诊断任务上，所提方法在皮肤镜数据上准确率提升11个百分点，并减少了无根据的声明，但整体性能仍不足以临床部署。
Conclusion: 在受控设置下，该初步研究为视觉混淆场景中零样本代理性能提供了初步见解，但人类标注的不确定性以及临床背景的缺失限制了实际转化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MolGraphBench: A Benchmark of GNN Architectures for Molecular Regression Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Molecules are often represented as SMILES strings, which can be readily converted to hand-crafted descriptors or fingerprints (FP) for molecular property prediction. Research has demonstrated that SMILES can be converted to molecular graphs $G = (V, E)$, with atoms as nodes $(V)$ and bonds as edges $(E)$. These molecular graphs can subsequently be used to train graph neural networks (GNN) models. Despite the recent surge in application of GNN (existing and novel architectures) for molecular property prediction, a rigorous benchmark is still lacking. We propose MolGraphBench, a comprehensive benchmark of four commonly used GNN models for molecular property prediction. Benchmarking results demonstrate graph convolutional network (GCN) and graph isomorphism networks (GIN) as the optimal GNN architectures for molecular graph regression tasks, based on absolute performance, training efficiency, transfer learning and prediction quality. The study also indicates the non-complementary nature of molecular fingerprints in the fusion (GNN-FP) framework. Furthermore, our GNN models achieved performance superior or comparable performance to current state-of-the-art GNN baselines across three datasets (GCN with RMSE of $0.518$ on B3DB, GIN-FP with RMSE of $1.022$ on FreeSolv and GIN with MAE of $63.783$ on RT datasets). Findings from this study indicate that type of GNN-layer, should be treated as a tunable hyperparameter rather than a fixed design choice to achieve superior performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MolGraphBench，一个针对分子回归任务中四种常用图神经网络（GCN、GIN、GAT、GraphSAGE）的基准测试。实验表明，GCN和GIN在绝对性能、训练效率、迁移学习和预测质量方面表现最优，且分子指纹在融合框架中不具有互补性。模型在B3DB、FreeSolv和RT数据集上达到或超越当前最优基线。
Motivation: 尽管GNN在分子性质预测中应用广泛，但缺乏严格的基准测试来系统比较不同架构在分子回归任务上的表现。
Method: 构建分子图（原子为节点，化学键为边），在四个标准GNN模型（GCN、GIN、GAT、GraphSAGE）上进行系统基准测试，评估绝对性能、训练效率、迁移学习能力和预测质量。
Result: GCN和GIN被确定为最优架构；GCN在B3DB数据集上RMSE为0.518，GIN-FP在FreeSolv上RMSE为1.022，GIN在RT数据集上MAE为63.783。
Conclusion: GNN层类型应作为可调超参数而非固定设计选择，以获得最优性能。

papers.title: VideoSketcher: Sequential Sketch Generation Using Video Model Priors
papers.abstract_en: Sketching is inherently sequential: strokes are drawn progressively to explore and refine ideas. Yet most generative approaches treat sketches as static images, ignoring the temporal process underlying creative exploration. Modeling this sequential structure remains challenging: prior methods either rely on large-scale human-drawn datasets with limited diversity, or use large language models (LLMs) to produce drawing instructions, often at the cost of visual fidelity. We present VideoSketcher, a method for generating high-quality sketching processes by adapting pretrained text-to-video diffusion models to the sparse, continuous nature of sketch formation. Our key insight is that LLMs and video diffusion models offer complementary strengths: LLMs act as semantic planners that decompose concepts into step-by-step instructions, while video diffusion models serve as powerful "renderers" that translate them into temporally coherent sketch sequences. We introduce a two-stage fine-tuning strategy that decouples temporal structure from visual appearance: stroke ordering is learned from synthetic shape compositions, while style is distilled from as few as seven hand-drawn examples. Despite minimal supervision, our method can generate diverse, high-quality sequential sketches that faithfully follow specified drawing orders. Our framework naturally extends to brush style control and autoregressive generation, supporting artistic applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoSketcher 是一种利用预训练文生视频扩散模型生成高质量草图绘制过程的方法。它通过两阶段微调策略解耦时间结构与视觉外观，从合成形状学习笔画顺序，从少量手绘样本提炼风格，从而生成遵循指定绘制顺序的序列草图。
Motivation: 现有生成式方法将草图视为静态图像，忽略其顺序性；而前期方法依赖大规模人工数据集或LLM，导致视觉保真度低。目标是为高质量草图绘制过程的生成提供解决方案。
Method: 提出两阶段微调策略：第一阶段从合成形状中学习笔画顺序，第二阶段从少量手绘样本中蒸馏风格。利用LLM作为语义规划器，视频扩散模型作为渲染器，协同生成时序一致的草图序列。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能在极少监督下生成多样、高质量、遵循指定绘制顺序的顺序草图，并支持笔刷风格控制和自回归生成。
Conclusion: VideoSketcher 展示了将视频扩散模型应用于草图生成的有效性，未来可拓展至艺术创作等应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Critical Look at Targeted Instruction Selection: Disentangling What Matters (and What Doesn't)
papers.abstract_en: Instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) often involves selecting a subset of instruction training data from a large candidate pool, using a small query set from the target task. Despite growing interest, the literature on targeted instruction selection remains fragmented and opaque: methods vary widely in selection budgets, often omit zero-shot baselines, and frequently entangle the contributions of key components. As a result, practitioners lack actionable guidance on selecting instructions for their target tasks. In this work, we aim to bring clarity to this landscape by disentangling and systematically analyzing the two core ingredients: data representation and selection algorithms. Our framework enables controlled comparisons across models, tasks, and budgets. We find that only gradient-based data representations choose subsets whose similarity to the query consistently predicts performance across datasets, models, and candidate pools. While no single method dominates, gradient-based representations paired with greedy round-robin selection often perform best on average at low budgets, but these gains diminish at larger budgets. Finally, we unify several existing selection algorithms as forms of approximate distance minimization between the selected subset and the query set, and support this view with new generalization bounds. More broadly, our findings provide critical insights and a foundation for more principled data selection in LLM fine-tuning. The code is available at https://github.com/dcml-lab/targeted-instruction-selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性地解构了目标指令选择（targeted instruction selection）中的两个核心组成部分——数据表示（data representation）和选择算法（selection algorithm），并通过控制实验对比了多种组合。研究发现，只有基于梯度的数据表示（gradient-based representations）能够使所选子集与查询集的相似度持续预测性能；贪心轮询选择（greedy round-robin selection）在低预算下表现较好，但优势随预算增大而减弱。文章还将多种现有选择算法统一为近似距离最小化（approximate distance minimization）框架，并给出了新的泛化界。
Motivation: 指令微调中的目标指令选择文献碎片化且不透明，方法之间缺乏公平比较，常忽略零样本基线，且核心贡献相互纠缠，导致实践者缺乏可操作的指导。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，将目标指令选择解耦为数据表示（如梯度表示、嵌入表示等）和选择算法（如贪心、聚类等）两个独立维度，并在多个模型、任务和预算下进行控制实验。同时从理论上统一了多种现有算法为近似距离最小化形式，并推导泛化界。
Result: 只有基于梯度的数据表示能使所选子集与查询集的相似度稳定预测性能；贪心轮询选择在低预算下平均表现最优，但增益随预算增大而消失。
Conclusion: 研究为LLM微调中更原则化的数据选择提供了关键见解和基础，但未声称存在一种在所有情况下都最好的统一方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model soups need only one ingredient
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large pre-trained models on a target distribution often improves in-distribution (ID) accuracy, but at the cost of out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness as representations specialize to the fine-tuning data. Weight-space ensembling methods, such as Model Soups, mitigate this effect by averaging multiple checkpoints, but they are computationally prohibitive, requiring the training and storage of dozens of fine-tuned models. In this paper, we introduce MonoSoup, a simple, data-free, hyperparameter-free, post-hoc method that achieves a strong ID-OOD balance using only a single checkpoint. Our method applies Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to each layer's update and decomposes it into high-energy directions that capture task-specific adaptation and low-energy directions that introduce noise but may still encode residual signals useful for robustness. MonoSoup then uses entropy-based effective rank to automatically re-weigh these components with layer-wise coefficients that account for the spectral and geometric structure of the model. Experiments on CLIP models fine-tuned on ImageNet and evaluated under natural distribution shifts, as well as on Qwen language models tested on mathematical reasoning and multiple-choice benchmarks, show that this plug-and-play approach is a practical and effective alternative to multi-checkpoint methods, retaining much of their benefits without their computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MonoSoup，一种基于单个检查点的数据无关、无超参数的后处理方法，通过 SVD 分解每层更新并利用熵有效秩自动重加权成分，实现 ID 准确率和 OOD 鲁棒性的平衡。实验在 CLIP 和 Qwen 模型上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 权重空间集成方法（如 Model Soups）能改善微调后的分布外鲁棒性，但需要训练和存储多个检查点，计算开销大。本文旨在用单个检查点达到类似效果。
Method: 对每层更新进行 SVD 分解，分为高能量方向（任务适应）和低能量方向（噪声或残余信号），然后用基于熵的有效秩自动计算层间系数，重新加权这些成分。
Result: 在 CLIP 模型微调 ImageNet 的自然分布偏移测试以及 Qwen 语言模型的数学推理和多选基准上，MonoSoup 作为即插即用方法达到了与多检查点方法相近的性能，但无额外计算开销。
Conclusion: MonoSoup 是多检查点方法的实用且有效的替代方案，保留了其优势而无需计算负担。

papers.title: SleepMaMi: A Universal Sleep Foundation Model for Integrating Macro- and Micro-structures
papers.abstract_en: While the shift toward unified foundation models has revolutionized many deep learning domains, sleep medicine remains largely restricted to task-specific models that focus on localized micro-structure features. These approaches often neglect the rich, multi-modal context of Polysomnography (PSG) and fail to capture the global macro-structure of a full night's sleep. To address this, we introduce SleepMaMi , a Sleep Foundation Model engineered to master both hour-long sleep architectures and fine-grained signal morphologies. Our framework utilizes a hierarchical dual-encoder design: a Macro-Encoder to model full-night temporal dependencies and a Micro-Encoder to capture short-term characteristics from biosignals. Macro-Encoder is trained via Demographic-Guided Contrastive Learning, which aligns overnight sleep patterns with objective subject metadata, such as age, sex and BMI to refine global representations. Micro-Encoder is optimized via a hybrid Masked Autoencoder (MAE) and multi-modal contrastive objective. Pre-trained on a massive corpus of $>$20,000 PSG recordings (158K hours),SleepMaMi outperforms or matches state-of-the-art existing foundation models across a diverse suite of downstream tasks, demonstrating superior generalizability and label-efficient adaptation for clinical sleep analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SleepMaMi，一个通用的睡眠基础模型，采用层次双编码器架构：宏观编码器通过人口统计引导对比学习建模整夜睡眠的全局时间依赖，微观编码器通过混合掩码自编码器和多模态对比学习捕获短时生物信号特征。模型在超过 20,000 条多导睡眠图记录（158K 小时）上预训练，在多种下游任务上达到或超越现有基础模型，展现出更强的泛化能力和标签效率。
Motivation: 当前睡眠医学模型局限于聚焦局部微结构的任务特定模型，忽略了多模态背景和整夜睡眠的全局宏观结构，限制了通用性和性能。
Method: 采用层次双编码器：宏观编码器利用人口统计信息（年龄、性别、BMI）引导的对比学习对齐整夜睡眠模式；微观编码器通过混合掩码自编码器和多模态对比目标进行优化。
Result: 在包含超过 158K 小时的 20,000 条 PSG 记录上预训练后，在多项下游临床睡眠分析任务中优于或匹敌现有基础模型，展示了优越的泛化能力和标签高效性。
Conclusion: 该工作证明整合宏观与微观睡眠结构可以构建通用的睡眠基础模型，为临床睡眠分析提供更全面的表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conditional Diffusion Guidance under Hard Constraint: A Stochastic Analysis Approach
papers.abstract_en: We study conditional generation in diffusion models under hard constraints, where generated samples must satisfy prescribed events with probability one. Such constraints arise naturally in safety-critical applications and in rare-event simulation, where soft or reward-based guidance methods offer no guarantee of constraint satisfaction. Building on a probabilistic interpretation of diffusion models, we develop a principled conditional diffusion guidance framework based on Doob's h-transform, martingale representation and quadratic variation process. Specifically, the resulting guided dynamics augment a pretrained diffusion with an explicit drift correction involving the logarithmic gradient of a conditioning function, without modifying the pretrained score network. Leveraging martingale and quadratic-variation identities, we propose two novel off-policy learning algorithms based on a martingale loss and a martingale-covariation loss to estimate h and its gradient using only trajectories from the pretrained model. We provide non-asymptotic guarantees for the resulting conditional sampler in both total variation and Wasserstein distances, explicitly characterizing the impact of score approximation and guidance estimation errors. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods in enforcing hard constraints and generating rare-event samples. The code of the numerical experiments can be found at https://github.com/ZhengyiGuo2002/CDG_Finance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Doob's h变换、鞅表示和二次变分过程的硬约束条件扩散引导框架，通过引入漂移修正项使生成样本以概率1满足指定事件，无需修改预训练分数网络。基于鞅和二次变分恒等式，提出两种离策略学习算法（鞅损失和鞅-协变损失），利用预训练模型轨迹估计h及其梯度，并提供非渐近理论保证。实验验证了该方法在硬约束生成和罕见事件采样中的有效性。
Motivation: 在安全关键应用和罕见事件模拟中，软或基于奖励的引导方法无法保证约束满足，需要生成样本以概率1满足预设事件的硬约束条件。
Method: 基于扩散模型的概率解释，利用Doob's h变换导出带显式漂移修正的条件引导动力学，通过鞅和二次变分恒等式设计两种离策略学习算法估计条件函数h及其梯度，仅利用预训练模型轨迹。
Result: 提供了总变差距离和Wasserstein距离下的非渐近保证，显式刻画了分数近似和引导估计误差的影响。数值实验验证了硬约束强制执行和罕见事件生成的有效性。
Conclusion: 提出的硬约束条件扩散引导框架在理论保证和实证效果上均有效，适用于安全关键场景和罕见事件模拟。

papers.title: DeFrame: Debiasing Large Language Models Against Framing Effects
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, ensuring their fair responses across demographics has become crucial. Despite many efforts, an ongoing challenge is hidden bias: LLMs appear fair under standard evaluations, but can produce biased responses outside those evaluation settings. In this paper, we identify framing -- differences in how semantically equivalent prompts are expressed (e.g., "A is better than B" vs. "B is worse than A") -- as an underexplored contributor to this gap. We first introduce the concept of "framing disparity" to quantify the impact of framing on fairness evaluation. By augmenting fairness evaluation benchmarks with alternative framings, we find that (1) fairness scores vary significantly with framing and (2) existing debiasing methods improve overall (i.e., frame-averaged) fairness, but often fail to reduce framing-induced disparities. To address this, we propose a framing-aware debiasing method that encourages LLMs to be more consistent across framings. Experiments demonstrate that our approach reduces overall bias and improves robustness against framing disparities, enabling LLMs to produce fairer and more consistent responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型中存在框架效应（framing effect），即语义等价的表述方式差异会导致偏见评估结果不一致。通过引入“框架差异”（framing disparity）概念，作者发现现有去偏方法虽能改善平均公平性，但无法消除框架引起的偏见差异。提出一种框架感知的去偏方法，鼓励模型在不同框架下输出更一致，实验表明该方法能降低整体偏见并提高对框架差异的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有公平性评估未能考虑提示表述方式（框架）的影响，导致隐藏偏见难以被发现。
Method: 提出框架感知去偏方法，通过增强训练或微调使得模型对语义等价的框架产生更一致的回答。
Result: 该方法在公平性基准上降低整体偏见并提高对框架差异的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 框架效应是公平性评估中的关键未探索因素，需在去偏中显式考虑。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 该方法在公平性基准上降低整体偏见并提高对框架差异的鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 框架效应是公平性评估中的关键未探索因素，需在去偏中显式考虑。

papers.title: Probabilistic function-on-function nonlinear autoregressive model for emulation and reliability analysis of stochastic dynamical systems
papers.abstract_en: Constructing accurate and computationally efficient surrogate models (or emulators) for predicting dynamical system responses is critical in many engineering domains, yet remains challenging due to the strongly nonlinear and high-dimensional mapping from external excitations and system parameters to system responses. This work introduces a novel Function-on-Function Nonlinear AutoRegressive model with eXogenous inputs (F2NARX), which reformulates the recently proposed $\mathcal{F}$-NARX method from a function-on-function regression perspective. The proposed framework substantially improves predictive efficiency while maintaining high accuracy. By combining principal component analysis with Gaussian process regression, F2NARX further enables probabilistic predictions of dynamical responses via the unscented transform in an autoregressive manner. Such probabilistic prediction capabilities further facilitate active learning for first-passage probability evaluation. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through case studies of varying complexity. Results show that F2NARX outperforms state-of-the-art NARX model by orders of magnitude in efficiency while achieving higher accuracy in general. Meanwhile, the active learning approach enables accurate estimation of first-passage failure probabilities for dynamical systems using only a small number of training time histories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种函数到函数非线性自回归外生输入模型（F2NARX），用于随机动力系统的概率仿真和可靠性分析。该模型将主成分分析与高斯过程回归相结合，通过无迹变换实现概率预测，并支持主动学习以高效估计首次通过失效概率。实验表明，F2NARX在精度和效率上均优于现有NARX模型几个数量级。
Motivation: 构建精确且计算高效的动力系统响应代理模型在工程领域至关重要，但由于外部激励和系统参数到响应的强非线性高维映射，现有方法面临挑战。
Method: 从函数对函数回归角度重新表述F-NARX方法，结合主成分分析与高斯过程回归，通过无迹变换在自回归方式下实现概率预测，并用于主动学习。
Result: 在多个复杂度算例中，F2NARX在效率上优于先进NARX模型几个数量级，同时精度更高；主动学习仅需少量训练时程即可准确估计首次通过失效概率。
Conclusion: F2NARX为随机动力系统仿真和可靠性分析提供了高效准确的代理建模框架。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: One Probe Won't Catch Them All: Towards Targeted Deception Detection
papers.abstract_en: Linear probes are a promising approach for monitoring AI systems for deceptive behaviour. Previous work has shown that a linear classifier trained on a contrastive instruction pair and a simple dataset can achieve good performance. However, these probes exhibit notable failures even in straightforward scenarios, including spurious correlations and false positives on non-deceptive responses. In this paper, we demonstrate that deception detection is inherently heterogeneous: while a single universal probe achieves modest improvements (+0.032 AUC), post-hoc oracle analysis reveals substantially higher potential (+0.108 AUC) when probes are matched to specific deception types, and synthetic validation experiments suggest this ceiling is achievable a priori when the deception type is known in advance. Our findings reveal that instruction pairs capture deceptive intent rather than content-specific patterns, explaining why prompt choice dominates probe performance (70.6% of variance). Given this heterogeneity, we conclude that organizations should define their specific threat models and deploy appropriately matched probes rather than seeking a universal deception detector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究线性探针在AI欺骗检测中的表现，发现欺骗检测本质上是异质的：通用探针仅提升0.032 AUC，但后验oracle分析显示，当探针与特定欺骗类型匹配时，AUC可提升0.108；合成验证实验表明，若事先知道欺骗类型，该上限是可实现的。指令对捕获的是欺骗意图而非内容模式，提示选择解释70.6%的性能方差。结论是组织应根据自身威胁模型部署匹配探针，而非追求通用检测器。
Motivation: 已有线性探针在对比指令对和简单数据集上表现良好，但在真实场景中存在虚假相关和假阳性等显著失败，表明需要更针对性的检测方法。
Method: 使用对比指令对和简单数据集训练线性分类器，并通过后验oracle分析（将探针与特定欺骗类型匹配）及合成验证实验来评估性能上限。
Result: 通用探针仅提升0.032 AUC；oracle分析显示匹配特定欺骗类型时可达+0.108 AUC；提示选择主导探针性能，解释70.6%的方差。
Conclusion: 欺骗检测具有异质性，组织应定义威胁模型并部署针对性的探针，而非追求单一通用检测器。

papers.title: Relighting as a Probe of Visual Priors via Augmented Latent Intrinsics
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-image relighting requires representations that separate illumination from scene properties while preserving dense geometry, material, and photometric cues. We use this task as a probe of visual priors: unlike recognition tasks that reward invariance, relighting tests whether visual features retain the information needed for light transfer. Through a controlled generative relighting framework, we find that strong semantic encoders can degrade relighting quality, exposing a semantic--photometric trade-off between abstraction and physical fidelity. We introduce Augmented Latent Intrinsics (ALI), which balances this trade-off by fusing dense, pixel-aligned visual features into a latent-intrinsic relighting model and refining it with self-supervision on unlabeled real image pairs. ALI improves relighting quality, especially on glossy, metallic, and transparent materials, and demonstrates that generative relighting is an effective tool for quantifying what visual encoders encode about the physical world.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version for ICML 2026. Project page: https://augmented-latent-intrinsics.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出增广潜在本征 (Augmented Latent Intrinsics, ALI) 框架，利用图像重光照作为探针来评估视觉编码器保留物理世界信息的能力。研究发现强语义编码器会损害重光照质量，揭示抽象与物理保真度之间的语义-光度权衡。ALI 通过融合密集像素对齐的视觉特征和自监督细化，在光泽、金属和透明材质上提升重光照效果。
Motivation: 现有视觉编码器多针对识别任务优化，追求不变性，但重光照任务要求保留光照、几何、材质等物理信息，本文旨在量化不同编码器对这些信息的保留程度。
Method: 提出增广潜在本征 (ALI)，将密集像素对齐的视觉特征融合到潜在本征重光照模型中，并利用未标注的真实图像对进行自监督细化。
Result: ALI 在光泽、金属和透明材质上显著提升重光照质量，实验表明重光照可作为评估视觉编码器物理世界表征能力的有效工具。
Conclusion: 图像重光照是量化视觉编码器物理世界信息保留能力的有效探针，ALI 平衡了抽象与物理保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stabilizing the Q-Gradient Field for Policy Smoothness in Actor-Critic Methods
papers.abstract_en: Policies learned via continuous actor-critic methods often exhibit erratic, high-frequency oscillations, making them unsuitable for physical deployment. Current approaches attempt to enforce smoothness by directly regularizing the policy's output. We argue that this approach treats the symptom rather than the cause. In this work, we theoretically establish that policy non-smoothness is fundamentally governed by the differential geometry of the critic. By applying implicit differentiation to the actor-critic objective, we prove that the sensitivity of the optimal policy is bounded by the ratio of the Q-function's mixed-partial derivative (noise sensitivity) to its action-space curvature (signal distinctness). To empirically validate this theoretical insight, we introduce PAVE (Policy-Aware Value-field Equalization), a critic-centric regularization framework that treats the critic as a scalar field and stabilizes its induced action-gradient field. PAVE rectifies the learning signal by minimizing the Q-gradient volatility while preserving local curvature. Experimental results demonstrate that PAVE achieves smoothness comparable to policy-side smoothness regularization methods, while maintaining competitive task performance, without modifying the actor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明连续 actor-critic 方法中策略不平滑的根本原因在于评论家 (critic) 的微分几何性质，并提出 PAVE 框架，通过对评论家进行正则化来稳定其诱导的动作梯度场，从而在不修改 actor 的情况下实现策略平滑。实验表明 PAVE 在保持任务性能的同时达到了与策略侧平滑正则化方法相当的平滑度。
Motivation: 连续 actor-critic 方法学到的策略常出现高频振荡，不适合物理部署。现有方法直接正则化策略输出，但本文认为这治标不治本。
Method: 通过隐式微分推导出最优策略的敏感度由 Q 函数的混合偏导（噪声敏感度）与动作空间曲率（信号区分度）之比决定，并据此提出 PAVE 框架，该框架将评论家视为标量场，通过最小化 Q 梯度波动同时保留局部曲率来修正学习信号。
Result: 摘要指出 PAVE 达到了与策略侧平滑正则化方法相当的平滑度，同时保持了有竞争力的任务性能，且无需修改 actor。
Conclusion: 本文从评论家几何角度解释了策略不平滑的根源，并提出了一种评论家中心的正则化方法，为未来研究提供了新视角。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Toward all-optical unsupervised Hebbian learning in deep photonic neuromorphic networks
papers.abstract_en: We propose a deep photonic neuromorphic network (PNN) architecture based on phase-change material (PCM) synapses and local optical feedback for online, unsupervised Hebbian learning. The proposed architecture combines optical vector-matrix multiplication, non-volatile PCM synaptic weighting, and local coincidence-driven synaptic adaptation within a multilayer photonic crossbar framework compatible with photonic integrated circuits. Unlike conventional PNNs that rely on externally computed gradients, repeated optical-electrical-optical conversions, or global backpropagation, the proposed framework employs local Hebbian learning governed directly by correlated pre- and post-synaptic optical activity. To investigate the feasibility of the proposed learning mechanism, we implemented the PNN design using fiber-optic components, programmable variable optical attenuators, and real-time software control that incorporates PCM thermal dynamics. Supervised and unsupervised learning behaviors were experimentally evaluated under both offline and online learning conditions using representative image-recognition tasks. The experimental results demonstrate adaptive synaptic evolution, successful optical inference, and autonomous pattern encoding through local Hebbian learning under realistic fiber-optic hardware conditions. These results establish a pathway toward future integrated photonic neuromorphic systems capable of scalable and energy-efficient online Hebbian learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于相变材料（PCM）突触和局部光学反馈的全光学深度光子神经形态网络（PNN）架构，用于在线无监督Hebbian学习。该架构结合光学向量矩阵乘法、非易失性PCM突触加权和局部符合驱动的突触自适应，在多光子交叉杆框架中实现，无需外部梯度计算或光-电-光转换。实验使用光纤元件、可编程可变光学衰减器和实时软件控制（包含PCM热动力学）实现了监督和无监督学习，在代表性图像识别任务中展示了自适应突触演化、光学推理和自主模式编码。
Motivation: 传统光子神经形态网络依赖外部计算梯度、反复光-电-光转换或全局反向传播，限制了在线无监督学习的效率和可扩展性。
Method: 提出多层光子交叉杆框架，利用PCM作为非易失性突触权重，通过局部前后光学活动的相关性驱动Hebbian学习，并采用光纤元件和实时软件控制模拟PCM热动力学进行实验验证。
Result: 实验结果表明，在真实光纤硬件条件下，该架构能实现自适应突触演化、成功的光学推理和自主模式编码，验证了局部Hebbian学习的可行性。
Conclusion: 该工作为未来集成光子神经形态系统实现可扩展、能效高的在线Hebbian学习铺平了道路。

papers.title: Prior-Informed Flow Matching for Graph Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \textit{Prior-Informed Flow Matching (PIFM)}, a conditional flow model for graph reconstruction. Reconstructing graphs from partial observations remains a key challenge; classical embedding methods often lack global consistency, while modern generative models struggle to incorporate structural priors. PIFM bridges this gap by integrating embedding-based priors with continuous-time flow matching. Grounded in a permutation equivariant version of the distortion-perception theory, our method first uses a prior, such as GraphSAGE or node2vec, to form an informed initial estimate of the adjacency matrix based on local information. It then applies rectified flow matching to refine this estimate, transporting it toward the true distribution of clean graphs and learning a global coupling. Experiments on different datasets demonstrate that PIFM consistently enhances classical embeddings, outperforming them and state-of-the-art generative baselines in reconstruction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prior-Informed Flow Matching (PIFM)，一种条件流模型用于图重构。该方法结合基于嵌入的先验（如 GraphSAGE）和连续时间流匹配，先利用先验形成局部信息估计的邻接矩阵，再通过整流流匹配将其向干净图的真实分布运输，学习全局耦合。实验表明 PIFM 在多个数据集上持续提升经典嵌入，并在重构精度上优于最先进的生成基线。
Motivation: 从部分观测重构图面临挑战：经典嵌入方法缺乏全局一致性，而现代生成模型难以融入结构先验。
Method: PIFM 基于置换等变版的失真-感知理论，首先使用先验（如 GraphSAGE 或 node2vec）基于局部信息形成邻接矩阵的初始估计，然后应用整流流匹配 (rectified flow matching) 细化该估计，将其向干净图的真实分布运输，从而学习全局耦合。
Result: 在多个数据集上，PIFM 持续增强经典嵌入，在重构精度上优于经典嵌入和最先进的生成基线。
Conclusion: PIFM 通过整合嵌入先验和流匹配，有效改进了图重构的质量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Prior-Informed Flow Matching (PIFM)，一种条件流模型用于图重构。该方法结合基于嵌入的先验（如 GraphSAGE）和连续时间流匹配，先利用先验形成局部信息估计的邻接矩阵，再通过整流流匹配将其向干净图的真实分布运输，学习全局耦合。实验表明 PIFM 在多个数据集上持续提升经典嵌入，并在重构精度上优于最先进的生成基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 从部分观测重构图面临挑战：经典嵌入方法缺乏全局一致性，而现代生成模型难以融入结构先验。
summary_sections.method: PIFM 基于置换等变版的失真-感知理论，首先使用先验（如 GraphSAGE 或 node2vec）基于局部信息形成邻接矩阵的初始估计，然后应用整流流匹配 (rectified flow matching) 细化该估计，将其向干净图的真实分布运输，从而学习全局耦合。

papers.title: Bi-Anchor Interpolation Solver for Accelerating Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Flow Matching (FM) models have emerged as a leading paradigm for high-fidelity synthesis. However, their reliance on iterative Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) solving creates a significant latency bottleneck. Existing solutions face a dichotomy: training-free solvers suffer from significant performance degradation at low Neural Function Evaluations (NFEs), while training-based one- or few-steps generation methods incur prohibitive training costs and lack plug-and-play versatility. To bridge this gap, we propose the Bi-Anchor Interpolation Solver (BA-solver). BA-solver retains the versatility of standard training-free solvers while achieving significant acceleration by introducing a lightweight SideNet (1-2% backbone size) alongside the frozen backbone. Specifically, our method is founded on two synergistic components: \textbf{1) Bidirectional Temporal Perception}, where the SideNet learns to approximate both future and historical velocities without retraining the heavy backbone; and 2) Bi-Anchor Velocity Integration, which utilizes the SideNet with two anchor velocities to efficiently approximate intermediate velocities for batched high-order integration. By utilizing the backbone to establish high-precision ``anchors'' and the SideNet to densify the trajectory, BA-solver enables large interval sizes with minimized error. Empirical results on ImageNet-256^2 demonstrate that BA-solver achieves generation quality comparable to 100+ NFEs Euler solver in just 10 NFEs and maintains high fidelity in as few as 5 NFEs, incurring negligible training costs. Furthermore, BA-solver ensures seamless integration with existing generative pipelines, facilitating downstream tasks such as image editing.

papers.title: Creativity Reconsidered: Generative AI and the Problem of Intentional Agency
papers.abstract_en: Many theorists maintain that conscious intentional agency is a necessary condition of creativity. We argue that this requirement, which we call the Intentional Agency Condition (IAC), should be abandoned. We motivate this by highlighting the problems this criterion encounters in the face of recent advances in generative AI, which is ostensibly creative despite being incapable of intentional agency. We present two corpus analyses to illustrate the rapidly increasing tendency of people to predicate creativity to generative AI. In response to this predicament, theorists of creativity have proposed a range of conflicting solutions, which we critically evaluate. We find that none of these satisfyingly resolves the initial predicament, and we therefore propose a novel approach. Our claim is that ascriptions of creativity are dependent on what we call creative ability. This solution explains why intentional agency is important for judgements of creativity, without being a necessary condition. Our approach thereby accommodates AI creativity without dismissing the intuition that perceived intentions are of key importance for ascriptions of creativity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了传统观点认为意识意图能动性是创造力必要条件的立场，认为生成式AI的创造力现象要求放弃这一条件。通过语料分析展示公众越来越将创造力归因于AI，并批判现有解决方案，提出基于“创造能力”（creative ability）的新框架，解释意图在创造力判断中的核心地位但非必要条件。
Motivation: 传统创造力理论要求有意识意图能动性（IAC），但生成式AI虽无意图却表现出创造力，导致理论困境。
Method: 提出“创造能力”概念，并开展两项语料分析以证明人们日益将创造力归因于生成式AI，同时系统批判现有冲突解决方案。
Result: 语料分析显示公众将创造力归因于AI的趋势显著上升；现有方案均未能满意解决意图与AI创造力的矛盾。
Conclusion: 基于创造能力的方案能同时容纳AI创造力并保留直觉上意图的重要性，为创造力理论提供新路径。

papers.title: Meta Flow Maps enable scalable reward alignment
papers.abstract_en: Controlling generative models is computationally expensive. This is because optimal alignment with a reward function--whether via inference-time steering or fine-tuning--requires estimating the value function. This task demands access to the conditional posterior $p_{1|t}(x_1|x_t)$, the distribution of clean data $x_1$ consistent with an intermediate state $x_t$, a requirement that typically compels methods to resort to costly trajectory simulations. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Meta Flow Maps (MFMs), a framework extending consistency models and flow maps into the stochastic regime. MFMs are trained to perform stochastic one-step posterior sampling, generating arbitrarily many i.i.d. draws of clean data $x_1$ from any intermediate state. Crucially, these samples provide a differentiable reparametrization that unlocks efficient value function estimation. We leverage this capability to solve bottlenecks in both paradigms: enabling inference-time steering without inner rollouts, and facilitating unbiased, off-policy fine-tuning to general rewards. Empirically, our single-particle steered-MFM sampler outperforms a Best-of-1000 baseline on ImageNet across multiple rewards at a fraction of the compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Meta Flow Maps (MFMs)，将一致性模型和流映射扩展到随机过程，实现从任意中间状态高效采样干净数据并估计价值函数，从而解决生成模型奖励对齐中的计算瓶颈。实验表明，在ImageNet上，单个粒子steered-MFM采样器以极低计算量超越Best-of-1000基线。
Motivation: 生成模型与奖励函数的最优对齐需要估计价值函数，这依赖于条件后验分布，通常导致昂贵的轨迹模拟，计算成本高。
Method: 提出Meta Flow Maps框架，训练模型进行随机单步后验采样，生成任意多个i.i.d.干净数据样本，并提供可微重参数化用于高效价值函数估计。
Result: 在ImageNet上，单粒子steered-MFM采样器以极低计算量超越Best-of-1000基线。
Conclusion: MFMs同时解决了推理时引导和微调两个范式中的瓶颈，无需内部滚动即可实现高效奖励对齐。

papers.title: DiT-JSCC: Rethinking Deep JSCC with Diffusion Transformers and Semantic Representations
papers.abstract_en: Generative joint source-channel coding (GJSCC) has emerged as a new Deep JSCC paradigm for achieving high-fidelity and robust image transmission under extreme wireless channel conditions, such as ultra-low bandwidth and low signal-to-noise ratio. Recent studies commonly adopt diffusion models as generative decoders, but they frequently produce visually realistic results with limited semantic consistency. This limitation stems from a fundamental mismatch between reconstruction-oriented JSCC encoders and generative decoders, as the former lack explicit semantic discriminability and fail to provide reliable conditional cues. In this paper, we propose DiT-JSCC, a novel GJSCC backbone that can jointly learn a semantics-prioritized representation encoder and a diffusion transformer (DiT) based generative decoder, our open-source project aims to promote the future research in GJSCC. Specifically, we design a semantics-detail dual-branch encoder that aligns naturally with a coarse-to-fine conditional DiT decoder, prioritizing semantic consistency under extreme channel conditions. Moreover, a training-free adaptive bandwidth allocation strategy inspired by Kolmogorov complexity is introduced to further improve the transmission efficiency, thereby indeed redefining the notion of information value in the era of generative decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiT-JSCC consistently outperforms existing JSCC methods in both semantic consistency and visual quality, particularly in extreme regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiT-JSCC，一种基于扩散Transformer的生成式联合源信道编码（GJSCC）方法，用于极端信道条件下的高保真图像传输。方法包括一个语义-细节双分支编码器与粗到细的条件DiT解码器，并引入基于Kolmogorov复杂度的自适应带宽分配策略。实验表明，在语义一致性和视觉质量上优于现有JSCC方法，尤其在极端条件下。
Motivation: 现有GJSCC方法使用扩散模型作为生成解码器，但常产生视觉逼真但语义一致性有限的结果，因重建导向的JSCC编码器与生成解码器存在根本性不匹配。
Method: 提出DiT-JSCC，包含语义-细节双分支编码器（语义优先）和粗到细的条件DiT解码器，以及无训练的自适应带宽分配策略（基于Kolmogorov复杂度）。
Result: 摘要报告在极端条件下（超低带宽、低信噪比）在语义一致性和视觉质量上持续优于现有JSCC方法。
Conclusion: 重新定义了生成解码时代的信息价值，并开源项目以促进GJSCC研究。

papers.title: PiDR: Physics-Informed Inertial Dead Reckoning for Autonomous Platforms
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental requirement for full autonomy is the ability to sustain accurate navigation in the absence of external data, such as GNSS signals or visual information. In these challenging environments, the platform must rely exclusively on inertial sensors, leading to pure inertial navigation. However, the inherent noise and other error terms of the inertial sensors in such real-world scenarios will cause the navigation solution to drift over time. Although conventional deep-learning models have emerged as a possible approach to inertial navigation, they are inherently black-box in nature. Furthermore, they struggle to learn effectively with limited supervised sensor data and often fail to preserve physical principles. To address these limitations, we propose PiDR, a physics-informed inertial dead-reckoning framework for autonomous platforms in situations of pure inertial navigation. PiDR offers transparency by explicitly integrating inertial navigation principles into the network training process through the physics-informed residual component. PiDR plays a crucial role in mitigating abrupt trajectory deviations even under limited or sparse supervision. We evaluated PiDR on real-world datasets collected by a mobile robot and an autonomous underwater vehicle. We obtained more than 29% positioning improvement in both datasets, demonstrating the ability of PiDR to generalize different platforms operating in various environments and dynamics. Thus, PiDR offers a robust, lightweight, yet effective architecture and can be deployed on resource-constrained platforms, enabling real-time pure inertial navigation in adverse scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PiDR，一个物理信息惯性航位推算框架，用于自主平台在无GNSS或视觉信号时的纯惯性导航。PiDR 通过物理信息残差组件将惯性导航原理显式集成到网络训练中，提升可解释性，并在有限监督下减轻轨迹发散。在移动机器人和自主水下航行器的真实数据集上，定位精度提升超过29%，表明其能泛化到不同平台和环境。
Motivation: 纯惯性导航面临传感器噪声导致的漂移问题，现有深度学习模型是黑盒，且难以在有限监督数据下学习并保持物理规律。
Method: 提出 PiDR 框架，通过物理信息残差组件将惯性导航原理融入神经网络训练，实现透明且物理一致的航位推算。
Result: 在移动机器人和自主水下航行器的真实数据集上，定位精度提升超过29%。
Conclusion: PiDR 提供鲁棒、轻量且有效的架构，可部署于资源受限平台，实现实时纯惯性导航。

papers.title: Environment-Adaptive Covariate Selection: Learning When to Use Spurious Correlations for Out-of-Distribution Prediction
papers.abstract_en: A common approach to out-of-distribution prediction restricts models to causal or invariant covariates to avoid spurious associations that may change across environments. Despite its theoretical appeal, this strategy can underperform empirical risk minimization when only a subset of the causal parents of the outcome is observed. In such settings, non-causal covariates can serve as proxies for unobserved causal parents and improve prediction when the proxy relationship is stable, but they can hurt when shifts disrupt that relationship. Thus, the optimal covariate set can depend on the specific shift encountered. Because different shifts leave signatures in the unlabeled covariate distribution, we propose an environment-adaptive covariate selection algorithm that maps environment-level summaries to environment-specific covariate sets. These summaries may be hand-crafted or learned from multi-environment data, and prior causal knowledge can be incorporated as constraints. Across simulations and applied datasets, the proposed method improves over static causal, invariant, and other non-adaptive rules under diverse shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布外预测中的协变量选择问题，提出一种环境自适应算法，根据环境级摘要动态选择协变量集，在未观测到所有因果父变量时利用稳定的代理关系提升预测性能。模拟和实际数据表明该方法优于静态因果、不变性等非自适应规则。
Motivation: 仅使用因果或不变协变量的策略在未观测到所有因果父变量时可能劣于经验风险最小化，而非因果协变量可作为代理变量，但环境变化可能破坏代理关系的稳定性，因此需要根据具体环境自适应选择协变量集。
Method: 提出环境自适应协变量选择算法，将环境级摘要映射到环境特定的协变量集；摘要可手工设计或从多环境数据中学习，并允许融入先验因果知识作为约束。
Result: 在模拟和实际数据集上，该方法在多种分布偏移下优于静态因果、不变性及其他非自适应规则。
Conclusion: 本文展示了利用环境级信息动态选择协变量集可以提升分布外预测的鲁棒性，但未讨论摘要的获取成本或算法在高维、复杂环境下的扩展性。

papers.title: AI-enhanced tuning of quantum dot Hamiltonians toward Majorana modes
papers.abstract_en: We propose a neural network-based model capable of learning the broad landscape of working regimes in quantum dot simulators, and using this knowledge to autotune these devices - based on transport measurements - toward obtaining Majorana modes in the structure. The model is trained in an unsupervised manner on synthetic data in the form of conductance maps, using a physics-informed loss that incorporates key properties of Majorana zero modes. We show that, with appropriate training, a deep vision-transformer network can efficiently memorize relation between Hamiltonian parameters and structures on conductance maps and use it to propose parameters update for a quantum dot chain that drive the system toward topological phase. Starting from a broad range of initial detunings in parameter space, a single update step is sufficient to generate nontrivial zero modes. Moreover, by enabling an iterative tuning procedure - where the system acquires updated conductance maps at each step - we demonstrate that the method can address a much larger region of the parameter space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的模型，能够学习量子点模拟器工作区域的广阔景观，并利用该知识通过输运测量自动调谐器件，以在结构中获取马约拉纳模。模型以无监督方式在合成电导图上训练，使用包含马约拉纳零模关键特性的物理信息损失函数。结果表明，深度视觉变换器网络能有效记忆哈密顿参数与电导图结构的关系，并提出参数更新以驱动系统走向拓扑相。单次更新即可从宽范围的初始失谐产生非平庸零模；迭代调谐过程可覆盖更大参数空间。
Motivation: 量子点器件调谐至马约拉纳模状态通常需要大量人工干预，效率低且难以规模化。现有自动调谐方法依赖特定假设或搜索空间有限。
Method: 提出基于视觉变换器 (vision-transformer) 的神经网络，在合成电导图上进行无监督训练，损失函数融合马约拉纳零模的物理约束。模型通过单步或迭代方式输出哈密顿参数更新，引导系统进入拓扑相。
Result: 摘要表明，从宽范围的初始参数失谐出发，单次更新即可产生非平庸零模；迭代调谐能够覆盖更大的参数空间区域。
Conclusion: 该AI方法可高效自动调谐量子点阵列至马约拉纳模所需条件，为拓扑量子计算中的器件调控提供新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GH-ESD: Grounded Hypothesis-Driven Error Slice Discovery for Instance-Level Vision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Systematic failures of vision models on semantically coherent subsets, known as error slices, reveal limitations in robustness and evaluation. Existing slice discovery approaches largely model slices as clusters in representation space or combinations of predefined attributes. While effective for image-level classification, such formulations are insufficient for instance-level tasks such as object detection and segmentation, where failures often arise from contextual relational and spatially grounded visual patterns. We propose GH-ESD (Grounded Hypothesis-Driven Error Slice Discovery), a generate and verify framework that reformulates slice discovery as grounded hypothesis generation and statistical verification. GH-ESD constructs relational failure hypotheses using LLM priors and grounded visual evidence, discovers hypothesis slices at the instance level via Vision Language Models, and verifies them through statistical trend analysis over instance-level errors. We also introduce GESD (Grounded Error Slice Dataset), a new benchmark for instance-level error slice discovery, providing expert-defined and spatially grounded slices derived from detection and segmentation failures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GH-ESD consistently outperforms baselines, improving Precision@10 by 0.10 (0.73 vs. 0.63) on the GESD benchmark for detection tasks, while also supporting segmentation scenarios. GH-ESD identifies interpretable slices that facilitate actionable model improvements. The GESD dataset will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GH-ESD，一种基于假设驱动的错误切片发现框架，专门针对实例级视觉任务（如目标检测和分割）。该框架利用LLM先验和视觉证据生成关系性失败假设，通过视觉语言模型发现假设切片，并进行统计验证。还构建了GESD基准数据集，包含专家定义的实例级错误切片。实验表明，在检测任务上Precision@10从0.63提升至0.73，同时支持分割场景。
Motivation: 现有错误切片发现方法主要针对图像级分类，无法有效处理实例级任务中常见的上下文关系和空间视觉模式导致的失败。
Method: 提出生成-验证框架：首先利用LLM和视觉证据生成关系性失败假设，然后通过视觉语言模型在实例级发现假设切片，最后通过统计趋势分析进行验证。
Result: 在GESD基准上，检测任务Precision@10达到0.73，优于基线0.63，提升0.10；方法同样适用于分割场景。
Conclusion: GH-ESD能够识别可解释的错误切片，从而促进针对性的模型改进。GESD数据集将在论文接收后公开。

papers.title: Bring My Cup! Personalizing Vision-Language-Action Models with Visual Attentive Prompting
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize well to generic instructions, they struggle with personalized commands such as "bring my cup," where the robot must act on one specific instance among visually similar objects. We study this setting of manipulating personal objects, in which a VLA must identify and control a user-specific object unseen during training using only a few reference images. To address this challenge, we propose Visual Attentive Prompting (VAP), a simple-yet-effective training-free perceptual adapter that equips frozen VLAs with top-down selective attention. VAP treats the reference images as a non-parametric visual memory, grounds the personal object in the scene through open-vocabulary detection and embedding-based matching, and then injects this grounding as a visual prompt by highlighting the object and rewriting the instruction. We construct two simulation benchmarks, Personalized-SIMPLER and Personalized-VLABench, and a real-world tabletop benchmark to evaluate personalized manipulation across multiple robots and tasks. Experiments show that VAP consistently outperforms generic policies and token-learning baselines in both success rate and correct-object manipulation, helping to bridge the gap between semantic understanding and instance-level control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出视觉注意力提示（Visual Attentive Prompting, VAP），一种无需训练的外部适配器，使冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够处理个性化指令（如“把我的杯子拿来”），仅需少量参考图像即可识别并操控未见过的用户特定物体。VAP将参考图像作为非参数视觉记忆，通过开放词汇检测和嵌入匹配定位目标物体，然后通过高亮物体和重写指令注入视觉提示。在仿真和真实基准上的实验表明，VAP在成功率和目标物体操控上优于通用策略和基线方法。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型能很好地泛化到通用指令，但在个性化指令（如“把我的杯子拿来”）上表现不佳，因为机器人需要从视觉相似物体中识别用户指定的特定实例。该任务要求模型仅凭少量参考图像在训练中未见过的场景中操作个人物体。
Method: 提出视觉注意力提示（VAP），这是一种训练免费的外部适配器，包含三个步骤：1) 将参考图像视为非参数视觉记忆；2) 通过开放词汇检测和基于嵌入的匹配在场景中定位个人物体；3) 通过高亮物体并重写指令将定位信息作为视觉提示注入冻结的VLA模型，实现自上而下的选择性注意。
Result: 在构建的两种仿真基准（Personalized-SIMPLER和Personalized-VLABench）以及真实桌面基准上，VAP在成功率和正确物体操控两个指标上一致优于通用策略和基于令牌学习的基线方法。
Conclusion: VAP提供了一种简单有效的途径，弥合了VLA模型在语义理解与实例级控制之间的差距，无需微调即可实现个性化物体操控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers for Nonlinear Matrix Decompositions
papers.abstract_en: We present an algorithm based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) for solving nonlinear matrix decompositions (NMD). Given an input matrix $X \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$ and a factorization rank $r \ll \min(m, n)$, NMD seeks matrices $W \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times r}$ and $H \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times n}$ such that $X \approx f(WH)$, where $f$ is an element-wise nonlinear function. We evaluate our method on several representative nonlinear models: the rectified linear unit activation $f(x) = \max(0, x)$, suitable for nonnegative sparse data approximation, the component-wise square $f(x) = x^2$, applicable to probabilistic circuit representation, and the MinMax transform $f(x) = \min(b, \max(a, x))$, relevant for recommender systems. The proposed framework flexibly supports diverse loss functions, including least squares, $\ell_1$ norm, and the Kullback-Leibler divergence, and can be readily extended to other nonlinearities and metrics. We illustrate the applicability, efficiency, and adaptability of the approach on real-world datasets, highlighting its potential for a broad range of applications.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures. v3: Revised version: added new experiments and comparisons. Code available from https://gitlab.com/Atharva05/admm-for-nmd
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的非线性矩阵分解（NMD）算法，处理形如 X ≈ f(WH) 的分解，其中 f 是逐元素非线性函数。在 ReLU、平方和 MinMax 等非线性模型上评估，支持最小二乘、L1 范数和 KL 散度等多种损失函数，在真实数据集上展示适用性和效率。
Motivation: 传统矩阵分解假设线性关系，而实际应用中常需非线性变换（如非负稀疏数据、概率电路表示、推荐系统），需要一种灵活高效的通用算法。
Method: 基于 ADMM 的优化框架，将 NMD 问题分解为交替更新的子问题，可灵活适配不同非线性函数和损失函数。
Result: 在三个代表性非线性模型上验证：ReLU（非负稀疏数据近似）、平方（概率电路表示）和 MinMax（推荐系统），展示算法在真实数据集上的有效性和计算效率。
Conclusion: 所提 ADMM 方法灵活且高效，易于扩展到其他非线性和度量，适用于广泛的应用场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Smol-GS: Compact Representations for Abstract 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We present Smol-GS, a novel method for learning compact representations for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Our approach learns highly efficient splat-wise features to model 3D space, which capture abstracted cues, including color, opacity, transformation, and material properties. We propose octree-derived positional encoding, which explicitly models spatial locality and enhances representation efficiency. We further apply entropy-based compression to exploit feature redundancy and compress splat coordinates using a recursive voxel hierarchy. This design enables orders-of-magnitude reduction in storage while preserving representation flexibility. Smol-GS achieves state-of-the-art compression performance on standard benchmarks with high-level rendering quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Smol-GS，一种学习 3D 高斯散点 (3DGS) 紧凑表示的新方法。它通过学习高效的 splat 特征来建模 3D 空间，包括颜色、透明度、变换和材质属性；采用八叉树位置编码显式建模空间局部性，并利用熵压缩和递归体素层次压缩 splat 坐标。在标准基准上实现了数量级的存储压缩，同时保持高渲染质量。
Motivation: 3D 高斯散点表示虽然渲染质量高，但存储开销大，不利于实际应用。需要一种紧凑表示来大幅降低存储而不牺牲表示灵活性。
Method: 提出学习 splat 级特征；设计八叉树位置编码增强空间局部性；应用熵编码压缩特征冗余；使用递归体素层次压缩 splat 坐标。
Result: 在标准基准上实现了目前最优的压缩性能，存储减少数个数量级，同时保持高渲染质量。
Conclusion: Smol-GS 证明了通过结合可学习特征、八叉树编码和分层压缩，可以显著压缩 3DGS 表示而保留渲染效果，为高效 3D 场景表示提供新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Machine Learning Approach to Moment Closure Relations for Plasma: A Review
papers.abstract_en: The requirement for large-scale global simulations of plasma is an ongoing challenge in both space and laboratory plasma physics. Any simulation based on a fluid model inherently requires a closure relation for the high order plasma moments. This review compiles and analyses the recent surge of machine learning approaches developing improved plasma closure models capable of capturing kinetic phenomena within plasma fluid models. We survey two methodological families: neural-network surrogates (from multilayer perceptrons to Fourier neural operators, the latter recently reproducing both linear and non-linear Landau damping online within a fluid solver) and equation-discovery methods such as sparse regression; and organise the studies by whether they are tested offline against reference data or online within a time-evolving solver. We outline the challenges associated with machine-learning closures, including off-diagonal pressure-tensor accuracy, generalisation beyond the training distribution, and stable integration into large-scale simulations, and the directions future research might take to address them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了机器学习在等离子体矩闭合关系中的应用，涵盖神经网络代理（如傅里叶神经算子）和方程发现（如稀疏回归）两类方法，并比较了离线测试和在线求解器集成。傅里叶神经算子已在流体求解器中在线再现了线性和非线性朗道阻尼。文章还讨论了压力张量精度、泛化能力和大规模模拟稳定性等挑战。
Motivation: 大规模等离子体全局模拟需要高阶矩的闭合关系，传统闭合模型难以捕捉动理学效应，机器学习提供了潜在解决方案。
Method: 综述了两类方法：神经网络代理（从多层感知机到傅里叶神经算子）和方程发现（如稀疏回归），并按测试方式（离线/在线）组织文献。
Result: 傅里叶神经算子已能在流体求解器中在线重现线性和非线性朗道阻尼；其他方法在离线参考数据上表现出潜力，但挑战仍存。
Conclusion: 机器学习闭合需解决压力张量精度、分布外泛化和大规模模拟稳定集成等挑战，未来需针对这些方向进一步研究。

papers.title: The Hidden Cost of Approximation in Online Mirror Descent
papers.abstract_en: Online mirror descent (OMD) is a fundamental algorithmic paradigm that underlies many algorithms in optimization, machine learning and sequential decision-making. The OMD iterates are defined as solutions to optimization subproblems which, oftentimes, can be solved only approximately, leading to an inexact version of the algorithm. Nonetheless, existing OMD analyses typically assume an idealized error free setting, thereby limiting our understanding of performance guarantees that should be expected in practice. In this work we initiate a systematic study into inexact OMD, and uncover an intricate relation between regularizer smoothness and robustness to approximation errors. When the regularizer is uniformly smooth, we establish a tight bound on the excess regret due to errors. Then, for barrier regularizers over the simplex and its subsets, we identify a sharp separation: negative entropy requires exponentially small errors to avoid linear regret, whereas log-barrier and Tsallis regularizers remain robust even when the errors are only polynomial. Finally, we show that when the losses are stochastic and the domain is the simplex, negative entropy regains robustness-but this property does not extend to all subsets, where exponentially small errors are again necessary to avoid suboptimal regret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究非精确在线镜像下降（inexact OMD）的性能保证，揭示了正则子光滑性与近似误差鲁棒性之间的复杂关系。当正则子一致光滑时，推导了因误差导致的额外遗憾的紧界；对于单纯形及其子集上的障碍正则子，发现负熵需要指数级小误差以避免线性遗憾，而对数障碍和Tsallis正则子则仅需多项式级误差。在随机损失和单纯形域下，负熵恢复鲁棒性，但此性质不推广到所有子集。
Motivation: 现有OMD分析通常假设理想无误差环境，限制了实践中对性能保证的理解；需要系统研究近似误差对OMD的影响。
Method: 通过理论分析，对不同类型正则子（一致光滑、障碍正则子如负熵、对数障碍、Tsallis）在近似误差下的遗憾界进行刻画，并区分确定性和随机损失场景。
Result: 一致光滑正则子下得到紧的遗憾界；负熵在确定性场景下需要指数级小误差，而对数障碍和Tsallis仅需多项式级误差；随机损失下负熵在单纯形上恢复鲁棒性，但子集上仍需要指数级小误差。
Conclusion: 近似误差对OMD的影响高度依赖于正则子的光滑性及问题结构，实践中应谨慎选择正则子以避免过高的计算精度要求。

papers.title: Linear Mode Connectivity under Data Shifts for Deep Ensembles of Image Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: The phenomenon of linear mode connectivity (LMC) links several aspects of deep learning, including training stability under noisy stochastic gradients, the smoothness and generalization of local minima (basins), the similarity and functional diversity of sampled models, and architectural effects on data processing. In this work, we experimentally study LMC under data shifts and identify conditions that mitigate their impact. We interpret data shifts as an additional source of stochastic gradient noise, which can be reduced through small learning rates and large batch sizes. These parameters influence whether models converge to the same local minimum or to regions of the loss landscape with varying smoothness and generalization. Although models sampled via LMC tend to make similar errors more frequently than those converging to different basins, the benefit of LMC lies in balancing training efficiency against the gains achieved from larger, more diverse ensembles. Code and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/DLR-KI/LMC. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实验研究数据偏移下深度集成的线性模式连接（LMC），发现数据偏移可视为随机梯度噪声，通过小学习率和大批量可缓解其影响。LMC模型倾向于犯相似错误，但能在训练效率与多样性收益之间取得平衡。
Motivation: 理解数据偏移如何影响LMC，并寻找缓解条件，以平衡集成模型的训练效率与性能。
Method: 通过实验分析不同学习率和批大小下LMC的行为，将数据偏移解释为额外的梯度噪声源。
Result: 小学习率和大批量有助于模型收敛到同一局部极小值，减少数据偏移影响；LMC模型更频繁地犯相似错误。
Conclusion: LMC在数据偏移下仍有效，但需谨慎选择超参数；其价值在于平衡效率与集成多样性。
