papers.title: Algebraic Dead Directions in LayerNorm Transformers: A Forward-Pass-Only Diagnostic at LLM Scale
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained transformers sit near singular minima of the loss, where the Fisher information metric degenerates along dead directions: directions in parameter space along which the directional Fisher vanishes. Locating such a direction normally needs a forward pass and an eigendecomposition of activations, or a sampling-based complexity estimate; none returns a direction computable from the network's parameters alone. We give one, for LayerNorm transformers. The inverse-scale direction $γ^{-1}/\|γ^{-1}\|$ of the LayerNorm affine is an exact algebraic kernel of the post-final-norm centred activation covariance, for any input distribution, and induces a corresponding dead direction in parameter space. It is read from the LN scale parameter alone, with no forward or backward pass and no eigensolve: the cheapest dead-direction read, specific to LayerNorm. We test it on $14$ pretrained transformers ($9$ LayerNorm, $5$ RMSNorm; $160$M-$35$B; language and vision objectives). At random initialisation the predicted direction matches the measured bottom singular direction (one forward pass, direct SVD) to four decimal places on $9/9$ LayerNorm models, and is correctly absent on $5/5$ RMSNorm models, which lack the mean-subtraction projector that creates it. On the trained checkpoint the covariance eigenvalue along this direction deepens by ${\sim}10^3\times$ and further dead directions open; the random-init-to-trained gap is a one-forward-pass, per-checkpoint readout of singular structure along the predicted coordinate. Two consequences follow in closed form: the residual stream's smallest singular value is preserved block-to-block on $13/14$ transformers measured on their own input distribution, the one exception (Gemma$4$-$31$B) a genuine dead direction the same read pinpoints; and the kernel direction's presence classifies a transformer's normalisation from the parameters alone.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Empirical companion to arXiv:2606.05957
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对预训练Transformer中损失函数奇异最小值附近的死亡方向（dead directions）问题，提出一种仅需前向传播的诊断方法。该方法利用LayerNorm仿射变换的逆尺度方向作为精确代数核，可直接从参数中读取死亡方向，无需反向传播或特征分解。在14个预训练模型（9个LayerNorm、5个RMSNorm）上验证，预测方向与实测底部奇异方向在9/9个LayerNorm模型上吻合至小数点后四位，并在RMSNorm模型上正确缺失。研究发现，训练后沿该方向的协方差特征值加深约10³倍，且可逐块识别残差流的最小奇异值变化。
Motivation: 现有方法识别死亡方向需要前向传播、激活值特征分解或基于采样的复杂度估计，无法仅从网络参数计算。本文旨在为LayerNorm transformer提供一种仅需参数即可计算的死亡方向诊断方法。
Method: 提出LayerNorm逆尺度方向 γ^{-1}/||γ^{-1}|| 作为后归一化中心激活协方差的精确代数核，该方向直接由LayerNorm尺度参数读出，无需前向/反向传播或特征分解。
Result: 在9个LayerNorm预训练模型上，随机初始化时预测方向与实测底部奇异方向匹配至小数点后四位；在5个RMSNorm模型上正确缺失。训练后协方差特征值沿该方向加深约10³倍。在13/14个模型上残差流最小奇异值逐块得以保持，唯一例外（Gemma4-31B）可被该方法定位。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了LayerNorm transformer中死亡方向的最廉价诊断，且其存在与否可直接从参数出发分类标准化类型（LayerNorm vs RMSNorm）。

papers.title: Concept Flow Models: Anchoring Concept-Based Reasoning with Hierarchical Bottlenecks
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) enhance interpretability by projecting learned features into a human-understandable concept space. Recent approaches leverage vision-language models to generate concept embeddings, reducing the need for manual concept annotations. However, these models suffer from a critical limitation: as the number of concepts approaches the embedding dimension, information leakage increases, enabling the model to exploit spurious or semantically irrelevant correlations and undermining interpretability. In this work, we propose Concept Flow Models (CFMs), which replace the flat bottleneck with a hierarchical, concept-driven decision tree. Each internal node in the hierarchy focuses on a localized subset of discriminative concepts, progressively narrowing the prediction scope. Our framework constructs decision hierarchies from visual embeddings, distributes semantic concepts at each hierarchy level, and trains differentiable concept weights through probabilistic tree traversal. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CFMs match the predictive performance of flat CBMs, while substantially mitigating information leakage by reducing effective concept usage. Furthermore, CFMs yield stepwise decision flows that enable transparent and auditable model reasoning with hierarchical class structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出概念流模型（CFM），用分层瓶颈树替代传统概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的扁平瓶颈，通过在层次结构中分布语义概念来减少信息泄漏。实验表明CFM在保持预测性能的同时，有效降低了概念冗余使用，并生成可审计的分步决策流。
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型在概念数量接近嵌入维度时出现信息泄漏，模型可能利用虚假相关性，损害可解释性。
Method: 提出概念流模型，构建分层概念驱动的决策树，每个内部节点关注局部判别概念子集，通过概率树遍历训练可微分的概念权重。
Result: 在多个基准上，CFM匹配了扁平CBM的预测性能，同时显著缓解信息泄漏，减少了有效概念使用量。
Conclusion: CFM通过分层决策流实现了透明、可审计的推理，适用于具有层次类结构的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimal Ansatz-free Hamiltonian Learning In Situ
papers.abstract_en: Characterizing the features of a Hamiltonian that governs a quantum system serves as a fundamental subroutine of quantum device calibration, signal sensing, and error correction. Recent works proposed protocols have achieved the optimal Heisenberg-limited scaling learning ansatz-free Hamiltonians from their real-time evolutions without fully specifying interaction structures. However, these protocols rely on both deep circuits with interleaving probes and control, and extremely short time resolution, making them difficult to implement on near- and intermediate-term in situ quantum experiments. In this work, we propose a computationally efficient, control-free, and ancilla-free algorithm that uses only Pauli product state preparation and measurement, and learns an ansatz-free Hamiltonian $H$ with $||H||\leqΛ$ in total evolution time of $Θ(\fracΛ{ε^2}\log(\fracΛε))$. The evolution time cost of our algorithm is optimal for any control-free protocols as we further prove a lower bound of $Ω(\fracΛ{ε^2}\log(\fracΛε))$. Technically, our method introduces a randomized-sampling framework that combines band-limited kernel-based time sampling with a displacement sieve for Hamiltonian structure learning. The characteristic probe time resolution depends only on $Λ$ instead of $\varepsilon$, which makes our protocol especially appealing in the high-precision regime for sensing and calibration applications. We also show that the algorithm maintains the same asymptotic total evolution time in the presence of state-preparation-and-measurement (SPAM) noise when the Hamiltonian is local after calibration. Our results demonstrate the fundamental cost of experimentally friendly Hamiltonian learning and provide a practical route to rigorous in situ characterization of near-term quantum platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需预设哈密顿量形式（ansatz-free）的原位哈密顿量学习算法，仅使用泡利积态制备与测量，无需控制或辅助比特。在总演化时间上达到最优的Θ(Λ/ε² log(Λ/ε))缩放，并证明了下界。该方法引入带限核时间采样与位移筛的随机化采样框架，探针时间分辨率仅依赖Λ而非ε，在高精度传感与校准场景中尤其适用，且在局域哈密顿量存在态制备与测量（SPAM）噪声时保持相同渐近复杂度。
Motivation: 现有达到海森堡极限的最优哈密顿量学习方案依赖深度交缠探针电路和极短时间分辨率，难以在近期中等规模量子实验中原位实现。本文旨在设计计算高效、无需控制、无需辅助比特且实验友好的协议。
Method: 提出一个随机化采样框架，结合带限核函数的时间采样与位移筛（displacement sieve）进行哈密顿量结构学习。算法仅需泡利积态制备与测量，探针时间分辨率仅由哈密顿量范数Λ决定，而非精度ε。
Result: 摘要报告该算法在总演化时间上达到最优的Θ(Λ/ε² log(Λ/ε))，并证明了控制无关协议的下界Ω(Λ/ε² log(Λ/ε))。在局域哈密顿量存在SPAM噪声时，算法保持相同渐近总演化时间。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了实验友好哈密顿量学习的基本代价，为近期量子平台的原位严格表征提供了实用路径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种无需预设哈密顿量形式（ansatz-free）的原位哈密顿量学习算法，仅使用泡利积态制备与测量，无需控制或辅助比特。在总演化时间上达到最优的Θ(Λ/ε² log(Λ/ε))缩放，并证明了下界。该方法引入带限核时间采样与位移筛的随机化采样框架，探针时间分辨率仅依赖Λ而非ε，在高精度传感与校准场景中尤其适用，且在局域哈密顿量存在态制备与测量（SPAM）噪声时保持相同渐近复杂度。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有达到海森堡极限的最优哈密顿量学习方案依赖深度交缠探针电路和极短时间分辨率，难以在近期中等规模量子实验中原位实现。本文旨在设计计算高效、无需控制、无需辅助比特且实验友好的协议。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个随机化采样框架，结合带限核函数的时间采样与位移筛（displacement sieve）进行哈密顿量结构学习。算法仅需泡利积态制备与测量，探针时间分辨率仅由哈密顿量范数Λ决定，而非精度ε。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该算法在总演化时间上达到最优的Θ(Λ/ε² log(Λ/ε))，并证明了控制无关协议的下界Ω(Λ/ε² log(Λ/ε))。在局域哈密顿量存在SPAM噪声时，算法保持相同渐近总演化时间。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作展示了实验友好哈密顿量学习的基本代价，为近期量子平台的原位严格表征提供了实用路径。

papers.title: LEAP: Layer-skipping Efficiency via Adaptive Progression for Vision Transformer Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) with Vision Transformer (ViT) backbones, such as DINOv2, have become essential for downstream tasks like object recognition and semantic segmentation. The immense computational requirements of backbones often necessitate distillation into smaller architectures for edge deployment. Feature-based knowledge distillation (KD) often suffers from the teacher-student gap; the student struggles to imitate teacher's complex feature map due to its limited capacity. To mitigate this bottleneck, we propose LEAP: Layer-skipping Efficiency via Adaptive Progression, a training curriculum for ViT feature-based knowledge distillation. By utilizing the teacher's intermediate feature maps as a sequence of progressively more difficult targets, our curriculum allows the student to build a foundational representation before tackling higher-level abstractions. Our results demonstrate that this paradigm significantly accelerates convergence through adaptive difficulty selection across various student model sizes and dataset scales. With our curriculum, the LEAP-distilled ViT-S achieves 90.1% accuracy on ImageNet-100, a +12.24% improvement compared with baseline. On ImageNet-1K, LEAP achieves +3.84% and +7.75% improvement for the instance retrieval task on the Oxford and Paris datasets, respectively. Furthermore, the curriculum enables 25.1% savings in training FLOPs and 21% savings in training time on ImageNet-100 by implementing early-stopping for teacher inference during the initial stages of training. Code is available at https://github.com/KevinZ0217/LEAP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LEAP，一种用于视觉 Transformer 特征级知识蒸馏的训练课程方法，通过利用教师模型的中间特征图作为渐进式难度目标，使学生模型逐步学习。在 ImageNet-100 上，LEAP 蒸馏的 ViT-S 达到 90.1% 准确率，相比基线提升 12.24%；在 ImageNet-1K 的实例检索任务上，在 Oxford 和 Paris 数据集分别提升 3.84% 和 7.75%。此外，课程方法通过早期停止教师推理节省了 25.1% 的训练 FLOPs 和 21% 的训练时间。
Motivation: 特征级知识蒸馏中教师与学生之间的能力差距是主要瓶颈，学生模型因容量有限难以模仿教师复杂的特征图。现有方法未充分利用教师中间层特征的渐进难度来指导学习。
Method: 提出 LEAP 课程，将教师的中间特征图视为一系列渐进式困难目标，通过自适应难度选择，让学生先建立基础表示再学习高层抽象，并实现训练早期的教师推理提前停止。
Result: 在 ImageNet-100 上 ViT-S 准确率 90.1%（+12.24%）；在 ImageNet-1K 的 Oxford 和 Paris 实例检索任务上分别提升 3.84% 和 7.75%。训练 FLOPs 减少 25.1%，训练时间减少 21%。
Conclusion: LEAP 课程通过渐进式目标选择和早期停止有效加速了蒸馏收敛，在不同学生规模和数据集上均取得显著提升。

papers.title: Insulin4RL: Real-Time Insulin Management in the Intensive Care Unit for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning (ORL) offers the potential to improve the quality of clinical decision-making using historical electronic health record (EHR) data. Current training and evaluative practices in this field rely heavily on EHR datasets that have been temporally discretised into fixed, regular time intervals. Discretisation creates fictional representations of complex clinical scenarios and compromises the generalisability of retrospective model evaluations. In this paper, we introduce Insulin4RL, a healthcare ORL dataset featuring naturally irregular inputs and actions from real clinical trajectories. Derived from MIMIC-IV, Insulin4RL comprises over 375,000 labelled decisions across 12,209 patients requiring insulin infusion titration in the Intensive Care Unit. The dataset can thus be used for research into ORL model performance under realistic clinical sampling assumptions. We provide a description of the dataset's structure and characteristics, baseline performance metrics using model-free offline reinforcement learning, and a standardised evaluation protocol using fitted Q-evaluation. We conclude with suggested areas for future research that could be addressed using this resource.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Insulin4RL，一个用于离线强化学习（ORL）的医疗数据集，源自MIMIC-IV，包含超过37.5万个标注决策，用于重症监护病房中胰岛素输注滴定的实时管理。数据集具有自然不规则的时间采样，以克服传统固定时间间隔离散化带来的泛化性问题。论文提供了数据集结构、基线性能指标和标准化评估协议。
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习训练和评估依赖于固定时间间隔离散化的电子健康记录（EHR）数据集，这创建了虚构的临床场景表示，损害了模型回顾性评估的泛化性。
Method: 提出Insulin4RL数据集，基于MIMIC-IV构建，包含12,209名患者的自然不规则输入和动作轨迹，并提供了无模型离线强化学习的基线性能指标以及拟合Q评估的标准化评估协议。
Result: 摘要报告了数据集包含超过375,000个标注决策，并给出了基线性能指标，但未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 数据集可用于研究现实临床采样假设下的ORL模型性能，并提出了未来研究方向，如处理不规则时间序列和临床决策支持。

papers.title: Can In-Context Learning Support Intrinsic Curiosity?
papers.abstract_en: Effective machine learning depends not only on how we model data, but also on what data we choose to collect. While large sequence models have revolutionized data modeling, the problem of automated data selection, or "intrinsic curiosity", remains a significant challenge. Classic approaches incentivize exploration by rewarding an agent based on its "learning progress", which measures how much a newly acquired observation improves a world model's predictive ability. However, evaluating these rewards traditionally requires expensive inner loops of gradient descent updates within each trajectory, rendering them computationally impractical at scale. In this work, we investigate whether the emergent in-context learning (ICL) capabilities of sequence models can eliminate this bottleneck by serving as immediate, update-free world models. Specifically, we evaluate whether an exploration policy can be trained to maximize learning progress, using solely the prediction errors and counterfactual context manipulations of an in-context learner. We first prove that in general Markov decision processes, this is in fact impossible in an unbiased way: the resulting intrinsic rewards either suffer from nuisance terms that bias their estimation of true learning progress, or they cannot be implemented using an in-context learner's prediction errors. Conversely, we prove a positive result for a broad subclass of non-temporal settings, encompassing active learning and Bayesian Experimental Design: here, ICL-derived rewards successfully bound and asymptotically converge to the true learning progress. We corroborate our theory with controlled experiments across continuous and symbolic environments, demonstrating that our ICL-driven framework successfully trains curious data-collection policies that explore optimally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究序列模型的内在好奇心（intrinsic curiosity）问题，探索是否能利用上下文学习（ICL）作为无需梯度更新的世界模型来驱动探索策略。理论证明在一般马尔可夫决策过程中，直接使用ICL的预测误差估计学习进步存在偏差或无法实现，但在非时间设置（如主动学习、贝叶斯实验设计）中，ICL驱动的奖励可以收敛到真实学习进步。实验在连续和符号环境中验证了框架的有效性。
Motivation: 传统基于学习进步（learning progress）的内在好奇心方法需要昂贵的梯度内循环更新，计算上不可扩展。本文尝试利用序列模型的上下文学习能力消除这一瓶颈。
Method: 提出使用上下文学习（ICL）作为即时、免更新的世界模型，通过预测误差和反事实上下文操作来训练探索策略最大化学习进步。理论分析了其可行性的条件。
Result: 理论证明：一般马尔可夫决策中ICL无法无偏估计学习进步；但在非时间任务（如主动学习）中，ICL驱动的奖励可以渐近收敛到真实学习进步。实验在连续和符号环境中验证了ICL驱动的探索策略能够实现最优探索。
Conclusion: 上下文学习在特定设置下可以支持内在好奇心，但一般马尔可夫决策中存在根本性局限。

papers.title: Diffusion Language Models: An Experimental Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized language modeling through autoregressive generation, enabling strong performance across a wide range of tasks. Recently, Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as an alternative paradigm that generates text through iterative denoising rather than next-token prediction, allowing parallel refinement of entire sequences. While numerous diffusion-based architectures have been proposed, differences in evaluation protocols, datasets, inference budgets, and generation hyperparameters make it difficult to compare their capabilities and understand the trade-offs they offer. In this work, we present a systematic experimental analysis of modern DLMs. Specifically, we evaluate eight state-of-the-art DLMs across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, translation, knowledge, and structured problem solving, while explicitly considering both generation quality and computational efficiency. Beyond downstream evaluation, we analyze the impact of key inference-time factors, including denoising steps, context length, block size, and parallel unmasking strategies, and complement large-scale experiments with controlled comparisons of smaller models trained under identical conditions. Our analysis highlights the strengths and limitations of diffusion-based language modeling across different tasks, architectures, and inference budgets. We show that the behavior of DLMs is strongly influenced by generation-time design choices, leading to distinct trade-offs between performance and computational efficiency. Overall, our study provides practical insights into the capabilities and deployment characteristics of contemporary DLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对扩散语言模型（DLMs）进行了系统实验分析，评估了8种最先进的DLM在8个基准上的表现，涵盖推理、编码、翻译、知识和结构化问题解决，同时考虑生成质量和计算效率。分析了推理阶段的关键因素（去噪步数、上下文长度、块大小、并行去掩蔽策略），并进行了受控比较。结果表明DLM的行为强烈受生成时设计选择的影响，存在性能与效率的权衡。
Motivation: 尽管已有多种扩散语言模型，但评估协议、数据集、推理预算和超参数的差异使得难以比较其能力和权衡。本文旨在通过系统性实验分析，提供现代DLM的实用见解。
Method: 对8种最先进DLM在8个基准上进行评估，包括推理、编码、翻译、知识和结构化问题解决。分析推理阶段因素（去噪步数、上下文长度、块大小、并行去掩蔽策略），并在相同条件下训练较小模型进行受控比较。
Result: 摘要指出DLM的行为受生成时设计选择强烈影响，产生性能与计算效率之间的不同权衡。
Conclusion: 研究提供了当代DLM的能力和部署特性的实用见解，强调了生成时设计选择的重要性。

papers.title: Secure Coding Drift in LLM-Assisted Post-Quantum Cryptography Development: A Gamified Fix
papers.abstract_en: The transition to Post Quantum Cryptography (PQC) introduces considerable implementation complexity, requiring strict adherence to constant-time execution, side channel resistance, and precise parametrisation. Simultaneously, large language models (LLMs) are heavily embedded in software development workflows, including cryptographic engineering. While LLMs improve productivity, evidence shows that they frequently generate insecure or suboptimal code, particularly in security critical domains. This paper introduces Secure Coding Drift in PQC, a novel socio technical vulnerability model capturing the gradual degradation of secure coding practices due to sustained reliance on LLM-generated code. Unlike prior work that focuses on static vulnerabilities, we conceptualise security risk as a longitudinal behavioural phenomenon rising from human AI interaction. To mitigate this, we propose a gamified, LLM augmented secure coding framework that embeds adversarial evaluation, behavioural feedback, and security scoring into development workflows. Our approach reframes LLMs from passive assistants into active security co-pilots, contributing toward safer PQC implementation in AI mediated environments.
papers.comment: Accepted for 2026 SIGIR Workshop on Vulnerabilities in Generative Systems for Information Retrieval track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出后量子密码学（PQC）开发中的安全编码漂移概念，即持续依赖LLM生成代码导致安全实践逐渐退化。作者设计了一个游戏化、LLM增强的安全编码框架，通过对抗评估、行为反馈和安全评分将LLM从被动助手转为主动安全副驾驶，以缓解该风险。
Motivation: PQC实现要求严格的安全编码规范，而LLM广泛用于软件工程但常生成不安全代码；现有工作关注静态漏洞，忽略了长期人-AI交互导致的安全实践退化。
Method: 提出一个游戏化的LLM增强安全编码框架，包含对抗性评估、行为反馈和安全评分机制，将LLM重新定位为主动的安全协同驾驶者。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在通过行为干预和即时反馈，减少LLM辅助开发中的安全编码漂移，促进更安全的PQC实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring Curriculum Alignment across Topical Coverage, Competency, and Cognitive Depth: A Longitudinal Framework Applied to CS2013 and CS2023
papers.abstract_en: Undergraduate computer science is governed by international curricular guidelines revised about once a decade, yet programs lack a reliable, reproducible way to measure how completely they cover the current guidelines and how that coverage shifts when the guidelines are restructured. We address this with a human-in-the-loop pipeline that measures a program's coverage of an external body of knowledge, applied longitudinally to one accredited BSc in Computer Science against Computer Science Curricula 2013 (CS2013) and 2023 (CS2023). The pipeline represents the program and each guideline as structured corpora, generates candidate course-to-knowledge-unit matches by semantic retrieval, and confirms them through human judgment under an explicit coverage definition. Of seven benchmarked retrievers, a reciprocal-rank-fusion ensemble was strongest, and a reputed long-context model underperformed a small sentence model, so retriever choice must be measured. Both maps were validated by an independent second rater (Cohen's kappa 0.64 for CS2023, 0.69 for CS2013). The program covers 49.7% of CS2023 and 50.9% of CS2013 knowledge units, near-constant across a decade. Extending the same retrieve-then-confirm design to competency articulation and cognitive depth shows that the program articulates the competency for ~88% of covered units under each guideline, yet delivers it at the recommended depth for 76% of present units under CS2023 against 95% under CS2013, a gap reflecting the newer guideline's raised expectations, not the program. The longitudinal comparison separates persistent structural gaps (parallel and distributed computing, foundations of programming languages, systems fundamentals), uncovered against both guidelines and ABET, from differences that reflect the standard's evolution. The instrument is reusable and available from the authors on request.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个人类参与的管道（human-in-the-loop pipeline），用于衡量计算机科学课程对课程指南（如CS2013和CS2023）的覆盖程度，包括主题覆盖、能力表述和认知深度。对某个认证的计算机科学学士学位进行纵向分析，发现该课程覆盖约50%的知识单元，且十年间变化不大。一个新的发现是，在认知深度方面，CS2023的期望更高，导致课程满足深度要求的比例从95%下降到76%。
Motivation: 大学计算机科学课程缺乏可靠且可重复的方法来测量其对最新课程指南的覆盖程度，以及在指南更新时覆盖情况如何变化。
Method: 提出一个人类参与的管道，将课程和指南表示为结构化语料库，通过语义检索生成课程与知识单元的候选匹配，再由人工根据明确的覆盖定义确认。使用七种检索器基准测试，最优的是倒数秩融合集成（reciprocal-rank-fusion ensemble），而长上下文模型表现不如小句模型。
Result: 该课程覆盖CS2023知识单元的49.7%，CS2013的50.9%，几乎不变。在能力表述方面，约88%的覆盖单元有表述；但认知深度方面，CS2023下76%满足深度要求，CS2013下95%，反映出新指南期望提高。独立评分者一致性良好（Cohen's kappa 0.64/0.69）。识别出持久的结构性差距。
Conclusion: 该工具是可重复使用的，可从作者处获取。纵向比较区分了持久的结构性差距与因标准演进导致的差异。

papers.title: Deontic Policies for Runtime Governance of Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agentic AI systems driven by Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce a new class of security, privacy, and compliance challenges: an agent that can invoke tools, manipulate data, install software, and coordinate with peer agents across organizational boundaries must be constrained not just by authentication and access control, but by the full structure of enterprise governance. This includes specifying what agents are permitted and prohibited from doing, what they areobliged to do after certain actions (e.g., notify the CISO), under what conditions a standing obligation may be waived, and which rules take precedence when policies conflict. This governance problem exceeds what current policy engines provide. Systems such as XACML, Rego, and Cedar address only the permit/prohibit subset of this governance structure. They do not provide obligation lifecycle management, meta-policy conflict resolution, dispensations that waive obligations in specific circumstances, and ontological reasoning over domain class hierarchies commonly found in applications such as healthcare, cybersecurity, or data privacy. We propose AgenticRei, which realizes key governance requirements such as obligations, dispensations, policy conflict resolutions, and reasoning over policies, as well as the basic permit/prohibit constraints. We use a deontic policy language built on the Rei framework, expressed as OWL (Web Ontology Language) and evaluated at runtime by a high-performance logic engine entirely outside the LLM. The same pipeline governs both tool invocations by the agent and agent-to-agent messages. We show through examples that deontic policies capture governance constraints around security and privacy that mostly cannot be expressed in current production engines. Our approach composes naturally with industry-standard frameworks like A2AS.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. To be published in the 2026 IEEE Symposium on Agentic Services which is part of the IEEE Conference on Web Services
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM驱动的自主智能体系统在安全、隐私与合规方面的治理挑战，提出AgenticRei框架，基于Rei的规范策略语言，用OWL表达并通过高性能逻辑引擎在运行时执行，支持义务、豁免、冲突解决等，超越了现有XACML/Rego/Cedar策略引擎的能力。
Motivation: 现有策略引擎（XACML、Rego、Cedar）仅支持许可/禁止，无法处理义务生命周期管理、元策略冲突、豁免、领域本体推理等企业治理需求，而LLM agent会跨组织调用工具、操作数据，需要更完整的治理。
Method: 提出AgenticRei，基于Rei框架构建规范策略语言，用OWL表示策略，在LLM外部用高性能逻辑引擎在运行时评估，同时约束工具调用和agent间通信。
Result: 通过例子展示规范策略能捕捉当前生产引擎大多无法表达的安全与隐私治理约束，并与A2AS等行业标准框架自然兼容。
Conclusion: 作者认为规范策略（deontic policies）能有效补充现有治理体系的不足，为agentic AI系统提供运行时治理。

papers.title: Scaling Generative Foundation Models for Chest Radiography with Rectified Flow Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the first generative foundation model for chest radiograph synthesis trained from scratch at the billion-parameter scale. Existing radiographic AI models often suffer from poor generalisation across patient subpopulations, institutions, and acquisition settings, resulting in limited real-world clinical utility. Controlled, high-fidelity synthesis of chest radiographs is a promising path toward diversifying clinical datasets and evaluating the robustness of diagnostic models. Therefore, we present the largest specialist generative foundation model for chest radiographs to date, with over 1.3B parameters, trained for 1.6T tokens on a curated, heterogeneous dataset comprising 1.2M radiographs and clinical expert-guided metadata. Our model supports controllable radiograph generation and editing across multiple demographic subgroups, acquisition views, and a dozen pathologies. Moreover, we significantly advance the state of the art in radiograph synthesis fidelity, producing images that are indistinguishable from real radiographs to clinical experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了首个在十亿参数规模上从头训练的胸部X光片生成基础模型，采用矫正流变换器（Rectified Flow Transformers），在包含120万张X光片和临床专家指导元数据的异构数据集上训练了1.6万亿tokens。模型支持可控的放射图像生成和编辑，覆盖多个亚群、拍摄视角和十多种病理，生成的图像在临床专家眼中与真实放射图像无法区分。
Motivation: 现有放射学AI模型在不同患者亚群、机构和采集设置下泛化能力差，导致临床实用性有限。高质量可控的合成数据有助于多样化临床数据集并评估诊断模型的鲁棒性。
Method: 训练了13亿参数的基础生成模型，采用矫正流变换器架构，在包含120万张X光片和临床专家指导元数据的异构数据集上训练了1.6万亿tokens，支持可控的多样本生成和编辑。
Result: 显著提升了放射图像合成保真度，生成的图像在临床专家评估中与真实图像无法区分，并超越以往技术水准。
Conclusion: 这是迄今最大的胸部X光片专业生成基础模型，推动了放射图像合成的前沿，有望改善临床数据多样性和模型评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 3D-DLP: Self-Supervised 3D Object-Centric Scene Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce 3D-DLP, a self-supervised object-centric representation learning model that decomposes scene-level RGB-D or voxel observations into a set of 3D latent particles. Building on the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework, each particle encodes disentangled attributes, including 3D keypoint position, bounding box dimensions, and appearance features, and represents a distinct entity in the scene. The model learns interpretable per-particle segmentation maps through an end-to-end self-supervised reconstruction objective. We demonstrate on both simulated and real-world datasets that the learned latent space is interpretable and controllable: by manipulating particle positions and decoding, we can generate novel scene configurations. Furthermore, we show that leveraging these compact 3D latent particles for downstream robotic manipulation improves performance over baselines that either lack explicit 3D information or rely on memory-intensive dense 3D inputs without object-centric structure. Code and videos are available at https://eubooks3003.github.io/3d-dlp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出3D-DLP，一种自监督的以物体为中心的3D场景表示学习方法，将场景级RGB-D或体素观测分解为一组3D潜在粒子。每个粒子编码解耦的属性，包括3D关键点位置、边界框尺寸和外观特征，并通过端到端的自监督重建目标学习可解释的逐粒子分割图。在模拟和真实数据集上展示了粒子操作的可控性，以及在下游机器人操作任务中的性能提升。
Motivation: 现有方法要么缺乏显式3D信息，要么依赖无物体中心结构的内存密集型密集3D输入，限制了场景理解和下游任务的性能。
Method: 基于Deep Latent Particles (DLP)框架，将RGB-D或体素观测分解为3D潜在粒子，通过自监督重建目标学习粒子属性及分割图。
Result: 在模拟和真实数据集上，通过操纵粒子位置和解码可生成新场景配置；用于下游机器人操作时，性能优于缺少3D信息或使用密集3D输入的基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调3D-DLP学习到的潜在空间具有可解释性和可控性，且其紧凑的3D粒子表示在机器人操作等下游任务中具有优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Playful Agentic Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current agentic robot systems can write executable Code-as-Policy programs, observe feedback, and revise behavior across multiple attempts, but they remain largely task-driven: reusable skills are acquired only after explicit instructions. We study Playful Agentic Robot Learning, where an embodied coding agent uses self-directed play as a continual skill-learning stage before downstream tasks arrive. We introduce RATs, Robotics Agent Teams designed for play-time skill acquisition. During play, RATs proposes novel yet learnable exploratory tasks, plans and executes robot-code policies, verifies intermediate progress, diagnoses failures, retries with dense, step-level feedback, and distills successful executions into a persistent code skill library. At test time, the agent reuses relevant skills from this frozen library to help solve new tasks. Experiments in LIBERO-PRO and MolmoSpaces show that play-learned skills improve held-out downstream tasks over no-play and random-play baselines, with 20.6 and 17.0 percentage-point gains over CaP-Agent0 on LIBERO-PRO and MolmoSpaces, respectively. Moreover, the learned skills can be plugged into other inference-time Code-as-Policy agents by simply retrieving them into the context, improving RoboSuite and real-world transfer by 8.9 and 8.8 points, respectively, without finetuning the underlying model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Playful Agentic Robot Learning 方法，让具身编码智能体通过自我导向的玩耍阶段持续学习技能，建立持久代码技能库，并在下游任务中重用。方法包括 RATs 框架，在玩耍中自主探索任务、执行代码策略、诊断失败并蒸馏成功经验。实验表明，玩耍学习的技能在 LIBERO-PRO 和 MolmoSpaces 上分别提升下游任务性能 20.6 和 17.0 个百分点，且技能库可无微调迁移至其他智能体。
Motivation: 当前具身机器人系统多任务驱动，仅在收到明确指令后获取可重用技能，缺乏自我探索式的持续学习阶段，限制了技能积累和泛化能力。
Method: 提出 RATs (Robotics Agent Teams)，在玩耍阶段自主提出可学习探索任务，规划并执行机器人代码策略，验证中间进展，诊断失败并利用密集步骤级反馈重试，将成功执行蒸馏为持久代码技能库；测试时从冻结库中检索相关技能辅助新任务。
Result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 和 MolmoSpaces 上，玩耍学习的技能使下游任务性能分别比无玩耍基线提升 20.6 和 17.0 个百分点；技能库可插入其他推理时 Code-as-Policy 智能体，在 RoboSuite 和真实世界迁移中分别提升 8.9 和 8.8 点，无需微调。
Conclusion: 自导玩耍式技能学习能显著提升下游任务表现，且所学技能具有良好的可迁移性和通用性。

papers.title: MortarBench: Evaluating Mortgage Loan Origination Agents
papers.abstract_en: Loan origination is the process by which a lender creates a new loan, from application and underwriting through approval and funding. This process serves a critical role in evaluating the eligibility and level of risk posed by an applicant. Recently, firms have begun using mortgage loan agents to augment human loan officers, despite a lack of any public benchmark. To fill this gap, we present MortarBench, a loan origination agent benchmark. MortarBench uses a financial data synthesis and mutation pipeline to generate examples with broad edge case coverage that match real-world distributions and questions. We find that state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) perform poorly, with closed-source models achieving at most 77.1\% exact match accuracy. We also discover systematic biases in LLM perception of foreignness related to non-English names. Noting these weaknesses, we introduce CRIT, a confidence calibration framework. Our method increases accuracy to 80.5\% while improving risk management steering and reducing bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MortarBench，一个用于评估抵押贷款发起代理（loan origination agent）的基准。该基准通过金融数据合成和变异流水线生成覆盖边缘案例的样本，并匹配真实分布。实验发现，最先进的大型语言模型（LLMs）表现不佳，闭源模型最高精确匹配准确率仅为77.1%，并且存在与非英语姓名相关的对外国性（foreignness）的系统性偏见。作者还引入了CRIT置信度校准框架，将准确率提升至80.5%，同时改进了风险管理控制并减少了偏见。
Motivation: 抵押贷款发起流程在评估申请人资格和风险水平中至关重要，但缺乏公开基准来评估自动化代理的性能。
Method: 提出MortarBench基准，包含金融数据合成和变异流水线以生成边缘案例；同时提出CRIT置信度校准框架。
Result: 闭源LLMs在MortarBench上最高精确匹配准确率仅77.1%，CRIT框架将准确率提升至80.5%，并减少偏见。
Conclusion: LLMs在贷款发起任务上表现不足且存在偏见，CRIT框架可部分缓解这些问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does Text Actually Help? Uncovering and Resolving Text Collapse in Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal time series forecasting, which pairs numerical sequences with domain-relevant textual reports, promises to inject world knowledge into forecasting pipelines. However, we uncover a critical failure mode in existing frameworks that we term text collapse: the text branch converges to a content-independent transformation, contributing negligible discriminative signal regardless of the input description. We argue that text collapse is a consequence of a fundamental asymmetry in time series forecasting: the numerical input is strongly autocorrelated with the output, making the numerical backbone inherently dominant, while the text branch, despite carrying complementary and often critical information, is insufficiently utilized, leading to its systematic underexploitation. To address this, we propose \textbf{REST-TS} (\textbf{R}esidual-\textbf{E}xclusive \textbf{S}upervision for \textbf{T}ext in \textbf{T}ime \textbf{S}eries), which turns the asymmetry into a design principle: the numerical backbone produces its own independent numerical forecast, and the text branch is exclusively supervised to predict the structured components of the residual, the prediction gap that numbers cannot explain. Because no numerical pathway can reduce these losses, the text branch must extract genuine content from the input description. Evaluated across diverse real-world domains and backbone architectures, REST-TS achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently demonstrates greater text-branch utilization than existing frameworks, providing strong empirical evidence that supervising the text branch on the residual compels it to extract genuine content from the input.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态时间序列预测中文本分支存在“文本塌陷”问题，即文本分支收敛为内容无关的变换，几乎不贡献判别信号。提出REST-TS方法，将数值主干独立预测，文本分支专门监督残差（数值无法解释的预测差距），从而强制文本提取真实内容。在多个真实领域和主干架构上取得SOTA，并证实了文本分支利用率的提升。
Motivation: 现有多模态时间序列预测中，数值主干与输出强自相关，导致文本分支被系统性地利用不足，出现文本塌陷问题，限制了知识注入的效果。
Method: REST-TS：数值主干独立产生数值预测，文本分支仅被监督去预测残差（即数值预测与真实值之间的结构成分），因为数值通路无法减少残差损失，文本分支必须从输入描述中提取真实内容。
Result: 在多个真实世界领域和不同骨干架构上达到SOTA性能，文本分支利用率显著高于现有框架，实证表明监督残差能迫使文本提取真实内容。
Conclusion: 文本塌陷是多模态时间序列预测的关键失败模式，REST-TS通过将文本分支监督置于残差上有效解决了该问题，为文本在多模态预测中的作用提供了新设计原则。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Spectral Retrieval-Augmented Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting leverages historical patterns to predict future values, but traditional methods face challenges when dealing with complex, non-stationary patterns that are difficult to memorize during training. Retrieval-augmented approaches have emerged as promising solutions by retrieving similar historical patterns to enhance predictions. However, existing retrieval methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: spectral blindness, which overlooks critical frequency-domain characteristics that capture underlying periodic structures, and temporal recency, which treats all historical data equally without emphasizing recent, more relevant patterns. In this paper, we propose SpecReTF, a novel retrieval method that addresses these issues by converting time series into windowed frequency representations, measuring similarity with a combined metric that captures both amplitude and phase information. To balance recency and historical context, we apply an exponential moving average weighting scheme that emphasizes recent windows. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that SpecReTF outperforms time-domain retrieval methods, achieving superior forecasting accuracy across diverse, non-stationary time series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpecReTF，一种频谱检索增强的时间序列预测方法，通过将时间序列转换为窗口化频域表示，结合幅值和相位信息的相似度度量，并应用指数移动平均加权方案来平衡新近性和历史上下文。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，SpecReTF优于传统时域检索方法，在非平稳时间序列上取得了更优的预测精度。
Motivation: 现有检索增强方法存在频谱盲性（忽略频域特征）和时间新近性（平等对待所有历史数据）两个根本限制，导致在复杂非平稳时间序列预测中表现不佳。
Method: 提出SpecReTF，将时间序列转换为窗口化频域表示，使用结合幅值和相位信息的组合度量来测量相似性，并采用指数移动平均加权方案以突出近期窗口。
Result: 在多种基准数据集上，SpecReTF在预测精度上全面超越了时域检索方法，尤其适用于非平稳时间序列场景。
Conclusion: 该工作通过频域检索和指数加权机制有效解决了频谱盲性和时间新近性问题，提升了检索增强时间序列预测的性能。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Spectral DPPs via NEPv: A Scalable Continuous Relaxation of Determinantal MAP for Diversity-Aware Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a small, diverse, high-quality subset from a massive pool of candidates is a recurring primitive in modern machine learning -- data curation and coreset selection for training and fine-tuning large models, active-learning batch acquisition, prompt and exemplar selection for in-context learning, retrieval diversification, and experimental design. Determinantal Point Processes (\DPP s) give a principled, well-calibrated notion of diversity for this task, but their \emph{MAP} objective -- pick a size-$k$ subset $S$ maximizing $\logdet(L_S)$ -- is NP-hard, and the standard greedy and sampling algorithms scale superlinearly in the ground-set size $n$. This cost is prohibitive precisely in the data-centric regime where diversity matters most, where $n$ ranges over millions to billions of candidate examples, features, or embeddings. We recast \DPP-MAP as a continuous optimization problem over the Stiefel manifold, and show that its first-order optimality conditions form a \emph{Nonlinear Eigenvalue Problem with eigenvector dependency} (\NEPv) of a previously unstudied form. This \NEPv\ admits a self-consistent field (\SCF) iteration with a spectral-gap-based local contraction guarantee, giving a principled iterative solver where the diversity objective drives an eigenvector-dependent operator. The resulting algorithm, \OurMethod, requires only matrix-vector products with the kernel and runs in time $O\!\big((ndk+nk^2)\,t\big)$ for a small number of iterations $t$, scaling near-linearly in $n$ and integrating directly with low-rank and feature-map kernels common in ML. This paper focuses on the relaxation, solver, and scaling analysis; full real-data benchmarking is left to a planned empirical study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可扩展的连续松弛方法，将NEPv（特征向量依赖的非线性特征值问题）引入行列式点过程（DPP）的MAP求解，通过自洽场迭代实现近线性时间复杂度的多样性感知子集选择。该方法仅需矩阵-向量乘积，适用于大规模（n百万至十亿）数据集。
Motivation: DPP-MAP目标（最大化logdet(L_S)）是NP难的，且现有贪心或采样算法在地面集大小n极大时计算成本过高，限制了数据多样性选择在大规模机器学习场景中的应用。
Method: 将DPP-MAP重新表述为Stiefel流形上的连续优化问题，其最优性条件形成一类新的NEPv，并设计自洽场迭代求解器，具有基于谱间隔的局部收缩保证。算法复杂度为O((ndk + nk²)t)，t为迭代次数。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅给出算法复杂度分析和理论收敛性保证；实际基准测试留待后续实证研究。
Conclusion: 本文专注于连续松弛、求解器和可扩展性分析，为DPP-MAP提供原则性迭代方法，可直接集成低秩和特征图核，但缺乏真实数据上的性能验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Representational Limit of Scalar Interactions: An Interventional Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Signed pairwise interaction scores fundamentally conflate uniqueness (U), redundancy (R), and synergy (S). We prove this on a minimal 3-way XOR structural causal model: faithful indices such as Shapley-Taylor return zero per pair, whereas projective indices such as Shapley Interaction spread the third-order effect into pair scalars that conflate the three mechanisms. We introduce Stochastic Hi-Fi, a post-hoc, retraining-free predictability decomposition that estimates per-feature U/R/S profiles by interventional masked inference. The estimator provides exact interventional semantics, finite-sample Monte Carlo bounds, strict variance reduction from coupled diamond sampling, and uniform finite-vocabulary convergence. Across tabular SCMs, Stochastic Hi-Fi recovers structure missed by scalar baselines (up to 411x larger interaction-magnitude recovery ratios). It also separates redundant and synergistic heads in the GPT-2 IOI circuit. On NIH ChestX-ray14, Stochastic Hi-Fi matches GradCAM on Pointing Game and improves substantially on Deletion AUC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明标量成对交互分数（如Shapley-Taylor、Shapley Interaction）无法区分唯一性（U）、冗余性（R）和协同性（S），并在三元XOR结构因果模型上给出理论证明。作者提出Stochastic Hi-Fi，一种无需重新训练的后验预测分解方法，通过干预性掩码推理估计每个特征的U/R/S轮廓，提供精确干预语义、有限样本蒙特卡洛界和方差缩减，在表格SCM、GPT-2 IOI电路和NIH ChestX-ray14上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有标量成对交互分数将U、R、S三种机制混为一谈，无法揭示特征间的真实交互类型，限制了模型可解释性。
Method: 提出Stochastic Hi-Fi，一种基于干预性掩码推理的后验预测分解方法，利用耦合菱形采样实现严格方差缩减，并为有限词汇量提供一致收敛保证。
Result: 在表格SCM上，Stochastic Hi-Fi比标量基线恢复结构时交互幅度恢复比提高多达411倍；在GPT-2 IOI电路上成功分离冗余和协同注意力头；在NIH ChestX-ray14上，Pointing Game匹配GradCAM，Deletion AUC显著优于基线。
Conclusion: Stochastic Hi-Fi能以精确干预语义分解特征贡献，揭示标量方法遗漏的结构信息，但计算成本可能较高（未提及具体限制）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlexLAM: Resolving the Bottleneck Trade-off in Latent Action Learning
papers.abstract_en: Latent actions provide a compact interface between action-free video and downstream decision-making, yet existing Latent Action Models (LAMs) force every transition through a fixed-capacity bottleneck. We identify a bottleneck trade-off: overly tight codes can discard transition cues needed for action alignment, while overly loose codes preserve additional transition variation that must be resolved when alignment labels are scarce or narrowly distributed. FlexLAM replaces this fixed capacity with variable-length latent actions trained by nested dropout, yielding prefix-valid codes that capture compact transition structure first and add detail only when needed, without new architectures or losses. A single FlexLAM matches or surpasses separately trained fixed-capacity LAMs at every evaluated token budget under standard scarce-label supervision and under a low-return single-task alignment stress test, indicating that FlexLAM is not merely adjustable at inference time but learns a better latent-action interface at the same token budgets. The same model supports inference-time token-budget adjustment without retraining, and FlexLAM improves Ego4D transition reconstruction. These results suggest that variable-length latent actions are an architecture-free, drop-in upgrade to the fixed-capacity bottleneck in latent action models, latent-action world models, and video-pretrained action interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlexLAM，一种变长潜在动作模型，通过嵌套 dropout 训练生成前缀有效编码，以解决固定容量瓶颈的权衡问题。在标准稀缺标签监督和低回报单任务对齐压力测试下，单个 FlexLAM 匹配或超越每个评估 token 预算下的单独训练固定容量 LAM，并支持推理时调整 token 预算。改进 Ego4D 过渡重建。
Motivation: 现有潜在动作模型（LAM）强制每个过渡通过固定容量瓶颈，导致紧密编码丢弃过渡线索、松散编码引入额外变化，在标签稀缺时难以对齐。
Method: 采用变量长度潜在动作，通过嵌套 dropout 训练，先捕获紧凑过渡结构，仅在需要时添加细节，无需新架构或损失函数。
Result: 在标准稀缺标签监督和低回报单任务对齐压力测试下，单个 FlexLAM 匹配或超越每个评估 token 预算下的单独训练固定容量 LAM；支持推理时调整 token 预算；改进 Ego4D 过渡重建。
Conclusion: 变量长度潜在动作可作为无架构、即插即用的升级，替代潜在动作模型、世界模型及视频预训练动作接口中的固定容量瓶颈。

summary_sections.result: 在标准稀缺标签监督和低回报单任务对齐压力测试下，单个 FlexLAM 匹配或超越每个评估 token 预算下的单独训练固定容量 LAM；支持推理时调整 token 预算；改进 Ego4D 过渡重建。
summary_sections.conclusion: 变量长度潜在动作可作为无架构、即插即用的升级，替代潜在动作模型、世界模型及视频预训练动作接口中的固定容量瓶颈。

papers.title: JustDiag!: A Diagnostic Justification Engine for Accountable Root Cause Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can produce fluent root cause analyses, but fluent final answers alone are insufficient evidence for accountability in high-stakes operations. In real incident response, engineers need to know what evidence supported a diagnosis, which alternatives were considered, where contradictions remained, and whether the system resolved the case or preserved uncertainty. We address this gap with JustDiag, a diagnostic justification engine for RCA that maintains an explicit process state over evidence, findings, competing hypotheses, conflicts, and next checks. We evaluated the system on 66 real-world incidents using a two-layer protocol that separately scores final-answer quality and process quality. Relative to a matched control without diagnostic justification, JustDiag achieved stronger outcome and process scores, while accepting slightly lower terminal completion due to more calibrated non-closure. These results suggest that accountable RCA requires explicit diagnostic justification artifacts and process-aware evaluation, not only fluent final answers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JustDiag，一个用于可问责根因分析（RCA）的诊断理由引擎。它维护显式的过程状态，包含证据、发现、竞争假设、冲突和下一步检查，以弥补大语言模型仅输出流畅结论而缺乏可解释性的不足。在 66 个真实事件上，采用双层评估协议分别打分最终答案质量和过程质量，实验显示 JustDiag 在结果和过程得分上均优于匹配对照，但终端完成率略低，因为其不关闭（non-closure）更校准。作者认为可问责 RCA 需要显式的诊断理由工件和过程感知评估，而非仅依赖流畅的最终答案。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型生成的根因分析虽然流畅，但在高风险运维中，工程师需要知道支持诊断的证据、考虑过的替代方案、存在的矛盾以及系统是否保留不确定性，仅是流畅的最终答案不足以支撑可问责性。
Method: JustDiag 诊断理由引擎通过维护一个显式的过程状态来追踪证据、发现、竞争假设、冲突以及下一步检查，从而为根因分析提供结构化的理由生成。
Result: 在 66 个真实事件上，使用双层协议分别评估最终答案质量和过程质量，相比匹配对照，JustDiag 在结果和过程得分上更强，但终端完成率略低，因其更倾向于校准的不关闭（non-closure）。
Conclusion: 论文强调可问责的根因分析需要显式的诊断理由工件和过程感知评估，而不仅仅依赖流畅的最终答案。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Signatures of Reasoning: Free-Energy and Spectral-Form-Factor Diagnostics for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination detection in large language models (LLMs) is deployment-critical, and recent work shows that the spectrum of attention-derived graph Laplacians carries strong signal about reasoning quality. Prior spectral diagnostics, however, summarize the Laplacian spectrum by a handful of eigenvalues or hand-picked scalars, leaving most of its structure unused. We propose Free-Energy Signatures (Fes), a spectral descriptor that treats each layer's attention Laplacian as a Hamiltonian and extracts its thermodynamic potentials partition function, free energy, spectral entropy, heat capacity together with the random-matrix-theory (RMT) spectral form factor. We prove three results: (i)~Lipschitz stability of Fes under attention perturbation; (ii)~an expressiveness result showing that Fes enriches finite spectral summaries and approximates moment-derived spectral functionals under explicit regularity and grid-resolution assumptions; and (iii)~a finite-sample PAC bound on the AUROC of a training-free detector built from Fes. Empirically, across six open-weight LLMs and six benchmarks, a lightweight probe on Fes descriptors achieves the strongest aggregate AUROC among attention-spectral baselines, improving over LapEig by $+6.5$ AUROC points and over GoR-4 by $+2.4$ points on average, while requiring no update to the underlying LLM. In the fully unsupervised setting, an RMT-deviation score achieves mean AUROC $0.71$, providing a label-free but weaker detector. A complementary RMT analysis shows that correct generations exhibit more Wigner-Dyson like spectral statistics, whereas hallucinations exhibit more Poisson-like statistics. The anonymized code and config are provided in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自由能签名（Fes）作为谱描述符，用于大型语言模型幻觉检测。Fes将每层注意力拉普拉斯视为哈密顿量，提取配分函数、自由能、谱熵、热容以及随机矩阵理论谱形状因子。理论证明其Lipschitz稳定性、表达能力和PAC界。实验在6个开源LLM和6个基准上，基于Fes的轻量级探针平均AUROC比LapEig高6.5点，比GoR-4高2.4点，无监督RMT偏差分数平均AUROC为0.71。
Motivation: 现有基于注意力图拉普拉斯谱的幻觉检测方法仅使用少量特征值或手工标量，忽略了大部分谱结构。
Method: 将每一层的注意力拉普拉斯矩阵作为哈密顿量，计算其配分函数、自由能、谱熵、热容，并结合随机矩阵理论谱形状因子，构造自由能签名（Fes）。
Result: 跨6个开源LLM和6个基准，Fes轻量级探针实现平均AUROC提升：优于LapEig 6.5点，优于GoR-4 2.4点。无监督RMT偏差分数平均AUROC为0.71。
Conclusion: Fes描述符能更充分利用谱结构，无需更新LLM即可有效检测幻觉，且具有理论保证。

papers.title: VERITAS: Verifier-Guided Proof Search for Zero-Shot Formal Theorem Proving
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based formal provers often collapse rich verifier signals (syntax errors, type mismatches, partial goal progress) into a binary pass/fail bit. We present VERITAS, a zero-shot framework that routes every verifier signal back into proof search through a two-phase protocol: Best-of-N sampling first, then a critic-guided MCTS pass that ingests Phase 1 failures as explicit negative examples. The protocol preserves every theorem solved by its own Phase 1 sweep, so Phase 2's additional solves are attributable to feedback-driven exploration. VERITAS reaches 40.6% on miniF2F (vs. an independently run Best-of-5 at 36.9%, Portfolio 26.2%) and 7.3% on VERITAS-CombiBench, a 55-theorem combinatorics benchmark we release on which Best-of-5 (1.8%) falls below Portfolio (3.6%), exposing that unguided sampling hurts when correct lemma names must be recovered iteratively from verifier feedback. Artifacts are available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VERITAS，一种零样本形式化定理证明框架，利用验证器信号（语法错误、类型不匹配、部分目标进展）而非简单二进制反馈来指导证明搜索。采用两阶段协议：第一阶段 Best-of-N 采样，第二阶段批评引导的 MCTS，将第一阶段失败作为显式负例。在 miniF2F 上达到 40.6%（对比 Best-of-5 36.9%），在发布的 55 定理组合学基准 VERITAS-CombiBench 上达到 7.3%（Best-of-5 仅 1.8%），表明无指导采样在需要从验证器反馈中迭代恢复正确引理名称时表现不佳。
Motivation: 现有的基于 LLM 的形式化证明器通常将丰富的验证器信号（语法错误、类型不匹配、部分目标进展）简化为二进制通过/失败信号，未能充分利用中间反馈来指导搜索。
Method: 提出两阶段协议：第一阶段进行 Best-of-N 采样以快速生成候选证明；第二阶段使用批评引导的 MCTS，将第一阶段的失败作为显式负例，指导探索，同时保留第一阶段已解决的定理。
Result: 在 miniF2F 基准上达到 40.6%（对比独立运行 Best-of-5 的 36.9% 和 Portfolio 的 26.2%）；在自行发布的 55 定理组合学基准 VERITAS-CombiBench 上达到 7.3%（Best-of-5 仅 1.8%，Portfolio 为 3.6%），表明无指导采样在需要从验证器反馈中恢复正确引理名称时表现更差。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过保留第一阶段已解决的定理，第二阶段的额外求解可归因于反馈驱动的探索；同时发布的基准暴露了无指导采样的局限性，验证器反馈对于需要迭代恢复引理名称的任务至关重要。

papers.title: Human-AI Agent Interaction in a Business Context
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are increasingly integrated into core business processes, understanding and designing effective interaction patterns between humans and AI agents becomes crucial for value creation. This study identifies and evaluates principles and criteria for a positive User Experience (UX) with AI agents, along with methods for its measurement. We identify user expectations and needs to facilitate adoption, build trust, and support user-centered decision-making by development teams. Using a mixed-methods approach that combines qualitative and quantitative techniques, we explore interaction patterns between humans and AI agents. The findings from this exploratory research serve as the basis to develop a survey experiment which evaluates the effectiveness of specific design elements on a larger scale. This foundational research contributes to the development of more intuitive and effective human-AI agent interactions in business settings.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 tables, 1 figure, submitted to Springer Nature
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究通过混合方法识别和评估商业场景下人类与AI代理交互的用户体验原则和标准，旨在促进采用、建立信任并支持用户中心决策。
Motivation: 随着AI代理融入核心业务流程，需要理解并设计有效的人-AI交互模式以创造价值。
Method: 采用定性和定量结合的混合方法，探索交互模式，并基于发现开发大规模调查实验以评估设计元素有效性。
Result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但指出研究为更直观有效的人-AI代理交互奠定了基础。
Conclusion: 该探索性研究为商业环境中更直观有效的人-AI代理交互提供了基础贡献。

papers.title: Unified Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling with Shared Context-Visual Tokenizer is Key to Unification
papers.abstract_en: Unified Multimodal Modeling aims to integrate visual understanding and generation within a single system. However, existing approaches typically rely on two disparate visual tokenizers, which splits the representation space and hinders truly unified modeling. We propose UniAR, a unified autoregressive framework where a single discrete visual tokenizer serves as the key bridge between understanding and generation, enabling a shared context in which the model can directly interpret its own generated visual tokens without additional re-encoding. UniAR adapts a pretrained vision encoder with multi-level feature fusion and a lookup-free bitwise quantization scheme, preserving both high-level semantics and low-level details while scaling the effective visual vocabulary at minimal cost. Building on this, the unified autoregressive model adopts parallel-bitwise-prediction to jointly predict spatially grouped, multi-level visual codes, substantially reducing visual sequence length and accelerating generation. Finally, a diffusion-based visual decoder operates on discrete visual tokens to decode high-fidelity images. Through large-scale pre-training, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, UniAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on image generation and image editing while remaining competitive on multimodal understanding benchmarks. The project page is available at https://sharelab-sii.github.io/uniar-web.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniAR，一个统一的自回归框架，使用单一的离散视觉分词器作为理解和生成之间的桥梁，无需额外重新编码。通过多级特征融合、无查找逐位量化、并行逐位预测和扩散视觉解码器，在图像生成和编辑上达到最先进性能，同时在多模态理解基准上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有多模态建模方法通常依赖两个不同的视觉分词器，导致表示空间分裂，阻碍真正统一的建模。
Method: UniAR采用预训练视觉编码器结合多级特征融合和无查找逐位量化，使用并行逐位预测减少视觉序列长度，并通过扩散视觉解码器从离散视觉标记解码高保真图像。
Result: 通过大规模预训练、监督微调和强化学习，UniAR在图像生成和编辑任务上取得最先进性能，在多模态理解基准上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 共享上下文-视觉分词器是实现统一多模态自回归建模的关键，UniAR在理解和生成上均表现优异。

papers.title: DRFLOW: A Deep Research Benchmark for Personalized Workflow Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Deep research (DR) systems are increasingly used for complex information-seeking tasks, but existing works mainly focus on generating reports and summaries. In contrast, many enterprise tasks instead require an agent to identify concrete workflows which is a sequence of action-steps. For example, rather than summarizing budgeting policies, an agent should be able to determine the steps needed to answer a question such as: "How do I request new headcount given a fixed budget?". Therefore, we introduce DRFLOW, a benchmark for evaluating personalized workflows predicted by agents from heterogeneous sources. Each task requires the agent to identify relevant evidence from scattered sources, then use that evidence to predict the correct action-step sequence for the user's task. DRFLOW contains 100 tasks across five domains, with 1,246 reference workflow steps grounded in more than 3,900 sources. We define seven diagnostic metrics covering factual grounding, step recovery, structural ordering, condition resolution, and personalization. We further present DRFLOW-Agent (DRFA), a workflow-oriented reference agent to predict personalized workflow. We show that although DRFA improves over strong baseline agents (upto 10.02% average F1 score), there is substantial room for improvement remains across these workflow metrics, indicating that predicting complete and correct personalized workflows remains a challenging frontier for deep research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRFLOW 是一个评估智能体从异构来源预测个性化工作流（action-step 序列）的基准。包含 100 个跨五个领域的任务、1246 个参考步骤和超过 3900 个来源。作者提出 DRFA 智能体，在 F1 上最高提升 10.02%，但预测完整正确的工作流仍具挑战。
Motivation: 现有深度研究系统主要生成报告和摘要，而企业任务需要智能体识别具体工作流（如确定预算下申请新人员的步骤），但目前缺乏相应的评估基准。
Method: 构建 DRFLOW 基准，包含七个诊断指标（事实基础、步骤恢复、结构顺序、条件解析、个性化等）。提出工作流导向的参考智能体 DRFLOW-Agent (DRFA)。
Result: DRFA 在强基线模型上平均 F1 最高提升 10.02%，但所有指标上仍有显著改进空间，表明预测完整且正确的个性化工作流仍是困难问题。
Conclusion: DRFLOW 揭示了现有深度研究系统在工作流预测方面的不足，并指出这一任务具备挑战性，需要进一步研究。

papers.title: Kernel-Based Functional Balancing for Causal Inference with Compositional Treatments
papers.abstract_en: We study causal effect estimation with compositional treatments, where the exposure lies on a simplex and the estimand is defined over compositions rather than scalar or binary values. By considering a projection of the average potential outcome onto the treatment space, a kernel-based covariate functional balancing approach is adopted for weight construction. The weights are obtained by directly minimizing a worst-case balancing error over a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) defined on the joint space of treatments and covariates, instead of being estimated under a treatment assignment model. Building on these weights, an augmented weighted estimator (AWE) is proposed, where the outcome function is estimated via kernel ridge regression and combined with a marginal augmentation over the covariate distribution. Despite the complex structure of the resulting objective, a finite-dimensional convex optimization problem is formulated via a representer theorem and a low-rank approximation. The proposed estimator achieves $\sqrt{n}$-consistency without requiring consistent estimation or smoothness of the weights. An asymptotic normality result is established around a sample-specific target. Empirical performance is demonstrated through simulation studies and a real data application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对成分处理（compositional treatments）下的因果效应估计问题，提出一种基于核的协变量函数平衡方法，通过最小化在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）上的最坏情况平衡误差来构造权重，并进一步提出增广加权估计量（AWE）。理论证明了√n一致性和渐近正态性，模拟和真实数据验证了性能。
Motivation: 现有因果推断方法多针对标量或二元处理，而成分处理（如资源分配比例）的效应估计尚缺乏有效方法。
Method: 采用核方法将处理与协变量的联合空间映射到RKHS，直接最小化最坏情况平衡误差得到权重；结合核岭回归估计结果函数，并通过边际增广得到增广加权估计量（AWE）。通过表示定理和低秩近似将问题转化为有限维凸优化。
Result: 摘要声称估计量达到√n一致性，且无需权重的一致估计或光滑性；建立了关于样本特定目标的渐近正态性；模拟和真实数据应用验证了方法有效性。
Conclusion: 论文提出的核函数平衡方法为成分处理下的因果推断提供了理论保障和实用算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoCA-Agent: A Market-of-Claims Code Agent for Financial and Numerical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Financial and tabular question answering requires more than fluent reasoning: answers must be grounded in the exact facts, formulas, units, signs, and scales that support them. A single misread cell or incorrect operation can silently produce a plausible but wrong result. We introduce \textsc{MOCA-Agent}, a market-of-claims code agent that replaces free-form multi-agent debate with claim-level verification. The system decomposes each question into typed atomic claims, asks specialist trader agents to buy or sell those claims, clears their orders into confidence-weighted accept/reject decisions, and synthesizes an executable Python program from market-supported evidence. A code-aware verifier then checks the program for execution, structural consistency, and common financial reasoning errors, with at most one market-aware repair round. Across ten public benchmarks spanning financial numerical reasoning, general tabular reasoning, ESG question answering, and multimodal chart reasoning, \textsc{MOCA-Agent} achieves strong performance using a fixed Qwen3.6-27B backbone, including $78.3\%$ on FinQA, $76.0\%$ on FinanceMath, $71.2\%$ on MultiHiertt, $86.9\%$ on ESGenius, and $85.6\%$ average on FinChart-Bench. These results show that aggregating evidence at the level of atomic claims, rather than whole answers, improves robustness in high-stakes numerical reasoning.\footnote{The code and data are available: https://github.com/UBC-NLP/MoCA-Agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoCA-Agent，一种基于主张市场（market-of-claims）的代码智能体，用于金融和数值推理。系统将问题分解为原子主张，由专业交易者智能体买卖这些主张，根据市场支持的证据生成可执行 Python 程序，并经过代码感知验证和至多一轮市场感知修复。在十个公开基准上，使用固定 Qwen3.6-27B 骨干网络取得强性能，包括 FinQA 78.3%、FinanceMath 76.0%、MultiHiertt 71.2%、ESGenius 86.9%、FinChart-Bench 平均 85.6%。结果表明在原子主张层面聚合证据比整体答案更鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有方法在金融和表格问答中易因单细胞误读或运算错误产生看似合理但错误的结果，需要更细粒度的验证机制。
Method: 将问题分解为类型化原子主张，通过多智能体市场机制进行买卖和清算，生成置信度加权的接受/拒绝决策，最终合成可执行 Python 程序，并配合代码感知验证器检查执行和结构一致性。
Result: 在十个基准上取得强性能，如 FinQA 78.3%、FinanceMath 76.0%、MultiHiertt 71.2%、ESGenius 86.9%、FinChart-Bench 平均 85.6%。
Conclusion: 在原子主张层面聚合证据可提升高风险数值推理的鲁棒性，且方法具有可扩展性。

papers.title: KG-SoftMAP: Soft Knowledge-Graph Priors for Bayesian Network Structure Learning from Sparse Discrete Data
papers.abstract_en: Learning Bayesian network (BN) structure from sparse discrete data is hard: when each instance records only a few variables, most variable pairs lack the joint observations needed for reliable scoring, and data-only methods recover little structure. However, imperfect domain knowledge, expressible as a weighted directed knowledge graph (KG), is often available. We propose KG-SoftMAP, which encodes such a KG as a finite-strength, confidence-weighted edge prior and maximizes a MAP objective combining the BDeu score with a logit-form prior; the KG may be expert-curated or LLM-extracted. On synthetic benchmarks with known DAGs, KG-SoftMAP reaches Directed-F1 (DF1) $0.19$--$0.32$ at observation rate $ρ=0.05$ and DF1 $0.44$--$0.97$ at $ρ\geq0.2$, while every data-only learner tested stays near zero under the same sparse masks. Recovery tracks KG quality: controlled corruption degrades it smoothly, a zero-signal KG yields DF1 $0.00$, and a blindly LLM-extracted KG with imperfect precision and recall still drives substantial recovery. On three real sparse educational datasets, the learned BN acts as a concept-level posterior model: on SAF it matches logistic regression (LR) within $0.03$ F1_FAIL while providing an inspectable concept graph, calibrated Fail probabilities, and tractable posterior queries from partial observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KG-SoftMAP，一种从稀疏离散数据中学习贝叶斯网络结构的方法，通过将专家或大语言模型提取的知识图谱编码为有限强度的边先验，并结合 BDeu 评分和 logit 形式先验最大化 MAP 目标。在合成基准上，当观测率 ρ=0.05 时 Directed-F1 达到 0.19–0.32，ρ≥0.2 时达到 0.44–0.97，而所有纯数据驱动方法在相同稀疏掩码下几乎为零；在三个真实稀疏教育数据集上，学习到的网络可作为概念级后验模型，在 SAF 数据集上 F1_FAIL 与逻辑回归相差 0.03 以内，同时提供可检查的概念图和校准的失败概率。
Motivation: 从稀疏离散数据中学习贝叶斯网络结构时，数据驱动方法因缺乏联合观测而几乎无法恢复结构，而现成的领域知识（如加权知识图谱）往往被忽略。
Method: KG-SoftMAP 将知识图谱作为有限强度的置信加权边先验，通过最大化结合 BDeu 评分和 logit 形式先验的 MAP 目标来学习网络结构，知识图谱可由专家或大语言模型提取。
Result: 在合成基准上，KG-SoftMAP 在 ρ=0.05 时 DF1 达 0.19–0.32，ρ≥0.2 时达 0.44–0.97，而纯数据方法几乎为零；知识图谱质量影响恢复效果，零信号图谱 DF1=0.00，不完美的 LLM 提取图谱仍能驱动显著恢复；在三个真实教育数据集上，学习到的 BN 在 SAF 数据集上 F1_FAIL 与逻辑回归相差 0.03 以内。
Conclusion: KG-SoftMAP 能有效利用不完美的知识图谱从稀疏数据中恢复贝叶斯网络结构，尤其适用于数据稀疏但领域知识可得的场景，如教育评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Streaming Interventions: Can Video Large Language Models Correct Mistakes as They Occur?
papers.abstract_en: Learning everyday skills, like cooking a dish, relies increasingly on instructional media such as online videos. This opens the door to the use of video (and multimodal) large language models (LLMs) as task guidance assistants. A crucial capability for the real-world success of a prospective task guidance assistant is it's ability to intervene proactively as soon as a mistake is apparent in order to guide the user. To evaluate this crucial capability, we introduce Ego-MC-Bench (Mistake Corrections), a benchmark for evaluating reactive, step-by-step task guidance in realistic cooking scenarios. Extensive experiments show that Ego-MC-Bench is highly challenging for state-of-the-art video LLMs. We argue that a key reason is the limited availability of training data for fine-tuning models on this task. Although there exists a wide range of cooking video datasets, existing datasets lack examples of mistakes along with appropriately timed interventions. To help address this data limitation, we also introduce Ego-CoMist, a counterfactual synthetic dataset created by transforming non -interactive cooking videos into supervised training examples showing proactive interventions. We show that fine-tuning on Ego-CoMist yields performance gains especially for smaller and more efficient video LLMs that are well suited for delivering assistance on edge devices.
papers.comment: The project page is available at https://apratimbh.github.io/livecookv2/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频大语言模型在实际任务指导中的主动错误干预能力，提出了Ego-MC-Bench基准和Ego-CoMist合成数据集。实验表明现有视频LLM在该基准上表现不佳，而通过在合成数据上微调，尤其是小型高效模型，性能有所提升。
Motivation: 视频LLM作为任务指导助手需要能够主动干预用户错误，但缺乏评估该能力的基准和训练数据。现有烹饪视频数据集缺少错误及其及时干预的示例。
Method: 构建Ego-MC-Bench基准评估视频LLM在烹饪场景中的反应式逐步任务指导能力；同时提出Ego-CoMist，通过反事实合成将非互动烹饪视频转化为带有主动干预的监督训练样本。
Result: Ego-MC-Bench对先进视频LLM极具挑战性；在Ego-CoMist上微调后，小型高效视频LLM（适合边缘设备）获得了性能提升。
Conclusion: 主动干预能力是任务指导助手的关键，而合成数据可以缓解训练数据缺乏的问题，尤其对边缘设备上的轻量模型有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffuse AI Control on Fuzzy Tasks
papers.abstract_en: AI models deployed in critical domains, such as AI safety research, may subtly sabotage our efforts due to misalignment. Diffuse AI Control is a subfield of AI safety concerned with mitigating risks from AI sabotage distributed over long deployment horizons (diffuse threats). These risks are particularly pernicious on fuzzy tasks, i.e. tasks which are hard to grade or require intuition. To understand diffuse threats on fuzzy tasks, we introduce a framework that considers AI control as an adversarial game between a blue team and a red team. The blue team uses a weak trusted model to construct a weak score against which they would train a strong, potentially subversive model to remove the subversion propensity if it were present. The red team then tries to find model behaviors that are rated highly by the weak score, and thus might not be trained out, but actually correspond to poor performance. We test our framework on the task of writing experimental proposals for research questions from recent ML papers. We use a language model with access to the original paper as a proxy "ground-truth" scorer. Our red team discovers subversive behaviors using multi-objective evolutionary prompt optimization. We show that Opus~4.6 can write proposals that are worse according to the ground truth proxy than those of GPT-OSS-20B, while the weak scorer rates them as highly as the best proposals from Opus 4.6. We then propose an adversarial optimization algorithm for the blue team that discovers more robust prompts for the weak model. This algorithm produces a blue team prompt that our red team optimization fails to exploit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对模糊任务（fuzzy tasks）上的扩散AI控制（diffuse AI control）的框架，将AI控制建模为蓝队与红队之间的对抗博弈。蓝队使用弱信任模型构建弱评分，训练强模型消除潜在的颠覆倾向；红队则通过多目标进化提示优化寻找被弱评分高估但实际表现差的行为。在ML论文实验提案任务上，Opus 4.6生成的提案被弱评分器高估，但实际质量低于GPT-OSS-20B；蓝队通过对抗优化算法得到更鲁棒的提示，使红队无法利用。
Motivation: AI模型在关键领域可能因 misalignment 而长期、隐蔽地破坏人类努力（扩散威胁），尤其在难以评分或需要直觉的模糊任务上风险突出。
Method: 将AI控制视为蓝队（使用弱信任模型构建弱评分，训练强模型消除颠覆倾向）与红队（使用多目标进化提示优化寻找被弱评分高估但实际差的行为）之间的对抗博弈。
Result: 在实验提案任务中，Opus 4.6能写出比GPT-OSS-20B更差的提案，但弱评分器给予其与最佳提案同样高的评分；蓝队的对抗优化算法生成的提示使红队优化无法成功利用。

papers.title: The ACUTE Protocol: Operationalizing Language Model Activations for Better Calibration, Utility, and Trust
papers.abstract_en: As language models improve and become increasingly deployed to solve a variety of tasks, trustworthiness becomes essential. Calibration is a good proxy for trust: well-calibrated confidence estimates help inform the risk versus reward tradeoff when trusting a specific model output. Unfortunately, even as models improve, they remain poorly calibrated, often biasing towards overconfidence. Additionally, calibration can be gamed: a policy that always predicts the base rate is perfectly calibrated, but completely uninformative. To resolve this, we develop a new metric, expected utility renormalized by the oracle (EURO), that balances calibration and informativeness. We also propose a general-purpose activation-based confidence, utility, and trust estimation protocol (ACUTE) to appropriately adjudicate uncertainty. The ACUTE protocol provides flexible, sample-efficient, and compute-efficient confidence estimators for 3 tasks including multiple choice question answering, tool-calling, and scientific document summarization across 6 models from 4 model families. ACUTE outperforms strong baselines on EURO, while maintaining low calibration error. Taken together, our work shows that equipping LLMs with the ACUTE protocol can improve calibration, utility, and trustworthiness in numerous settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACUTE协议，通过利用语言模型激活来估计置信度、效用和信任度，并引入新指标EURO平衡校准与信息量。在多项选择问答、工具调用和科学文档摘要等任务上，ACUTE优于强基线，同时保持低校准误差。
Motivation: 现有语言模型校准不佳且易被操纵（如预测基率可完美校准但无信息），需要一种既能反映校准又能反映信息量的方法。
Method: 提出基于激活的置信度、效用和信任估计协议（ACUTE），以及新度量EURO（期望效用经Oracle重归一化）。
Result: 在6个模型（4个模型族）的3项任务上，ACUTE在EURO指标上优于强基线，且校准误差低。
Conclusion: ACUTE协议可提升LLM在多种设置下的校准、效用和信任度。

papers.title: Target-Side Paraphrase Augmentation for Sign Language Translation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Sign language translation (SLT) remains constrained by the limited availability of paired sign-video/text corpora and by the heavy-tailed vocabularies typical of real-world datasets. We study a target-side augmentation strategy in which a large language model (LLM) generates controlled paraphrase variants of the reference spoken-language sentence while the sign input remains unchanged. Concretely, we use GPT-4o to produce semantically faithful variants of the training targets and train a Signformer-style pose-based Transformer under a two-stage schedule: pre-training on the augmented corpus followed by fine-tuning on the original references. We evaluate this strategy on three datasets that span complementary challenges: PHOENIX14T (German Sign Language), a real-world corpus with moderate lexical diversity; the Greek Sign Language Dataset with highly controlled, repetitive recordings; and LSA-T (Argentinian Sign Language), a naturalistic corpus with a large vocabulary and severe long-tail sparsity. This range allows us to characterize precisely when and why target-side augmentation is beneficial. On PHOENIX14T, augmentation improves BLEU-4 from 9.56 to 10.33, demonstrating that paraphrastic exposure helps the decoder generalize beyond memorized reference phrasing. The near-saturated GSL baseline and the extremely sparse LSA-T setting reveal the limits of the approach: in both cases, single-reference lexical overlap metrics are insufficient to capture the full picture, motivating a complementary semantic evaluation. To our knowledge, this is the first study to examine LLM-generated target-side paraphrases as an augmentation mechanism for SLT, and the first to apply an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation protocol to SLT. This complementary evaluation reveals gains in semantic fidelity that lexical overlap metrics understate.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在大语言模型（GPT-4o）辅助下，对目标端口语语句进行受控释义增广，以缓解手语翻译中平行语料稀缺和词汇长尾分布问题。在三个不同特点的数据集上评估，结果表明该策略在中等词汇多样性的PHOENIX14T上提升BLEU-4（9.56→10.33），但在近饱和或极度稀疏场景下词汇重叠指标不足以捕捉语义增益，需辅以语义评估。
Motivation: 手语翻译受限于配对视频-文本数据稀缺和真实数据集的词汇长尾分布，现有方法难以泛化到未见过的表达。
Method: 使用LLM（GPT-4o）生成参考句的语义忠实释义变体，保持手语输入不变，采用两阶段训练：先在增广语料上预训练，再在原始参考句上微调。模型为基于姿态的Signformer风格Transformer。
Result: 在PHOENIX14T上BLEU-4从9.56提升至10.33；在希腊手语数据集（近饱和）和LSA-T（极度稀疏）上词汇重叠指标提升有限，但LLM-as-a-Judge评估显示语义忠实度有增益。
Conclusion: 目标端释义增广在中等词汇多样性场景有效，但在近饱和或极度稀疏场景下需结合语义评估；这是首次将LLM生成的释义和LLM-as-a-Judge用于手语翻译。

papers.title: Superhuman Safe and Agile Racing through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems have achieved superhuman performance in isolation or simulation, yet they remain brittle in shared, dynamic real-world spaces. This failure stems from the dominant single-agent paradigm for physical applications, where other actors are ignored or treated as environmental noise, preventing effective coordination. Here we show that multi-agent reinforcement learning provides the essential safety scaffolding required for real-world interaction. Using high-speed quadrotor racing as a high-stakes testbed, we train agents to navigate complex aerodynamic interactions and strategic maneuvering with a variable number of racers. Through league-based self-play, agents evolve sophisticated anticipatory behaviors, including proactive collision avoidance, overtaking, and handling multi-agent physical interactions, including aerodynamic downwash. Our agents outperform a champion-level human pilot in multi-player races at speeds exceeding 22 m/s, while simultaneously reducing collision rates by 50 % compared to state-of-the-art single-agent baselines. Crucially, training with diverse artificial agents enables zero-shot generalization to safer human interaction. These results suggest that the path to robust robotic co-existence lies not in isolated safety constraints, but in the rigorous demands of multi-agent interaction. Multimedia materials are available at: https://rpg.ifi.uzh.ch/marl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）训练高速四旋翼赛车无人机，在超过22 m/s的速度下与人类冠军飞行员比赛，实现了超人的性能和安全性，碰撞率比单智能体基线降低50%，并零样本泛化到安全的人机交互。
Motivation: 当前自主系统在隔离或仿真中表现超人，但在共享动态真实环境中脆弱，因为单智能体范式忽略其他参与者，导致缺乏协调。
Method: 使用多智能体强化学习，以高速四旋翼赛车为测试平台，通过联赛自对弈训练智能体处理复杂空气动力学交互和策略机动，包括主动避碰、超车和多智能体物理交互（如空气动力学下洗流）。
Result: 在多人比赛中超越人类冠军飞行员（速度>22 m/s），碰撞率比最先进的单智能体基线降低50%，且通过对多样化人工智能体的训练零样本泛化到安全的人类交互。
Conclusion: 该结果表明，实现鲁棒的机器人共存路径不在于孤立的 safety constraints，而在于多智能体交互的严格要求。

papers.title: Pseudo-Formalization for Automatic Proof Verification
papers.abstract_en: Reliable verification of proofs remains a bottleneck for training and evaluating AI systems on hard mathematical reasoning. Fully formal proofs, in languages like Lean, are easy to verify because they are unambiguous and modular. Most proofs, particularly those written by AI systems, have neither property, and translating them into formal languages remains challenging in many frontier math settings. We propose Pseudo-Formalization (PF), a proof format that captures the modularity and precision of formal proofs while retaining the flexibility of natural language. A Pseudo-Formal proof is decomposed into self-contained modules, each stating its premises, conclusion, and proof in natural language. To verify the correctness of a regular natural language proof, an LLM translates it to Pseudo-Formal and then verifies each module independently, an algorithm we call Block Verification (BV). We evaluate PF+BV on two benchmarks spanning olympiad and research-level mathematics, where it pareto-dominates LLM-as-judge baselines on error-finding precision and recall. To support future work, we release our research-level proof verification benchmark ArxivMathGradingBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出伪形式化（Pseudo-Formalization）格式，将自然语言证明分解为自包含模块，每个模块明确前提、结论和证明；结合块验证（Block Verification）算法，让LLM将自然语言证明翻译为Pseudo-Formal后独立验证各模块。在奥林匹克和研究级数学基准上，该方法在错误发现精度和召回率上帕累托优于LLM-as-judge基线。
Motivation: 完全形式化证明（如Lean）难以生成，尤其在前沿数学领域；自然语言证明缺乏模块化和精确性，自动验证困难。
Method: 提出Pseudo-Formal（PF）格式，要求将自然语言证明分解为自包含模块，每个模块用自然语言陈述前提、结论和子证明；设计块验证（Block Verification）算法，先由LLM将自然语言证明翻译为PF，再独立验证每个模块的正确性。
Result: 在奥林匹克级和研究级数学基准上，PF+BV在错误发现精度和召回率上同时优于LLM-as-judge基线，实现帕累托支配。
Conclusion: 伪形式化结合块验证为自动证明验证提供了有效范式，同时发布了研究级证明验证基准ArxivMathGradingBench以支持后续研究。

papers.title: CogniFold: Always-On Proactive Memory via Cognitive Folding
papers.abstract_en: Existing agent memory remains predominantly reactive and retrieval-based, lacking the capacity to autonomously organize experience into persistent cognitive structure. Toward genuinely autonomous agents, we introduce CogniFold, a brain-inspired "always-on" agent memory designed for the next generation of proactive assistants. CogniFold continuously folds fragmented event streams into self-emerging cognitive structures, bootstrapping progressively higher-level cognition from incoming events and accumulated knowledge. We ground this by extending Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory from two layers (hippocampus, neocortex) to three, adding a prefrontal intent layer. Emulating the prefrontal cortex as the locus of intentional control and decision-making, CogniFold achieves this through graph-topology self-organization: cognitive structures proactively assemble under the stream, merge when semantically similar, decay when stale, relink through associative recall, and surface intents when concept-cluster density crosses a threshold. We evaluate structural formation using CogEval-Bench, demonstrating that CogniFold uniquely produces memory structures that match cognitive expectations and concept emergence. Furthermore, across eight downstream benchmarks -- two probing long-term conversational memory (LoCoMo, LongMemEval) and six spanning other cognitive domains -- we validate that CogniFold simultaneously performs robustly on conventional memory tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenNorve/CogniFold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CogniFold，一种受大脑启发的“始终在线”的智能体记忆系统，通过将碎片化事件流持续折叠为自涌现的认知结构。作者将互补学习系统（CLS）理论从两层（海马体、新皮层）扩展到三层，增加前额叶意图层，并通过图拓扑自组织实现认知结构的主动组装、合并、衰减、关联回忆和意图涌现。在CogEval-Bench上验证了结构形成符合认知期望，并在LoCoMo、LongMemEval等八个下游基准上表现稳健。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆以被动检索为主，缺乏自主组织经验为持久认知结构的能力，限制了真正自主智能体的发展。
Method: 基于CLS理论增加前额叶意图层，通过图拓扑自组织：认知结构在事件流中主动组装，语义相似时合并，过时后衰减，通过关联回忆重连，概念簇密度超过阈值时涌现意图。
Result: 在CogEval-Bench上展示了符合认知期望的结构形成和概念涌现；在LoCoMo、LongMemEval等八个下游基准上同时取得稳健性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为CogniFold是迈向真正自主智能体的重要一步，并开源代码。

papers.title: Minimal Filling Architectures of Polynomial Neural Networks: Counterexamples, Frontier Search, and Defects
papers.abstract_en: We provide counterexamples to the unimodal minimal filling architecture conjecture for polynomial neural networks (PNNs) with power activation functions. Fixing the input and output widths, the conjecture states that any minimal filling architecture has unimodal widths for the hidden layers. We found counterexamples via a frontier search, recursive dimension bounds on neurovarieties, and symbolic computation. Notably, several subarchitectures of our main example exhibit large defect, in contrast with the predominantly small-defect behavior observed in prior literature.

papers.title: Approximate Next Policy Sampling: Replacing Conservative Target Policy Updates in Deep RL
papers.abstract_en: We revisit a classic "chicken-and-egg" problem in reinforcement learning: to safely improve a policy, the value function must be accurate on the state-visitation distribution of the updated policy. That distribution over states is unknown and cannot be sampled for the purposes of training the value function. Conservative updates solve this problem, but at the cost of shrinking the policy update. This paper explores an alternative solution, Approximate Next Policy Sampling (ANPS), which addresses the problem by modifying the training distribution rather than constraining the policy update. ANPS is satisfied if the distribution of the training data approximates that of the next policy. To demonstrate the feasibility and efficacy of ANPS, we introduce Stable Value Approximate Policy Iteration (SV-API). SV-API modifies the standard approximate policy iteration loop to hold the target policy fixed while an iteratively updated behavioral policy gathers relevant experience. It only commits to a new policy once a convergence criterion has been met. If certain stability criteria are met, the update is guaranteed to be safe; otherwise, it remains no less safe than standard approximate policy iteration. Applying SV-API to PPO yields Stable Value PPO (SV-PPO), which matches or improves performance on high-dimensional discrete (Atari) and continuous control benchmarks while executing substantially larger target policy updates. These results demonstrate the viability of ANPS as a new solution to this classic challenge in RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中策略改进与价值函数准确性的“鸡生蛋”问题，提出近似下一策略采样（ANPS）方法，通过修改训练分布而非约束策略更新来解决。作者引入稳定价值近似策略迭代（SV-API）框架，并应用于PPO得到SV-PPO，在Atari和连续控制任务上匹配或超越PPO性能，且允许更大的目标策略更新。
Motivation: 经典强化学习中，安全改进策略需要价值函数在新策略的状态访问分布上准确，但该分布未知且无法采样。保守更新虽可解决但缩小了策略更新幅度。
Method: 提出近似下一策略采样（ANPS），通过修改训练分布使其近似于下一策略的分布，而非约束策略更新。具体实现为稳定价值近似策略迭代（SV-API），该框架固定目标策略，同时使用迭代更新的行为策略收集相关经验，在收敛后才提交新策略。
Result: 将SV-API应用于PPO得到SV-PPO，在高维离散（Atari）和连续控制基准测试中匹配或改进了性能，同时执行了更大规模的目标策略更新。
Conclusion: 摘要表明ANPS为解决强化学习中策略改进的安全性问题提供了新方案，且SV-PPO的实验结果证明了其可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Too long; didn't solve
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical benchmarks consisting of a range of mathematics problems are widely used to evaluate the reasoning abilities of large language models, yet little is known about how their structural properties influence model behaviour. In this work, we investigate two structural length variables, prompt length and solution length, and analyse how they relate to model performance on a newly constructed adversarial dataset of expert-authored mathematics problems. We find that both prompt and solution lengths correlate positively with increased model failure across models. We also include a secondary, exploratory analysis of cross-model disagreement. Under a difficulty-adjusted normalised analysis, both variables retain weak negative associations with realised model separation, slightly stronger for prompt length. Overall, our main robust finding is that structural length is linked to empirical difficulty in this dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究数学基准中提示长度和解答长度对LLM推理性能的影响，发现两者与模型失败正相关，且结构长度与经验难度相关。
Motivation: 数学基准广泛用于评估LLM推理能力，但其结构性质如何影响模型行为知之甚少。
Method: 构造对抗性数学问题数据集，分析提示长度和解答长度与模型性能的关系，并进行跨模型不一致性探索分析。
Result: 提示长度和解答长度均与模型失败正相关；在难度调整后，两者仍与模型分化有弱负关联，提示长度关联稍强。
Conclusion: 结构长度与经验难度存在稳健关联，是主要发现。

papers.title: CareTransition-Audit: A Benchmark to Audit Discharge Summaries for Efficient Care Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Incomplete or inconsistent discharge documentation drives care fragmentation and avoidable readmissions. Despite its critical role in patient safety, auditing discharge summaries relies on manual review and does not scale. We propose an automated framework for auditing discharge summaries using large language models (LLMs). Our approach operationalizes the DISCHARGED framework into a checklist of 46 questions. Using 50 summaries from the MIMIC-IV database, with clinician ground-truth labels, we benchmark 11 LLMs. Model-assessed mean documentation completeness ranges from 54.9% to 74.2%, and the best-performing models achieve a Cohen's kappa values around 0.5 against clinician labels, indicating moderate agreement. All models struggle to identify ambiguous documentation (Unclear), highlighting a key gap in current automated auditing. This work provides a clinician-validated benchmark and zero-shot baselines for systematic quality improvement in clinical documentation.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at IEEE-ICHI 2026; Accepted at SD4H@ICML
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个自动化审计出院总结的基准CareTransition-Audit，利用大语言模型（LLMs）将DISCHARGED框架操作化为46个问题的清单，在50份来自MIMIC-IV的总结上评测了11个LLM。模型评估的文档完整性平均为54.9%至74.2%，最佳模型与临床医生标签的Cohen's kappa值约为0.5（中度一致），所有模型在识别模糊文档（Unclear）方面表现不佳。
Motivation: 不完整或不一致的出院文档导致护理碎片化和可避免的再入院，但审计出院总结依赖人工审查且不可扩展。
Method: 提出基于大语言模型的自动化审计框架，将DISCHARGED框架转化为46个问题的清单，并利用MIMIC-IV数据库的50份总结和临床医生标注的真实标签进行评测。
Result: 模型评估的文档完整性均值在54.9%至74.2%之间，最佳模型与临床医生的Cohen's kappa约0.5，所有模型在识别模糊文档方面表现不佳。
Conclusion: 本工作提供了一个临床验证的基准和零样本基线，用于临床文档的系统性质量改进，并指出现有自动审计在识别模糊文档方面的关键缺口。
